description: A thin layer of steel hides a core made of pure Jade, blessed by the Empress to help ward off evil. In Wuji, Jade symbolizes eternity and immortality. To the Isles, it represents hope and unity.

name: Brandished Noble Amethyst Katana
description: Each of the Yokai Isles’ Noble Houses passes a blessed blade from one family head to the next. It must be periodically purified at a shrine to keep evil spirits from possessing the heirloom.

name: Brandished Ruby Kitsune Katana
description: Weapons gifted from Yokai for the express purpose of hunting others of their kind are inherently cursed. The shrines of the Yokai Isles see many visitors seeking purification rituals.

name: Brawler Dagger
description: This dagger is usually used by rogues and thugs. It has metal spikes that cover the fist like brass knuckles. The dagger is held backwards to conceal the blade.

name: Breathtaking Love Chalices
description: As potent as the kiss of a first love.

name: Brentan's Dual Berry Mugs
description: When one mug just isn't enough!

name: Bright Astravian Rapiers
description: This isn't steel or iron. The synthetic material created with Astravia's now forbidden technology can't be forged by any other means, even magical. It's said to never rust, or melt in lava.

name: Bright Blades of Protection
description: Sworn to protect and serve, the Celestial Templar Guardians will defend any who seek refuge from the terrors that lurk in the Shadows.

name: Bright Blades of the Light
description: Your journey for Good and the Light begins here!

name: Bright Daggers of Destiny
description: The rebuilding process of your empire starts here.

name: Bright DragonKnight Accoutrements
description: The Bright Dragon Knights of Swordhaven are an elite squad of warriors. Wielding light magic is a bonus, but not required to join.

name: Bright Faerie's Claymores
description: Over hill, over dale, thorough bush, thorough brier, over park and pale, through flood, through fire, the Faerie Queen's knights wander everywhere. Their quest? To bring her Summer's jewels to enchant and dazzle mortal fools.

name: Bright Faerie's Scythes
description: Over hill, over dale, thorough bush, thorough brier, over park and pale, through flood, through fire, the Faerie Queen's knights wander everywhere. Their quest? To bring her Summer's jewels to enchant and dazzle mortal fools.

name: Bright Flames

name: Bright Guardian's Axes
description: The white and gold regalia of the Bright Celestial Guardian is a mark of distinction for its bearer, signaling their supreme skill.

name: Bright Officer's Kunais
description: Whether you are a Paladin, Litch, BeastHunter, or Void HighLord… whatever class, role, or alignment you choose, it's important to take time to celebrate the holidays with your family and friends.

name: Brightfall Captain's Armaments (0 AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: Brightfall Captain's Armaments (AC)
description: Death, the great equalizer. Everyone will meet the reaper one day. The heroes of Brightfall face their own mortality, noble and brave. If they must, they will bring honorable death to when there are no other options.

name: BrightSteel Conquest Accoutrements
description: Spear in one hand, sword in the other. No need for a shield when you only in attack mode.

name: BrightSteel Spear and Shield
description: Attack from long range and defend when they get too close.

name: Brightwind Athame
description: Grovebreak-ians are all out about recycled materials; this beauty was handcrafted from the souls of fallen fiends!

name: Brikebeiner Ice Claymores
description: Birkebeiner was an ice dragon that was said to have crawled out of the Underworld. It was hungry for Kings but a dragonlord defeated it in combat, and urged it to travel to the Northlands with them in search of better prey.

description: Birkebeiner was an ice dragon that was said to have crawled out of the Underworld. It was hungry for Kings but a dragonlord defeated it in combat, and urged it to travel to the Northlands with them in search of better prey.

name: Brilliant Swords of Cosmic Fate
description: Forged with the magical energy from the star you were born under. Cosmic dust coalesced into magnificent steel. The shape of your heart and destiny is a righteous sword.

name: Broad Moglow Blades

name: Brush and Shield
description: Your enemies will fall to a rainbow of color! Though only the color of red will paint the battlefield!

name: Brutal Axes of the Archfiend
description: Crafted by fiendish weaponsmiths chained to infernal forges, these axes were crafted in honor of Nulgath the ArchFiend. Only the strongest members of his Nation are worthy of wielding them.

name: Brutal Battle Blades
description: This sword is gifted to the most promising heroes who train in Oaklore Keep. Somehow, this Frogzard ended up with TWO of them?! O_O

name: Brutal Bone Daggers

name: Brutal Dagger
description: It ain't pretty… but it's effective.

name: Brute Cutters
description: These are the types of daggers used for Horc Honor Comabt.

description: If she gets scratchy just find Verlyrus.

name: Burgle Bags
description: It fits in the palm of your hand but can contain a whole household full of stolen goods. It's the expert thief's version of a hero's bag of holding.

name: Burning Lights Of Destruction

description: The heart of the flame burns brightest in those mages willing to sacrifice everything for their power.

description: The white tiger has long been recognized as the true "king of the beasts." He is most honorable and worthy of your worship. If you serve him with a pure heart and absolute virtue, you will be rewarded.

name: Cakra Baskara

name: Candy Dagger
description: These daggers will deliver three layers of PAIN!!!

name: CandyCorn Daggers
description: You'll have a cornucopia of adventures with these daggers! Aw… That was a corny pun.

name: CandyCorn Mini Plushies
description: This sweet set is made of one of Oishii's tastiest harvest treats — CANDY CORN! /Equip it at your own risk, the chances of monsters eating you will increase by 100% if worn in battle.

name: CandyCorn Pumpkin + Broom
description: This sweet set is made of one of Oishii's tastiest harvest treats — CANDY CORN! /Equip it at your own risk, the chances of monsters eating you will increase by 100% if worn in battle.

name: Candycorn Swords
description: This sweet treat might look corny, but you can make your enemies eat dirt if you wield it well.

name: Cangaceiro's Dual Peixeira
description: Determinação. Fidelidade. Dignidade. Justiça.

name: Captain's Cutlass of Boom
description: Jumpin' whales and sailfish, would ya lookit that? This here, me mateys, is a gun and cutlass fit for the best pirate. Give yer regards to Blackbeard as you send more scalliwags down to depths with this weapon. Lords of the high seas, this is treasure.

name: Captain's Hook
description: A favorite amongst those who have lent a helping hand. Also comes in handy when fishing without tackle.

name: Captain's Shield
description: You are Lore's greatest defender!

name: CardBlades
description: You recieved the Color Custom CardBlades from your purchase of the AQW Battle Card Game. You can use this blades to surgically remove the Heart of the Cards. Matches your Eye color.

name: Cardboard Swords of Oblivion
description: It may not be the real thing, but it'll do when you Battle paper mache Sneevils in their Box town.

name: Cardinal Knuckle Cutter
description: Grip these tightly and take them for a spin. Lashing out has never been more fun, or deadly, and all of you to do is set someone's jaw ablaze with pain in one punch to get them listening.

name: Cardletter Katanas
description: Not meant for duels in the rain.

name: Carmel Sandwich Cookies
description: NOM NOM NOM! This cookie sandwich with carmel filling is the perfect treat for a hungry hero looking to reward himself after battle. One of Oishii's favorite recipes.

name: Carmine Crystal Shield and Dagger
description: Created from unbreakable crystal, this shield and dagger set is sure to tear, slice, rip and impale anything you can imagine. And think about that shield for a moment… It's going to hurt someone while protecting you.

name: Carnax Disciple's Daggers
description: The Alpha are a cult of psionic sorcerers whose leader created Carnax in another timeline. Your task is to do whatever you can to protect and defend this creature… no matter where or when it appears.

name: Carnax Laser Swords
description: Magic lasers. When laser lasers just don't cut it.

name: Carnicero Dual Axes
description: The technology may evolve, but some things will never change.

name: Carotene Hull Breakers
description: The Hoptimus Prime frame is hard coded to prevent the urge to munch on its own weapons.

name: Casual Ilustrado Book And Quill
description: Whether leading an army in battle or planning your next adventure in Yulgar's Inn, you'll look like a hero.

name: Cat Claw Kamas
description: Was the Giant's massive kitty declawed? Well now it is. Engage in a giant cat-fight anywhere!

name: Cat Claws
description: Use your enemies as your newest scratching post! Me-ooowww!

name: Cataclysmic Daggers
description: The brutal Destruction that can be dealt when wielding these daggers will bring any foe to their knees. Rise as they fall!

name: CC Crustacean Crusher
description: For Randor the Red's birthday, he's labored to weaponize lobsters! Use the crushers to crash through your opponents' helms! You will sea that, with these, you can claw your way to the top!

name: Celebration Arrows
description: Wooden toys given to aspiring new heroes during one of the most special days in Battleon. The forests will have new Rangers protecting the peace.

name: Celebration Blades

description: Wooden toys given to aspiring new heroes during one of the most special days in Battleon. The forests will have new Rangers protecting the peace.

name: Celebration Daggers
description: Wooden toys given to aspiring new heroes during one of the most special days in Battleon. They'll be accomplished Rogues in no time.

name: Celestial Accoutrements
description: Shine on, Celestial Hero!

name: Celestial ArchFiend Swords
description: Smite Evil in the name of justice and all that is good? Definitely not anymore, but the Nation finds these weapons invaluable. They have Evil rivals after all.

name: Celestial Avenger Daggers
description: Those who desire revitalizations in their passions and self-esteem will find comfort grasping the blade cut from pure emerald. Look inside the hilt to find a lone spirit that will let you know that you are not alone.

name: Celestial Beacon Dagger
description: This celestial dagger was crafted by Bido for Gjappy. It is a beacon of hope, and now they are sharing it with you!

name: Celestial Celebrant's Law Accoutrements (0 AC)
description: Sing, oh sing, of glory and our joyous victory! The light still shines, the dark has gone, and our celestial realm is free.

name: Celestial Celebrant's Law Accoutrements (AC)
description: Sing, oh sing, of glory and our joyous victory! The light still shines, the dark has gone, and our celestial realm is free.

name: Celestial ForceBlades
description: When the light fades, the fall approaches. When this happens, the monsters begin to run.

name: Celestial Grace Orbs
description: Unyielding faith. A force of purity with great potential for mutual harm.

name: Celestial Light Daggers
description: Let the power of the Light compel you!

name: Celestial Starsabers
description: The light of these weapons came from a radiant ancestor. Their eyes are as numerous as the stars. Even now, they watch the progress of the progeny.

name: Celtic Hunter Reavers
description: These epic Celtic Hunter Reavers is from a dimension far, far away… one where your luck, skill, and strength in battle will lead you to VICTORY!

name: Ceremonial Tribal Blades
description: We wish you a Yeti New Year!

name: Cerulean Crystal Shield and Dagger
description: Created from unbreakable crystal, this shield and dagger set is sure to tear, slice, rip and impale anything you can imagine. And think about that shield for a moment… It's going to hurt someone while protecting you.

name: Chained Oni Blood Katanas (0 AC)
description: The Oni's katanas were transformed by the Fiend's Void, and thirsts for the blood of their former brethren. They exemplify both the creed of the Oni, and the maxims of the Nation.

name: Chained Oni Blood Katanas (AC)
description: The Oni's katanas were transformed by the Fiend's Void, and thirsts for the blood of their former brethren. They exemplify both the creed of the Oni, and the maxims of the Nation.

name: Chained Rune Bonebreakers
description: A chains slowly envelops a sword that remains a noble symbol of resistance and enlightenment. If it successfully wraps itself around the hilt, the sword will suffocate, losing the will to go on. The chain halts when in possession of a like-minded warrior.

name: Chains of Lycosura
description: The chains used to bind The Beast were cut into fragments, and given to the Generals of the Legion's Dark Council. Some use them as weapons, ritual implements, or in extreme cases, seal their own Legionnaires.

name: Chakram
description: Catch!

name: Chakras of Renewal
description: A pain of Chakras symbolizing the rebirth of 7 Chakras of your body. Watch your soul bloom brighter than ever!

name: Champion of Ice Katar
description: A personal favorite to the Champion of Ice, they are light and sharp; strong enough to help its user endure in hand-to-hand combat. Even gloves won't be enough to keep the hands safe from its blades.

name: Champion's Gilded Axes
description: There comes a time in every young person's life when they have to stand their ground, put on their grownup-pants, and heft two massive great axes in either hand. It'll happen to you too, one day.

name: Chaobold Pokers
description: Hammered from a rare ore, these daggers are used by Chaobolds to poke and stab any unwelcome visitors that stumble into the mines they haunt.

name: Chaorrupted Daggers
description: Yarrrr! Chaorrupted sea monsters will fall to your daggers… just make sure you don't get distracted by all their waving tentacles.

name: Chaorrupted Ruler's Dagger (AC)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Chaorrupted Ruler's Dagger (Legend)
description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

description: The Queen of Monsters knows all. Sees all. Destroys all… Except those followers who prove worthy. Will you be one of them?

name: Chaos Ally Daggers

name: Chaos Anchors
description: T' fury o' t' seven seas be no match for t' wrath o' Chaos!

name: Chaos Bandit's Rusted Blades
description: This bandit's blades must have been looted from a nearby camp during Drakath's attack on Battleon. Look, the chaorruption has already started seeping into them. O_O

name: Chaos Breaker's Daggers
description: Is this what Chaos looks like when it becomes broken by the forces of Order?

name: Chaos Chronomancer's HourGlasses
description: The sands freely pass from one glass to the other, swirling with unknown and tantalizing possibilities.

name: Chaos Crystal Daggers
description: Made from shattered and reforged Chaos Crystal, these blades' shifting hues will distract and hypnotize your opponents.

name: Chaos Cyclops Dagger
description: The conclusion after the Chaos soldier climbs up and fights against the malice towards positivity.

name: Chaos Dagger Revolvers
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: Chaos Fiend's Swords (0 AC)
description: The fiends were not infected by Chaos. it grew from within spread like a rash, and dug its roots into their edged steel.

name: Chaos Fiend's Swords (AC)
description: The fiends were not infected by Chaos. it grew from within spread like a rash, and dug its roots into their edged steel.

name: Chaos Hand Runes
description: The Loremasters have learned that there are many different fields of study… and to truly understand Chaos, you must fully immerse yourself in it.

name: Chaos Infused Daggers
description: Time to send your enemies and even your mind down a roller coaster ride to insanity with this pointy blade!

name: Chaos Myconian Renders
description: Chaos has infected all things - even the fungi! Be very careful when ingesting mushrooms… who knows what effect they will have.

name: Chaos Myconian Swordbreaker
description: Chaos has infected all things - even the fungi! Be very careful when ingesting mushrooms… who knows what effect they will have.

name: Chaos PuppetMaster's Dual Scissors
description: The Queen of Monsters was a heartless manipulator, using her son - Drakath - as a pawn in her quest to return to our world. Recognize her skill and celebrate her ruthlessness. BOW DOWN.

name: Chaos Shankers
description: Travel-sized for the hero who quest is to cause more chaos wherever they go.

name: Chaos Spy Blades
description: Take caution when choosing this twisted sword because as long as its eyes are open, you will never find contentment again.

name: Chaos Spy Blades (Legend)
description: I've seen Plague Doctors use these types of masks, but never a spy. I guess it's not so much about "not being noticed" as "can't be identified".

name: Chaos Star Daggers
description: Toss them quick and fast and from a distance, you're practically firing a laser from the palm of your hands.

name: Chaos Wedding Candles
description: The tag reads, "Keep away from flamable toys and guests who used too much hairspray."

name: ChaosFang Commander's Accoutrements (0 AC)
description: The means justifies the ends, when you lead a crew as viciously dedicated to Good as the ChaosFang Naval Commander does.

name: ChaosFang Commander's Accoutrements (AC)
description: The means justifies the ends, when you lead a crew as viciously dedicated to Good as the ChaosFang Naval Commander does.

name: Chaotic Captain's Cutlass + Flintlock (0 AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Captain's Cutlass + Flintlock (AC)
description: Chaos sails the seas of Lore!

name: Chaotic Energy Claws
description: Magic imbued with Chaos is much stronger - it is no wonder that so many Sorcerers and Sorceress' fall prey to its lure.

name: Chaotic Healer's Dual Vortex (AC)
description: Gather as much whirling chaos as you can, and use it as a weapon!

name: Chaotic Healer's Dual Vortex (Non-AC)
description: Gather as much whirling chaos as you can, and use it as a weapon!

name: Chaotic Knight Blades
description: An obsidian blade chaorrupted by Cemaros to help her punish deserters of the chaotic alignment.

name: Chaotic Life Rings (AC)
description: There's something wriggling inside of these life rings. One of the Chaos Twins can't swim, so its sentience is an added percaution should that sister get into a spot of trouble.

name: Chaotic Life Rings (Legend)
description: There's something wriggling inside of these life rings. One of the Chaos Twins can't swim, so its sentience is an added percaution should that sister get into a spot of trouble.

name: Chaotic LightBlades
description: Though they share the same violet hue as those who have found harmony within themselves and the fourth, these weapons represents the polar opposite.

name: Chaotic Long Lycan Dagger
description: A very long dagger that is starting to show signs of Chaorruption.

name: Chaotic Miasma Daggers
description: Dual slivers of screaming insanity desperately seeking a home in living flesh.

name: Chaotic Obsession Armaments
description: The violet flame will never go out. Not until the enemy is pierced or until the world ends. Chaos has found itself attracted to grudges that will live long after flesh rots.

name: Chaotic Obsession Blades
description: The idea of 'control' has seeped its way into every being of Chaos. Even this sword resembles a closed clawed fist clutching the blade. All will be taken with Chaos.

name: Chaotic Sand Reavers
description: These daggers pulse with the purple power of Chaos! You'd be wise to use them sparingly, as they're apt to corrupt you when you least expect it!

name: Chaotic Savage Accoutrements
description: These Berserkers have been overcome, but they STILL fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: Chaotic Scar Edges
description: Chaos is always moving, even when only dregs of it remain. These weapons were awarded to those who refuse to give up on ambition and fury. They have a mission - to remind the world why they feared Chaos.

name: Chaotic Scar Rippers

name: Chaotic StormClaws

name: Chaotic WarMage Dagger
description: The power of Chaos can be used in many different ways. The Chaotic WarMage uses it to boost their own personal power in battle.

name: Chaotic Witch's Wand + Tome (0 AC)

name: Chaotic Witch's Wand + Tome (AC)
description: Most mages use mana to power their spells. But Chaotic Witches and Warlocks choose to use a more unpredictable, but arguably more powerful substance… Chaos itself.

name: Chartreuse Crystal Shield and Dagger
description: Created from unbreakable crystal, this shield and dagger set is sure to tear, slice, rip and impale anything you can imagine. And think about that shield for a moment… It's going to hurt someone while protecting you.

name: Cheat Code Daggers
description: You incorrectly entered the 14-digit long cheat code and got these daggers instead!

name: Cheese Cutters (AC)
description: Who cut the cheese? You did, with your cheese cutters!

name: Cheese Cutters (Legend)
description: Who cut the cheese? You did, with your cheese cutters!

name: Cheese Dagger
description: It's the Year of the Rat, and these renegade Samurai have made their allegiance known!

name: Cherry Blossom Love Fans

name: Cherry Bomb
description: Explosively delicious! The cherry bomb is actually a quarter stick of dynamite.

name: Cheval Glass Swords
description: This enchanted sword captures every moment of their owner's life and its glistening light leaves a bitter reminder that as a hero, you will always be ill-fated.

name: Chicken Cow Knight's Sword + Shield
description: These brave bovine knights aren't chicken and never run away from a fight!

name: ChickenCow ArmBlade

name: Chickencow Drumsticks

name: ChickenCow Fang
description: By Zeuster! Did Voltabolt help in the extraction of this fang?

name: ChickenCowboy's Revolvers
description: CLUCK CLUCK MOOOOOOVE'EM OUT! YEEEEHAW! Giddyup Heroes!

name: Chimeric Pincer Blades (AC)
description: Weapons born from the same well of life as the Chimera Parasitoid. In their sibling's hands, they render all battles almost tiresomely tame.

name: Chocolate Sandwich Cookie (Dagger)
description: NOM NOM NOM! This cookie sandwich with carmel filling is the perfect treat for a hungry hero looking to reward himself after battle. One of Oishii's favorite recipes.

name: Chrono Commandant Gun

name: Chrono Cryolysis Blades

name: Chrono Cryolysis Reavers
description: A weapon created from a frozen fragments from a river of time. Everything it touches freezes as they were, living the same moment forever.

name: Chrono DragonKnight Blades
description: Prepare to meet an untimely demise.

name: Chrono ShadowHunter Guns
description: What the bullet strikes, it leaves nothing behind. Bones disappear, blood is unmade, and a small hole in time begins to tear open.

name: Chrono ShadowHunter Lanterns
description: Dark beasts call to one annother, and the souls trapped in this lantern lead the ShadowSlayer to their next target.

name: Chrono ShadowSlayer Guns
description: What the bullet strikes, it leaves nothing behind. Bones disappear, blood is unmade, and a small hole in time begins to tear open.

name: Chrono Tech Daggers
description: Click to retract the small blade. This tech, discovered by Deuce, comes from the future… or perhaps the very, very VERY distant past?

name: Chronofrost Hammers
description: The first strike freezes the target completely. The second strike is rarely used, meant to shatter and erase a frozen fragment of a condemned timeline.

name: Chronohammers of Lore
description: Smash on the ground in case you need a restart!

name: ChronoReaper Axes
description: Before Drakath's Chaorruption, the TimeReapers shone the blue of pure mana. It is time you saw them in their purest state!

name: ChronoReaper Blades
description: Before Drakath's Chaorruption, the TimeReapers shone the blue of pure mana. It is time you saw them in their purest state!

name: Chronosmith's Dual Retrocausality
description: Backwards, forwards, and sideways. Time's an ocean with currents going all over the place. To someone as 'enlightened' as Cysero, everything happens at once.

name: ChronoStrike Dagger
description: Slice through time AND your opponents!

name: ChronoStriker Slicers (AC)
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time rules over the past, present, and future. The ChronoStriker armor will enable you to strike at your enemies regardless of the timeline they inhabit.

name: ChronoStriker Slicers (Special)
description: The Eternal Dragon of Time rules over the past, present, and future. The ChronoStriker armor will enable you to strike at your enemies regardless of the timeline they inhabit.

name: Chthonic Fiend Exsanguinators (Legend)
description: The blood of the old fiends will run cold. They have no place in this world; a world that belongs to the Nation.

name: Classier Rabbit Chakrams

description: Sometimes simple is the most classy, y'know?

description: Sometimes simple is the most classy, y'know?

name: Clavic Daggers
description: When you are out of weapons, you sometimes have to improvise. Even if that means raiding the body next to you. Who wants to join in THAT raid?!?!

name: Claw of Nulgath

name: Claw of the Shrew
description: These claws are effective in combat and work wonderfully when getting the dirt on someone.

name: Claws of Darkness
description: Looks like you need some backbone to use these spiny claws!

description: Forged in the heart of the Astral Realm, these color-custom daggers have their cutting power magnified tenfold by the arcane magics flowing through them.

name: Claws of the Daeva
description: Aya, lady of the Dunes, knows all that pass through the Sandsea and the Realms of the Djinn. Secrets are borne to her ears upon the wind, and she keeps them in a jeweled casket by her side.

name: Claws of the Underworld
description: Denizens of the Underworld must always be ready for an attack by those who would take their power.

name: Claws of the Weald
description: Blessed by Druid elders, these claws were forged from the very essence of the mother tree, lending their power to those who harness a deep connection with nature.

name: ClawsOfTheBlaze
description: Gouge your way through the battlefield with these claws!

name: Cleavers of Madness
description: They're smiling at you. When they were making these writhing weapons, certain members of the Scale taught them how to make faces.

name: Cleavers of the Lone Tree
description: Majestic jade axes that carries the whispers of the woods. A "lone tree" reared by the face of death, rot, and decay. There will always be a witch, and a maiden to learn from her…or cut her down.

name: Cleavers of the Truth
description: You'll never MEAT an enemy you can't find a good use for when you have this axe equipped.

name: Cleavers of the Wild
description: Majestic jade axes that carries the whispers of the woods. A "lone tree" reared by the face of death, rot, and decay. There will always be a witch, and a maiden to learn from her…or cut her down.

name: Cleyera Sakaki Katanas

name: Cloaked Nocturu Daggers
description: For the rogue with a spooky side.

name: Closed Circuit
description: The energy contained in this weapon's circuitry is enough to blow DoomWood apart! It is a measure of great trust that ArcAttack allows you to keep it.

name: Cobalt Beast Hand Axes
description: The primeval beasts of yore had bones and hearts made of unbreakable ice. Wearing the pelts of these beasts and fusing with their souls, the Wardens of today forged those bones and hearts into deadly weapons.

name: Cobalt Flurries
description: Blades made from Ice extracted from an Elemental. No one was slain to forge them. A FrostFire Lord manifested them in battle as extensions of their body.

name: Cobalt Flurry and Shield
description: A blade made from Ice extracted from an Elemental. No one was slain to forge it. A FrostFire Lord manifested it in battle as an extension of their body.

name: Cobalt Glacier Crusher (Dagger)
description: In the past, the great beasts of the Northlands shaped the ice and mountains with their claws. Now in tandem with their mortal partners, they cleave armies in two with weapons made from their hearts.

name: Cobalt Knuckle Cutter
description: Grip these tightly and take them for a spin. Lashing out has never been more fun, or deadly, and all of you to do is set someone's jaw ablaze with pain in one punch to get them listening.

name: Cockatrice Hunter's Accoutrements
description: The shield acts as a black mirror, to reflect the cockatrice's gaze. Once it's petrified, smash it the hammer.

name: Cocytus Fractal Spell Runes
description: This rune that may come from a dark and malicious place, but the unique fractals of ice never lose their ethereal wonder.

name: Cold Delusions Blades
description: Blades drenched in dark power, once dragged through the belly of its master's Lord. This is a law of the land. Power must be passed on. Eventually, the wielder will become a mentor themselves. (Changes in combat)

name: Cold Delusions Katanas
description: Blades drenched in dark power, once dragged through the belly of its master's Lord. The severance of loyalty gives deeper depths to the shadows powering the katana.

name: Cold Extinction Blades
description: The FrostBlood burdened by these blades could be human. Perhaps they're an elf, or even a Glaceran. The cold overwelmed them, and forced its will into their hands.

description: *No description*

description: *No description*

name: ColdSteel Blade + Shield
description: Real heroes know when you're up against a fire dragon, you don't fight fire with fire, you use cold, sharp steel.

name: Colonicus' Wing Dagger
description: To be unsuspecting, this might look like a turkey leg. But we know better, don't we. Gross.

description: Beautifully, Deadly and Color Customizable! Like a color customizable model slash ninja.

name: Colorful Giftbox Dagger 2021
description: Happy Frostval 2021! These giftboxes will NOT open. (CC to Base and Trim)

name: Colorful Grenwog Waterguns
description: Rabbits are known to be careful and cautious, but enjoy a spot of spontaneity. There could be water in this gun, but what if you got creative?

description: A beautiful stenciled, color customizable paper fan, worthy of the nobles!

name: Colorless Pumpking Daggers
description: Perfect for carving up enemies.

name: Combat Cupid's Reavers
description: Cupids are typically known for using their bows to find their partners. However, combat cupids modify theirs for an extra advantage in battle.

name: Compass Rose Skulls
description: The ashes smoulder, and the smoke blows down the path you need to walk.

description: A sword for the rebels and new blood. Doom may have a Master but these Shadows spit in the face of this fraud. Total domination will be achieved under new names, hand in hand with their chosen champion.

name: Conquest Accoutrements
description: The white heat of this bow makes it unwieldable by anyone but the spirit of Conquest… or those he possesses.

name: Conquest's Regal Pistols
description: If you're going to challenge the Horseman of Conquest to a duel, I strongly recommend letting him keep the bow. Disarm him, and he'll pull out this baby. I did that during a spar, and couldn't stop laughing even when I got shot in the shoulder.

name: Conquest's Regal Rapiers (0 AC)
description: Fine blades, straight to the point. Kings and queens covet Conquest's precision. Was the Horseman one of them before he was given his steed? He'll never tell. Real rulers don't need to explain their power.

name: Conquest's Regal Rapiers (AC)
description: Fine blades, straight to the point. Kings and queens covet Conquest's precision. Was the Horseman one of them before he was given his steed? He'll never tell. Real rulers don't need to explain their power.

name: Contract Butchers of Nulgath
description: If you break your contract with Nulgath, it is the Contract Keepers that will be sent after you.

name: Cool Swords

name: Copperwire Daggers
description: Careful you might get a little shock from these.

name: CorDemi Daggers
description: Compacts itself for increased portability! Also makes it easier to hide in your pocket. Click to Activate.

name: Corpse Wax Candelabras
description: Where do all the fleshy parts go when someone turns into an Undead skeleton? The Underworld doesn't let them go to waste.

name: Corrupt Katana and Cutlass
description: *No Description*

name: Corrupted Guardian's Hammers
description: The Mana Core contains the most pure magic available. But with Malgor's corruption… no one can predict what will happen now. Mages around the world wait, fearful, for the outcome of even the most basic spells

name: Corrupted Skullsplitter Blades
description: Enemies slain with these blades may still be useful once reanimated… but they'll glow a nice bright purple.

name: Corrupted TimeSlicer
description: Time flows, curves and circles back on itself. Corrupted Chronomancers introduce flaws into the stream to better manipulate it.

name: Corundum Carvers
description: Rough and rugged, you won't find many ornate weapons, only those use to fight.

name: Corundum Kris
description: Ruby, also called corundum, is the stone of nobility and courage, and is often placed into portions or applied to weaponry to enhance these qualities.

name: Cosmic Fiend's Quasars (0 AC)
description: Two windows to the Fiend’s Void are ripped open. They resemble watchful eyes, hungrily consuming sights only Lore has to offer.

name: Cosmic Fiend's Quasars (AC)
description: Two windows to the Fiend’s Void are ripped open. They resemble watchful eyes, hungrily consuming sights only Lore has to offer.

name: Cosmic Frost Omen Breakers
description: The sword has seen countless battles, shattering under the weight of conflicts that will never end. Still, it holds its shape as its purpose has yet to be fulfilled.

name: Cosmic Hunter's Antimatter Sabres
description: Made from material that rarely comes into existence in our universe. A sabre of this nature has only been found in the hands of a Cosmic Bounty Hunter, and they don't share secrets for free. (Item is CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Cosmic Hunter's Blaster Pistols
description: Quick on the draw and surgical in precision, the target is dead before they hit the ground,. With a weapon this good, bringing in the bounty alive is going to cost extra. (Item is CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Cosmic Nebula Riftblades
description: Blades forged from nebular energy, capable of tearing rifts through space itself. Each strike distorts existence, leaving echoes of the cosmic void in its wake.

name: Cosmic Omen Breakers
description: The swords have seen countless battles, shattering under the weight of conflicts that will never end. Still, they hold their shape as their purpose has yet to be fulfilled.

name: Cosmic Reavers
description: Follow the stars and your dreams. They'll guide you to your greatest happiness.

name: Cosmic Slashers
description: Follow the stars and your dreams. They'll guide you to your greatest happiness. (This item will go perma-rare on June 30th, 2020)

name: Cosmic Spirits of the Sword
description: From the heavens, a star answers your summons and forms into the shape of your heart; an honorable sword that is at its most brilliant when it protects the innocent.

name: Courage Armaments
description: With your sword and shield in hand, you'll be able to face down any opponent. But they are not needed; as a Hero, you have the courage to take them all on barehanded!

name: Cowbell + Dinger
description: Everything needs more COWBELL!

name: Cowmander Pistols
description: What in tarnation, this isn't the wild west! These be the sweaty seas! Bring them cows home, boys!

name: Crafter Chakram (Dagger)
description: Throw these at your enemies or play fetch with your dragon.

name: Creature 83 Awakened Bats
description: A group of Creature 83 is often called a "fluffle" in parts of Northern Lore, but this bat is anything BUT fluffy!

name: Creature 83 Bats
description: A group of Creature 83 is often called a "fluffle" in parts of Northern Lore, but this bat is anything BUT fluffy!

name: Creeper Dagger
description: It's good to be resourceful! A crudely put-together dagger using a spare Creeper claw. Leg. Thing.

name: Crescent Dagger
description: The moon is very important to a Werewolf… so important that most of their weapons feature the shape of a crescent moon!

name: Cretaceous Armaments
description: Saw your way to victory while protecting yourself with a saur-riffic shield! Dino-MITE!

name: Crimson Archer Armblades
description: It can come in handy when even it is being tracked and the ceiling is the last place their enemies think to look.

name: Crimson Blades of Swordhaven
description: It may seem abnormally heavy at first, but if the wielder is a worthy owner, the soothing power of light helps support the weight you must carry. It's the same way your burdened responsibility as a faithful commander must carry to save the world.

name: Crimson Darkling Lamps
description: Plague Doctors can be seen whispering to their lamps as they traverse the dark. Perhaps their knowledge and skill came from the same murky origins as the diseases they seek to cure.

name: Crimson Destructor Swords
description: Powered by the rare mineral Crimsidium, found in the year 20122013, this blade is able to slice like a ninja and cut like a razor blade!

name: Crimson Grenwog Carrot Kunais
description: Carrots aren't actually that healthy of a snack to feed to rabbits. Too much sugar. It makes more sense to shower your enemies in a rain of adorable carrot kunai.

name: Crimson Grenwog Waterguns
description: Rabbits are known to be careful and cautious, but enjoy a spot of spontaneity. There could be water in this gun, but what if you got creative?

name: Crimson Hesperides and Shield
description: A blade crafted from the blood of the legendary Atlas Lion. Ghastly rumors say that this golden king sacrificed his children to outrun old age. The honor of eradicating all Evils of this world was his right alone.

name: Crimson Needle and Grimoire
description: The CrimsonFlame Fanatics are a small but powerful sect of fire magic users. They travel the land, "purifying" evildoers that cross their paths.

name: Crimson NovaBlades Persei
description: Mystic blades forged with the heat of a red supergiant, the largest stars in space. Eta Persei is a star that, without fail or falter, guides heroes home.

name: Crimson Piano Strikers
description: This Strikers are on key when it comes to tuning pianos! Also very useful against tone-deaf baddies.

name: Crimson Star Reavers
description: Wield these blades in the name of loyalty, honor, and justice for all. (This item goes rare on July 31st.)

name: Crimson Star Slashers
description: Wield this blade in the name of loyalty, honor and justice for all. (This item goes rare on July 31st.)

name: Crimson StarEdges Suhail
description: Mystic blades forged with the heat of a red supergiant, the largest stars in space. Suhail, also known as Lambda Velorum, guides adventurers through journeys of wonder and destiny.

name: Criosphinx Sun Swords
description: The personal weapon of each warrior that guarded the Pharaoh's of old were forged individually. The more monsters these blades fell, the darker they became.

name: Crispy Maize Maces
description: It needs a matching dip, and maybe you'll find that in the guts of your enemies.

name: Crow Hand of Victory
description: Cheer for your favorite feathered team!

name: Crowned Axes of the Underworld
description: The crown upon these axes do not symbolize royalty. It shows all those who gaze upon its blade that you keep Kings in check. All are equal in death.

name: Crude Twin Dagger
description: A strange looking dagger design. Few have the skill to use it well.

name: Cruel Claw of Blizzard
description: This claw attachment is imbued with the destructive power of a blizzard.

name: Unidentified 32 (Cruel Dagger of Nulgath)
description: What luck! You've won the "Cruel Dagger of Nulgath".

name: Crustacean Crusher
description: For Randor the Red's birthday, he's labored to weaponize lobsters! Use the crushers to crash through your opponents' helms! You will sea that, with these, you can claw your way to the top!

name: Crustacean Crusher CC 2011
description: For Randor the Red's birthday, he's labored to weaponize lobsters! Use the crushers to crash through your opponents' helms! You will sea that, with these, you can claw your way to the top!

name: Cruxes of Violet
description: Elegant blades once wielded by a former champion of the Aeris Battlespire. The Arena Masters wiped their slate clean so they can find a new, worthier owner.

name: Cryofreeze Catalyst Armaments
description: There's much to be said about these weapons, meant to hunt and torture traitors. Weren't they forged by a very notable traitor? It only matters if one believes their treachery was justified.

name: Crypt Knight Swords
description: Haaaaaahhhhhh… You will die slowly, mortal! Nulgath the ArchFiend will have your soul. FOREVER.

name: Crypt Rogue BackBlades
description: Your gold or your life? Your choice. One way or another, you'll give your fair share to Nulgath the ArchFiend.

name: Crypt Samurai Blades
description: A samurai should always be prepared for death - whether his own or someone else's.

name: Crypt Soldier Sword and Shield
description: Haaaaaahhhhhh… You will die slowly, mortal! Nulgath the ArchFiend will have your soul. FOREVER.

name: Cryptic Daggers
description: Cryptics are Atealan illusionists whose minds are their most powerful weapons. The only limit to their abilities is their imagination.

name: Crypto Collector Guns
description: How do you collect that which does not exist… except in cyberspace?

name: Crystal Auberon Claws
description: Magic freezes your blood, fortifying your fists with ice. Know that overreliance on this power will eventually turn the rest of you into a creature akin to an Ice Elemental.

name: Crystal Ice Daggers
description: Crafted from crystals found deep in the Northlands, this weapon will never shatter, no matter how fragile it looks.

name: Crystalisk Daggers
description: These crystal daggers, formed by millions of years of pressure, glow with their own inner fire.

name: Crystallis Chappals

name: Crystallis Dango

name: Crystallis Soldier's Gun + Shield
description: The Crystallis administration recruits only the most skilled and loyal citizens to guard and serve. Are YOU worthy to join?

name: Crystallis Voidslayer Claws
description: These claws were known to rip through the very fabric of Crystallis' void. Use them wisely, for they are now yours to wield.

name: Crystallis Wayfinder Sheath (AC)
description: The Archivist has sent the Crystallis Admirals out to head up the search for what belongs to her.

name: Crystallis Wayfinder Sheath (Legend)
description: The Archivist has sent the Crystallis Admirals out to head up the search for what belongs to her.

name: Crystallized Soul Lanterns
description: There's still use for weak souls with feeble wills. They're crystallized, lit with fires of the Soul Forge, and melt as the lantern burns them away.

name: Crystallized Spirit Spear
description: This spear was crafted from spirit energy gathered from the unmourned undead and crystallized into a deadly weapon. (This item goes rare on March 31, 2021.)

name: Crystallized Void Blades (AC)
description: These blades raking against flesh burns more painfully than fire or frostbite.

name: Crystallized Void Blades (Legend)
description: These blades raking against flesh burns more painfully than fire or frostbite.

name: Crystamorph Dual Banes
description: Manamorph's shed their extremities, this is made with what's left over.

name: Cupid of Evil Bow + Arrow
description: For those who want a reason to shoot people with arrows and not get in trouble. Spread the love…errr evil!

name: Cupid of Gold Bow + Arrow
description: For those who want a reason to shoot people with arrows and not get in trouble. Spread the love!

name: Cupid of Love Bow + Arrow

name: Cursed Blade and Pistol
description: A carrier of a curse that had done away with innocents before, you might be carrying a silent killer coursing inside. How far would you go to find what you seek?

name: Cursed Blood Blade and Pistol
description: A carrier of a curse that had done away with innocents before, you might be carrying a silent killer coursing inside. How far would you go to find what you seek?

name: Cursed Claws
description: Looks like you need some backbone to use these spiny claws!

name: Cursed Dual Grudge Nagamaki
description: A set of ancestral blades, heavily imbued with the curses of the Legion. They were used to slay hundreds of its’ members before their final master bent the knee to Dage.

name: Cursed Fleshrippers (Legend)
description: Upon closer examination, the 'teeth' of these cursed blades are real. They're fangs plucked from the mouths of screaming Vampires.

name: Cursed Fleshrippers (Non-Legend)
description: Upon closer examination, the 'teeth' of these cursed blades are real. They're fangs plucked from the mouths of screaming Vampires.

name: Cursed Guns
description: The ghosts of the past will never let go, haunting the next person who finds these guns.

name: Cursed Handheld Webs
description: Your handshakes are going to leave a huge impression.

name: Cursed Jester's Stabbers
description: Jesters are normally used to entertain guests at fancy dinners… but something went wrong when this Jester was practicing next to a some Necromancers, and now they are cursed!

name: Cursed Legion Cutlass and Pistol
description: Those who've wielded this cursed blade have all met a grisly end. And you won't be the last.

name: Cursed Pharaoh's Blades
description: Once owned by a powerful Pharaoh, a great tragedy befell him and his people. Legends states it was this blade that caused the downfall of an entire empire.

name: Cursed Psy Op Guns
description: A soul forged weapon that can't be fired the conventional way. Its inner workings can only be operated by someone with experience with telekenesis or some professional string work.

name: Cursed Revolvers
description: The ghosts of the past will never let go, haunting the next person who finds these guns.

name: Cursed Stalker's Knife
description: Once simple pirates these now cursed souls sail the darkest deeps of the seas looking for souls to harvest.

name: Cursed Star Daggers
description: Toss them quick and fast and from a distance, you're practically firing a laser from the palm of your hands.

name: Curvaceous Killer
description: Curvaceous and beautiful, this sword will break hearts and take names. Feel confident as you slice through the air and cut down the enemy one by one.

name: Curved Dagger
description: A simple weapon used for ambush.

name: Curved Edge of the FireLord
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Curved Heartrend Daggers
description: The bond between a champion and his weapons is powerful. When he falls, does his blade follow?

name: Curved Prisma Daggers
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with these color-shifting daggers crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Custom Emblazoned Competitor's Phone and Bag
description: A distinctive logo is emblazoned on tough, high quality materia, to show off exactly who you are.

name: Custom Gem Daggers
description: Custom dagger offered by the jewelers and blacksmith's of Thelima. They have different properties depending on which gems you choose, but most reccommend going with your birthstone.

name: Cutesy GrenwogSlayer's Accoutrements
description: Enemies will be asking fur trouble against this bunny bow.

name: Cutesy GrenwogSlayer's Daggers
description: How could something so cute be so deadly?

name: Cutesy Pink Panda Bats
description: The hot pink tape strips hide the big dent. You'll likely need more of that.

name: Cyber Abyssian's Executors (0 AC)
description: Deadly weapons as well as universal serial buses. When a new Executor is delivered to a Cyber Prowler, they're injected with new updates and information. They're also employed to deliver viruses to cybernetic competitors.

It would usually take years for it to happen, but you've gotten it early because of a hidden strength Dage senses in you.

description: The Dragon of Time is able to move through and control space and time… but something malicious hides in cyberspace. A Cyberspace Dragon of Time may spell doom for our future! (CC to accessory)

name: CyberStrike Achievement Blades
description: For the first time ever, Chairman Platinum has authorized the release of the CyberStrike Blade to you, his most outstanding "problem solver." It is traditionally awarded to superintendents who excel at slashing operational costs (and industry spies) on Cyber Monday.

name: CyberVoid Dagger
description: Made entirely of digital code, these minions have escaped from the cyberworld to do the bidding of their cyberfiend master.

name: Cyborg Monk Sticks
description: Definitely not used for walking, and the Cyborg Monk has long since moved passed the virtue of humility.

name: Cycloptic Piercer Blades
description: Eye can't imagine an opponent would enjoy the sight of you in this terrifying battlegear.

name: Cypress Scalpels
description: Deadly weapons meant for precise slicing and clean cuts. Outside of battle, They were used to carve and sculpt frozen statues. Some of them were alive, just warm enough to feel every slice.

name: Cysero's Defender Dagger
description: This style of weapon was crafted by Cysero in honor of all his friends, who are ready to jump to his defense at any moment.

name: Cysero's Dual Breakers
description: Cysero's Dual warhammers are magically enhanced every time he shatters a weapon with them.

name: Cysero's Potatoes
description: You can never have enough potatoes.

name: Cysero's Rootbeer Mugs
description: Double-fisted and FROSTY! (Root bear's the best thing to toast cheers to the New Year. See you on Friday, Heroes! Make sure to save some shenanigans for me.)

name: Dacite Daggers
description: A pair of massive blades crafted from igneous, volcanic rock found only on Mount Mafic. Daggers this hot never cool down.

name: Dage's Pride Blade and Pistol
description: Those who've wielded this cursed blade have all met a grisly end. And you won't be the last.

description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Dagger of Awe! (AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Dagger of Feelings
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: Forged by Disturbed indestructible, this dagger will be the perfect weapon to train on the heart of your enemy. Aim well and true, and let heart-covered blade do its worst.

name: Dagger of Serpents
description: This dagger has a serpent crafted on it's blade.

name: Dagger of the Bat
description: This dagger has an ornamented bat for its hilt.

name: Dagger to the Heart
description: Painful is the dagger that pierces a heart in love. Despite the beauty of this blade, it is not meant to comfort. It is meant to shatter life, run through the beating heart, and bring death to others.

name: Daggers of Abyssal Order
description: Nulgath forged this dagger in fire, and cooled it with his blood. Merely owning the dagger would compel obedience from members of the Nation through powerful magic.

name: Daggers of Akriloth
description: Even the smallest version of the Great Fire Dragon should not be trifled with.

name: Daggers of Crescent
description: Send your foes to their final resting place deep within the darkness of the night.

name: Daggers of Darkness
description: Crafted in the depths of the Underworld, these daggers are the personification of evil!

name: Daggers of Deception
description: A perfect weapon for those who have mastered treachery.

name: Daggers of Destiny
description: Only with these dagger can you rebuild an empire.

name: Daggers of Destruction
description: You will shatter an empire and bring their king to his knees!

name: Daggers of Djet
description: A set of daggers aging back to the Sek Duat Dynasty. According to legend, these weapons will never dull, symbolizing "eternity" that they represent.

name: Daggers of Dragonkin
description: Modeled after the ferocity of dueling dragons, these menacingly large daggers strike fear into the hearts of your enemies.

name: Daggers of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Daggers of Guiding
description: The AQW Ambassadors thank you for playing AQWorlds. This weapon is a gift from them to wish you good luck in your adventures!

name: Daggers of Love
description: Don't need mana. Don't need fame. Don't need a pyromancer's burning flame. You're strong and you're loving, not cruel anytime. You'll always save a life. That's the power of LOVE!

name: Daggers of Maddened Will (AC)
description: Madness drips from these daggers' sharpened points. You are its chosen master, and your footsteps will be feared throughout these rotting lands. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Daggers of Maddened Will (Legend)
description: Madness drips from these daggers' sharpened points. You are its chosen master, and your footsteps will be feared throughout these rotting lands. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Daggers of Malevolence
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Daggers of Omniramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Daggers of Purity
description: A blade is what its wielder makes of it. Celestial Commander are expected to smite the wicked and humble the exalted with their sword. Are you capable of performing such tasks?

name: Daggers of Ra
description: Infused with the fury of the sun gods, these ancient daggers have withstood the test of time… and abrasive sandstorms. These weapons were inspired by your fellow player, Minar!

name: Daggers Of Rage
description: Don't let any of the blood these daggers spill get in your eyes or your mouth. There's no telling what it'll do to you!

name: Daggers of Scorching
description: Melt through the shackles that plague Embersea's innocent!

name: Daggers of Semiramis
description: Defend the Elementals and fight those who wish to steal their powers!

name: Daggers of the Depths
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: ghostly hands grasp these blades aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… they are a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Daggers of the Desolate Desert
description: A favorite amongst Sandrunners, these quick and nimble daggers slice through anything foolish enough to stand within striking distance.

name: Daggers of the Forsaken
description: An elite cadre of sentient undead known as The Forsaken wield these weapons. The daggers are used as sidearms for an "if all else fails" scenario.

name: Daggers of the Pumpking
description: Perfect for carving up enemies.

name: Daggers of the Underworld
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Dainty Alchemist's Athames
description: Recruited by Big Daddy, these alchemists are entrusted to brew handmade love potions.

name: Daisies
description: Flower power! Daisy's are a hero's blossom, and they'll use you as a bed when you're dead!

name: Dalgona Cookies
description: The BEST post-PVP victory treat a squished hero could ask for.

name: Damask Rose Rapiers
description: Gallant swords that will always be raised to defend the beautiful. Theirr sweet scent fortells its arrival.

name: Dancing Blades
description: For Trolls, all life occurs on a stage. And war, war is but a dance between two people, or two nations.

name: Dancing Sakura Daggers
description: These razor sharp daggers are made of Sakura glass, which combines sand, shredded sakura petals, and ancient magics into the deadliest of weapons!

name: Dandelion Kiwi Cookies
description: Mmmm, DOUBLE dandelion-shaped cookies filled with a light, sweet kiwi creme! Now THIS is what I call a sweet reward!

name: Dark Aeneid Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: The forging of these cutlasses was inspired by one of Vergil's stories. It told of a great destiny that would be born from devastating loss. A Hero crossed the endless sea to build the foundation of a grand empire. It's a favorite of Dage's.

name: Dark Aeneid Cutlasses (AC)
description: The forging of these cutlasses was inspired by one of Vergil's stories. It told of a great destiny that would be born from devastating loss. A Hero crossed the endless sea to build the foundation of a grand empire. It's a favorite of Dage's.

name: Dark and Ugly Sticks
description: There's quite a few monsters that have already been beaten with this.

name: Dark Angelic Neesha's Daggers (AC)
description: A ray of sunshine caught by the Archangel and given to one of his most capable attendants. They fall from the skies, striking down evil to protect the innocent.

name: Dark Angelic Neesha's Daggers (Legend)
description: A ray of sunshine caught by the Archangel and given to one of his most capable attendants. They fall from the skies, striking down evil to protect the innocent.

name: Dark Arcana Dagger
description: These chakrams are fortified with magic so dark it shines!

name: Dark Asgardian Hammer + Shield (0 AC)
description: Forged in the land of the underworld gods, this dark plate commands the fury and anger of the deities it was forged by. Every strike cracks with the intensity of lightning.

name: Dark Asgardian Hammer + Shield (AC)
description: Forged in the land of the underworld gods, this dark plate commands the fury and anger of the deities it was forged by. Every strike cracks with the intensity of lightning.

name: Dark Assassin Daggers
description: Curved and slick as a solid rock, it can do much more than slice and dice fruit to make smoothies.

name: Dark Astravian General Pistols
description: High ranking Astravian warriors are required to be experts in all forms of combat and weaponry. Titania and Regulus preferred the up close and personal. Captain Aurola's marksmanship was peerless. Together, their only weakness was the affection they held for their fellow Astravians.

name: Dark Astravian Rapiers
description: Rapiers made of material that can't be replicated by any forge or Mage. It's as if something alive is taking the form of a sword to lure humans into making contact.

name: Dark Beach Balls (AC)
description: Easy to see when you're hitting ithemover a net, but impossible to find if you drop them in an oil spill.

name: Dark Beach Balls (Legend)
description: Easy to see when you're hitting ithemover a net, but impossible to find if you drop them in an oil spill.

name: Dark Blades of Swordhaven
description: It may seem abnormally heavy at first, but if the wielder is a worthy owner, the soothing power of light helps support the weight you must carry. It's the same way your burdened responsibility as a faithful commander must carry to save the world.

name: Dark Bloodletter Katanas
description: Nation hopefuls are maddened by Nulgath's trials until they become mindlessly loyal attack dogs. Ironically, Carnage started out that way, and was shaped to become a skilled General instead. This blade sharpened as he rose.

name: Dark Carrot Kunais
description: Carrots aren't actually that healthy of a snack to feed to rabbits. Too much sugar. It makes more sense to shower your enemies in a rain of adorable carrot kunai.

name: Dark Champion Daggers
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword hold power beyond compare.

name: Dark Chocolate Popsicles (AC)
description: The rich, deep flavor of dark chocolate, cooled to a frosty chill.

name: Dark Chocolate Popsicles (Legend)
description: The rich, deep flavor of dark chocolate, cooled to a frosty chill.

name: Dark Daggers of Shade
description: Hidden from sight, these daggers harness the dark powers from the shadows.

name: Dark Delinquent's Street Bats (0 AC)
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Dark Delinquent's Street Bats (AC)
description: There are many who choose to defy the rules of the Crystallis administration. These citizens roam the streets, breaking curfews and windows. They will soon be… re-educated.

name: Dark Draco Sanguis Blades

name: Dark Draconic Daggers
description: Even the great Sepulchure would be envious of these daggers.

name: Dark Dragon Heart Renders
description: Two of many blades that growls and spits. The Dracolich Lord has an entire armory of them, created from the bones of dragons that were partnered with enemy Dragonlords.

name: Dark Dragon's Fang Reavers

name: Dark Dragon Summoner's Rifts
description: The apocalypse will soon make its entrance.

name: Dark Dual Arachnotana
description: How to be stealthy and edgy in 2 easy steps.

name: Dark Dual CA Assaulters
description: This weapon is the property of the Crystallis administration. Return to Suite 37a1C, c/o Chief Munitions Coordinator.

name: Dark Dual Manslayer of Taro
description: Slicing through saving.

name: Dark Eclipses of Enyo
description: Life, memory, scars, grudges, everything in this world is temporary. The realm of the dead will have it all, and those who resist will bleed.

name: Dark Energy of Despair
description: Let your opponents feel what you feel.

name: Dark Exo Dagger
description: *No description*

name: Dark Flames of Fury
description: Legion Pyromancers don't play around with normal fire. Their blue flames come deep with the underworld.

name: Dark Flaming Fists
description: Your passion to fight burns hot within your heart…and your fists! Ahhhh! Stop drop and roll! STOP DROP AND ROLL!!

name: Dark Frost Fang Katana and Sheathe (AC)
description: A hunter whose heart is truly frozen by winter's skin-numbing bite can hold such a blade with no further handicap. It may be as light as paper, but it can slice glaciers as if they are citrus fruit.

name: Dark Frost Ninja Daggers
description: These daggers would be far too cold to hold, if you weren't a frost ninja.

name: Dark Frostscythe Kamas
description: Fun sized version! Perfect for cleaning dragon scales off your face.

name: Dark Hand's Claws
description: An elite group of assassin's known as the Dark Hand plagued the realm of Lore for hundreds of years. Thought to have finally been removed, their numbers once again grow.

name: Dark Hand's Dual Cyclones
description: An elite group of assassin's known as the Dark Hand plagued the realm of Lore for hundreds of years. Thought to have finally been removed, their numbers once again grow.

name: Dark Hand's Kusari-Gama
description: An elite group of assassin's known as the Dark Hand plagued the realm of Lore for hundreds of years. Thought to have finally been removed, their numbers once again grow.

name: Dark Hand's Slaughters
description: The Dark Hand Behemoth brutally crushes their opponents in a roaring frenzy of blood. When their prey stops moving, a horrible sense of disappointment washes over them, and they set their sights on their next duel.

name: Dark Knight's Acolyte Blades
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dark Knight's Apprentice Blades
description: Dage the Evil sends his Dark Knights forth to terrorize the good and lure the wicked to his realm. The most skilled may prove strong enough to join the Undead Legion.

name: Dark Knight's Axes

name: Dark Knight's Ensorcelled Blade + Shield (0 AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

name: Dark Knight's Ensorcelled Blade + Shield (AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

name: Dark Knight's Ensorcelled Shield + Spear (0 AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

name: Dark Knight's Ensorcelled Shield + Spear (AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!
