name: Dark Knight's Spear + Shield (AC)
description: Dark Knights of the Underworld were wickedly strong in life. In undeath, they are unstoppable!

name: Dark Lunar Daggers
description: The Winter Solistice, full moon, and lunar eclipse all came together in a perfect storm of natural night-time beauty, and this weapon was forged for you to celebrate it!

name: Dark Manifestation Swords
description: Your negative emotions are being ejected from the timestream, like a mortal's body getting rid of toxins. Combined with your power, a new form of life has been created… and has evolved.

name: Dark Metal Necro Scythes
description: What's more metal than a rock concert full of head-banging undead? A necromancer who can bind their spirits and control them. FOREVER.

name: Dark Mirrored Accoutrements
description: If you ever face a beast that takes "looks can kill" to a dangerous level, then anything with a mirror you can get your hands on is ideal for the confrontation. This one is not effective against vampires.

name: Dark Naval Handguns (AC)
description: A firearm subtle in its connection to forbidden ritualistic magic. It always hits its target, at the cost of one day leading it's master to turn on a loved one.

name: Dark Naval Handguns (Legend)
description: A firearm subtle in its connection to forbidden ritualistic magic. It always hits its target, at the cost of one day leading it's master to turn on a loved one.

name: Dark Omen Barbs
description: Blades that humble houses and pact writers, yearning to tear into the arrogant who sit atop thrones built on mortal mistakes.

name: Dark Omen Trick Cards
description: Give a face to the King of Spades. Give a face to the Queen of Hearts. Who is your friend, who is your enemy, and who do you want to burn?

name: Dark Ops Cold Steel Axes
description: Understated handaxes that could be used by anyone. They're meant for silent use, able to split open traitorous Legion steel. Sometimes, they inexplicably appear in the possession of heroes hunting rampaging undead.

name: Dark Ops Cold Steel Knives
description: Skilled hands can use these knives to cut through bones like butter before the enemy realizes that they've been reduced to cubes.

name: Dark Ops Cold Steel Kukris
description: A skilled hand can use these blades to cut through bones like butter before the enemy realizes that they've been reduced to cubes.

name: Dark Ostraka
description: Simple blades given to new members of the Legion. Made from shards of broken weaponry, these swords have been reforged countless times. They force the wielder to refine their skills and techniques.

name: Dark Pirate Caster's Cutlass + Pistol (0 AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Dark Pirate Caster's Cutlass + Pistol (AC)
description: So ye be wantin' to join Dage's crew? Better not plunder the Dark Lord's treasure or he be makin' you walk the plank!

name: Dark Refraction Daggers (0 AC)
description: The reflection in the blade of this dagger rarely ever shows your current self. Lights dance and you'll catch glimpses of you at your best, your worst, and what you'll never be.

name: Dark Refraction Daggers (AC)
description: The reflection in the blade of this dagger rarely ever shows your current self. Lights dance and you'll catch glimpses of you at your best, your worst, and what you'll never be.

name: Dark Sea Corsair's Battle Gear
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it.

name: Dark Sea Corsair's Pistols
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it.

name: Dark Sea Corsair's Rapiers
description: YARRRR! Ye an' yer crew rule the Dark Seas, an' all who are cursed enough to cross yer path will rue th' day… assumin' they survive it.

name: Dark Shogun Katanas
description: These former rulers aren't ready to concede yet. Their undying pledge to defend their lands goes beyond life itself.

name: Dark Snowfall Daggers
description: If you've ever wanted your very own snowstorm, carry around these icy daggers!

name: Dark Sorceress Chakram
description: A type of handmade dreamcatcher crafted from gorillaphant tusks that if placed above their owners in their sleep would listen to a soothing poem in the dark sorcerers' native language, but would you feel differently about it if you were told the poem is actually distressing prophecy if translated?

name: Dark Stabbers
description: These daggers glow of blood red in anticipation of feeding on your foes. The taste for your enemies flesh linger on the tip of these blades.

name: Dark StarkCaster Dagger
description: I know nothing, Hero, except that… I am the StarkCaster in the darkness. Night gathers, and now my eternal watch begins. It shall not end until my death. I shall always serve the Undead Legion.

name: Dark Sting
description: When spelunking, it's always smart to pack a set of daggers. You never know what dangers maybe lurking around the corner, waiting…watching. Parts are color custom.

name: Dark Styx
description: Now you can /rock through the battlefield as hard as Ray!

name: Dark Talons of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Magical claws bind to your hands giving you the tearing power of a void beast.

name: Dark Talons of Nulgath (AC)
description: Magical claws bind to your hands giving you the tearing power of a void beast.

name: Dark Undead Assassin Swords
description: Slice and dice your living oppenents when you wield these undead assassin blades!

name: Dark Undead Leader Swords (AC)
description: Symbols are power. The mere sight of the fearsome blade will tame the even the wildest wills of the restless dead.

name: Dark Undead Leader Swords (Legend)
description: Symbols are power. The mere sight of the fearsome blade will tame the even the wildest wills of the restless dead.

name: Dark Void Paladin Katanas
description: The bursts of electricity that spiral down the blade will deliver a "shocking" blow to the foolish who dare challenge you.

name: Dark Winter Hexer Orbs (0 AC)
description: Channel the power of blizzards and black ice to destroy your enemies!

name: Dark Winter Hexer Orbs (AC)
description: Channel the power of blizzards and black ice to destroy your enemies!

name: Darkblood Eviscerator Daggers
description: Disembowel Checklist: Sharp Daggers - Check Enemy - Still Searching. To operate these arm blades, click the top of the hilt to extend the blade and click the bottom of the blade to access its magical glyphs.

name: Darkblood Keydaggers
description: The key to victory is SUFFERING!

name: Darkblood Nulgath Hammers
description: A new nation bows to Nulgath… and an army of Darkblood Warriors battle in the name of the Archfiend!

name: DarkFrost BattleAxes
description: An axe forged to hack through stone frozen dragon scales. It was reforged with those same scales, and becomes a deadly weapon used to maim lost hunters and misplaced dragons.

name: DarkFrost Commander's BattleAxes
description: An axe forged to hack through stone frozen dragon scales. It was reforged with those same scales, and becomes a deadly weapon used to maim lost hunters and misplaced dragons.

name: DarkFrost Commander's Reavers
description: Exiling is rare in Northland communities. Only the gravest of crimes would force the hand of judgment to throw the guilty into the unforgiving tundra. Those who survive change into monsters, and the weapons they used to hunt beasts are then turned on former kin.

name: DarkFrost Reavers
description: Exiling is rare in Northland communities. Only the gravest of crimes would force the hand of judgment to throw the guilty into the unforgiving tundra. Those who survive change into monsters, and the weapons they used to hunt beasts are then turned on former kin.

name: DarkLord PaladinSlayer DarkBlades
description: TECHNICALLY THEY'RE LIGHTBLADES BUT WHAT PALADINSLAYER IN THEIR RIGHT MIND USES ANYTHING WITH THE WORD LIGHT IN IT?

name: DarkLord PaladinSlayer DarkSabers
description: TECHNICALLY THEY'RE LIGHTBLADES BUT WHAT PALADINSLAYER IN THEIR RIGHT MIND USES ANYTHING WITH THE WORD LIGHT IN IT? (Spins in combat)

name: Darkness Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Darkness!

name: Darkon's Debris 14
description: You didn't get Fa's scythe, but she let you have half of it.

name: Darkon's Debris 2020
description: 2 rats 2 furious.

name: Darkon's Debris 319 Dual
description: This emergency tool will be of help whenever the bunny patting goes wrong. Can also be used for monster slaying if you're into that kind of gig.

name: Darkon's Debris 4.1
description: It's almost summer, and now you're ready to slice some fruits!

name: Darkon's Debris 4.2
description: A pink sticky note on it reads: "I'll let you borrow these since I have no use for them right now ;) - Re"

name: Darkon's Debris 508 Dual
description: What you're looking for is closer than you think.

name: Darkon's Delicious Daggers
description: NOM NOM NOM

name: Darkon's Double Fried 1952
description: Darkon's Double Fried Turdraken… one for each fist.

name: Darkovian Carryon Cutters
description: You'd think hitting the Darkovian beach would turn you into a bloody mess, but that's where the fun is!

name: Darkovian Noble Daggers
description: *No description*

name: Darkovian Shell Piercers
description: You'd think hitting the Darkovian beach would turn you into a bloody mess, but that's where the fun is!

name: Darksided Fiend Blades
description: A deadly blade sheathed in darkness. It slays the enemies of the Nation silently, letting their pieces sink into the Void.

name: Darkstar Shards Daggers
description: These shards burst into light when activated, blinding your enemy.

name: Darkwave Violin and Bow
description: Time to kill it with the Cruxshadows!

name: Darkwolf Bandit's Swords
description: Hmm… there's something familiar about these bandit blades. (Imported from DragonFable.)

name: Darkwood Carved Armaments
description: The toy maker didn't expect this kind of request, but put their full effort into the project as always. They hope the rowdy kid that gets this as a gift will use it responsibly.

name: Dawn Vindicator Swords
description: As a recruit gains more knowledge, they are able to move up a rank and wear the Dawn Vindicator gear.

name: Dayak Battle Gear
description: Ancestors of the Dayak warriors once lived in the Celestial Realm, but now make the island of Nunsatara their home. They protect their people and the land they've come to love

name: Dead Aim Guns (AC)
description: A Darkness Necromancer student's prize project, that was easily stolen from them by a pirate. They kill and instantly raises targets into undead minions.

name: Dead Aim Guns (Legend)
description: A Darkness necromancy student's prize project, which was easily stolen from them by a pirate. They kill and instantly raises targets into undead minions.

name: Dead Knight Armaments
description: Your blade is made of solidified Darkness. Your shield is made of harded terror and can stop any blade, every arrow. You are a Dead Knight, a member of the elite forces of Darkness!

name: Deadly Fan
description: Beautiful and Deadly! Like a model slash ninja.

name: Deadman's Decapitator (Dagger) (AC)
description: Careful in the carnival, you just might lose your head.

name: Deadman's Decapitator (Dagger) (Legend)
description: Careful in the carnival, you just might lose your head.

name: Deadsea Scalpers
description: Not one of Naval Commander Vordred's favorite tools. They shave way to much off the top, and he's left with pieces of what would have been perfectly good SKULLS.

name: Death Drives (AC)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of these blades is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Death Drives (Legend)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of these blades is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Death's Culling Pistols
description: Guns like this are boring to the Horseman of Death. Like the operas he enjoys, the deaths he prefers are slow burns. A bullet ends things way too quickly and impersonally. If Lord Dage has Death in a hurry, this'll have to do.

name: Death's Dual Culling of the Sea (0 AC)
description: Out at sea, death comes easily. Some are born, and instantly go cold. The anguish of sailors stranded on broken wooden planks, slowly perishing, exposed to the elements, is embodied by these cruel looming blades.

name: Death's Dual Culling of the Sea (AC)
description: Out at sea, death comes easily. Some are born, and instantly go cold. The anguish of sailors stranded on broken wooden planks, slowly perishing, exposed to the elements, is embodied by these cruel looming blades.

name: Death's Requiem Axes
description: A rare soulforged weapon that honor the dead. Inhabiting this axe are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Death's Requiem Blades (AC)
description: Rare soulforged weapons that honor the dead. Inhabiting these blades are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Death's Requiem Blades (Legend)
description: Rare soulforged weapons that honors the dead. Inhabiting these blades are souls who relinquished their right to a peaceful afterlife. They empower the wielder with their strength, and destroy those that would defy death.

name: Death Scythe of Nulgath
description: Nulgath empowers you "Iron Scythe of Nulgath" creating this deadly weapon of the Abyss.

name: Deathknight Dagger
description: Legend says that a brave Knight would run around Lore with the same set of daggers. Unfortunately for him, the weapon's name was changed after a certain incident…

name: DeathMonger Accoutrements
description: Does any one really need to dual wield THAT much ferocity? Who could be so bloodthirsty? DeathMongers--that's who.

name: DeathMonger Mace Accoutrements
description: The perfect weapon set for the horcish DeathMonger who just isn't satisfied with victory--they demand, and expect, total annihilation.

name: Deathwalker Executions (AC)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Deathwalker Executions (Legend)
description: There is no force greater than death. Use it to dominate your enemies.

name: Debris 297 Blades
description: Do you know what true emptiness is? There is no light. Not even a space for the darkness to fill the sun's absence. Will you trust in fate, or take control of your own destiny? The choice is yours.

name: Debris .45 Revolvers
description: The odds of these custom-made .45 caliber revolvers turning you mad increase each time you fire them. But in the interest of bringing love and peace to the world… you should risk it.

name: Debris Commander's Cutlasses (AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim,Accessory.)

name: Debris Commander's Cutlasses (Legend)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim,Accessory.)

name: Debris Commander's Guns (AC)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim,Accessory.)

name: Debris Commander's Guns (Legend)
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture. (CC to Trim,Accessory.)

name: Debris Commander's Pistols
description: YARRRR! When ye sail through seas of madness, ye cannot know what debris ye'll salvage. Only the bravest Commanders are willin' t' risk their sanity (and their crew) on such an uncertain venture.

name: Debris Death Book and Pens
description: A harmless looking notebook. Following its rules down to the details will allow you to shape your own reality, one sacrifice at a time.

name: Debris Pens
description: Considering what Debris actually is, don't start chewing on them if you start spacing out.

name: Decima Renders
description: In the Underworld, fate is flexible. Stray too far into the Land of the Dead, and these blades will cut your fate short. All that are claimed by the Sentinels belong to the Lord of the Legion.

name: Deeprage Daggers
description: Bones of long dead creatures, warped by the darkest magics into blades of wicked beauty.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Blades
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Dark Guns
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Light Guns
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: DeepSea Star Pirate's Shooties
description: DeepSea Star Pirates study the creatures found only in the brightest seas and the darkest of abyssal waters. They vow to use their power to protect all of the creatures that make the trenches their home.

name: Default Dagger
description: Dagger

name: Default Daggers of Awe
description: This slightly-used but still AWE-some set of daggers is for adventurers who haven't quiiiite finished their quests to create all of the Items of Awe.

name: Defiant Rogue Daggers
description: This matching set of daggers signify that you are a member in good standing of the Lore Rogue's Guild. You don't have to pay your monthly dues… they picked your pocket when you weren't looking.

name: Defilers of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged these swords using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Deity Daggers
description: A pair of jewels encrusted daggers. The craftsmanship and edge are fit for any higher power.

name: Dekanor's Dual Disparia (AC)
description: Named for the Great Dragon of Darkness, the dream of all Legion Dragonlords. None of them know what the real Dekanor looks like, so the face adorning these blades is but a fantasy.

name: Dekanor's Dual Disparia (Legend)
description: Named for the Great Dragon of Darkness, the dream of all Legion Dragonlords. None of them know what the real Dekanor looks like, so the face adorning these blades is but a fantasy.

name: DeleteQ's Dual Shadow-letter
description: Spear in one hand, sword in the other. No need for a shield when you only in attack mode.

name: Deleuze Ice Axes (AC)
description: The style of these ice axes imitates the style of the marauders the Deleuze Tundra claimed when it was silent snow. Now awakened, the Winter Void hunts the same way those ancient barbarians did.

name: Deleuze Ice Axes (Legend)
description: The style of these ice axes imitates the style of the marauders the Deleuze Tundra claimed when it was silent snow. Now awakened, the Winter Void hunts the same way those ancient barbarians did.

name: Deleuze Ice Blades (0 AC)
description: Cut and carved from the living Fiend Tundra known as the Deleuze, the blades share a mind with the Winter Void. They take pleasure in freezing and shattering foes.

name: Deleuze Ice Blades (AC)
description: Cut and carved from the living Fiend Tundra known as the Deleuze, the blades share a mind with the Winter Void. They take pleasure in freezing and shattering foes.

name: Delicate Snowflake Rapiers
description: The Court of the Winter Fae enjoy the dramatics of romance and duels. It is tradition for the duelists to have their weapons created by the ice magic of their heart's desire. A delicate snow flower made these rapiers.

name: Deliverances of Agony
description: The tides of love and war overlap. Dull blades that once belonged to a forgotten traveler awaken, furious and alone. They seeks to spread an agony that destroys language and cuts a wounded, scorned warrior to the core.

name: Delta V Disks
description: A pair of chakrams originating from the alien planet of Delta V. Looks like you're ready for an epic dual duel!

name: Deluxe Ermine Staff (0 AC)
description: The real master of this staff is the ermine wrapped around its crystal. It holds powerful transformation magic that can allow beasts to walk among men.

name: Deluxe Ermine Staff (AC)
description: The real master of this staff is the ermine wrapped around its crystal. It holds powerful transformation magic that can allow beasts to walk among men.

name: Demented Doom Dagger
description: Found during the battle for control of the Underworld, who knows what these daggers will be capable of.

name: Demonic Dual Doujikiri
description: The blades of an exiled OniSlayer Empress. She died, betrayed and abandoned. Her vengeful spirit haunts the katanas. Now the coveted weapons of the Four Oni Lords, they seek the blood of those they once protected.

name: Demonmalice
description: A combination of Demonshriek mace and the Malice shield. The amount of hurt these can deal to your enemies will have them shrieking for you to stop.

name: Deprived Blood Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: As it taints the armor of paladins with their own blood, the blade darkens to black and dissolves back into the sea's darkness.

name: Deprived Blood Cutlasses (AC)
description: As it taints the armor of paladins with their own blood, the blade darkens to black and dissolves back into the sea's darkness.

name: Desaturated Brush and Shield
description: Paint the town… black and white?! No no no! You must get the paintball gun and fill Battleontown with COLOR!

name: Desert Black Moon Blades
description: A weapon styled after the shape of the waning moon's shadow. As it hangs over the Sandsea, the worst of its monsters creep out of the desert. These blades await their challenge.

name: Desert Hound Knives
description: When all else fails, you need to trust in old fashioned steel.

name: Desert Hound Kukris
description: When all else fails, you need to trust in old fashioned steel.

name: Desolate Duel Axes
description: Good for chopping wood and enemies down.

name: Destiny Blade and Shield
description: A shield for protection, and a glowing sword for attack. May you never lose the Light!

name: Destiny Mace and Shield
description: A shield for protection, and an electrified mace for attack! You will never lose the Light with this weapon in your hand!

name: Destroyers of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged these axes using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Destructo-Tacos
description: Unleash the almighty wrath of DOUBLE TACOS!

name: Devoured Sinner's Blades
description: Forgotten with time, this once formidable blade has been overgrown with mother nature's "gift". the thorns on the vines help compensate for lack of a sharp edge.

name: Devouring Sea's Blades
description: In the silence of the depths, you hear whispers. Or is that the chewing of flesh? Even the leviathans of the sea will one day fall, and the scavengers tear what they can from it. Just like how you made this blade from a rotting Titan.

name: Diabolical Armorbreakers
description: Forged to tear into metal plating like paper, the blade bypasses your foe's skills, talent, and experience. Time and effort become meaningless, and what remains is left to rot.

name: Diabolical Cane Sword
description: Travelling the dark seas requires you to not only take charge of your crew but to prove your worth. Only the most dedicated of the Diabolical fleet are granted the title of Admiral — wear it with pride.

name: Diabolical Coffins
description: You hear whispers and sense yearning from within these sanctified caskets. Their voices cloud your mind. Rumors say that only those with incredible strength can awaken what sleeps within.

name: Diabolical Delinquent Bats
description: Something tells me that you won’t be hitting home runs with this bat. Let’s just hope whoever on the other side of this bat will also respawn.

name: Diabolical Flintlocks
description: An elaborate flintlock, perhaps more so for decoration than actual use, it's still good enough to blast a hole through your foes.

name: Diabolical Gargoyle Armaments
description: With these armaments in hand, venture into the menacing unknown. You become what the beasts fear, and nothing will get in your way.

name: Diabolical Resolutions
description: This overclocked keyblade will have eldritch beings with little time left on this plane, I don't think it supports WiFi though.

name: Diabolical Sinner's Blades
description: A sword formerly held by no one of consequence, this blade from another realm will guide you to salvation.

name: Diabolical Warden's Katanas
description: Two ornate katanas, with pure silver blades, perhaps they’ll be stained with a different color once their use is up.

name: Diamond Polaris Blades (AC)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Diamond Polaris Blades (Legend)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Diamond Pyre Blades (AC)
description: A fire fueled by the diamonds from the Fiend's Void burn hot enough to melt bones. Only those with greed that burns even harder can wield these weapons.

name: Diamond Pyre Blades (Legend)
description: A fire fueled by the diamonds from the Fiend's Void burn hot enough to melt bones. Only those with greed that burns even harder can wield these weapons.

name: Diamond Pyre Hammers (AC)
description: These hammers have living jaws that bite and tear diamonds out from the mutated scapes of the Void. Though they're meant to chew through flesh, they mashe stone and steel just as easily.

name: Diamond Pyre Hammers (Legend)
description: These hammers have living jaws that bite and tear diamonds out from the mutated scapes of the Void. Though they're meant to chew through flesh, they mash stone and steel just as easily.

name: Diamond Rings
description: Diamonds are a ten on a scale of hardness. They won't get scratched when you need to throw down to protect your dearly beloved.

name: Die BlutSpuckers
description: Each shot uses a pint of blood, and the gun has a habit of shooting on its own without warning. Try not to be wasteful.

name: Digital Terror
description: It looks like Vampire Max has just released the hottest hand-held SmartScythes in all of Lore! Download yours today!

name: Dimmed Overdriven Knight's Blades
description: Wrenched out of the dark, these blades has been blessed with divine Light. Redemption can be yours if you promise your body and soul.

name: Dire Daggers
description: Bet you thought there was going to be a DragonFable joke here, huh?

name: Dire Delusions Blades
description: Blades drenched in dark power, once dragged through the belly of its master's Lord. This is a law of the land. Power must be passed on. Eventually, the wielder will become a mentor themselves. (Changes in combat)

name: Dire Delusions Katanas
description: Blades drenched in dark power, once dragged through the belly of its master's Lord. The severance of loyalty gives deeper depths to the shadows powering the katana.

name: Disarmed Daggers
description: I got to hand it to you…

name: Disciple's Bleached NecroStaff + Book
description: Treat your tricky enemies with the deadliest threat they'll ever see… the LAST thing they'll ever see.

name: Disciple's NecroStaff + Book
description: Treat your tricky enemies with the deadliest threat they'll ever see… the LAST thing they'll ever see.

name: Disease Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Disease!

name: Dissonant Espressivos

name: DOUBLESMASH Hammers
description: It might be heavier than it looks because it was originally used in the tribal rituals, but if you can lift it with ease, you will be viewed as the strongest in the Bloodtusk Region.

name: Dracolich Tinsel Carvers

name: Draconian Vindication Axes

name: Draconic Cardbroadswords
description: Your blades will never truly break, so long as the arts and crafts store keeps having that sale on tape every weekend.

name: Draconic Daggers of Tercessuinotlim (0 AC)
description: The mountains where Nulgath has created his fortress are filled with various Dragons, Wyrms, and assorted other creatures. Unlike the DragonSlayers, these Dragon Tamers do not kill these creatures, but tame them to their will. Probably so they can set them upon all of Nulgath's enemies.

name: Draconic Extinction Array (0 AC)

name: Dragon Dicers

description: Decisive blades, unburdened by fear, hope, or will. They strike faster than lightning, stopping hearts long before rivals realize they're dead. They seek to cut the core of the world next.

name: Dual Abyssal Tenkaen
description: No one knows who forged these forbidden creations. They were sealed in a shrine that quickly became abandoned, left to rot and decay. The Kami within began to whistle, luring foolhardy warriors that still had the delicious will to fight.

name: Dual AeroFrost Katanas
description: Gundahar, famed Northlands Hunter and Smith, forged this blade from the frozen breath of a dire beast terrorizing helpless villagers in the Northlands.

name: Dual Akiban Katanas
description: An upper echelon of the warrior class, the Akiban Samurai defends the Empress and the land from evil. Their warcry is: "For honor, for the Isle, and for the Empress!"

name: Dual Akiban Shuriken
description: An upper echelon of the warrior class, the Akiban Samurai defends the Empress and the land from evil. Their warcry is: "For honor, for the Isle, and for the Empress!"

name: Dual Alchemical Onyx Katanas
description: Katana crafted by Bido fusing Onyx and Baltic Ambar together using Alchemical Runes.

name: Dual Alien Chakrams
description: This chakram was founded on an alien world when used in close combat it splits in half to be used as a dagger!

name: Dual Alteon's Pride
description: This gold and alabaster sword is appropriately named for its regal design. Proof of your dedication to Swordhaven and the surrounding areas.

name: Dual Amethyst Crystal Axes
description: If the summer's excessive humidity deals damage to your HP, then an ice crystal scepter like this is an ideal for cooling off and dealing with pesky fire elementals. Just don't stare too closely at its center.

name: Dual Anagenesis
description: Swords made from your own flesh, mutating, transforming, and growing. Together, you and the Arcana evolve, taking fate into your own hands, and turning it into divine weapons.

name: Dual Ancestral Dao
description: Golden blades are wielded by the protectors of the Royal Family. During the Lunar New Year, a Jade Descendant blesses them with fortune and protection. A hint of their unique magic manages to slip in, too.

name: Dual Ancient Legion Axe
description: One Ancient Legion Axe just isn't enough sometimes… double the axe-tion, double the fun!

name: Dual Ancient Wanderer's Long Guns
description: This wanderer has traveled far from his home port in the Sandsea. How he ended up here, we may never know.

name: Dual Androktasia (AC)
description: Blades carried by the Willbreakers of the Underworld's Phlegethon. The weapons contain a portion of their soul to ensure a 'deeper experience.' They can feel the sensation of cutting into bone and flesh more intimately.

name: Dual Androktasia (Legend)
description: Blades carried by the Willbreakers of the Underworld's Phlegethon. The weapons contain a portion of their soul to ensure a 'deeper experience.' They can feel the sensation of cutting into bone and flesh more intimately.

name: Dual Angelic Lightnings
description: You've discovered how to call lightning? Make sure you remember its name. (Gives 5% more gold and 5% bonus against Undead when equipped)

name: Dual Angler Rapiers
description: Stabs most elegantly.

name: Dual Ankh Athames
description: Fun sized version! Perfect for scraping dragon scales and shreds of lavazard skin off your face.

name: Dual Apocalyptic LichKing's Axes
description: With an army of undead, you can destroy the world… all you need to do is create it!

name: Dual Aquatic Warrior's Fans (Legend)
description: Awash in love and loyalty, Aquatic Warriors have pledged to follow the Avatar of Water until the very seas run dry.

name: Dual ArachnoFury Blades
description: Sling around the web fighting villains and staying away from newsmen who demand pictures.

name: Dual Arachnotana
description: The big black spider, made a web on the tree. It was big and round, until you sliced it up with a sword.

name: Dual Arata Gamer Bats (AC)
description: The gear a gamer uses can make the difference between victory and defeat!

name: Dual Arata Gamer Bats (Legend)
description: The gear a gamer uses can make the difference between victory and defeat!

name: Dual Arcane Dark Caster Pistols

name: Dual Arcane DataKnight Claws
description: Battle alongside the Dragons of Time as you attempt to command the universe!

name: Dual Arcane Pirate Cutlasses

name: Dual ArchFiend Warrior Champion Swords

name: Dual ArchFiend Warrior Swords
description: Warriors of the ArchFiend serve the darkness, Evil, but above all… they serve their Master, Nulgath!

name: Dual Avenger's FlintLocks (0 AC)

name: Dual Avenger's FlintLocks (AC)
description: The life of a privateer is a hard one, but rewarding. Please the Crown and riches will find you… but not without bloodshed and battle.

name: Dual Axes of Shadows
description: Using spells calling on the Shadow, these Battlemages are feared throughout the brighter parts of Lore.

name: Dual Cyan Zappers

description: A hunter whose heart is truly frozen by winter's skin-numbing bite can hold such a blade with no further handicap. It may be as light as paper, but it can slice glaciers as if they are citrus fruit.

name: Dual Dark Tiger's Claw (Special)
description: These are a bit more comparable to tiger claws than swords.

description: The only acceptable length from which to pet a tiger

description: As the Dark Hand Behemoth's streak of bloody victories increased, they grew stronger, larger, and their thoughts became consumed by battle. To the master of this blade, this is the proper evolution of their kind.

name: Dual Darkblood Katanas

name: Dual Darkon's Debris 6
description: Perfect for cutting up big fish to serve as sashimi. Might have been used on humans before, but don't sweat the small stuff. (Boost: 12% more damage to all monsters when equipped + chance to summon comets)

name: Dual Darkovian Pirate Knives (AC)

description: What is undead can never die, and what was born of two worlds, and rejected by both… will NEVER forgive and NEVER forget. Werepyrates will RULE Darkovia and the Midnight Seas!

name: Dual Enchanted Kitsune Katana (0 AC)

name: Dual Enchanted Kitsune Katana (AC)

description: Katanas wielded by one of the founders of the Yokai Isles' royal family. Their golden edges radiates with purity, having been washed in the blood of a powerful dragon.

name: Dual Enchanted Omnia Mortis

name: Dual Enchanted Serpent Hulusi

name: Dual Enchanted Shinobi Katanas

name: Dual Enchanted Void Axes
description: From the depths of Tercessuinotlim, there were always whispers of a Void so powerful, only Nulgath himself knew of their existence. Now they've come out of the shadows. (This armor set was inspired by fellow AQW player Crab).

name: Dual Energized Veselago
description: Energy blades of mysterious make. The handles were found entombed in metal, and seemed to come alive when struck by lightning.

name: Dual Enraged Fiend's Bane
description: Dage has many enemies but the ArchFiend is his most lethal. These hunters are trained for the soul purpose of destroying the Nation.

name: Dual Epiphany of Eudaimonia
description: The Lord of the Underworld forged gifts for the Oraculi, engraved with one of the lessons he learned sitting in on a debate. The scholars pursued knowledge for its own sake, attaining a constant state of contentment even in death.

name: Dual Epsilon Veselago
description: Energy blades of mysterious make. The handles were found entombed in metal, and seemed to come alive when struck by lightning.

name: Dual Eternal Chakrams

name: Dual Evil J-Sixth Lord Blades
description: "It is not necessary to lie to achieve anything of value. A skilled Sixth-Lord is nearly impossible to defeat."

name: Dual Exalted Apotheosis

name: Dual Excavated Glaive: Sword

name: Dual Eye Of Astaroth Blades
