description: If the summer's excessive humidity deals damage to your HP, then an ice crystal scepter like this is an ideal for cooling off and dealing with pssky fire elementals. Just don't stare too closely at its center.

name: Dual Laser Daggers
description: Four laser blades in two! Your enemies better be prepared with laser-quick reflexes or you'll skewer them with the power of light!

name: Dual Laser Hanzamune Blades
description: A legendary blade crafted by the greatest Yokai swordsman, Hanzamune, in which the sword is named after. It is a great honor to wield this century-old sword.

name: Dual Lava Rock Knuckles (0 AC)
description: "Fire to strengthen, fire to blind, fire to scorch the unwary mind…" Ignus warriors draw strength from the barely-tamed molten trapped inside cooled lava rock.

name: Dual Lava Rock Knuckles (AC)
description: "Fire to strengthen, fire to blind, fire to scorch the unwary mind…" Ignus warriors draw strength from the barely-tamed molten trapped inside cooled lava rock.

name: Dual Lead Purgatorio Coins
description: These aren't the coins you're looking for.

name: Dual Legendary Broodfiend Blades
description: Infect the world with Nulgath's darkness and bring strength and victory to the Nation!

name: Dual Legendary Magma Sword
description: An ancient blade forged in the pits of a volcano, that has been destroyed or forgotten. Until now because Quibble Coinbiter has for sale!

name: Dual Legion Cutlass
description: Slay your foes, me hearty… DOUBLE TIME!

name: Dual Legion DoomBlade
description: Even Sepulchure would be envious of this DoomBlade. (Has a chance to do the Shadowburst animation when equipped.)

name: Dual Legion Doombringer
description: The weapon of choice for wrecking the halls.

name: Dual Legion Fans
description: *No description*

name: Dual Legion Fiend's Bane
description: Having the blades crafted from the finest metal ores in the Styx River and also from the bone dusts of the dead fiends, this sword carries a threatening reminder to all Nation Fiends who are preparing to battle a Legion FiendHunter.

name: Dual Legion FiendHunter Blades
description: Having the blades crafted from the finest metal ores in the Styx River and also from the bone dusts of the dead fiends, this sword carries a threatening reminder to all Nation Fiends who are preparing to battle a Legion FiendHunter.

name: Dual Legion Flesh Ripper
description: Drawn for you LIVE by Dage The Evil!

name: Dual Legion Officer Blaster guns
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PVP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Dual Legion Operative's Guns
description: Legion Operatives move stealthily through the shadows, carrying out Dage the Evil's dark work in silence.

name: Dual Legion Pirate's Cutlasses
description: Maybe one day you will be a Pirate Captain…

name: Dual Legion Pride Cleaver E
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Dual Legion Pride Cleaver P
description: Nightwraith and the AdventureQuest Worlds team hope you enjoy this (item type), brought over to AQW to celebrate 10 years of adventures, battles, and PvP victories in EpicDuel!

name: Dual Legion Soul Devourers
description: A sharp yet enchanted blade, capable of absorbing the soul of your defeated enemies. It works as a core, sending the soul essence directly to yours.

name: Dual Legion Symbiote's Rage
description: The parasite infecting this armor was created especially for Dage's Legion. Now truly be one with the Dark Lord.

name: Dual Legion Vampire Scythe
description: Legion Vampires are unlike any other. Brutal, remorseless, and cruel, Vampires brandish this monumental scythe as a fair warning to anyone foolish enough to cross their path.

name: Dual LeoSpire Royalty Kris
description: The lion symbolises three of LeoSpire's greatest national values: courage, excellence and strength. May you always embody these as you battle through Lore!

name: Dual Leviasea Sword
description: The energy coursing through the futuristic blade crystallizes into particles that dance around the hilt. Crafted by Veneeria.

name: Dual Leviathan Slayer's Slashers
description: The Leviathan lurks deep beneath the dark waters of the Styx in the Underworld. Rarely has it been seen, and NEVER slain. Until now.

name: Dual Leviathan Warrior Tridents
description: These leviathan patrol the deeps making sure that none enter their most sacred spaces.

name: Dual Lich Bone Slicers
description: Designed by necromancers from the Necropolis, these weapons were crafted in the Doom Cauldron for undead assassins. Made from bonesteel!

name: Dual Light Prismatic Katana
description: An ivory blade that proves its wielder to be an honorable Hero on the Island of Yokai. Color custom base, trim, and glow!

name: Dual Lightedge Shuriken (0 AC)
description: The Future Legion's steel consumed weapons that were once made entirely of bone. Which wretched mine produced such a strange and alien material?

name: Dual Lightedge Shuriken (AC)
description: The Future Legion's steel consumed weapons that were once made entirely of bone. Which wretched mine produced such a strange and alien material?

name: Dual Lightning Lich's Strikes (AC)
description: "Good is a point of view, Hero."

name: Dual Lightning Lich's Strikes (Special)
description: "Good is a point of view, Hero."

name: Dual Lightning Slashers
description: Call down the lightning and summon thunder to terrify your foes with these daggers from Twilly's Spring Seasonal 2013 shop!

name: Dual Lightning Strikes (AC)
description: ''Good is a point of view, Hero''

name: Dual Lightning Strikes (Special)
description: "Good is a point of view, Hero."

name: Dual Lightstrike Energy Blades
description: The gleaming blade is made up of pure energy, capable of giving your targets a world-class sunburn on strike.

name: Dual Lilith Katana
description: A mystic katana from the para-elemental plane teeming with incalculable amounts of raw magic.

name: Dual Loathing of Múspell
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Dual Loathing of Surtr
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Dual Lovesick Infernal Murakumo
description: A thunderous katana that calls down lightning with each beat of your heart. (Click to transform)

name: Dual Loyal Alloy Tourne
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master of their kin.

name: Dual Loyalty Blade of the Nation
description: Nulgath smirks. Then tells you this blade is unpredictable. It was forged with unstable energy. Though you can wreak incredible devastation the sword can also betray you…

name: Dual Lucevan Le Stelle
description: These sparkling blades of festive wishes hide a darker story. A Knight tried to save his Lady from a wedding she didn't want. He was caught, and sentenced to death. The Noblewoman wished for a miracle, but the stars fell too late.

name: Dual Lucky Caladbolgs
description: Top o' the morning to ya Legion gombeens. Feeling lucky today?

name: Dual Luminous Beam Blades
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Dual Luminous Mikazuki
description: Katanas wielded by one of the founders of the Yokai Isles' royal family. Their golden edges radiates with purity, having been washed in the blood of a powerful dragon.

name: Dual Lunaris Axes
description: Embedded with blessed moon rock, these dual axes harness the power of the symbolic troll in the moon.

name: Dual Lusè Shu Katanas
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these Ninja are celebrating!

name: Dual Lycan Spirit Katanas
description: Not just an blade will take down Vampirates, the spirit blade is blessed with many ancient warnings.

name: Dual M4tr1x Commander's Cutlasses (AC)
description: Tales tell that these pirates be unlucking flying under the colors of Cyber Monday but no one has found their booty yet. So who's really the unlucky one?

name: Dual M4tr1x Commander's Cutlasses (Legend)
description: Tales tell that these pirates be unlucking flying under the colors of Cyber Monday but no one has found their booty yet. So who's really the unlucky one?

name: Dual Mace of Purified Souls
description: A half-purified, but still mighty mace that could smite the light and darkness alike.

name: Dual Mace of the Grand Inquisitor
description: Intending to eliminate heresy. The Inquisitors were so intimidating, even the innocent would admit guilt. Therefore, sealing their fate.

name: Dual Maces of Light
description: Using spells calling on the Light, these Battlemages are feared throughout the darker parts of Lore.

name: Dual Maces of Shadows
description: Using spells calling on the Shadow, these Battlemages are feared throughout the brighter parts of Lore.

name: Dual Magma BlazeBeard Cutlasses
description: Blazebeard, known as "the dread pirate of Drakonus," is the most notorious pirate to sail the Seven Seas. But with the Magmanacles, he is now strong enough to expand his control BEYOND the water.

name: Dual Maleo Keris
description: The Keris blades are thought to have a real, tangible presence about them. Each one has its own individual self, with their own separate abilities. Like people, no two are exactly alike.

name: Dual Maleo Kujang
description: Wielding this dagger makes you feel preternaturally quick, as though you're wielding the wind itself.

name: Dual Maleo Mandau
description: This sword is the essence of the word "weapon." Just holding it feels strangely satisfying, like giving an old friend a firm handshake. This is a blade that is waiting to be used.

name: Dual Mammoth Crusher Blade
description: Striking someone with this massive blade is like hitting someone with a mountain!

name: Dual ManaShaper's Blades
description: Legends says the glacial core for this was stolen from the Ice Queen Aisha.

name: Dual Manslayer of Taro
description: Nulgath teaches you how to dual wield Taro's Manslayer.

name: Dual Mary's Blaster Bomb (AC)
description: The life of a privateer is a hard one, but rewarding. Please the Crown and riches will find you… but not without bloodshed and battle.

name: Dual Mary's Blaster Bomb (Legend)
description: The life of a privateer is a hard one, but rewarding. Please the Crown and riches will find you… but not without bloodshed and battle.

name: Dual Masquerade Fans
description: When the Blood Moon rises the Masquerade calls.

name: Dual Matrix Hanzo Void Katana
description: You are a Horror, slashing through the Matrix, killing all in your sight.

name: Dual Maximillian's Whip
description: Whip it, this whip is good. The classic bull whip is good for everything from taming lions to escaping ancient temples.

name: Dual Melon Chappals
description: Sometimes you just have to slap someone with a flip-flop or two.

name: Dual Merciless Ensis
description: A simple ritual tool that punishes souls who attempt to escape the Underworld. It reminds the dead that they can still feel pain. Though it originated in Legion forges the living are also keen on keeping the dead buried.

name: Dual Mercy's Touch (AC)
description: Intentionally blunted blades that inflict horrendous pain on both the living and the dead. Their name comes from their final touch, which puts their master's victim out of their misery.

name: Dual Mercy's Touch (Legend)
description: Intentionally blunted blades that inflict horrendous pain on both the living and the dead. Their name comes from their final touch, which puts their master's victim out of their misery.

name: Dual Midnight Hanzo Void Katanas
description: The Archfiend provides you with a second blade as he knows you aren't good enough to win with one. Gives +15 Class Points when equipped.

name: Dual Mighty Sword of the Dragons
description: Like a real dragon, this sword is able to scorch your enemies with the flame it emits.

name: Dual Miners Hands of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite gold digging destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Dual Mirrored Katanas
description: A stealthy ally in the fight against Chaos.

name: Dual Misericordia
description: A simple blade that once belonged to the current General of the Cocytus. It's ab act of mercy, honoring worthy foes with death instead of cursing them with eternal undead servitude.

name: Dual Molten Lunara (AC)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, these blades will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with them.

name: Dual Molten Lunara (Legend)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, these blades will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with them.

name: Dual Molten Solara (AC)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, these blades will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with them.

name: Dual Molten Solara (Legend)
description: Forged with the heat of an erupting volcano, these blades will burn through the earth to return home. A careful warrior must be on guard, lest they be dragged into the lava floes with them.

name: Dual Monsterborn Blades
description: Nothing is so dangerous that it can't be conquered and controlled.

name: Dual Monsterlord Blades
description: In a different world, a different timeline, Drakath -- Champion of Chaos -- would have been the MonsterLord, heir to the Queen of Monsters. But this is not that world, and he has seized his own power, and his own destiny.

name: Dual MonsterLord Reavers
description: In a different world, a different timeline, Drakath -- Champion of Chaos -- would have been the MonsterLord, heir to the Queen of Monsters. But this is not that world, and he has seized his own power, and his own destiny.

name: Dual Morning Stars
description: It's great for bashing in your enemy's shiny armor. Hmmm… seems the Zardman boss holds another unique mace now.

name: Dual Mors Certa
description: One of the many soul forged weapons in Slaine's arsenal. The death of his enemies are certain, but the hour it arrives is not. The Legionnaires of the Acheron prefer to wring every last scream from their prey. That's the joy of the living.

name: Dual Mountain Breakers
description: These weapons are perfect for the dwarf who can't smash things fast enough.

name: Dual Mystic Sigil Blades
description: Tap into the darkness that flows through the Underworld to enhance your power and become one of Lore's most powerful magic users!

name: Dual NaNdroid General Sabers
description: The Galactic NaNdroid General is noted for their ruthlessness in battle. The very name strikes fear into the heart of those who travel through the lands of the Galactic Federation.

name: Dual Necronus Plasma Gun
description: A ray gun that is coated from the shiniest and polished metal found on Necronus, allowing it to stay in good condition in the intensity of a rigorous fight for fame and fortune. Its beaming rays may turn other types of metal to sand.

name: Dual Necrotic Commander's SoulGun
description: Unlife is cruel. But sail with a good crew and yer afterlife will be richer than your mortal life ever was!

name: Dual Necrotic Commander's SoulPistol
description: Unlife is cruel. But sail with a good crew and yer afterlife will be richer than your mortal life ever was!

name: Dual Necrotic Dao of Doom
description: Weapons made to establish the Yinglian Dynasty. They remain as empty vessels yet to meet their Emperor and Shadow. Once they obtain both, they will have the power to cleave the sun in two.

name: Dual Necrotic Swords of Doom
description: The darkness compells… DOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOOM!!!!!

name: Dual Neuling Brandt
description: Balanced and durable blades meant for adventurers who've just made the switch from wood to steel. The Dwarves make a lot of them, but each is forged with care. This is the start of someone's dream, after all.

name: Dual Neuling Stahlschwert
description: Greatswords meant for bulkier beginners. These are usually forged for Dwarves who're looking for new horizons, but regularly given to humans and Drows that like carrying bigger sticks.

name: Dual Nightborn Cutlass
description: In the night, shadow creatures stalk near the rift - but is their goal to break it? Or become one with it?!

name: Dual Nightborn Sword
description: Even though Riftbreakers disguise themselves as rift monsters, using their fists to fight them is extremely dangerous as the chances of getting poisoned increases.

name: Dual Nightmare Hunter Pistol
description: Kill your fears with bullets, silver and iron. Just remember to point it at a nightmare, and deal with reality with your own hands.

name: Dual North Star Brilliance (AC)
description: In the cold isolation of the north, only the stars will witness your bravery. They shine for you, piercing the darkness.

name: Dual North Star Brilliance (Legend)
description: In the cold isolation of the north, only the stars will witness your bravery. They shine for you, piercing the darkness.

name: Dual Not so nICE Axes
description: You don't play nicely with others, you say? Well two chilling axes should help confirm that statement!

name: Dual Nova Fomalhaut
description: Golden replicas made in the image of one of House Noelle's ancestral armaments. It's said that stars used to visit the Yew Mountain Chain. They saw the flames, and fluttered closer like moths, melting into interstellar steel.

name: Dual Oathbreaker Cutlasses
description: Some of the fiercest and deadliest pirates to sail the straights of Lore. You do not want to fall onto their bad side, those who have took a long walk off a short plank.

name: Dual Oblivion Blade of Nulgath
description: This mysterious, living blade has destroyed innumerable lives. You know of only one who has had the power to wield it, the old one. And now you may wield it's power and live to tell about it… for now.

name: Dual Oblivion of Nulgath Maces
description: "Simple mortal, you do not control me, I simply fight for you because Nulgath demands it!" It's good to have Oblivion fighting on your side. Even if not willingly. Pick him up and swing away!

name: Dual Obsidian Katanas (AC)
description: Yokai's Royal family has had a long time of samurai warriors to defend and protect them in times of battle.

name: Dual Obsidian Katanas (Special)
description: Yokai's Royal family has had a long time of samurai warriors to defend and protect them in times of battle.

name: Dual Octopirate Rapiers
description: The sword of the Octopus Captains!

name: Dual Omnia Mortis
description: Nihil interit. Everything dies, nothing perishes. All life ends, but they leave their mark. The soul persists. Dage forged this blade, and gave it to the General of the Acheron to slay those who sully this law.

name: Dual Oni Katanas
description: This blade has witnessed much bloodshed over the years but also trained many worthy successors such as Taro the Manslayer.

name: Dual Oni Soul Kama
description: The Oni believe that the divide between them and human beings is paper-thin. When night falls and violence reigns, enraged farmers become indistinguishable from Oni in revelry.

name: Dual Oppression Katanas
description: These swords are of Shadowfire make, standard issue to the infantry of the dynasty. Quick and powerful, they were the terror of the ancient world.

name: Dual Orb Weaver Axe
description: This axe is powered by an enchanted spider who never leaves the blade. The axe's spider poisons its enemy with black magic before feasting on their very life essence!

name: Dual Overfiend Blade of Nulgath
description: Nulgath, Abyss General's monstrous form is the result of his original form shifting to another reality. His sword has also shifted.

name: Dual Overfiend Cutlasses
description: So ye be join' the Nation's crew? Dun think he'll be goin' any easy on ye scurry rat then Dage would. Nulgath will do more than simply lock ye in the brig. Serve him well.

name: Dual Overlord's DoomBlade
description: Forged in the style of Sepulchure's own sword, the OverLord's DoomBlade houses not one but several darkness elementals reacy to tear into anything in their path.

name: Dual Painadin Shadowreapers of Doom
description: Painadin Overlords are a powerful asset in Alteon's army. Their axes are coated in poison from RedDeath Swamp, to speed up their victim's conversion to Alteon's army.

name: Dual PainBlades
description: Be careful not to slice yourself on the edge of these noxious blades. It'll bring you closer to being under Noxus' power!

name: Dual PainSaw of Eidolon
description: An ancient haunted artifact once belonging to an Evil Lord of the Undead Legion. Its wielder shall forever be cursed by the spirit dwelling within…

name: Dual Paladin's Demise Pistol
description: MORE PALADIN SKULLS. YARRRRRR!

name: Dual PaladinSlayer's Star Swords
description: MORE PALADIN SKULLS. YARRRRRR!

name: Dual PaladinSlaying Cutlasses
description: MORE PALADIN SKULLS. YARRRRRR!

name: Dual Paladinum Beams (AC)
description: Remember: in a fantasy game, it's always a good idea to bring a Blaster Beam to a blade fight, so become the Iron Warrior you never expected to be!

name: Dual Paladinum Beams (Legend)
description: Remember: in a fantasy game, it's always a good idea to bring a Blaster Beam to a blade fight, so become the Iron Warrior you never expected to be!

name: Dual Paragon Fiend Blades
description: When the minions harvest souls for Dage, not all are used. The Paragon fiends feed on the some of the discarded to gain more strength and power.

name: Dual Party Slasher Birthday Sword
description: Birthday presents too hard to open? No problem; slash through them with this! A present given on AQW's 1st Birthday! Color custom Trim and Base!

name: Dual Pearl Dust Shuriken
description: Shuriken dusted with ground up pearls from deep sea oysters. There is a belief that this substance poisons the victim's dreams. Though the target survives the first cut, they slowly succumb to endless nightmares.

name: Dual Pencil of Endless Scribbles
description: Zorbak traded you this for his I.O.U note. If the pencil is mightier than the sword… then DRAW your weapon!

name: Dual Phantom Elegance Rapiers
description: The festivities for Heroes Heart Day have just begun, get ready to have some holiday fun!

name: Dual Phoenix Blade of Nulgath
description: Nulgath twists the powers within the Phoenix Blade to bend to your will. It is now under your control.

name: Dual Pirate Mage Cutlasses
description: Small traces of a deadly disease course through the hilt of the cutlass. Initially pacifists, pirate mages often sheathe them to avoid endangering their mates. If they were attacked, that's when they'll break out their lethal cutlasses.

name: Dual Pirate Mage Flintlock
description: For those pirate magi who prefer actual guns to staffs.

name: Dual Plasmatic Daggers
description: A poisoned dirk greatly treasured by the cryptkeepers in the Eergcast Catacombs for it contains a slow-acting, fatal venom that can either corrupt a willing soul or kill an unwilling soul. One of these dirks are usually found in discarded tombstones spread out around the catacombs.

name: Dual Platinum Axe of Destiny
description: A gift from Artix for help testing something big.

name: Dual Platinum ShadowFire Katanas
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Dual Platinum ShadowFire SkullBringers
description: Civilization in the Shadowlands is centered around one thing - protect the Lords. When you wear this gear, none will dare cross you.

name: Dual Poleaxes of Shade
description: Using spells calling on the Shadow, these Battlemages are feared throughout the brighter parts of Lore.

name: Dual Pony Gary Yellow Toy
description: RROAARRRRRRRRRR! *squeak*

name: Dual Power Saws
description: I'm twice the lumberjack and double the OK…

name: Dual Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath
description: Nulgath teaches you to dual wield your "Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath."

name: Dual Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath (Rare)
description: Nulgath teaches you to dual wield your "Primal Dread Saw of Nulgath". (Rare)

name: Dual Primal Hanzo Void Blades
description: These imperial Voids of Nulgath's army possess qualities that normal primal Voids do not have, hence why they are prized by the ArchFiend.

name: Dual Prince of Dragon's Blade
description: The silversmith that created this sword was known to be a savant artist on the battlefield and from the comfort of his forge, therefore, he merged beauty and brute strength into one masterpiece.

name: Dual Prisma Orb of Victory
description: Freedom. Equality. Liberty for all!

name: Dual Prisma Spear of Victory
description: Freedom. Equality. Liberty for all!

name: Dual Prismatic Deathdealers
description: This blade's edge is so sharp that a skilled wielder can cut through the fabric of space and time. That means that if you fall to this sword, it is technically possible that you will die yesterday.

name: Dual Prismatic Destiny Sabers
description: We've included 376 color crystals in this saber so you can have unlimited color possibilities! The only setback is it weighs 90 pounds. Sorry.

name: Dual Proto Sabers
description: *No description*

name: Dual ProtoSlasher Mk6
description: You unlocked this weapon by purchasing the Future Legion Logo t-shirt from heromart. Evil salutes you!

name: Dual Pumpkin King's Nocturne
description: An eldritch touch made humble pumpkins evolve, and fostered a hunger for supremacy. Smash the competition! There's only room for one to grow!

name: Dual Pumpkin King's Revenge
description: An eldritch touch infected the Pumpkin King, overwhelming it with the urge to grow big enough for its shadow to fall over the moon. You ended its evolution prematurely, and had its desire for revenge sharpened into blades.

name: Dual Pumpkin King's Twilight
description: An eldritch touch infected the Pumpkin King, overwhelming it with the urge to grow big enough for its shadow to fall over the moon. You ended its evolution prematurely, and had its desire for revenge sharpened into blades.

name: Dual Pumpkin King's Wrath
description: An eldritch touch made humble pumpkins evolve, and fostered a hunger for supremacy. Smash the competition! There's only room for one to grow!

name: Dual Punk Coal Elf's Stabbers
description: It's a punk rock Frostval, and the Frostval trees are decorated with safety pins.

name: Dual Purified Claymore of Destiny
description: Nulgath teaches you to wield the "Purified Claymore of Destiny".

name: Dual Pyroclastic Beast's Rage (0 AC)
description: ﻿You've captured two flames from the Lavarock Hydra's enraged attack, and tamed them JUST enough to serve you as a weapon. Be careful they do not escape your control.

name: Dual Pyroclastic Beast's Rage (AC)
description: ﻿You've captured two flames from the Lavarock Hydra's enraged attack, and tamed them JUST enough to serve you as a weapon. Be careful they do not escape your control.

name: Dual Pyroclastic Mage Staves
description: Only the most powerful mages are strong enough to survive the molten waves of rage, fury and power that flow through the veins of a Pyroclastic mage.

name: Dual Pyroclastic Pistols (0 AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as an Pyroclastic pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Dual Pyroclastic Pistols (AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as an Pyroclastic Pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Dual Quarter Moon Axes
description: If swung quickly at hardened ice while its owner sprints, the ice splits into two pieces and the blade barely gets a scratch. Ice picking just got hardcore.

name: Dual Radioactive Blasters
description: See that glow? That's nuclear. Warning, not responsible if you turn into a giant radioactive mutant.

name: Dual Radioactive Rods
description: See that glow? That's nuclear. Warning, not responsible if you turn into a giant radioactive mutant.

name: Dual Ragnarok
description: Acquired by Dage the Evil, this sword is said to bring light to the darkness. Hidden away from the world, Dage now sees no threat from this magical weapon and is willing to sell it to the highest bidder.

name: Dual Raider's Cutlasses
description: Avast! The seven seas need plunderin' and set sail from Lolosia and fight the mighty kracken while searchin' for treasure!

name: Dual Railbows
description: Aim for the heart to guarantee instant love at first sight. Take caution for more than one blast can get your crush unhealthily obsessed with you. Ouch.

name: Dual Rainbow Star Polearm
description: Takes the term double rainbow to epic status.

name: Dual Rainbow Starswords
description: It's power level is OVER 9000. (And gives 25% more gold when equipped)

name: Dual Rampage Katanas
description: Slice those vegetables evenly or become the next dish on the menu.

name: Dual Rapier of Skulls
description: You do NOT want to know how this blade was made… or who from!

name: Dual Rapiers of Reaping
description: The rule of the rose, protect beauty and gentleness with your thorns. What were once white petals were inevitably dyed crimson red.

name: Dual Reawakened Ataraxia
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Dual Red Rose Blades
description: Sharper than the thorns on a rose.

name: Dual Red Zappers
description: Pew, pew! Ka-pow!

name: Dual Redemption Revolvers
description: You want gun-blades? I'll give you gun-blades, and you'll use them to take down all the steampunk cowboys and aliens that are headed at you this Friday the 13th!

name: Dual ReignBringers
description: Forged by the ancients of Alnaphar.

name: Dual Resistors
description: You won't be able to resist charging at your enemies when you have THESE awes-ohm weapons equipped!

name: Dual Resurrected Ataraxia
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Dual Reversed Chaos Backstabbers
description: You may follow Chaos, but that does not mean you can't do it in STYLE!

name: Dual Reversed Snow Hanafuyu
description: Blades that were forged under a persimmon tree in spring. They belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Dual Reviled Androktasia (Legend)
description: An evolved form of the Legion torturers' most coveted blades. These swords contain a portion of the Executioner's soul to ensure a 'deeper' experience. They feel the sensation of their blade slicing through a neck as if it's their own.

name: Dual Reviled Androktasia (Non-Legend)
description: An evolved form of the Legion torturers' most coveted blades. These swords contain a portion of the Executioner's soul to ensure a 'deeper' experience. They feel the sensation of their blade slicing through a neck as if it's their own.

name: Dual Revived Ataraxia
description: In an act of reconciliation, Lord Dage retrieved the souls of Legionnaires who fell because he betrayed their expectations. The forgiven rebels are forged into weapons, awaiting the day when they'll be ready to regain their bodies.

name: Dual Riftbreaker Cutlass
description: Break the Rift to save the world! The queen MUST not be allowed to let her creatures take control.

name: Dual Riftbreaker Sword
description: Even though Riftbreakers disguise themselves as rift monsters, using their fists to fight them is extremely dangerous as the chances of getting poisoned increases.

name: Dual Risen Auras
description: These Celestial beings were the original creations by Arthelyn when she created the realm.

name: Dual Risoluto
description: This divine spear has the power to absolve any demonic creature of their sins.

name: Dual Rocks
description: Everybody wants a rock to wind a piece of string around, and everybody wants a rockin' rock to swing around town! Rock on!

name: Dual Ronin Katanas
description: You stand for honor. You fall to no one. With 2 faithful color-custom Katanas at your side, unleash what you've learned from the Samurai and prove victorious no matter the challenge!

name: Dual Royal Convalescence
description: Blades born from the dreams of the Unsung. They are the crown, yet they also play the knight. This new World may have taken everything from them, but the slate has been wiped clean. The future can hold anything. Everything.

name: Dual Royal DragonKing Blades
description: The goldsmith that created this sword was known to be a savant artist on the battlefield and from the comfort of his forge, therefore, he merged beauty and brute strength into one masterpiece.

name: Dual Royal Raider Cutlasses
description: A cutlass gleaming with gold that was found inside a wooden chest locked away in an isolated grotto near Dwarfhold Mountains. Legend has it that its user could detect gold coins and valued treasures by how bright it gets.

name: Dual Runes of Darkness
description: Using the power of the Shadows, these mages serve Gravelyn and the ShadowScythe in the battle against Malgor.

name: Dual Runes of Light
description: Using the power of the Shadows, these mages serve Gravelyn and the ShadowScythe in the battle against Malgor.

name: Dual Saber of Ebilness
description: Fear ir is the path to darkness. With this you will feel the power of darkness.

name: Dual Safiria's Spirit Orb
description: Long-gone as she may be, Safiria will always be with those who have been truly loyal to her during the reign. May her spirit guide her chosen ones into darkness.

name: Dual Sandsea Naval Pistols (0 AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: Dual Sandsea Naval Pistols (AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: Dual Sandwich Cookies
description: NOM NOM NOM! This cookie sandwich with carmel filling is the perfect treat for a hungry hero looking to reward himself after battle. One of Oishii's favorite recipes.

name: Dual Sanguine
description: Fused with the heart of its previous owner, the Sanguine thrives on the blood of its victims.

name: Dual Sapphire Wish Khopesh
description: In Sandsea legends, the eye of fate is sky blue, and casts its gaze on those whose wishes will come true. This weapon was forged with sapphires, meant to guide their wielder to their destiny.

name: Dual Satria Keris
description: The attire of Nusantaran noble warriors who believe it is their duty to serve and protect their people.

name: Dual Satria Kujang
description: The attire of Nusantaran noble warriors who believe it is their duty to serve and protect their people.

name: Dual Savage Resolution
description: Blades forged from stone. They're engraved with runes that seal the wielder's true strength and savagery. Once shattered, the Void Brawler's unceasing hunger for destruction will swallow everything.

name: Dual Scarab Fiend Scimitars
description: Scarab Bloodrunners were once among the Sandsea's greatest warriors. Once they swore allegiance to Nulgath and embraced a new role as Fiends, they became some of his fiercest defenders.

name: Dual Scorpion Stingers
description: This dagger is made from two scorpion tails. Just as effective if it were alive.

name: Dual Screaming Knives
description: There are certain times of year when the need to SCREAM (and make others do it too) is totally ok!

name: Dual Sea King's Arabella (AC)
description: Magnificent blades offered to seafarers who carve their legends into history. The oceans have their lions, Kings among pirates who prowl the waves in gallant ships,

name: Dual Sea King's Arabella (Legend)
description: Magnificent blades offered to seafarers who carve their legends into history. The oceans have their lions, Kings among pirates who prowl the waves in gallant ships,

name: Dual Sea King's Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Avast! These pillaging Captains raid the sea for its vast bounty. The more decorated their swag be, the more treasure they've plundered!

name: Dual Sea King's Cutlass (AC)
description: Avast! These pillaging Captains raid the sea for its vast bounty. The more decorated their swag be, the more treasure they've plundered!

name: Dual Sealed Katanas
description: A Yokai Summoner most be careful when using their power. Spirits may look harmless at times but only an experienced Summoner may exorcise them.

name: Dual SeedSpitter's Vine Blade
description: Don't be fooled by all those "good for you" organic warning labels on your food (and enemies). Seedspitters are proof that nature can AND WILL kill.

name: Dual SeedSpitter's Whip
description: Don't be fooled by all those "good for you" organic warning labels on your food (and enemies). Seedspitters are proof that nature can AND WILL kill.

name: Dual Seishin Oni Katanas
description: The faint glow is brought on by the surrounding yurei which gives the blade its power.

name: Dual Sentinel's Katanas (AC)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Dual Sentinel's Katanas (Legend)
description: The Jaan serve as the guardian spirits of the Djinn Realm. If you want to proceed you must pass their trials.

name: Dual Sepulchure's Undead Blade
description: This sword hungers for destruction… are you sure you can control such dark energy?

name: Dual Seraphic Flintlocks
description: One shot, two shot, three shot VICTORY!

name: Dual Seri Gumum Slayer Blades
description: From out of the depths, the Sei Gumum rises to attack! Only the fiercest heroes have ever managed to slay these dread beasts.

name: Dual Seri Gumum Slayer Edges
description: From out of the depths, the Sei Gumum rises to attack! Only the fiercest heroes have ever managed to slay these dread beasts.

name: Dual Severed Mullion (AC)
description: When the fallen's souls split, the two qualities that defined them most solidified and sharpened. Violence and purity were refined in Dage the Evil's forge.

name: Dual Severed Mullion (Legend)
description: When the fallen's souls split, the two qualities that defined them most solidified and sharpened. Violence and purity were refined in Dage the Evil's forge.

name: Dual Shadow Claymores
description: Such a behemoth of a blade is capable of trembling walls down to rubble in one swift slash, allowing the capture of a potential hostage or escaped prisoner to be a piece of cake.

name: Dual Shadow Dragon Blades
description: Once thought to be a relic of the past, these defenders of the great Shadow Dragon have returned. But for what, that is not known.

name: Dual Shadow Fangs
description: The "bite" of this fang will leave quite a mark.

name: Dual Shadow Hanzo Void Katanas +20
description: You are a Shadow Assassin, slashing through the night, killing all in your sight. (Gives 20% more XP when equipped!) Suggested by fellow hero, Jams Loyal Subject!

name: Dual Shadow Ronin Katana
description: Strike with the force of a thousand samurais and the quickness of the wind.

name: Dual Shadow's Aura Orb
description: Sorcerers who support the Shadowscythe are among the deadliest in Lore. Hiding their faces, they move among the rest of the army without anyone knowing who they are.

name: Dual Shadow SoulSeeker
description: Straight from Dage's Soulforge, and empowered by the rage and hatred of those who have passed on. This sword was made to stamp out all things good and beautiful.

name: Dual Shadow Spear of Nulgath
description: A spear forged from the shadows of the underworld.

name: Dual Shadow Terror Axes
description: This axe is imbued with shadow energy.

name: Dual Shadow Void Shogun Katana
description: These warriors once served a ruthless emperor until the Archfiend destroyed him. Selling their souls to Nulgath they now serve a new master.

name: Dual Shadow War-Mage Blades
description: Often hiding in the shadows, these seasoned war mages use the dark to heightened their power in battle.

name: Dual ShadowCaster Katanas
description: A simple swipe from its swift, light blade could wither the grass, kill the trees, and evaporate the rivers. It is that power a Doom Caster is proud to possess and can use it without warning. If you care strongly about life, keep that blade sheathed and only use it when absolutely necessary. Suggested by player Lilith

name: Dual ShadowFlame Firebender Blades
description: Malgor's fury has been transmuted into power that ShadowFlame Firebenders can manipulate as easily as they do Lore's mana.

name: Dual Shadowforce Energy Blades
description: The gleaming blade is made up of pure energy, capable of giving your targets a world-class sunburn on strike.

name: Dual ShadowLight of Doom (0 AC)
description: This weapon does 5% more damage to Humans, Chaos, Dragons, Horcs, and Elemental monsters when equipped.)The darkness of the ShadowScythe seems to overflow from this weapon.

name: Dual ShadowLight of Doom (AC)
description: This weapon does 5% more damage to Humans, Chaos, Dragons, Horcs, and Elemental monsters when equipped.)The darkness of the ShadowScythe seems to overflow from this weapon.

name: Dual ShadowReapers Of Doom
description: The darkness from this weapon seems to overflow..

name: Dual ShadowRipper Blades
description: Helpful for sneaking through the shadows in Ebonslate.

name: Dual Shadowsleigher Kringlemesser
description: SLAY bells ring, are you listenin'? (Your opponnents are, because it means you're here, and they're DOOMED!)

name: Dual Shadowworn
description: The shadows wear away at your soul… and your sanity!

name: Dual Shamrock Fans
description: These open when you attack!

name: Dual Sharpened Bamboo
description: Never underestimate the power of a sharpened bamboo pole in the hands of a trained warrior.

name: Dual ShatterBone Axes
description: As Vordred once said, "MORE SKULLS!"

name: Dual Shatterfrost Blades
description: You'll be as cooooooool as ice with this frosty blades.

name: Dual Shatterglass Katanas
description: Made of pure ice, this katana will freeze the hearts of your enemies… before it pierces them!

name: Dual Shenlong Qiang
description: A spear made for the kin of dragons, able to purify blood into water with a touch. It's why they can destroy life, guiltless and free. Their crimes turn into rain.

name: Dual Shinobi Katanas
description: Elite Ninja warriors wear raiment that allows them to move freely in any direction - so you never know from where they will attack!

name: Dual Shipwrecked Captain's Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Dual Shipwrecked Captain's Cutlasses (AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Dual Shipwrecked Pirate's Pistols
description: Once Captains of great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Dual Shortened Fiend Maces
description: Slamming that heavy mace onto a body os water will freeze it solid, hence why the apprentice cyromancer proudly uses his weapon, human or elemental.

name: Dual Shu Ninja Katanas
description: It is the Year of the Rat, and these colorful Ninja are celebrating!

name: Dual Sickles of Gathering
description: A great farming tool for gathering the herbs for your potions.

name: Dual Sickles of the Eternal Dragon Warrior
description: Sometimes just one blade isn't enough… and sometimes you need four!

name: Dual Siege Mauls
description: Attack Swordhaven? That's a-poundin'.

name: Dual Silver Corsair Cutlasses
description: These buccaneer's buccaneers never back down from a fight, now whether they fight fair is another question.

name: Dual Silver Shotguns
description: A blast through the chest, and you're to blame. Undead UndeadSlayer, you give irony a bad name.

name: Dual Silver Wing Dagger
description: The handle is forged of the hardest rock found in the desert. The blade is made of sand packed so tightly together it forms an edge sharp enough to cut steel. Take the fury of the Sandsea with you at all times!

name: Dual Siren's Misery (0 AC)
description: Engraved on the cutlass is the woeful song of a Siren. It calls the living to join her in death. Your foes will find themselves drawn to the edges of these bitter blades.

name: Dual Siren's Misery (AC)
description: Engraved on the cutlass is the woeful song of a Siren. It calls the living to join her in death. Your foes will find themselves drawn to the edges of these bitter blades.

name: Dual Sketchy Cutlass
description: This weapon hat looks pretty sketchy to me. ( But then, what would you expect from gear you found inside a Sketchy Dragon?)

name: Dual Sketchy Guns
description: This weapon hat looks pretty sketchy to me. ( But then, what would you expect from gear you found inside a Sketchy Dragon?)

name: Dual Skull Breaker
description: These colossal weapons are only qualified as daggers because your inventory requires it. They are actually swords. Giant, terrifying, and doom causing swords.

name: Dual Skull Half-Axes
description: MORE SKULLS!!

name: Dual Skullbreaker's Reaver
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS.

name: Dual Sky Ripper Kamas
description: For Draconic Yokai Assassins, these Kamas serves as both weapons and tools to climb castles. Witnesses claim that their edges are sharp enough to puncture the sky itself, allowing its wielder to vanish into thin air.

name: Dual Slasher's Knives
description: Sometimes you have to turn the tables on the monsters.

name: Dual Slashers of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend welcomes warriors of ANY race… especially one as deadly as an enraged werepyre.

name: Dual Slashers of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend welcomes warriors of ANY race… especially one as deadly as an enraged werepyre.

name: Dual Slashers of Shrade
description: /Slay your way through hordes of undead… and try not to SCREAM!

name: Dual Slime Ice Cream Cones
description: The deliciously menacing Baron Sundae with his magically sweet wares. Careful of the ice cream it might melt.

name: Dual Snake Katanas 13
description: COLOR CUSTOM: In the Zodiac, the Snake is exciting, collected and dark. They are smooth and never lose their cool. You need to be double cool to manage both of these weapons at once.

name: Dual Snow Hanafuyu
description: Blades that were forged under a persimmon tree in spring. They belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Dual Sockarangs
description: I guess using boomerangs as a sock holder is one way to make sure your socks always come back to you.

name: Dual Sol Accendo
description: Blades tempered by flames from distant nebulas, forged with the intent to burn hotter than the sun. These regal blade are highly unstable, and their wielder doesn't care if they reduce everything to ash, so long as they shine the brightest.

name: Dual Sol Gloria
description: Blades tempered by flames from distant nebulas, forged with the intent to burn hotter than the sun. The regal blades are highly unstable, and their wielder doesn't care if they reduce everything to ash, so long as they shine the brightest.

name: Dual Sol Imperator
description: Axes tempered by flames from distant nebulas, forged with the intent to burn hotter than the sun. These creations are highly unstable, but their wielder doesn't care if they reduce everything to ash, so long as they shine the brightest.

name: Dual Sol Intenso
description: Branched blades that resemble sunlight scattering through the trees. When plunged into the heart of dark creatures, they will spread light through their veins.

name: Dual Solar Pirate Cutlasses
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it. You're a Solar pirate go where those winds take you.

name: Dual Solaris Double-Sided Khopesh
description: The Solaris Clan is accompanied by the rays of the sun no matter where they go.

name: Dual Soul Harvester Spear
description: This spear was crafted by Death to kill the living immortals and collect their souls.

name: Dual Soul Rippers
description: Quibble says he found this sword on the battlefield after the second great war. Deathknights were known to wield such sinister weapons to steal their enemies souls…

name: Dual Soul Terror Sword
description: Spirits slain by this sword still haunt this blade.

name: Dual Souledge Shuriken
description: The Future Legion's steel consumed weapons that were once made entirely of bone. But, what are they doing here? Did they slip through a temporal anomaly?

name: Dual Soulreaper of Nulgath
description: Nulgath takes your signed contract in exchange for the "SoulReaper of Nulgath." You're excited, yet uneasy, as Nulgath goes on to say, "Enjoy! As it states in the contract you signed, you can owe me later for this."

name: Dual Spears of Nulgath
description: One can feel the pulse of energy that travels through this fearsome spear.

name: Dual Spiked Baetyl
description: Maces forged from a meteorite that somehow crashed into the Underworld. Rather than bless the wielder with astronomical power, they slowly enfeeble them with alien magic. Giving them to new recruits is a Legion inside joke.

name: Dual Spiked Gu Duo
description: A mace meant to crush bones and prevent movement, not to take life. Oft it is told in times of great strife, being forced to live on like this is a punishment in of itself.

name: Dual Spookjuice Bottles
description: Going to party like it's 1920! Time to scare up some fun.

name: Dual Stable Ghostly Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones' locker.

name: Dual Stable Ghostly Cutlasses (AC)
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they went far below Davy Jones' locker.

name: Dual Stalker's Blades
description: The Darknight Stalkers roam the frozen wastes of the dark north in search of any who have wronged their friends and family. Once found, they are swiftly — justly — punished.

name: Dual Star Slasher
description: Quibble hastily mentions something about Star.. fighters.. captains or was it pirates? All you know is Quibble wants to get rid of it fast so is willing to sell it for a bargain.

name: Dual Star Sword
description: This blade seems to harness the power of light itself. It's a force to be reckoned with.

name: Dual Star Sword Breaker
description: This weapon was crafted by a strange race of beings. It was designed to be the only weapon capable of fighting a Starsword, but it was lost before it could be put into production.

name: Dual StarWalker Light Blades (AC)
description: "You can't stop the change, any more than you can stop time from passing."

name: Dual StarWalker Light Blades (Special)
description: "You can't stop the change, any more than you can stop time from passing."

name: Dual Steel Maces (AC)
description: Save the world with a mace made of steel!

name: Dual Steel Maces (Legend)
description: Save the world with a mace made of steel!

name: Dual Stella dei Miracoli
description: These sparkling blades of festive wishes hide a darker story. A Knight tried to save his Lady from a wedding she didn't want. He was caught, and sentenced to death. The Noblewoman wished for a miracle, but the stars fell too late.

name: Dual Stella Fomalhaut
description: Silver replicas made in the image of one of House Noelle's ancestral armaments. It's said that stars used to visit the Yew Mountain Chain, and gave parts of themselves to those who braved the peaks to meet the heavens.

name: Dual Stelle Invernali
description: These sparkling blades of festive wishes hide a darker story. A Knight tried to save his Lady from a wedding she didn't want. He was caught, and sentenced to death. The Noblewoman wished for a miracle, but the stars fell too late.

name: Dual StoneCrusher Fists (AC)
description: For the times when you're trying to put that monster between a rock and a hard place.

name: Dual StoneCrusher Fists (Non-AC)
description: For the times when you're trying to put that monster between a rock and a hard place.

description: You probably found this simply lying on the ground waiting to be used.

name: Dual Street Beater Reversed Blades (Special)
description: You probably found this simply lying on the ground waiting to be used.

name: Dual Sublimated Gunslinger's Dragon Guns
description: Only the best guns for the best gunslingers!

name: Dual Sunlight Daggers
description: A tiny beam of sunlight is held within the metal of these daggers. Careful, it's hot!

name: Dual Super Scion Balls
description: Keep you kirin in hand…

name: Dual Super Scion Blades
description: Becoming a Super Scion is easy, it's the charging up that takes most of the time. Usually close to half an hour. Plus side is you'll look super cool!

name: Dual Superheated Stones Chakram (0 AC)
description: Some say the world will end in fire, some say in ice. From what I've seen of battles dire, I hold with those who favor fire. But if it had to perish twice, I think I know enough of hate to prefer ice.

name: Dual Superheated Stones Chakram (AC)
description: Some say the world will end in fire, some say in ice. From what I've seen of battles dire, I hold with those who favor fire. But if it had to perish twice, I think I know enough of hate to prefer ice.

name: Dual Swanhild's Revenge (AC)
description: Upon the unhonorable slaying of their kin, all members of the Frostlorn Clan are duty-bound to take brutal revenge. The snow will fall red upon the defiler's lands forevermore.

description: Upon the unhonorable slaying of their kin, all members of the Frostlorn Clan are duty-bound to take brutal revenge. The snow will fall red upon the defiler's lands forevermore.

name: Dual Sweet Harvest Treats
description: Delicious, not nutritious, but exactly the reward a hero wants after a long hard Harvest battle!

name: Dual SwiftShift Knight Blades
description: Hand crafted swords for a skilled swordsman.

name: Dual Tachyon Blades
description: Dual wield the Tachyon Blades to cut through space and time! Your enemies will NEVER catch you now!

name: Dual Tainted Claymore of Nulgath
description: Nulgath teaches you to dual wield the "Tainted Claymore".

name: Dual Techno Hanzamune Blades
description: A legendary blade crafted by the greatest Yokai swordsman, Hanzamune, in which the sword is named after. It is a great honor to wield this century-old sword.

name: Dual Technobrawlers
description: Slash them with the sharp edge!

name: Dual Tempest Flintlock
description: She be a li'l scab, but no fear'n, she packs a might mighty wallop.

name: Dual Tenebral Beam Swords
description: Without darkness, there can be no light. Tenebral Warriors know that darkness is not always evil. It is a force of nature as powerful, fundamental, and natural as any other element.

name: Dual Tenebris Flails
description: This is a weapon you definitely don't want to be on the receiving end of.

name: Dual Terosin
description: Never let a kill go to waste -- so your fellow player Terosin believes! A massive pair of blades crafted from the bony remains of many unfortunate beasts.

name: Dual TheWicked
description: Are you Evil enough to wield this blade?

name: Dual Thronetaker's Blade
description: This was taken from a fallen contender for the throne of the Underworld. It is ancient and pulses with a malevolent power.

name: Dual TimeReaper Blades
description: Where Drakath goes the TimeReapers follow. Have to help keep the timelines clean!

name: Dual Toxic Bloodletters of Nulgath
description: Your thirst for bloodshed has been quenched. But there's always room for seconds… and thirds… and more…!

name: Dual Toxic Knight's Blades
description: While wandering through Lore, Bido came across a set of Knights that had become corrupted by a horrible toxin. Needless to say, he just had to grab their gear!

name: Dual Toxic Naval Pistols
description: Avast! Who knows what kind of sludge these pirates sailed into… whatever it was, it was pure toxic!

name: Dual Toxic Void Katanas
description: Nulgath is pleased by the creation of this katana in his honor. Arcane weaponsmaster Zee the Legend has done well!

name: Dual Tranquility
description: Yarrr! Your name - and your skill with a cutlass - will live on in infamy. FOREVER.

name: Dual Tribal Chieftains Hands of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite Bloodtuskers with this giant hand!

name: Dual Truly Cursed Legion Blades
description: Those who've wielded this cursed blade have all met a grisly end. And you won't be the last.

name: Dual Turbine Sabers
description: With this wand, winning all your battles will be a breeze!

name: Dual Ugly Stick
description: There's quite a few monsters that have already been beaten with this.

name: Dual Ultra Instincts of Nulgath (0 AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend welcomes warriors of ANY race… especially one as deadly as an enraged werepyre.

name: Dual Ultra Instincts of Nulgath (AC)
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend welcomes warriors of ANY race… especially one as deadly as an enraged werepyre.

name: Dual Ultra Switch Katanas
description: Sometimes… Size matters….. When it's about swords.

name: Dual Ultrasoaker 9001
description: The ultimate after-school weapons. Guaranteed A+ fun… but maybe don’t bring it into the library.

name: Dual Umbral Blades
description: Surrounded by demonfire, these blades will send the souls of your opponents to the Underworld.

name: Dual Unarmed
description: Can you say martial arts? Now your HANDS are the deadly weapon!

name: Dual Unconquerable Anicetus
description: Named after a Warrior that sacrificed themselves to seal an endless war that wages in the realm of the dead. No soul, dead or alive, can pass these blades unscathed. Leave the lost to their fates.

name: Dual Undead Legion Cutlass
description: Slay your foes, me hearty… DOUBLE TIME!

name: Dual Undead Plague Spear
description: A mere scrape from this vile weapon is deadly.

name: Dual Underworld Angelos (0 AC)
description: Small flames carried by a single soul from one side of the Underworld to the other. They led scores of lost souls back from the abyss, and sharpened into blades that reveal all paths in the nether.

name: Dual Underworld Angelos (AC)
description: Small flames carried by a single soul from one side of the Underworld to the other. They led scores of lost souls back from the abyss, and sharpened into blades that reveal all paths in the nether.

description: To gain access to the Underworld you must defeat one of the many Generals which roam the forsaken land looking for souls to harvest.

name: Dual Underworld Reavers
description: Slice 'em up, Legion style.

name: Dual Unstable Katanas +5
description: The gold for this was mined from Dwarfhold so it is of the highest quality.

name: Dual Urban Serpent Hulusi
description: Instruments made for delicate fingers and refined taste. It takes skill to mix traditional music with modern flair.

name: Dual Vampiric Crimson Sensu
description: Elegant accessories designed to capture the sophistication and mystery of the Yokai Isles' Vampiric visitors. They playfully hide their fangs behind the fans, enjoying evening strolls.

name: Dual Vampiric Midnight Sensu
description: Elegant accessories designed to capture the sophistication and mystery of the Yokai Isles' Vampiric visitors. They playfully hide their fangs behind the fans, enjoying evening strolls.

name: Dual Vampwing
description: A Devious Darkovian Scythe embedded with Shadow Slayer essence, able to slay all polymorphic humans. A design inspired by Outlaw13th.

name: Dual Vector Helaine
description: Feared blades that welcome the embrace of the storm. If they're stabbed into the ground, the land will be struck by lightning until the soil turns into charred ashes. They're named after King Gaheris' Queen, which did little to please her.

name: EarthVessel Rapiers
description: Rapiers wrapped in vines. When the noble courts of humans and Fae used to mingle, they'd conduct honorable duels for titles, domains, and names.

description: Forged from impeccable code generated by AI. EbilCorp does not take responsibility for any laws broken by this weapon.

name: EbilNet Signs
description: Someone took a wrong turn and ended up in the Tester Town.

name: Ebon Chaos Katanas
description: These katanas can slice through anything, but excessive use may cause chaorruption.

name: Ebon Chaos Revolvers
description: Made of blackened steel and chaos, these guns are also perfect for destroying chaorrupted monsters!

description: Life, memory, scars, grudges, everything in this world is temporary. The realm of the dead will have it all, and those who resist will bleed.

description: The blades of an Immortal Lich King that was used to give up their own Kingdom in an exchange for an empire of the dead. One can not rule with absolute power if they're weighed down by a heart.

name: Edges of Chaos
description: Blades with ancient etchings, carved to mimic leylines flowing into a humanoid body. Chaos invades its veins, fusing seamlessly, as if it were meant to.

description: Down in the deepest depths of the Underworld are warriors so feral and fiendish, those foolish enough to battle them are never seen again.

name: Eidolon Wings Rapiers (AC)
description: Weightless rapiers with a crossguards styled after a Vampire's elegant bat form. In exchange for a significant offering of blood, the weapons can cure the maladies of old age.

description: The Scale refer to these weapons as 'skin tags.' They appear at random, growing from empty spots in the garden. Taking the shape of lost swords, these 'lifeforms' lure unsuspecting victims into fusing with them. (Grows larger in combat)

name: Eldritch Twilight Daggers

name: Electrifying Zilla Purses

name: Electrifying Zilla Volleyballs
description: They're made of tough monster hide, and woven to match your outfit. So if they get stuck in shark teeth or fall in lava, no biggie!

name: Elemental DragonSlayer Polearm + Shield

name: Elemental Guardian's Blades
description: Blades with ancient etchings, carved to mimic leylines flowing into a humanoid body. Mana flows easily through the crevices, able to ignite into any element.

name: Elemental Rune Daggers

name: Empire Bloodguard's Blades

name: Empire Fleet Flintlocks
description: ﻿The handle of these pistols writhes in your grasp. Sooner or later, it'll fuse with the skin of your palms.

name: Empowered Bloodletter

name: Empowered Ungodly Reavers

name: Empyrean Chronomancer Daggers

Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence. To tap into this strength requires particular insight though.

name: Enchanted Acheron Soul Cleavers

name: Enchanted Ageless Necrorunes

name: Enchanted Akiba-kei Gatling Guns

name: Enchanted Akiba-kei Havoc Hammers

name: Enchanted Akiba-kei Mini Hammers
description: Wreak some havoc with hammer buddies that can't stop making faces.

name: Enchanted Beach Mischief Gear (0 AC)

description: These blades, wielded by Malakai the Contract Enforcer of Nulgath, severs the ties between lackluster fiends and the Nation. The katanas destroy their contracts, and their souls.

description: Your negative emotions are being ejected from the timestream, like a mortal's body getting rid of toxins. Combined with your power, a new form of life has been created… and has evolved.

name: Eternal Sovereign Guard's Armaments
description: In depictions of the Sovereign, what looks to be a crown or a halo adorns their neck. The spears of the Guards wear the same crown, a symbol of the Eternal's divinity.

name: Eternal Sovereign Guard's Blades
description: The armor and weapons of the Guard were forged in the image the Eternal Sovereign described in myth and legends. To emulate their Sovereign, the Guards too seek to dispel myths and legends.

name: Evacuation Protocol Utana + Sheath
description: These umbrella katana looks silly until the acid rain starts to fall.

name: Evacuation Protocol Utanas
description: These umbrella katanas look silly until the acid rain starts to fall.

name: Evader Daggers
description: These stone blades symbolize greatness amongst the Horc tribe, connecting Evaders to their primal roots. The red tribal sun painted on the stone represents unity between Evaders and the Earth.

name: Eventide Sorcerer's Offense Runes
description: A rune can give your spells flair, or add a little oopmh to a well-placed throat punch.

name: Eventide Sorcerer's Runed Broom
description: Stealing someone's broom isn't a joke. The rune either curses the thief, or blesses them for the audacity.

name: Everlasting Dual Misericordia
description: Perhaps this life didn't offer enough, or took everything it gave. A DeathSworn Knight, dissatisfied or scorned by their lot, sacrificed what little they have left to pursue power through slaughter. This is a mercy available to the lost.

name: Evoker of Souls
description: A pair of devious daggers created from strange organic materials not from this world. Perhaps Evokersoul may be able to provide some of this weapon's history?

name: Evolved Bloodletters of Nulgath
description: With twice the pain it inflicts, its owner will never go down without a fight ever again at the price of their hearts.

name: Evolved Butcher Knife
description: Good for cutting up dinner.

name: Evolved Fiend Talons
description: After years of powering up, Nulgath's Fiend has evolved!

name: Evolved Grenadier Blasters
description: This time you're the one yelling "Bombs Away!"

name: Evolved Scythe And Book
description: When one ascends beyond the mere raising of bones, then one can be called Evolved.

name: Evolved Staff And Book
description: When one ascends beyond the mere raising of bones, then one can be called Evolved.

name: Exalted Duality
description: Dual blades of Exalted design, brought together by a single purpose. (Item deals 40% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Exalted Swords of Fulfilled Fate
description: These blades has delivered countless souls to their destined fate, whether it be into the light or a cruel end. Justice is a miracle, one afforded to a destined few.

name: Excavated Glaive: Daggers
description: The weapon used by an ancient pilot, currently in dagger mode.

name: Executive Vordred's Sword ClipBoard
description: THIS SWORD GOT A PROMOTION. MORE SKULLS, MORE SUCCESS.

name: Exiled Ninjutsu Armaments
description: No forgemaster is the same, and those who provide to the Ao Tsuki are unwelcome by villages all over Yokai. Their weapons are meant to destroy sacred power, and the yokai who hold that power. (Color Customizable to Accessory)

name: Exiled Ninjutsu Tools
description: No forgemaster is the same, and those who provide to the Ao Tsuki are unwelcome by villages all over Yokai. Their weapons are meant to destroy sacred power, and the yokai who hold that power. (Color Customizable to Accessory)

name: ExoDagger Binsoku
description: This dagger will not only aid your agility, but when you click it you can transform into the light-wielding weapon of your dreams, or even dual handguns

name: Exodus Guardian's Blades
description: A blade forged from the flesh of an Exodus Titan. They were meant for the hands of mortals that have won their respect through combat and character. This blade would have been given to a certain Dragonlord, but the practice was already lost to time.

name: Exsanguination Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Blades likely to injure its wielder as they drain their prey of precious lifeblood. Red seeps into the silver edges, leaving the cutlass pristine as the moon.

name: Exsanguination Cutlasses (AC)
description: Blades likely to injure their wielder as they drain their prey of precious lifeblood. Red seeps into the silver edges, leaving the cutlass pristine as the moon.

name: Extra Smol Midnight Unicorn Toy
description: A comfy companion that will find you if you're lost in dreams, and rescue you from nightmares.

name: Eyes of Hubris
description: They were once named the Eyes of Envy, given to Noxus when he begrudgingly became a student. Back then, they could barely contain his potential and power. The Eyes have since weakened as Noxus slipped into complacency.

name: Face of Pain Daggers
description: What's more scary? These daggers or the face of your enemy will make when they see them?

name: Face-Slicing Knife
description: Just remember to clean it off before slicing your bread with it.

name: Facebreakers of Nulgath
description: There's an inscription on the hilt that reads: Instructions: 1. aim in general direction of face. 2. Bash. 3. Repeat as necessary.

name: Fae Skull Bangles
description: A ring made from the small skulls of an eradicated Fae Court of Summer. Seven sunny years in a distant land came to an abrupt end, and the arbiters of death left with a trinket to remember the occasion by.

name: Faerie Sai
description: This Sai is made from razor-sharp Faerie Coral.

name: Fairy Queen's Scythes
description: Certain Fae courts are cutthroat, for Fae are ageless and capricious beings. A Queen can only be replaced if they're killed. Usually, its their sires or knights who suddenly get the playful urge to wear a pretty crown.

name: Falcon Ranger Quiver and Bow
description: The arrows fall like rain, and the harp that shot them sings to mask the carnage.

name: FalconLord's Blades
description: The FalconLord Guardians that protect the tower are among Falconreach's fiercest, most skilled warriors. (This item is color customizable.) (This item is color customizable.)

name: Fall Fruit Assortment
description: The fruits wiggle and giggle. Someone's trying to hitch a ride into your home.

name: Fall Fruit Baskets
description: The fruits wiggle and giggle. Someone's trying to hitch a ride into your home.

name: Fall ScareCrow's Claws
description: The best way to sneak up on your enemy is to blend in with your environment. During Harvest, what better camouflage than as a scarecrow?

name: Fallen Commander's Accoutrements (0 AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen Commander's Accoutrements (AC)
description: Once a servant of the Light, this navy fell into the Underworld, where it now sails restlessly through the Stygian waters.

name: Fallen DeathKnight Accoutrements
description: Once they served the Celestial Realm but these DeathKnights now follow Ivoliss.

name: Fallen Star's Dark Hearts
description: Your weapon's final blow provided the energy needed for the cosmic explosion that keeps these miniature stars orbiting.

name: FallFire ArmBlades
description: Charged with the force of the forest, these branches work well as armblades when defeating mother nature!

name: FallFire Daggers
description: Charged with the force of the forest, these branches work well as daggers when defending mother nature!

name: Famine's Prodigal Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Cutlasses embellished with cursed gold from Famine's own vaults. That gold could have been used to feed the hungry, but was spent on extravagance instead. The despair and anger of the many sharpen these deadly blades.

name: Famine's Prodigal Cutlasses (AC)
description: Cutlasses embellished with cursed gold from Famine's own vaults. That gold could have been used to feed the hungry, but was spent on extravagance instead. The despair and anger of the many sharpen these deadly blades.

name: Famine's Prodigal Pistols
description: Every bullet Famine fires from this pistol costs a mountain of gold…In a metaphorical way, right? If this empties the Horsemen's budget, we're going to make Famine and his steed get a job at Scarbucks.

name: Fancy Lighter and Bomb
description: You live life on the smoky edge.

name: Fancy Naval Lighters
description: High-quality lighters that burn even when they're underwater.

name: Fang Blades of Nulgath
description: You are compelled to feed the fiend's spirit inhabiting this blade. Slay to slowly, and it may turn to feed on YOU! (This item is not color customizable)

name: Fangs of the Deep Dweller
description: You've stripped the Deep Dweller of his ferocious fangs and, with them, Cysero has crafted some wicked-sharp daggers!

name: Fangs of the Dishonored (AC)
description: Envy drove a heroic blade to a cold grave. Vengeance and fury raised it back from the dead, twisted into a cruel fang.

name: Fangs of the Dishonored (Legend)
description: Envy drove a heroic blade to a cold grave. Vengeance and fury raised it back from the dead, twisted into a cruel fang.

name: Fatalist Cosmos Daggers (AC)
description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.

name: Fatalist Cosmos Daggers (Legend)
description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.

name: Fatalist Cosmos Greatswords (AC)
description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.
