description: Mortals who mutate into pieces of the Fiend's Void are powerful, but are prone to suddenly lashing out at friend and foe. Their blades, crafted from their own cosmic bodies, burden them with visions of a pointless end.

name: Fated Blades of Doom
description: With reverence, some call it the original. With derision, others call it ancient. Neither can deny that it is heavy with Doomed fate, meant for the hands of those that would steer the Shadows closer to total domination.

name: Fear and Cruelty
description: Dual swords of Shadowfire make, designed to shear through armor as though it were paper.

name: Fell Fae Carvers
description: These blades are made from a mixture of metals lethal to the fair folk. Only a changeling could wield them without being harmed.

name: Fellow Player Skateboards
description: How do you do, fellow AdventureQuest Worlders?

name: Fenix Feathered Armblades (AC)
description: To receive the honor to touch the blazing jungle parrot's feathers unharmed in a huge accomplishment that brings you good fortune in the years to come.

name: Fenix Feathered Armblades (Legend)
description: To receive the honor to touch the blazing jungle parrot's feathers unharmed in a huge accomplishment that brings you good fortune in the years to come.

name: Ferocious Flame Dirks
description: Forged in the heat of the Champion of Fire's fury, these blades will sear the souls of all who oppose you.

name: Fest-EBIL Katanas (AC)
description: They're heated so both you, and whoever you plan to stick these through, will be warm during cold nights.

name: Fest-EBIL Katanas (Legend)
description: They're heated so both you, and whoever you plan to stick these through, will be warm during cold nights.

name: Festive Bell Daggers
description: No reindeer will laugh or call you names when they see these daggers.

name: Festive Hypesabers
description: Make your enemies feel the wrath of your resolute hype and joyful cheers in every Frostval, as well as the festivals and the birthday you celebrate.

name: Festive Wood Carved Armaments
description: The toy maker didn't expect this kind of request, but put their full effort into the project as always. They hope the rowdy kid that gets this as a gift will use it responsibly.

name: Festooned Festa Fans
description: Fashionable festive feathers festoon these Festa Fans!

name: Fiend Carver Betrayal Blades
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to rend the Archfiend's skin. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Fiend Dragon's Eyes Blades
description: The Eye of Astaroth the Fiend was inspired by one of Lore's most famous warriors, Arkadios!

name: Fiend Mauler's Diffuse Beam (AC)
description: You may think I am evil. I am not. I am the MOST EVIL.

name: Fiend Mauler's Diffuse Beam (Legend)
description: You may think I am evil. I am not. I am the MOST EVIL.

name: Fiend Mauler's Sabers
description: You may think I am evil. I am not. I am the MOST EVIL.

name: Fiend of Light Blades
description: Fiends who have fallen but still try to uphold the power of the Light. Keeping the forces of Darkness away while fighting not to succumb to it's grasp.

name: Fiend Orbs of Awakening
description: Visions can be seen of the Fiend God and the Archfiend's future in the depths of these orbs. It may cause cataracts.

name: Fiend's ArchPaladin Shield + Mace
description: Good or Evil… all heroes will eventually fall under the spell of the ArchFiend.

name: Fiend's Creed Blades
description: Blades that embodies the creed of all those who give themselves to the Fiend God's Void, and seek to devour it themselves. They are a symbol of the Archfiend's pride.

name: Fiend's Dark Paladin Shield + Axe
description: Good or Evil… all heroes will eventually fall under the spell of the ArchFiend.

name: Fiend's Draconic Trophy Axes
description: Given to you by Nulgath the ArchFiend himself, a reward for ridding his Nation of draconic traitors.

name: Fiend's Inception Blades (Legend)
description: Some Fiends are transformed in Adimonde's Void with their weapons. Even steel can grow teeth and eyes with the Fiend God's touch.

name: Fiend's Inception Blades (Non-Legend)
description: Some Fiends are transformed in Adimonde's Void with their weapons. Even steel can grow teeth and eyes with the Fiend God's touch.

name: Fiend Sticker
description: These were used by Belrot to drain the magic from his victims.

name: Fiendish Arachnomancer's Dorsal Whips
description:
An unconventional, yet fatal weapon. Even allied Nation followers dared not engage any Arachnomancer they see with these whips.
Thanks to Apus.

name: Fiendish Arachnomancer's Sickles
description: The truest, and purest way to hunt for your food. Brutal.

name: Fiendish Arachnomancer's Whips
description: An unconventional, yet fatal weapon. Even allied Nation followers dared not engage any Arachnomancer they see with these whips.

name: Fiendish Bloodhunt Daggers
description: Ever since Nulgath was betrayed, his loyal followers have begun to fuse the skulls and blood of their enemies into weapons that scream. They look to add to their collection, and please their Master.

name: Fiendish Covenants of Bone
description: Ever loyal to Master Nulgath, the Nation's greatest loyalists serve the Archfiend even in death. Their souls cling to their bones, waiting for another chance to prove themselves.

name: Fiendish Doomblades (0 AC)
description: The blade was forged from the armor of fallen Doomknights. They were puppets for the Shadows, easily slain and salvaged for scrap. Their dark red armor was melted down and sharpened by the Archfiend himself.

name: Fiendish Doomblades (AC)
description: The blade was forged from the armor of fallen Doomknights. They were puppets for the Shadows, easily slain and salvaged for scrap. Their dark red armor was melted down and sharpened by the Archfiend himself.

name: Fiendish Dracomancer Armaments
description: A Dragon's grudge gives the weapons an extra edge. It craves the downfall of others of its kind so that it won't have to suffer the humiliation of being an undead thrall alone.

name: Fiendish Duality Blades (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiendish Duality Blades (AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Fiendish Headhunter Blades
description: The blades themselves are a contract. The Archfiend carves a name into steel, and the wielder is sealed until they wipe their target off the face of Lore.

name: Fiendish Magus Spellcraft Tools (0 AC)
description: Of the spells Nulgath crafted for himself, few are allowed to be written down in ink. They must be recorded in his own blood, or the spells viciously backfire on the caster.

name: Fiendish Magus Spellcraft Tools (AC)
description: Of the spells Nulgath crafted for himself, few are allowed to be written down in ink. They must be recorded in his own blood, or the spells viciously backfire on the caster.

name: Fiendish Outlaw Battlegear
description: Any outlaw willing to serve and obey the orders of Nulgath the ArchFiend is welcome in the Nation. But beware… the price for betrayal is eternal suffering.

name: Fiendish Outlaw Quickdraw
description: Any outlaw willing to serve and obey the orders of Nulgath the ArchFiend is welcome in the Nation. But beware… the price for betrayal is eternal suffering.

name: Fiendish Stormbringer Armblades (0 AC)
description: Fiends that have been turned into the Nation's Stormbringers grow metallic appendages that conduct and attract energy. These bits can be torn off to serve as weapons.

name: Fiendish Stormbringer Armblades (AC)
description: Fiends that have been turned into the Nation's Stormbringers grow metallic appendages that conduct and attract energy. These bits can be torn off to serve as weapons.

name: Fiendish Stormbringer Armblades (Legend)
description: Fiends that have been turned into the Nation's Stormbringers grow metallic appendages that conduct and attract energy. These bits can be torn off to serve as weapons.

name: Fiendish Transcendence Blades
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Fiendish Transcendence Scythes
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Fiendish Trickster's Blades (0 AC)
description: The end of every Archfiend always comes from behind. At some point or another, they'll forget to look over their shoulder.

description: The end of every Archfiend always comes from behind. At some point or another, they'll forget to look over their shoulder.

name: Fiendish Trickster's Daggers (Legend)
description: The end of every Archfiend always comes from behind. At some point or another, they'll forget to look over their shoulder.

name: Fiendish Zweihanders of Bhamud
description: It is common practice for members of the Nation to use the bodies of the enemies and rivals to forge weapons. This masterpiece is a work of art even the great Archfiend acknolwedged.

name: Fierce Laser Colt Pistols (AC)
description: Aim straight, shoot sharp, win quickly!

name: Fierce Laser Colt Pistols (Legend)
description: Aim straight, shoot sharp, win quickly!

name: Fierced Grip Blade
description: A very stylish close combat blade.

name: Fiery Wrath + Hottica's Curse
description: While using Fiery Wrath, Hottica used this shield created to protect her from ice attacks—but when it burnt her morning toast to a crisp, she threw it into a volcano!

name: Fifteen Bladed Daggers
description: We two auto-attacked and the stream, from noon until server restart time, but bugs between us broad have roared since old long ago.

name: Final Ending
description: What cannot be bound or conquered must be destroyed.

name: Final's Dual Blades
description: Wow, look at those things. Could probably cut through close to anything. I wonder what the blade is made of?

name: Final's Dual Shadow Blades (AC)
description: Wow, look at those things. Could probably cut through close to anything. I wonder what the blade is made of?

name: Final's Dual Shadow Blades (Legend)
description: Wow, look at those things. Could probably cut through close to anything. I wonder what the blade is made of?

name: Fire Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Fire!

name: Firebird Maracas
description: Shake, shake, shake these fiery golden maracas!

name: Firebird's Fury Blades
description: A blade that radiates the golden shine of the sunrise and sunset. As the bane of the undead and immortal, its fire blazes for a worthy master, and snuffs out if that master falls for the sweet allure of eternity.

name: Firedancer's Torches
description: March to the heavy beat of the street parade while twirling these torches. Deadly and hot, beware anyone who interrupts your dance or threatens the atmosphere. They may have to deal with the circle of fire.

name: Firefeather Daggers
description: Made of bone, feathers and flame, Zoshi crafted this weapon while YOU watched and offered suggestions!

name: FireLord's Armblade
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: FireLord's Dagger
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: FireLord's Gilded Flame
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Firewalkers
description: These twin daggers were once tribal daggers made from volcanic glass, but have been reworked and enchanted with fire magic so they glow with their own inner flames.

name: Fireworks Explosion
description: Feliz Ano Novo! Manigong Bagong Taon! Joyeux Nouvel An! Xin Nian Hao! S Novim Godom! Frohes Neues Jahr! Felice Anno Nuovo! Happy New Year!

name: First Gold Cutlasses
description: Curved blades forged from gold, strengthened by a variety of other rare metals. They’re usually made from a corsair’s first plunder, giving every one significant meaning to their wielder.

name: First Gold Rapiers
description: Sophisticated blades forged from gold, strengthened by a variety of other rare metals. They’re usually made from a corsair’s first plunder, giving every one significant meaning to their wielder.

name: Fishin' Hooks
description: It takes two to make an attack go right! That's right, two. Two hooks, two ways of attack, two very painful ways to inflict injury and one very satisfied fighter. Catch yours today and make our enemies pay!

name: Fishy Sword & Shield
description: In the depths of the great waters is a fish that can do marvelous things. If brought to the surface, will transform into a rigid, vicious, weapon of mass destruction. Wrest the River Fishman's blade away from it to create this wicked weapon.

name: Fists of Fierceness
description: Make sure to wear glitter because it's gonna be a hot one… (This item requires a Pink Potion + the Fists of Fire)

name: Fists of Fire
description: Make sure to wear gloves because it's gonna be a hot one…

name: Fists of O-dokuro
description: How to have the most hardcore first fight ever.

name: Flaeschrendans
description: A malicious blade that feeds upon flesh and bone, augmenting and reconstructing itself with the bodies of its prey. To what limit will it devour and what will it become?

name: Flail and Shield of Cerberus
description: Finally a little shield-protection while you flail your weapon around aimlessly.

name: Flame Dagger
description: Scorch your enemies with this dagger of searing flame!

name: Flame Guardian's Accoutrements
description: *No description*

name: Flame Guardian's Blade + Shield
description: The famed Blade bestowed to the Flame Guardians.

name: FlameBlade Concealed Dagger
description: A true assassin is never without a weapon.

name: Flameborn Barbarian's Daggers
description: Your rage burns as brightly as the heart of Fiamme's fiery fortress. Channel that fury to take down ALL of your enemies!

name: Flamefists of Fury
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Flames of Fury
description: The flames of magic and power rise within you. Lite the embers and ignite your enemies!

name: Flaming Ash Rainers
description: ﻿Deep in the southern glaciers lies blades that are slowly melting holes into the eternal ice. They once made the cold skies snow ash but when their ambitious masters became lost, so were they.

name: Flesh Daggers
description: Freshly crafted from new zombie parts!

name: Flesh Shredder
description: Careful in the carnival, you just might lose your head.

name: Forbidden Dual EarthVessel Kris
description: Ritual blades seeped in forbidden magic. The court mages of Greenguard's previous dynasty conducted wretched rites to free their liege from fate.

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Daggers
description: Sacred weapon that once held deep ties to the earth and forests, now tainted with forbidden magic. They used to hunt aberrations. Now, they create them.

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Rapiers
description: Rapiers wrapped in vines. they used to be as vibrant and green as the Sea of Trees, but the touch of a forbidden entity twisted its form. A seed of disorder was planted, but that's the only way you can fight fate.

name: Forbidden EarthVessel Swords
description: The Royal Family once had deep ties to Nature, but dark ambition and an unknowable influence polluted this connection. Forbidden magic cursed their once pristine blades.

name: Forbidden Metamorphosis Fang
description: During one of their many squabbles, Apophis yanked one of Ouroboro's fangs out. In the Umbral Chaos' Shadow, it became jagged and alive. The eye, however, caused confusion. It's a paranoid little thing that refuses to blink.

name: Forbidden Pathos Blades (AC)
description: Turning failed Fiends into weapons is a common practice in the Nation, but these kinds of blades are special. The wielder typically has two, one mother and one father.

name: Forbidden Pathos Blades (Legend)
description: Turning failed Fiends into weapons is a common practice in the Nation, but these kinds of blades are special. The wielder typically has two, one mother and one father.

name: Force Guardian Daggers
description: A true Force Guardian feels the everything flow through them while keeping their emotions in check.

name: Foresters Daggers
description: We two have auto-attacked in the stream, from noon until server restart time, but bugs between us broad have roared since old long ago.

name: Formal GrenwogSlayer's Lacerators
description: Dress up for tons of GrenwogSlaying fun!

name: Formal Nation Blades
description: Elegant swords meant for keeping Nation business clean, in that they'll cut up enemies quickly and quietly without soiling your clothes with splatter.

name: Formal Nation Cane Sheath
description: The sound of this cane being knocked on the door is famous in noble circles. It'll silence an entire ballroom, and blow out the candles if the Fiends are especially eager for your signature.

name: Forsaken Frost Armaments (0 AC)
description: A war hero, loved by the people, was sent to a cold grave by a ruler who feared that they would steal the throne. When the war hero returned, everyone had something new to fear.

name: Forsaken Frost Armaments (AC)
description: A war hero, loved by the people, was sent to a cold grave by a ruler who feared that they would steal the throne. When the war hero returned, everyone had something new to fear.

description: Envy drove a heroic blade to a cold grave. Vengeance and fury raised it back from the dead, twisted into a cruel fang.

name: Forsaken Outrider Blasters
description: Outriders that have left the Nation have turned the professions of bounty hunting and banditry. They left the Archfiend behind but their dirty work has seen little change.

name: Forsaken Outrider's Soulbiters
description: When they left the Nation, either out of disgrace or to pursue free will, the Outrider took a token to remember the Nation by. It cuts brutally, even more so than it did when Nulgath was its master.

name: Fortitude + Hubris
description: Your work has paid off, here is your reward! Bonus to both Undead and Human, as your are perfectly balanced between Fortitude and Hubris!

name: Fortress Shield and Spear
description: With three of your fellow shield-carriers, you can form a group back with your shields held before you to form an impenetrable shield-fortress!

name: Fourteen Bladed Daggers
description: We two have auto-attacked in the stream, from noon until server restart time, but bugs between us broad have roared since old long ago.

name: Fourth Consular Dual Axes
description: When words fail, drastic action must be taken. If you're going to have to take this path, you might as well pull out the biggest weapons you have.

name: Fourth Consular Star Axes
description: When words fail, drastic action must be taken. If you're going to have to take this path, you might as well pull out the biggest weapons you have.

name: Fourth Guardian Dual Axes
description: Guardians who wield the Fourth master a variety of weapons, but it just feels better to run at the Sixth with axes.

name: Fourth Guardian Star Axes
description: Guardians who wield the Fourth master a variety of weapons, but it just feels better to run at the Sixth with axes.

name: Fractured Dual Aquitaine
description: The ancestral blades of House Vaughn, said to have been pulled from the heart of a golden buck. Like their master, there's a legend about them. The more paintings, copies, and depictions there are of these swords, the sharper they get.

name: Freak on a Leash Hands
description: Now you really can be a freak on a leash!

name: Freezing Lightning Blades
description: Weapons of iron and steel were no match for a sword that could turn armor into a tool of execution. Though deadly, it can not be raised against the kin of the Energy Champion.

description: A devious pair of daggers that will fulfill any assassin's resolution.

name: Golden Beater and Cowbell
description: NEEDS MOAR COWBELL

name: Golden Blade and Shield
description: A shield so shiny you can fix your hair in it.

name: Golden Blades of Eternity
description: A glorious golden blade, befitting an eternal hero.

name: Golden Bloodbiters
description: Blades dark as the night with edges as gold as Gravefang's legend. They were forged as gifts to appeal to the Abyssal Horde's pride. The swords are so heavy, only a Lycan hybrid can wield them.

name: Golden Bow + Arrow
description: Be careful!

description: These blades burn with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield them, or entrust them to those who share your fire.

description: These blades burn with the bright flames of your powerful will. Wield them, or entrust them to those who share your fire.

description: A blacksmith from Mythsong was comissioned to forge this spear for a special occasion. Each time you tap on it's tip, the spear will chime with the notes of a wedding march. It's an odd feature to explain to a confused foe.

name: Golden Chrono DragonKnight Blades
description: Prepare to meet an untimely demise.

name: Golden Clover Cleavers
description: A wee bit o luck is forged in these cleavers.

name: Golden Commander's Reavers
description: Gold be the only treasure worth searching for! Show your bounty by dressing in this fancy swag.

description: The mountains where Nulgath has created his fortress are filled with various Dragons, Wyrms, and assorted other creatures. Unlike the DragonSlayers, these Dragon Tamers do not kill these creatures, but tame them to their will. Probably so they can set them upon all of Nulgath's enemies.

name: Golden Destiny

name: Golden DoomFlame

description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Golden Dream Guardian Dual Scimitars
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Golden Firebird's Blades
description: A blade that radiates the golden shine of the sunrise and sunset. As the bane of the undead and immortal, its fire blazes for a worthy master, and snuffs out if that master falls for the sweet allure of eternity.

name: Golden FrostElf Daggers
description: The High FrostElf Kings and Queens have ruled over the frosty, frigid Northlands for millennia. This ceremonial regalia is worn for winter court audiences.

name: Golden Harmony Bouquets
description: Pure gold never tarnishes or rusts. May this love always stay the same.

name: Golden Lightweaver Blades
description: The power of Elemental Light surges from the glowing gemstone embedded into theilt. Some Lightweavers say that the gemstone is special pulled right out of their soul. Others say the gem is an Elemental. Which could be true?

name: Golden Monster Lord Axes
description: Only the bravest heroes who have battled and defeated all of Lore's many monster may called themselves true Monster Lords.

name: Golden Mugs
description: A jolly toast to Lucky Day!

name: Golden Paladin Titan's Blades
description: if you don't fight, you can't win. For the Light… For Good… BATTLEON!

name: Golden Panacea Claymores
description: Golden swords that bind instead of kill. If there is a cure for the darkness of the heart, you will find it.

name: Golden Phoenix's Fury Blades
description: The undead and undying plague Lore. Let the Phoenix's fire burn away their greed, and return them to the arms of the reaper.

name: Golden Phoenix's Glory Blades
description: The undead and undying plague Lore. Let the Phoenix's fire burn away their greed, and return them to the arms of the reaper.

name: Golden Pyromancer's Sabres
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAH

name: Golden Rabbit Daggers
description: A pair of gilded daggers adorned with a rabbit. Valuable on their own, these daggers give the wearer good luck.

name: Golden Redeemer Betrayal Blades
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to sever one's ties to the Nation completely. Upon its discovery, Nulgath perfected it and placed it in full view, as if daring the leeches to try.

name: Golden Scythes of the Sunborn
description: The Sunborn did not know that creatures of darkness were their enemies until they touched down on Lore's soil. These scythes leave scars on those who call the night home, cursing them to feel the scorch of the sun for the rest of their existences.

name: Golden Slicers
description: Circular logic might get you into some dire predicaments in DoomWood, but these Golden Slicers will be sure to get you out of them!

name: Golden Snowflake Rapiers
description: The Court of the Winter Fae enjoy the dramatics of romance and duels. It is tradition for the duelists to have their weapons created by the ice magic of their heart's desire. A member of fae royalty made these rapiers.

name: Golden Snowflake Sickles
description: Meant to break the ice and shine a little light. Beautiful, and a great tool for snowy rescues.

name: Golden Star Daggers
description: Toss them quick and fast and from a distance, you're practically firing a laser from the palm of your hands.

name: Golden Sword and Shield
description: For the elite warriors who do not fear the battlefield.

name: Golden Tonfa Blades
description: Easily hidden in the sand if a Dune Prince requires it later.

name: Golden Toothbrush & Toothpaste
description: For that golden smile of yours.

name: Golden Tvilling Verdighet
description: Swords named for the dignity of the Dragon who chose you as a Draco Knight. The blade is made of its crystalized breath.

name: Golden Victor's Hammers
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Golden Vinyl Records
description: These records are etched with the contents of the soul. They'll speak to anyone who'll listen, and cut anyone who doesn't.

name: Golden Warrior's Blade + Sheath
description: Your victories in battle honor your homeland and your ancestors. Happy Independence Day!

name: Golden Wreckord
description: Finally, a practical use for all those golden records! Wreck some buddies with these wreck-ords!

name: Golden x Silver Flintlocks (AC)
description: Alchemical Naval Commanders scour the seas in search of new reagents and creatures to use in their mystical, magical workings.

description: A simple axe which, over time, has slain so many that the flesh of the wielder's enemies have begun to cling to the blade like a curse. For the wrathful of the Nation, it is a blessing.

name: Gothic Alchemist‘s Athames
description: Recruited by Big Daddy, these alchemists are entrusted to brew handmade love potions …until they accidentally picked the wrong ingredients.

name: Gothic Galleon Dual Cutlasses
description: Yarrr! It be dark days. Man t' wheel as you and your hearties turn t' gears on your ship as you venture for treasure and adventure on t' open sea!

description: With the Grace of his Vindicators, Gramiel created blades made of devotion. Any who can shoulder the weight of their grave meaning can temporarily be as powerful as a Celestial.

name: Gramiel's Shattered Enochs
description: What's the point in belief and will if it's all fake?

name: Granite Rippers
description: Designed primarily for hunting, these blades also provide sufficient protection for the Horc on the move.

name: Grasp of Manus Blades
description: You never know when you'll need an extra hand or three to wield your backup blade.

name: Grasp of the Void
description: Although it's not what you'd call a "conventional" dagger, this strange… limb… from the Void makes a sturdy and effective weapon.

description: Underworld Summoner weapons are forged from steel stripped from tombs and crypts. The nature of such material lends itself to trapping souls.

name: Great Axes Of Eminence

name: Great BoneSwords Of Eminence
description: These blades are made from the Titan's own gargantuan bones. The transformation this monster underwent continues to force growth. The Legion subdues this behemoth by using its own remains to seal it.

name: Great Calabaza Blades
description: An eldritch touch awakened humble pumpkins, and their evolution surged. Snarling jaw, greedy vines, and temptingly sweet edges - ready to harvest and reap.

name: Great Lavastorm Scythes
description: Blaze forth with these lava infused axes

name: Great SawBlades Of Eminence (Legend)

description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, they must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

description: These weapons have the ability to turn their victims into more undead, and soon the sea will run out of room for all of them.

name: Grim Short Blades

name: Grim Skullswords of Vengeance
description: GRIMSKULL HOPES YOU LIKE HIS GIFT.

description: It might be grim, but it's a treasure to someone!

description: Tomes of dark arts pertaining to the specifics of casting at sea. All necromancy is the same, if you're an amateur. Real Dark Casters know how to rend the greatest amount of terror afforded by the ocean's bounty.

name: Grimskull's Khopeshs of Misery
description: Tugged straight from the ribcage of another would-be dungeon crawler, soon to be passed on when the next owner trips into a trap.

name: Grimskull's Reavers of Reckoning
description: This weapon is a fixture of the dungeons. Extremely effective yet easy to to drop, and always skids just an inch too far out of reach. It's a real knee-slapper for evil onlookers.

name: Grimskull's Survival Knives (AC)
description: Tool for getting back to the basics of dungeon building in the wild. If Grimskull's hurting for gold, he'll sell these at his post-dungeon experience gift shops.

description: You beat up the Grislyfang pirates, and you stole their tools!

name: Grove Druid's Dagger
description: Druids use their magic to protect the flora and fauna across Lore. Grove druids work to create peaceful sanctuaries where nature can flourish… until their charges are threatened. Then beware the force of their power!

name: GryphonClaw Knight's Blades
description: Upon ascending to the rank of Knight, members of the Order of the GryphonClaw swear a third oath: In recognition of the fact that humans cannot lie in the prescence of a Gryphon, Knighs vow never to lie. This makes them trusted anywhere they may travel.

name: GryphonClaw Warrior's Blades
description: A warrior must swear several oaths upon joining the martial Order of the GryphonClaw. The first two are: 1) To defend and protect any creature in danger. 2) To be as brave as a lion and as loyal as an eagle.

name: Guaranteed Demise (AC)
description: Remember to actually throw this when you start running out of fuse. You're not going to have a chance to regret it later.

name: Guillotine Betrayal Blades
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to slice off the Archfiend's head. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Guitar Cable Whips
description: Passing the AUX in the meanest way possible.

name: Guncraft Battle Armaments
description: The shadows have many faces. One bullet won't fit them all. There's silver for the rabid wolves, and iron for the crafty dark fae.

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer Big Irons
description: The shadows grow stronger each passing night. A wooden stake or a silver bullet won't do. Stab the beast's heart and shoot.

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer Bigger Irons
description: The kickback on this buddy bites harder than the beasts.

name: Guncraft Shadowslayer Biggest Irons
description: A shot through seven hearts. Can you beat that record?

description: The shadows grow stronger each passing night. A wooden stake or a silver bullet won't do. Stab the beast's heart and shoot.

description: These daggers are only for the most elite members of Dage's Undead Legion.

name: Gutters of Duality (AC)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Gutters of Duality (Legend)
description: As the Admiral of the Great Abyss, Nulgath has bestowed a great power upon you, his most loyal Naval Commander. Whether you choose to use such power for Good or Evil is completely up to you…

name: Hadopelagic Grade Flintlock (0 AC)
description: A firearm built to be able to fire under heavy water pressure. The flash of its blast can temporarily disperse the sea's terrors.

name: Hadopelagic Grade Flintlock (AC)
description: A firearm built to be able to fire under heavy water pressure. The flash of its blast can temporarily disperse the sea's terrors.

name: Hadopelagic Grade Handguns (AC)
description: A firearm built to be able to fire under heavy water pressure. The flash of its blast can temporarily disperse the sea's terrors.

name: Hadopelagic Grade Handguns (Legend)
description: A firearm built to be able to fire under heavy water pressure. The flash of its blast can temporarily disperse the sea's terrors.

name: Halcyon Coronation Axes
description: Axes that could cleave storm clouds and reveal blue skies, meant for the hands of a true Hero and Champion. They lost their luster over time after being passed from a King to his descendants.

name: Halcyon Skye Axes
description: Axes that could cleave storm clouds and reveal blue skies. They were meant for the hands of a true Hero and Champion. They passed from a King to his descendants, and lost their lustre.

name: Halcyon Skye Blades
description: Golden blades forged in a faraway land. They only gleam gold in the hands of true heroes, and can cleave storm clouds to reveal blue skies. Most rulers are unable to wield them in their golden form.

name: Halcyon Skye Hand Axes
description: A prince lifted these axes, determined to rend the heavens just like his father. Gold spoiled into a morose gray in his hands. Dark clouds hung over the Kingdom for generations, until a worthy commoner revealed the weapon's true form.

name: Halcyon Skye Longswords
description: The longswords takes on a muddy gray shade in the hands of an unworthy ruler. More often than not, its their retainers and knights that can reveal the blades' true golden gleam.

name: Halcyon Virtue Axes
description: Axes that could cleave storm clouds and reveal blue skies, meant for the hands of a true Hero and Champion. They lost their luster over time after being passed from a King to his descendants.

name: Halcyon Virtue Blades
description: Golden blades forged in a faraway land. They only gleam gold in the hands of true heroes, and can cleave stormclouds to reveal blue skies. Most rulers are unable to wield them in their golden form.

name: Hammer of Evil Persecution Shield (0 AC)
description: A weapon that was definitely named by a Paladin. A malicious spirit is sealed inside. With each swing of this hammer, it dies a little more.

name: Hammer of Evil Persecution Shield (AC)
description: A weapon that was definitely named by a Paladin. A malicious spirit is sealed inside. With each swing of this hammer, it dies a little more.

name: Hammers of Vindication
description: If a bell in a town rings seven times at dawn, that means they align themselves with the Dawn Vindicators. It is to honor Gramiel, who destroyed a H'orc army in just seven strikes of his hammer.

name: Hand of the Hoof
description: Who is number 1? The Warhorses, of courses!

name: Handaxes of Dread
description: This ordinary weapon from Lord Reingold's lair is well-crafted and will prove useful in battle. A solid piece of loot!

name: Handheld Racetrack Controllers
description: You're going to want to handle these carefully. A twitch will send your car through a wall.

name: Hands of Flare
description: Harness the power of the sun in your hands!

name: Hands of Serket
description: Scorpion venom was purified and crystallized into the shape of pincers. Though primarily wielded in combat, they were originally intended for use in surgery. Patients were understandably frightened.

name: Hands of the DoomPhoenix
description: Cheer for your favorite patriotic team!

name: Handy SleuthHounds
description: Two guard dogs on hand are worth four in the kennel on Baker Street.

name: Happy Holiblades
description: Happy holiblades and seasons beatings!

name: Harbinger of Destruction Swords (AC)
description: The blade comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harbinger of Destruction Swords (Legend)
description: The blade comes alive, sensing that you yearn for destruction. Be it the end of your enemies or the tearing down of fate, it will grant your dearest wish. (Color-customizable to Accessory)

name: Harle-Quint Daggers
description: For stabbing your enemies in the back while they're rolling on the floor laughing.

name: Harmonic Libra Orbs
description: Special magic orbs atuned to the Libra constellation. They disperse and share the mana of your companions, connecting your minds and dreams.

name: Harmony Vow Blades
description: Should the best man and maid of honor have trouble fighting off monsters and objecting guests, the bride and groom take up their blades. Weddings are a magnet for drama.

name: Harpies Hands of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite beaked destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Harvest Assassin's Blades
description: Turkill or not Turkill that is the question…

name: Harvest Assassin's Sword + Axe
description: Turkill or not Turkill that is the question…

name: Harvest Sword and Shield
description: This sword and shield was made out of this year's harvest. what happens to it when the food gets old? Eeeewww…

name: Hateful Goliaths
description: "Might makes right" haunts the behemoth that was forged into these blades. After eons without equal, an undead upstart killed it. Now, they're weapons defined by a grudge, cursing their wielder to die like a rat.

name: Haunted Gravestones
description: Beware of the pocong; some of them are just friends playing pranks or random gymbros, but if you're unlucky enough, you might find the real ones!

name: Haunted Triangle
description: DING! Your time is up!

name: Haunting Green Flames (0 AC)
description: What are you up to? Necromancy? Toxic Pyromancy? Or are you trying to stir up a birthday party?

name: Haunting Green Flames (AC)
description: What are you up to? Necromancy? Toxic Pyromancy? Or are you trying to stir up a birthday party?

name: Havoc Sage's Reavers (AC)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Havoc Sage's Reavers (Legend)
description: After ages of rigorous training and meditation, these Sages are enlightened in the art of war. All who oppose the Legion are swiftly incapacitated by these skilled masters.

name: Havok and Malice
description: A demonic axe and its menacing shield counterpart. These fearsome weapons seems to have minds of their own. Will you be the one to wield them, or will they wield you?

name: Hawberry Grenwog Carrot Kunais
description: Carrots aren't actually that healthy of a snack to feed to rabbits. Too much sugar. It makes more sense to shower your enemies in a rain of adorable carrot kunai.

name: Hawberry Grenwog Waterguns
description: Rabbits are known to be careful and cautious, but enjoy a spot of spontaneity. There could be water in this gun, but what if you got creative?

name: Hawkarang
description: A weapon created for the Royal Falconers of Swordhaven. It will always return to you!

name: Head Splitting Daggers
description: The hilts of these daggers are made from the skulls' of deceased Nation members.

name: Headless Pumpkin Blades
description: Ne'er-do-wells using the darkness of all hallow's eve as cover will never escape your gaze, or lack there of. Don't forget your head at home.

name: HeadSmash Rocks
description: Horc smash. In head! With rocks.

name: Healer of Time's Battle Gear
description: A compendium of remedies and recipes to heal.

name: Heart of Fire Daggers
description: The heart of fire gives these beings their power. Their everlasting heat will burn down their enemies.

name: Heart Render Betrayal Blades
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to exsanguinate the heart of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Heart Surgeon
description: This dagger was designed to remove your foe's heart with surgical precision.

name: HeartCrusher Blades
description: A strike to the heart, and you're too blame. You seek love, glory, and fame. (Changes when in combat)

name: HeartCrusher Maces
description: A blow to the heart, and you're too blame. You seek love, glory, and fame. (Changes when in combat)

name: Heartcrushing Warhammers
description: As you face your opponent, the only question you need to answer is… SMASH or pass?

name: Heartstone Keys
description: Made from the shards of a broken crystalized heart, smashed to bits in the Friend Zone.

name: Hearty Cutlasses
description: Avast me hearties!

name: Heavy Metal Necromancer Dual Scythes
description: What's more metal than a rock concert full of head-banging undead? A necromancer who can bind their spirits and control them. FOREVER. (This item is color customizable)

name: Heavy Serpent Ruan Case
description: Dropping the sickest tunes outta Yokai Isle!

name: Hei Gong Ji Fans (AC)
description: If you're a pyromancer, you'd love to play with these fans because the elemental inferno magic within them boosts their firepower. Just steer clear of anything that's flammable.

name: Hei Gong Ji Fans (Legend)
description: If you're a pyromancer, you'd love to play with these fans because the elemental inferno magic within them boosts their firepower. Just steer clear of anything that's flammable.

name: Hekyll and Jyde
description: A malicious set of identical kamas that split a lot more than just personalities…

name: Hell Rogue Daggers
description: The claws of the beast lurking in Oishii's oven.

name: Hellion Beast Cleavers (AC)
description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

name: Hellion Beast Cleavers (Legend)
description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

name: Hellion Tuskbreaker Maces (Legend)
description: The weapons of the glorious hunt are worn from centuries in the wilds. Over time, new weapons from all over the continent joined the fray as the Riders welcomed new members into their charge.

name: Helsgrove Guardian Dual Batons
description: Helsgrove Guardians protect their mistress, Helsdottir, as she hunts down fools trying to outrun her retribution.

name: Hero's Conviction Blades
description: Thousands of years in the past, a great Hero took up these blades to slay a foul King. This monster, who slew his own Queen to evoke forbidden power, was destroyed along with his cursed empire. Now, the blades waits for a new master.

name: Heroic Berserker Accoutrements
description: These Berserkers fight Chaos wherever and whenever they come across it. For Humanity!

name: Heroic Titan's Greatswords
description: Even in moments of deepest despair, we can still find hope. No matter how messed up things get, YOU have the power to save the day.

name: High Celestial Protector's Blades
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: High Celestial Protector's Longswords
description: Only the most skilled of the Celestial Realm's Guardians ascend to the ranks of the High Celestial Protectors. It is one of the realm's highest honors.

name: High Octane Car Keys
description: If the car breaks down, at least you can jump out and key the other guy's ride.

name: High Reversed Shadow Daggers
description: Adding the Deadtech Node seems to have removed all color from this item. How strange.

name: High ShadowScythe Daggers
description: Adding the Deadtech Node seems to have removed all color from this item. How strange.

name: High Tatras Daggers
description: Truth prevails! May you always battle with honor, in the spirit of your homeland's motto.

name: Hikari no Akuma Arms
description: Do not let the name fool you. They may be driven by the light but these Akuma still have deep dark powers.

name: Hikari's Sinned Accoutrements
description: Made by the deadly and talented Hikari!

name: Hinokami Katanas (AC)
description: Heirloom blades that connect to samurai by the flames of their souls instead of their blood. Their steel was scorched black by Dragon fire, transforming them into a katanas that cleaves the infinite.

name: Hinokami Katanas (Legend)
description: Heirloom blades that connect to samurai by the flames of their souls instead of their blood. Their steel was scorched black by Dragon fire, transforming them into a katanas that cleaves the infinite.

name: Hippodrome Star Cutlasses
description: Originally, these weapons were crafted for the stage, not the high seas. But theatre can quickly become reality, and anything can be deadly if sharpened.

name: Hitman's Pistols
description: Mission #357.A -- Chairman Platinum has ordered you to follow Target QV. Objective: observe, execute, report.

name: Hoarfrost Snowflake Rapiers
description: The Court of the Winter Fae enjoy the dramatics of romance and duels. It is tradition for the duelists to have their weapons created by the ice magic of their heart's desire. A warrior of the Sluagh made these rapiers.

name: Holiday Paragon of Light Dual Hammers
description: Members of the Bright Legion love Frostval… the sun shining on their armor and snow blinds their enemies and makes them look even MORE Good.

name: Hollow Demonic Dual Doujikiri
description: The blades of an exiled OniSlayer Empress. She died, betrayed and abandoned. Her vengeful spirit haunts the katanas. Now the coveted weapons of the Four Oni Lords, it seeks the blood of those they once protected.

name: Hollow Draconian Axes
description: Long have the Draconians served as minions and fodder for the greats of Dragonkind. No longer will this stand. The Draconians will be vindicated, and the rest of Dragonkind will be butchered by their blades.

name: Hollow Point Special
description: Sometimes when your fire dies down you just have to hit them with a shield…

name: Hollow Soul Dagger
description: A haunting pair of daggers believed to be infused with lost souls. Or rather, lost hollow souls.

name: Hollowborn Alchemist's BattleGear
description: Expert transmutationists, Hollowborn Alchemists are the masters of mutable magic. Their power lies in transforming objects into new states of being. The Shadow Fiend has granted them the ability to change the very nature of reality.

name: Hollowborn Alchemist's Blades
description: Expert transmutationists, Hollowborn Alchemists are the masters of mutable magic. Their power lies in transforming objects into new states of being. The Shadow Fiend has granted them the ability to change the very nature of reality.

name: Hollowborn Apocalypse Flames
description: When the last star dies and the last soul fizzles into nothingness, will there still be Hollowborn journeying through the dark?

name: Hollowborn Assassin Daggers
description: They are wielded by the Hollowborn, and are meant to harm other Hollowborn. Those who once called themselves Vindicators now slink through shadows, cursed to become what they despise.

name: Hollowborn Battlemage Armaments
description: Though the Hollowborn are given new life in the shade of the Shadow Fiend, its power serves whichever goals they pursue. These hammers can smite the Light, or make Darkness grovel, so long as there is sufficent drive.

name: Hollowborn Battlemage Hammers
description: Though the Hollowborn are given new life in the shade of the Shadow Fiend, its power serves whichever goals they pursue. These hammers can smite the Light, or make Darkness grovel, so long as there is sufficent drive.

name: Hollowborn Blades of Chaos
description: The legendary sword that has been used by Drakath for nearly 13 years, and the shadows have made it even more powerful…

name: Hollowborn Carrion Carvers (AC)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late.You've failed the test.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Carvers (Legend)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late.You've failed the test.

name: Hollowborn Carrion Greatswords (0 AC)
description: The swords are knightly in appearance. Fitting as they were taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest, comforted by death instead of the Shadow Fiend, as the Ravens relieve them of their duties

description: This blade was created from pure Chaos and empowered by pure Shadows. It may do damage against anything at any time… including Chaos itself.

name: Hollowborn Daggers of Thorns
description: ﻿Blades that persisted beyond death. When an elvish assassin overcame the Shadow Fiend's trial, the thorny vines sprouting from their body birthed a new poison. At a touch, it will allow the victim to meet the Fiend themselves.

name: Hollowborn Dark Orbs (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Dark Orbs (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Darkblood Axes
description: Ancient axes adorned with a face few Darkbloods can recognize. They come from an era long lost, and their Hollowborn kin believe it should stay that way. They leave Falguard, and bring the past with them.

name: Hollowborn Darkblood Chains
description: A chain and sickle designed by a Hollowborn sister who asserted that it requires stealth to use properly. The Hollowborn Darkblood stamped their hooves in excitement, completely ignoring her.

name: Hollowborn Drake Stingers
description: Affectionately called a stinger because, at most, it would feel like a pinprick to a Dragon. Dragonlords use this to handle mundane disputes.

name: Hollowborn DreamWalker's Claws
description: Some DreamWalkers can send their minds through dreams and dimensions to get information or watch their enemies, but Hollowborn DreamWalkers are able to go there personally if needed. Though it is a gift from the Shadow Fiend to do such thing, it comes with a  price.

name: Hollowborn Druid Spikes
description: The runes were originally the written form of the murmurs from the wellspring of all life. Everyone can understand them the moment they are born, but the language is lost as one's bonds to the natural world erodes.

description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

description: Always searching for ways to obtain more power, the Hollowborn Executioner has mastered all types of combat. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Lex et Ordo
description: "Alea jacta est" is what the Hollowborn Judge says as the judgment session starts. The lot is cast and, depending on what the defendant deserves, the punishment or pardon will be chosen. The law of ShadowFiend and the order of the Hollowborn Judge are absolute.

name: Hollowborn Necrotic Dagger (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!
