name: Hollowborn Omega Swords
description: With this blade, you will bring about the End: the end of your opponents, the end of Order, and the end of LORE itself! All shall fall to the power of Shadows!

name: Hollowborn Reaper's Daggers
description: Fallen warriors seeking for justice or revenge… it can be hard to tell the difference. Trained specially to fight infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper is both slayer and puppetmaster. (Item does 30% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Hollowborn Reaper's Kamas
description: Fallen warriors seeking for justice or revenge… it can be hard to tell the difference. Trained specially to fight infernal creatures, the Fiend Reaper is both slayer and puppetmaster. (Item does 30% more damage to all monsters when equipped.)

name: Hollowborn Shadow Shaper's Armblades
description: A fallen mage, now in service of the darkness and what lies there… A shadow manipulator who fuses them with his own mana, able to create and shape unique weapons, and strangely resistant minions. It is not common to see him in daylight, but hope never to find him the darkness of night.

name: Hollowborn Soul Eater Blades
description: A symbol of the Undead Legion, few have ever had the privilege of seeing such blades, let alone wield them. When their wielder passed the Shadow Fiend's test, the souls forged into the blades became influenced by its powers as well.

name: Hollowborn Soul Stealer
description: With Lae's assistance, NCS forged this cursed weapon. A scythe chained to a lamp, whose scythe steals the feelings of its target, making them empty, but more and more powerless.(Equip this item to do 15% more damage to all creatures.)

name: Hollowborn Swords (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Swords (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as Hollowborns!

name: Hollowborn Thunderlord Lightnings
description: The power of thunder and lightning is a difficult one to wield - one that only the most determined of Hollowborn can master.

name: Hollowborn Trainer's Axe + Whip
description: Don't mind the scratches, this weapon has been here for quite a while. Pity of your pupils, trainer. May the Shadow Fiend show you new paths and guide your lessons.

name: Hollowborn Treasure Hunter Necklaces
description: A pai of unassuming necklace with multiple uses. Look closely, and you'll find that they functions as a compasses, timers, poisonous gas detectors, and panic buttons for your brethren to come pick you up. Now that's Hollowborn magic.

name: Hollowborn Water Guns (AC)
description: The Hollowborn need to take breaks from chasing their ambitions. The Shadow Fiend wouldn't mind witnessing a couple of overly-competetive water fights. (Streaks of color are customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Water Guns (Legend)
description: The Hollowborn need to take breaks from chasing their ambitions. The Shadow Fiend wouldn't mind witnessing a couple of overly-competetive water fights. (Streaks of color are customizable to eye color.)

name: Hollowborn Wedding Candles
description: Lae was handing these out to guests at his wedding. No matter how long they burn, the wax won't melt. Thay must have worked a little magic.

name: Hollowborn Wedding Mugs
description: It was really nice of Lae and Thay to let the guests take these home. It doesn't matter what you pour into the mugs. The drink will bubble and warm on its own. Too bad it doesn't change into the color of your soul too.

name: Hollowborn Zweiblades (0 AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowborn Zweiblades (AC)
description: Deep inside the shadowrealm, there is a place where strong warriors and powerful wizards live. Fallen heroes and villains called the name of the Shadow Fiend, and now they all ascended once again as HollowBorns!

name: Hollowsoul Dual Dirks
description: The Hollowsoul Ghouls roam the halls of Hollowsoul Castle, but lately have been spotted roaming the shadows of MystCroft. It is too early to tell what kind of omen this may be.

name: HollowSword and Shield
description: When you can't decide whether to use a sword or a shield, use both! This duo of defensive destruction provides excellent protection while also serving as your best attack option, no matter what your state of existence is.

name: Holy Bird Daggers
description: Golden daggers evoking the giant birds of prey who fight for the Light. May you always have wind beneath your wings.

name: Holy Hand Grenade
description: Takest thou, this Holy Hand Grenade… One, two … five! And don't forget to let go!

name: Holy Shield and Hammer
description: When the hammer comes down, it'll knock those undead to the ground!

name: Holy Shield and Sword
description: Inscribed in the both of these items… "Fate will have its word, when sword falls on sword. But those who never yield, trust in the strength of their shield."

name: Hongbaoshi Blades (AC)
description: (This is the 0 AC version from the Treasure Chest.)Ruby blades that represents the burning passion in a Dragon's breath. Being gifted this weapon from Earthen Dragons is akin to a promise of protection.

name: Hongbaoshi Blades (Legend)
description: (Alternate 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)

name: Honorable Koi Ningyo Tachis
description: The aquatic nations which dwell under the Seven Seas of Yokai must defeat a ningyo in battle before they can be considered warriors. Legend also has it that eating a a ningyo's flesh may grant immortality… but no one has proven it true. Yet.

name: Honorable Ninja Dual Katanas
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of Honor may wield this weapon.

name: Honorable Ninja Dual Weapons
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of Honor may wield this weapon.

name: Honorbound Dual Katanas
description: Those who wield katanas don't do it because the want to, they do it because they have to. It is their duty.

name: Honorbound Twin Katanas
description: On their 18th birthday, the Honorbound teenagers are given the Twin Katanas as a coming of age present. With these blades, they will defend their land with the honor and courage just as their parents did before them.

name: Honored Gilded Axes
description: Gold extracted from the heart of the Dwarves mountain home isn't taken lightly. The detailing of these axes was made by the Dwarfhold Keep's elder council, and given to their most respected Heroes, Dwarven or otherwise.

name: Hooked Elite SoulSeeker Blades
description: Essentially weaponized meat hooks, used to dangle a SoulSeeker to prevent them from mindlessly attacking their own kin. When they're unleashed, the SoulSeekers brandish them in battle.

name: Hooked SoulSeeker Blades
description: Essentially weaponized meat hooks, used to dangle a SoulSeeker to prevent them from mindlessly attacking their own kin. When they're unleashed, the SoulSeekers brandish them in battle.

name: Horc Claw
description: Used like a dagger this weapon deadly in close quarters.

name: Horc Quickblades
description: Flexible blades that have proven effective in combat countless times before. To truly master their effectiveness takes years of training.

name: Horcish Naval Accoutrements (AC)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horcish Naval Accoutrements (Legend)
description: Horc Commanders may sail on sea, but are still like mountain — hard, tough, loyal. We keep the seas a near Bloodtusk Ravine free and strong, defending from Chaos.

name: Horcish Slicer Daggers
description: Slice quick, clean. End the battle fast.

name: Howling Frost Set
description: It's the most wonderful time of the year to wield a massive snowflake blade and shield!

name: Hraesvelgr Shield
description: Even the heavens will meet their end. This blade was forged for the Warbringers of the Legion, named after a soul Dage created himself. Should a final choice be made, it will set the sky ablaze and turn it to dust.

name: Hunter's Dagger
description: Clever Adventurers know it's not the size of the item that matters, it's how you use it.

name: Hunter's Gutter Daggers
description: Brings the phrase scrounging for food to a whole new level. These hunters explore Greenguard for food.

name: Hyperborean Bite
description: Look down to the barrel of this cold revolver and take aim. With each shot, the icy bite of death will take your enemies down.

name: Hyperspace Marine Sword + Shield
description: In space, no one can hear you.. oh, GROSS, what was THAT goo?

name: Iara's Water Orb
description: (This item deals 35% more damage to all monsters when equipped.) They tried to drown Iara, yet she was saved. Those who work to prevent this from ever happening again carry this.

name: Ice Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Ice!

name: Ice Lord Guardian's Dagger
description: Only a fool would battle against these frozen warriors of the North. Ice runs deep in their veins giving them the upper hand.

name: Ice Wizard's Staff + Tome
description: These elemental wizards gain their power from Ice, which is why you mostly see them in the winter months… especially around Frostval.

name: Icebound Contract and Lantern
description: This is the contract that binds the VoidFrost Revenant of Nulgath. In exchange for an Evil act accomplished by the Archfiend himself, the Revenants not only gave up their futures, but potentially the destinies of all life.

name: Icebound Contracts of the Archfiend
description: These are the contracts that bound the VoidFrost Revenants of Nulgath. In exchange for an Evil act accomplished by the Archfiend himself, the Revenants not only gave up their futures, but potentially the destinies of all life.

name: Icebound Scepter and Lantern
description: A staff that harnesses the power of deep hatred and spite, frozen in a moment of great suffering. The Fiends who were used to create this weapon will never be remembered. To all, including their Master, they were just ingredients.

name: IceEdge Swords
description: The spirit of ice gives these beings their power. Their everlasting chill will freeze their enemies to the core.

name: IceShard Dual Edges
description: Just remember to leave in the freezer when not in use. Comes in a rainbow of different flavors!

name: IceStorm Daggers (0 AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors. No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: IceStorm Daggers (AC)
description: The frozen Northlands builds the fiercest warriors. No amount of cold will stop these generals from conquering.

name: Icy Barbarian Blade + Shield
description: Warriors of the tundra, brute strength and determination give these barbarians a clear advantage in the battle.

name: Icy Barbarian Daggers
description: Warriors of the tundra, brute strength and determination give these barbarians a clear advantage in the battle.

name: Icy Blades of Doom (0 AC)
description: Even Evil heroes (maybe ESPECIALLY Evil heroes) need to chill out after battle. With your Icy Blade of Doom, you can cool off without sacrificing that battle-ready edge.

name: Icy Blades of Doom (AC)
description: Even Evil heroes (maybe ESPECIALLY Evil heroes) need to chill out after battle. With your Icy Blade of Doom, you can cool off without sacrificing that battle-ready edge.

name: Icy Blades of Doom (Legend)
description: Even Evil heroes (maybe ESPECIALLY Evil heroes) need to chill out after battle. With your Icy Blade of Doom, you can cool off without sacrificing that battle-ready edge.

name: Icy Flintlocks
description: Shiver me timbers! It be th' Icy Naval Commander's flintlocks! A pirate weapon this cool freezes over.

name: Icy Frostlorn Rogue Daggers
description: *No description*

name: Icy Infernal Blade + Shield
description: Don't let it being made of ice cold your judgement, this is a mighty weapon.

name: Icy Rapiers
description: Shiver me timbers! It be th' Icy Naval Commander's rapiers! A pirate weapon this cool freezes over.

name: Idalion's Blazing Fangs
description: This blade is as swift and merciless as the dragon whose fangs inspired their shape; they''re balanced to strike faster than the shadows can fall.

name: Idalion's Shadowbrand Blades
description: Forged in Mount Maleno’s sacred fire, this blade hums with a heat that only grows in battle.

name: Idalion's ShadowCleavers
description: Its edge bears the mark of Idalion’s strike, a deep burn where dragonfire met steel, now turned into a weapon of defiance.

name: Ignis Chakra
description: Molten heat pours off this chakra; it will take a warrior of great endurance to withstand the ferocity of the flames!

name: Ignited Guardian's Accoutrements
description: Hot to the touch, only the truest and bravest guardians may wield this weapon.

name: Ignited Guardian's Blade + Shield
description: Hot to the touch, only the truest and bravest guardians may wield this weapon.

name: Illusionary Pocket Watches
description: It's easy to mess with time. All you need to do is change your perception.

name: Illusionary Stage Props
description: Knock the cane against a door three times, and it'll open to a new dimension.

name: Illusionary Trick Cards
description: Blink, and they'll show you new faces.

name: Illusionist's Attack Deck
description: Blink, and they'll show you new faces.

name: Illusionist's Scar
description: Derived from solidified ectoplasm for a blade, this weapon's sharpness relies on its user's control over ectomancy.

name: Illustrious Savior's Blades
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Illustrious Splendor and Shield
description: This is the light of a resilient soul, and a face that screams that it exists. The last sunset approaches, but it isn't the end. Given a little hope and just enough time, nothing is impossible.

name: Illustrious Titanium Tusks
description: An ornate pair of daggers forged from pure titanium. Its craftsmanship reflects its brutality on the battlefield.

name: Immortal Chronomancer Daggers (AC)
description: Immortal Chronomancers transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence.

name: Immortal Chronomancer Daggers (Special)
description: These intrepid, timely explorers can step into a shadow in one time-stream and emerge from a completely different shadow in another time stream. Immortal Chronomancers transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence.

name: Immortal Crusader Saberbuss
description: As long as you stand together with your compatriots, you will NEVER be defeated! Your motto: Libertad O Muerte!

name: Immortal Sacrificer Macanas (AC)
description: Dage the Evil fancies the Beast half of his soul to be the fabled Dark Sun the Immortal Sacrificers speak of. He forged maces to match their preferences. They crush heads like berries.

name: Immortal Sacrificer Macanas (Legend)
description: Dage the Evil fancies the Beast half of his soul to be the fabled Dark Sun the Immortal Sacrificers speak of. He forged maces to match their preferences. They crush heads like berries.

name: Immortal Shadow Breakers
description: These time-worn blades are made from a vein of silver that passed through a leyline. They're constantly won and lost, treated as the regalia of both Vampires and Werewolves, and stolen back by ShadowSlayers to reclaim the night.

name: Immortal Void Blades (AC)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Immortal Void Blades (Legend)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Immortal Void Swords (AC)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Immortal Void Swords (Legend)
description: Those drenched in the immortal void find that even their weapons have taken on their likeness. Where they start, everything ends.

name: Immortalis Magus' Scythes
description: By the power of blood, breath, and bone, these dark magic users seek the ultimate prize: immortality… and they do not care who they must hurt to achieve it.

name: Imperial Assassin's Chakrams
description: Both weapons of hand to hand combat, and flashy alternatives to a staff. Spinning the Chakrams charges energy rapidly.

name: Imperial Gladius + Pavise
description: Crafted by the masterful hands of dwarven smiths, this sword performs exceptionally in close quarter skirmishes.

name: Inaba Oni Battle Fans
description: Some of Yue's customers are Oni who belong to Torakuma-Doji's clan. She designed battle fans to fit how their bloodthirsry nature and penchent for the adorable exists in harmony. Of course, she's terrified whenever they visit.

name: Inaba Oni Gourds
description: Some of Yue's customers are Oni who belong to Torakuma-Doji's clan. She designed gourds to fit how their bloodthirsty nature and penchant for the adorable exists in harmony. Of course, she's terrified whenever they visit.

name: Incandes Fulminatus
description: Mysterious in appearance and by nature, this unique dagger features an electrified runed blade and comfy hand grip. Glitter sold separately.

name: Incandescent Claymores
description: From the mountain's heart of gold, the claymore's blade is still warm from the fires of Dwarfhold Keep's forges. It is a double edged sword, both a devastating weapon and a beacon that beckons greed and danger.

name: Incendiary Cutlasses (AC)
description: Cutlasses forged from mana-infused, superheated metal. They're extremely volatile, and likely to cause an explosion on impact. Only someone who doesn't mind sixth-degree burns should wield them.

name: Incendiary Cutlasses (Legend)
description: Cutlasses forged from mana-infused, superheated metal. They're extremely volatile, and likely to cause an explosion on impact. Only someone who doesn't mind sixth degree burns should wield them.

name: Incendiary Rapiers (AC)
description: One nick will light your body like it's a candlewick. Count down from 3, and you'll be gone; evaporated into a crispy pink mist.

name: Incendiary Rapiers (Legend)
description: One nick will light your body like it's a candlewick. Count down from 3, and you'll be gone; evaporated into a crispy pink mist.

name: Infections Waiting to Happen
description: This knife would make your mother worry. Unless your mother enjoyed pain and suffering.

name: Infernal ArchFiend Swords
description: A Greater Infernal was torn apart and forged into a sentient weapon. It watches as those who once served it call Nulgath their Master. (CC to Accessory)

name: Infernal Athame
description: The flames of magic and power rise within you. Lite the embers and ignite your enemies!

name: Infernal Blade of Revontheus
description: This diabolical blade, a gift from Nulgath, was given to the Revontheus to combat Dage's Legion.

name: Infernal Bone Blades
description: The Infernal Flames' horns don't stop growing. They tear out the growths, and use them to tear open their enemies. Fire catches the blood, burning them to nothing.

name: Infernal Caladbolg Daggers (1)
description: Wielding Caladbolg, you will be able to chop the heads off your enemies and the top off hills!

name: Infernal Caladbolg Daggers (2)
description: Wielding Caladbolg, you will be able to chop the heads off your enemies and the top off hills!

name: Infernal Caladbolgs
description: Forged in fire and bathed in blood, this blade will rip the rope hope, determination, and price pride out of any wielding it… unless you become its master!

name: Infernal Chakrams
description: A painful weapon powered by the negative emotions and dark passions of the fallen. Once a warrior takes it into battle, there's no going back.

name: Infernal Defender's Devastators
description: Dark Infernal Defenders are among the strongest warriors a Celestial Guardian will ever face… and their prowess in battle cannot be denied.

name: Infernal Dual Starsaber
description: When a star collapses into a black hole, it can never go back to what it once was. Powered by raw hatred and despair, these weapons drag their enemies down with them.

name: Infernal General's Destroyers
description: High Infernal Generals command legions of Dark Infernal Defenders. Their power has been known to decimate entire armies… until today.

name: Infernal Hunter Batons (AC)
description: They pack a shock as devastating as divine lightning.

name: Infernal Hunter Batons (Legend)
description: They pack a shock as devastating as divine lightning.

name: Infernal Hunter Rocket Launchers (AC)
description: The answer to most problems, especially Infernal problems, is more fire power.

name: Infernal Hunter Rocket Launchers (Legend)
description: The answer to most problems, especially Infernal problems, is more fire power.

name: Infernal Krampus' Claws
description: You can feel the dark power pulsing off these claws. They are a testament to your many victories in the Infernal Arena.

name: Infernal Legion Athame
description: Legion Pyromancers don't play around with normal fire. Their blue flames come deep with the underworld.

name: Infernal Pirate Pistols
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they want far below Davy Jones's locker.

name: Infernal Pistol + Rapier
description: No one knows exactly what turned these once spirited pirates into vengeful infernal spirits but legend says they want far below Davy Jones's locker.

name: Infernal Regina Flintlocks (AC)
description: Humans were not created for the sea, a vast expanse of death. Yet, they strove to conquer it. Azalith saw this from the clouds, and felt begrudging admiration.

name: Infernal Regina Flintlocks (Legend)
description: Humans were not created for the sea, a vast expanse of death. Yet, they strove to conquer it. Azalith saw this from the clouds, and felt begrudging admiration.

name: Infernal Revenger Blade + Shield (0 AC)
description: The twisted infernals who follow Evil Archmage Brentan in the Mirror Realm love two things best. Fire, and dealing pain to their enemies.

name: Infernal Revenger Blade + Shield (AC)
description: The twisted infernals who follow Evil Archmage Brentan in the Mirror Realm love two things best. Fire, and dealing pain to their enemies.

name: Infernal Short Starsabers
description: When a star collapses into a black hole, it can never go back to what it once was. Powered by raw hatred and despair, these weapons drag their enemies down with them.

name: Infernal SoulRippers
description: The edges of this blade have been smeared with a toxic substance made from the saliva of Dark Makai mixed with the tears of your fallen enemies… plus a few other esoteric ingredients known only to Nulgath's Alchemists.

name: Infernal Starsabers
description: When a star collapses into a black hole, it can never go back to what it once was. Powered by raw hatred and despair, these weapons drag their enemies down with them.

name: Infernal Trigger Blades
description: Blades born from blood, drenched in the rage of the fallen and Infernal.

name: Infernal Underworld Kamas
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Infernal Underworld Katanas
description: Lost souls wander the underworld. Those who retain a measure of their strength and skill may be recruited into the Infernal Underworld Army. They guard the realm itself, unattached to any faction.

name: Inferno Daggers
description: Wield the blazing force of fire in your hand.

name: Inferno Nation Double Axes
description: A weapon that possesses the Fiend wielding it with an unceasing need for violence. The sound of these axes hacking away at bone echoes through barren battlefields.

name: Inferno Shower Daggers
description: Wield the blazing force of fire in your hand. Call upon a firestorm! Duel version.

name: Infinity Titan Reality Gauntlets
description: The hardest choices requires the stronger will. The end is near, but you have the strength of will to act on those choices. Never forget.

name: Infinity Titan Shield
description: The hardest choices requires the stronger will. The end is near, but you have the strength of will to act on those choices. Never forget. *shield appears in offhand only*

name: Injurious Heat
description: Fire flows, throbs and burns. It flows, slowly through this blade, and its burn is eternal. Feast your senses on the scent of burning flesh and the screams of the condemned.

name: InnDestroying Hammer
description: Want to destroy something? Have we got the weapon for you.

name: Insatiable Death Drives (AC)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of these blades is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Insatiable Death Drives (Legend)
description: The living and the dead are drawn to death and destruction. It is in their nature, and the glow of these blades is this essence in concentration. Made from the distilled death drive of doomed souls, the sharp edge attracts necks.

name: Intergalactic Revolver + Kitten Gun
description: Intergalactic…planetery… Too sweet to be sour, too nice to be mean… But a FANTASTIC thief.

name: Intergalactic Shield + Spear
description: Hired by the Furbles, these mercenaries follow them from world to world picking over what the Furbles leave behind.

name: Inverted Brawler Dagger
description: These daggers are rated 10 stabbies out of 10. That's not a real rating, but I did stab 10 people with them and none of them have moved. So I think it's the same thing.

name: Ionic Daggers (AC)
description: Some of the most powerful forces on our world are too small to see… but Ionic Warriors can manipulate the very building blocks of energy and matter to ensure they are victorious.

name: Ionic Daggers (Legend)
description: Some of the most powerful forces on our world are too small to see… but Ionic Warriors can manipulate the very building blocks of energy and matter to ensure they are victorious.

name: Ionized TimeSplitter Guns
description: The amount energy coursing through this weapon will shock you! Wielding it, your victories will be EPIC!

name: Iridescent Party Flames (0 AC)
description: The sparks pulse to the rhythm of your soul.

name: Iridescent Party Flames (AC)
description: The sparks pulse to the rhythm of your soul.

name: Iron Anchors
description: When someone yells "Anchors away!" no one will know if that means the ship's ready to dock, or if they're about to get a mean concussion.

name: Iron Daggers of the Wolf Commander
description: The iron blade wielded by the Commander of the Greywolf Brigade has been handed down through the generations. Rumor has it the blade will glow when betrayal threatens the Commander.

name: Iron Dussacks
description: They're called dussacks, but resemble a butcher's cleaver more than a pair of sabers. Hopefully, none of the monsters you're slaying in Darkovia end up being sold as 'beef.'

name: Iron Flight Cutlasses
description: The chosen blade of any seafaring shinobi. It's a cold streak in the night, light enough to be thrown and sharp enough to cleave enemies in two.

name: Iron Rippers
description: Rippers: Not just for heroes named Jack anymore! Weapons of this style serve the Skyguard well, whatever your name might be!

name: Unidentified Item of Nulgath (Iron Scythe of Nulgath)
description: This mysterious object is the "Iron Scythe of Nulgath."

name: Ironward Daggers
description: A dagger that never rusts, dulls, or breaks. Magic forges a deep link between it and the will of its master. So long as they never break, their dagger will shine stainless.

name: Ironwood's Rage
description: Elder Ironwood's rage at the Void incursion manifested as solidified flame. Use her fury to destroy your enemies!

name: Irredeemable Fiend Blades (0 AC)
description: Once one crosses the threshold of the Fiend's Void, there's no going back. Every inch of your being, down to the steel of your blade, is claimed and mutated.

name: Irredeemable Fiend Blades (AC)
description: Once one crosses the threshold of the Fiend's Void, there's no going back. Every inch of your being, down to the steel of your blade, is claimed and mutated.

name: Irredeemable Fiend Blades (Legend)
description: Once one crosses the threshold of the Fiend's Void, there's no going back. Every inch of your being, down to the steel of your blade, is claimed and mutated.

name: Ivory Blame Blade and Bangle
description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but heroes and paladins can't handle the weight. These blades can only be wielded by sullied hands.

name: Ivory Blame Blade and Shield
description: A sword that becomes sharper and deadlier the more Evil souls it cuts down, but heroes and paladins can't handle the weight. These blades can only be wielded by sullied hands.

name: Ivory Defilers of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged these swords using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Ivory Destroyers of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged these axes using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Ivoryblood Battleaxes
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed-blood descendants.

name: Ivoryblood Great Axes
description: An ancient Ice Dragon made a promise in their final days. They will protect their kin beyond the last sunset. Their scales and bones were forged into weapons that can only be wielded by their mixed-blood descendants.

name: Ixionidae GravaCrushers
description: Noble golden blades that were once fused with stars, used to cleave comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae Gravastars
description: Noble golden blades that were once fused with stars, used to hunt comets and asteroids. Those stars died, and turned into weapons of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae NeutroCrushers
description: Noble golden blades that were once fused with stars, used to cleave comets and asteroids. That star died, and turned into a weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae Neutrostars
description: Noble golden blades that were once fused with stars, used to hunt comets and asteroids. Those stars died, and turned into weapons of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae StarCrushers
description: Noble golden blades that were once fused with stars, used to cull comets and asteroids. Those star died, and turned into weapons of mindless and empty destruction.

name: Ixionidae StarDeaths
description: Noble golden blades that were once fused with starsm used to cull comets and asteroids. Those stars died, and turned into weapon of mindless and empty destruction.

name: J6's Birthday Guns
description: A shotgun in the right hands can be just as formidable in battle as a pistol in the left hands. Opposite is true if you're running to the left.

name: J6's Black Handguns
description: Pistol-whipping's really fun when you're wielding dual black guns!

name: J6's Handguns
description: Pistol-whipping's really fun when you're wielding dual guns!

name: J6's Obsidian Guns (0 AC)
description: A shotgun in the right hands can be just as formidable in battle as a pistol in the left hands. Opposite is true if you're running to the left.

name: J6's Obsidian Guns (AC)
description: A shotgun in the right hands can be just as formidable in battle as a pistol in the left hands. Opposite is true if you're running to the left.

name: J6 Sailor's Double Delight (0 AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: J6 Sailor's Double Delight (AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Jack O Daggers
description: A sinister set of daggers forged in honor of the great Evolved PumpkinLords of Mogloween.

name: Jack's Haunted Battle Gear
description: MUAHAHAHA! A deep, dark laugh rings out as you equip these. That's… that's fine, right? Nothing wrong with a good, hearty chuckle from an invisible companion. Right.

name: Jack's Haunted Treat Gear
description: MUAHAHAHA! A deep, dark laugh rings out as you equip these. That's… that's fine, right? Nothing wrong with a good, hearty chuckle from an invisible companion. Right.

name: Jade Bushido Katanas
description: Slice like a ninja, cut like a… really sharp sword!

name: Jade Cutters
description: Beautiful daggers with blades artfully cut from pure Jade.

name: Jade Daggers
description: Made by Bido, these jade daggers are filled with the fiery flames of one of the most unusual volcanoes in Lore - and only Bido knows where it is!

name: Jade Dragonguard Katana and Sheath
description: A thin layer of steel hides a core made of pure Jade, blessed by the Empress to help ward off evil. In Wuji, Jade symbolizes eternity and immortality. To the Isles, it represents hope and unity.

name: Jade Dragonguard Katanas
description: Thin layers of steel hide cores made of pure Jade, blessed by the Empress to help ward off evil. In Wuji, Jade symbolizes eternity and immortality. To the Isles, it represents hope and unity.

name: Jade Dragonguard Swords
description: A thin layer of steel hides a core made of pure Jade, blessed by the Empress to help ward off evil. In Wuji, Jade symbolizes eternity and immortality. To the Isles, it represents hope and unity.

name: Jade Rabbit Buccaneer Blades
description: The Jade Rabbit Pirates moved so quickly that their blades might as well have been invisible. Their techniques were eventually adopted by the Wuji Empire's navy.

name: Jade Rabbit Buccaneer Rapiers
description: Charming rapiers that plundered ships and freed prisoners. The original belonged to the Jade Rabbits' Captain, and they rest beside their master in her tomb.

name: Jade Rabbit Buccaneer Swords
description: Charming swords that plundered ships and freed prisoners. The original belonged to the Jade Rabbits' Captain, and they rest beside their master in her tomb.

name: Jade Rabbit Flintlocks
description: No matter where it's pointed, your shot will always hit your target. Just don't spend all your luck in one go.

name: Jade Rabbit Pirate Accoutrements
description: Charming weapons that plundered ships and freed prisoners. The originals belonged to the Jade Rabbits' Captain, and they rest beside their master in her tomb.

name: Jade Reavers
description: Made by Bido, these jade reavers are filled with the fiery flames of one of the most unusual volcanoes in Lore - and only Bido knows where it is!

name: Jaws of Depravity
description: A scythe shaped like the crooked jaw of an indulgent beast. It seeks to embrace your warmth with claws and teeth.

name: Jiangshi's Haunted Weaponry
description: A jiangshi, regardless of who they were in life, lashes out at the living indiscriminately. If armed, they become menaces worth the attention of the steel gaze.

name: Jiangshi's Strings of Beads
description: This bracelet was meant to give good fortune and protection to those of kind heart. Now, each bead carries the hateful wishes of a restless spirit. (CC to Accessory)

name: Jin Gong Ji Fans
description: If you're a pyromancer, you'd love to play with these fans because the elemental inferno magic within them boosts their firepower. Just steer clear of anything that's flammable.

name: Jolly Prismatic Frostval Polearm (0 AC)
description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Grab your sharpest blade and put on your your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Jolly Prismatic Frostval Polearm (AC)
description: Frostval is a time to spend with family and friends before you go off on your next adventure. Grab your sharpest blade and put on your your brightest smile! (This item is color customizable.)

name: Joyous Traveler LongSwords (AC)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / Deck your home with its greenery / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Joyous Traveler LongSwords (Legend)
description: Celebrate the return of the light / Deck your home with its greenery / And ribbons of red, green and gold shining bright!

name: Jultane_X's Legion Blades
description: To my Undead minion Jultane_x… your art work is legendary. For that, you deserve exclusive swords I crafted just for you. Keep up your amazing work, as for you have certainly caught the attention of the Artix Entertainment team and myself. --Dage the Evil

name: Jungle Assassin Daggers
description: Made from the shards of a broken crystalized heart, smashed to bits in the Friend Zone.

name: Justified Life Rings (AC)
description: Eventually, every beach and pool in Greenguard is going to have at least one. It's boyant for the good and just, but sinks like a rock if someone like a pick pocket jumps on it.

name: Justified Life Rings (Legend)
description: Eventually, every beach and pool in Greenguard is going to have at least one. It's boyant for the good and just, but sinks like a rock if someone like a pick pocket jumps on it.

name: Kabasaran Bone Clubs
description: Though a morbid weapon rarely used in the present, even the royalty of past Wentira did not turn gold overnight. They had to start from somewhere and protect themselves any way they could.

name: Kabasaran Shielded Polearm
description: Wentira had its own humble beginnings, and has no wish to hide or disregard them. These aged and battle weathered weapons have protected their home for time immemorial.

name: Kabasaran Shielded Sword
description: Wentira had its own humble beginnings, and has no wish to hide or disregard them. These aged and battle weathered weapons have protected their home for time immemorial.

name: Kabasaran Swords
description: Wentira had its own humble beginnings, and has no wish to hide or disregard them. These aged and battle weathered weapons have protected their home for time immemorial.

name: Kagutsuchi Inori Katanas
description: The flames can only be lit with blood. A swordsmith modeled these masterpieces after a child of flame. Their birth and immediate death created eight volcanos.

name: Kaharaka And Knight Slasher Daggers
description: By the power of these blades imbued with the forces of elemental stone and energy, no intelligent opponent will choose to stand against you… not if they wish to survive!

name: Kaharaka's Lightning Fangs
description: WARNING: these daggers' lightning energy are capable of shocking your foes… AND your friends… AND YOU!

name: Kaiju's Scimitars
description: This scimitars belonged to a scurvy dog that served the Kaiju. They be rotten to the core… but at least ye'll get a good weapon out o' them.

name: Kaiju Slayer Daggers
description: Because sometimes smaller is better… Right?… Guys…?

name: Kalayo's Oaths
description: Forged from molten metals from the depths of a volcano. Kalayo breathed fire on the blade, embuing it with an everlasting heat. When you wield the blade, you and Kalayo become as one.

name: Kampilan Sword + Shield
description: Maligayang Araw ng Kalayaan sa lahat ng manlalaro sa Pilipinas.

name: Kappa Kama
description: A weapon of the Kappa Ninja clan. Intimidating design. More intimidating against your enemies.

name: Karmic Battlegear
description: It is foolish king who sows seeds of injustice. Wise gardeners wait patiently, tools in hand, ready to reap their rewards when the harvest time comes.

name: Karrot Daggers
description: Sometimes life is too uncertain to have regrets. That's why ordinary people depend on heroes like you.

name: Kasuari Spear + Shield
description: Traditionally made of straw, Ewer clothing and accessories are worn by the men and women of Western Nunsantara for ceremonies.

name: Kasuari Sword + Shield
description: Traditionally made of straw, Ewer clothing and accessories are worn by the men and women of Western Nunsantara for ceremonies.

name: Kasuari Swords
description: Traditionally made of straw, Ewer clothing and accessories are worn by the men and women of Western Nunsantara for ceremonies.

name: Katanas of Renunciation
description: This blade, wielded by Malakai the Contract Enforcer of Nulgath, severs the ties between lackluster fiends and the Nation. It destroys their contracts, and their souls.

name: Kawaii Gecko Plushies
description: They're no Dragon, but their gallant heart is as big as one!

name: Keening Daggers
description: Named for the way they whistle through the air, and the sound of the target afterwards.

name: Kelly Knuckle Cutter
description: Grip these tightly and take them for a spin. Lashing out has never been more fun, or deadly, and all you have to do is set someone's jaw ablaze with pain in one punch to get them listening.

name: Ketchup and Mustard Bottles
description: At least TASTE it first before you slather all that stuff on! This is gourmet cooking right here.

name: Key Ring
description: Great for unlocking locks and escaping prison. Also comes in handy as a toddler's play toy.

name: Keys to Eden City
description: Eden City is home to many wonderous things, thanks to the exemplary planning and organization of the Crystallis Administration. As a tour guide, you'll chaperone visitors around and extoll their virtues.

name: Kezeroth's Dual Destroyers
description: Somehow you have managed to lift and wield both massive warhammers. You are truly a force to be reckoned with.

name: Khione's Curse Blades
description: The Lady of Ice stalks the night, and those who fail to greet meet the edge of her cold, cursed blade.

name: King Alteon's Golden Egis
description: Golden regalia worthy of a King. Alteon's armaments were forged by the people who believed in him.

name: King Alteon's Golden Maces
description: Alteon's sword is instantly recognizable, but he always had a fondness for blunt, straight-to-the-point maces. That used to get him in all sorts of trouble, which he can't afford anymore. Lynaria and Valen aren’t around to get him out of it.

name: King Alteon's Golden Swords
description: Corvak was King Alteon's Draconic partner, meant to protect the realm and his family until the end of their shared days. This dream did not come to be, but his memory lives on, defending the realm and King Alteon's daughters.

name: King's Armaments
description: King Alteon's original mace and his golden sword. His past and present. Never once did he forget the reason why he took the throne and crown.

name: King's Dual Torment
description: The KingSlayer is an eldritch warrior that feeds on those of royal blood, stealing their innate power and gifts. (This item goes rare March 31, 2021)

name: King's Hallowed Blades (0 AC)
description: Blades created from pale moonlight shining on darkness. They were awarded to the first of the Unhallowed Wights before being passed to the next generation, and the next, searching for one who would eclipse the moon.

name: King's Hallowed Blades (AC)
description: Blades created from pale moonlight shining on darkness. They were awarded to the first of the Unhallowed Wights before being passed to the next generation, and the next, searching for one who would eclipse the moon.

name: Kinsman's Partner Blades
description: One sword is yours, and the other belongs to another that accompanies you in spirit.

name: Kirin Horn Sai
description: Made from the real horns of a kirin, these sai are virtually unbreakable.

name: Kitsune Kukolnyy Katanas
description: Weapon that rots, trapped in a dying moment. They used to be Chaos Lord Kitsune's blades, but now they suffer the humiliation of becoming a Dragon's toys.

name: Kitty Bat and Backpack
description: Violence is bad and against the law, unless you're doing it for love. Especially the love of a cat. Then, anything goes.

name: Kitty Kawaii Bats
description: What is yours is mine, and if claws won't make you belieive that, then some blunt force trauma should do. Think of me in your concussed dreams.

name: Knight of Light's Sword + Shield
description: The royal guardians of Queen Lynaria, the defend all who pose a threat.

name: Knight's Swords of Brilliant Honor
description: From generation to generation, born under the auspices of the same righteous star, this sword changes hands. The spirit within grants its wielder's wishes.

name: Knight Slashers
description: No matter how many "stoneskin enchantments" your opponent has cast on his armor, this weapon will be able to pierce it (and his innards)!

name: Knuckleswords of Madness
description: The giftbox unwraps to reveal a weapon of eldritch horror… and devastating holiday power. Perfect to /SLAY all year long!

name: Krenos Spirit Katanas
description: Krenos is set to be the strongest of its kind. Even now, lightning sparks in anticipation of their birth. Like the warriors who wield these blades, their strength will venerate and alienate them. A great, yet lamentable fate awaits.

name: Krupuk Cracker Containers
description: Krupuk crackers are a delicious fried snack known for the crunch and snap as you bite into them. Perfect for a hungry hero after battling all day.

name: Kua-Toa Dagger
description: A devilish little dagger, perfect for assassins. This blade cuts deep and fast.

name: Kurogatana + Onigatana
description: This curse blade has defeated many many enemies.

name: Kurze's Chaotic Conclusion
description: The conclusion after the Chaos soldier climbs up and fights against the malice towards positivity.

name: Kyanos Accoutrements
description: The Warriors of Kyanos have very special gear to help handle the cold as they battle through the icy lands of Glacera.

name: Lady Lua's Fans
description: Lady Lua's fan is not just a weapon… it is also the symbol of the ruler of her house. It has been passed down through the ages when the heir ascends. (Changes when in combat)

name: Lagomorph Punk Hammers
description: If you’re a rabid rabbit, every problem looks like a nail.

name: Lanterns of Forsaken Souls (0 AC)
description: The flames that light these lanterns came from witch burnings. They mysteriously burned out of control, consuming the villages and Witch Hunters that dared offend the Legion's Sorceresses.

name: Lanterns of Forsaken Souls (AC)
description: The flames that light these lanterns came from witch burnings. They mysteriously burned out of control, consuming the villages and Witch Hunters that dared offend the Legion's Sorceresses.

name: Lapis Infernalis Daggers
description: Sky blue daggers that are pretty and sharp, but don't live up to their name. Lapis Infemalis is silver. The jeweller or blacksmith who made this blade were thinking they could make more gold if their wares had an alchemical vibe.

name: Laser Beam
description: Momentarily out of action… because the power cells are low.

name: Laser Hanzo Void Katanas (AC)
description: You are a Horror, slashing through the Matrix, killing all in your sight. Discovered by the intrepid Fairy, your fellow AQW hero!

name: Laser Hanzo Void Katanas (Legend)
description: You are horror, slashing through the Matrix, killing all in your sight. Discovered by the intrepid Fairy, your fellow AQW hero!

name: Lava Spear and Shield
description: The shield protects you from the heat of battle, while your spear kindles it.

name: Lava Star Daggers
description: Forged by Tana in the very heart of the Lore's Sun. This starsword is special. It's Hilt contains fragment of Fiamme's elemental essence.

name: Lavamorph Dual Banes
description: This lava rock dagger holds lava within it which can be released as another means of attack or block your foe off while fleeing.

name: Lavarock Destroyer's Blades (0 AC)
description: Molten rock twisted and hardened into jagged blades fit for their breath starved masters. Fire still pulses, and just being near them suffocates the living.

name: Lavarock Destroyer's Blades (AC)
description: Molten rock twisted and hardened into jagged blades fit for their breath starved masters. Fire still pulses, and just being near them suffocates the living.

name: Lavastorm Lord Scythes
description: Blaze forth with these lava infused axes

name: LaZer Blade of Times (AC)
description: A fancier way to cut through the ages.

name: LaZer Blade of Times (Legend)
description: A fancier way to cut through the ages.

name: Le Ultimate Brunch
description: A refined weapon for heroes of taste and terrible decisions. Served with a side of dramatic flair.

name: League Competitor's Classic Guns (Non-AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Classic Guns (0 AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Classic Guns (AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Gun (Dagger) (0 AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Custom Gun (Dagger) (AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Guns (AC)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: League Competitor's Guns (Legend)
description: Laser precision built in to win.

name: Left Sock Sheathed Cutlasses (AC)
description: Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Left Sock Sheathed Cutlasses (Legend)
description: Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Legacy Nation Blades (AC)
description: These blades wear the face of Archfiend Nulgath. His likeness in exact precision is only trusted to legacy members of the Nation. And his gifts do NOT come cheaply.

name: Legacy Nation Blades (Legend)
description: These blades wear the face of Archfiend Nulgath. His likeness in exact precision is only trusted to legacy members of the Nation. And his gifts do NOT come cheaply.

name: Legendary Broodfiend Talons
description: Infect the world with Nulgath's darkness and bring strength and victory to the Nation!

name: Legendary Knight's Sword + Shield
description: These brave soldiers swear to defend King Alteon, Queen Lynaria and all of Swordhaven from any danger.

name: Legion Beast Carver and Shield (0 AC)
description: A savage weapon made for beasts to slay and carve their kin. There are rumors among the Legion that it works best in the hands of those who have turned their backs on the Archfiend and his minions.

name: Legion Beast Carver and Shield (AC)
description: A savage weapon made for beasts to slay and carve their kin. There are rumors among the Legion that it works best in the hands of those who have turned their backs on the Archfiend and his minions.

name: Legion Beast's Claw Daggers
description: From deep within the shadows of the Underworld, the Beasts of the Legion stalk their prey, slaying swiftly and silently. To slay the beast, you must BECOME the beast.

name: Legion Bone Crusher and Shield
description: Works as well as any hammer when used on the living. But when used on the undead that refuse to serve the Legion's Lord, it binds their soul to their bone fragments, forcing them to exist in that pathetic state.

name: Legion Bone Crushers
description: Works as well as any hammer when used on the living. But when used on the undead that refuse to serve the Legion's Lord, it binds their soul to their bone fragments, forcing them to exist in that pathetic state.

name: Legion Conqueror Battle Gear
description: Before the Legion Conqueror met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror across the land. Now, they do the same for Dage the Evil. (Item is color customizable.)

name: Legion Conqueror Sword + Shield
description: Before the Legion Conqueror met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror across the land. Now, they do the same for Dage the Evil. (Item is color customizable.)

name: Legion Dark Arcana Dagger
description: These chakrams are fortified with magic so dark it shines!

name: Legion Deathdealer Blade and Shield
description: This blade and shield are only for the most elite members of Dage's Undead Legion.

name: Legion DeathFiend's Morningstars
description: Legion DeathFiends are sworn body and soul to Dage the Evil's Undead Legion. They stalk the edges of the Underworld looking for unwary victims.

name: Legion DeathSpines
description: Before the Legion Conqueror met their untimely end, they spread fear and terror across the land. Now, they do the same for Dage the Evil. (Item is color customizable.)

name: Legion Evocator Flames (0 AC)
description: An Evocator unique magic flares menacingly, with the ability to bring death to bones while the flesh burns but remains alive. A twist there, a bend here, and a monstrosity is born.

name: Legion Evocator Flames (AC)
description: An Evocator unique magic flares menacingly, with the ability to bring death to bones while the flesh burns but remains alive. A twist there, a bend here, and a monstrosity is born.

name: Legion Evocatus's Spadas (AC)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Dage after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Evocatus's Spadas (Legend)
description: The Evocatus are loyal Legionnaires who voluntarily choose to serve Lord Dage after the end of their mortal lives. Eternal servitude to their lord is the greatest honor in undeath.

name: Legion Loyalty Blades
description: This note will turn into the OathKeeper Undersworn Combo reward.

name: Legion Malignant Blades
description: Equipping this ancient, magically-crafted artifact will ensure that you will be fueled in battle by a malevolent fury strong enough to last beyond death.

name: Legion Skull Daggers
description: Forged by Quintenii, the Skull Daggers hold the might and rage of the Legion deep within its blades.

name: Legion SoulSeeker
description: Must be in Undead Legion to use. Straight from the Dage's Soulforge, and empowered by the rage and hatred of those who have passed on. A special alloy will respond ONLY to the Undead Legion members!

name: Legion Spine Shanks
description: The slow blades penetrates, and captures another soul for the Undead Legion of Dage The Evil.

name: Legion Star Daggers
description: Toss them quick and fast and from a distance, you're practically firing a laser from the palm of your hands.

name: Legion Symbiote Cleavers
description: The parasite infecting this armor was created especially for Dage's Legion. Now truly be one with the Dark Lord.

name: Legion War Wraith Dagger (0 AC)
description: The War Wraiths' blades pulse cold from gathering souls that still yearn for the rush of battle. They cling to this blade, desiring further glory.

name: Legion War Wraith Dagger (AC)
description: The War Wraiths' blades pulse cold from gathering souls that still yearn for the rush of battle. They cling to this blade, desiring further glory.

description: The War Wraiths' blades pulse cold from gathering souls that still yearn for the rush of battle. They cling to this blade, desiring further glory.

name: Leonine Regalia Greatswords
description: Ruled by the Sun, heroes who were born and battle under the Leo's star sign are recognized everywhere as passionate and creative. But much like the lion that represents them, they can be fiercely prideful when attacked.

name: Leprechaun's Curse
description: Made of the purest gold, these daggers were found hidden deep inside the trunk of a thousand year old tree. It is believed they belonged to a leprechaun who fought valiantly to save his home and village.

name: Leques da Mãe D'água
description: The cool breeze from the river cleanses your sorrows with a sense of calm.

name: Leques Ecantado da Mãe D'água
description: The cool breeze from the river cleanses your sorrows with a sense of calm.

name: Less Than You Need
description: This weapon was crafted just for Less, winner of the October Custom Weapon prize. It has 15% XP, CP, Gold, and Rep boosts, plus does 15% more damage to all monsters. Congratulations!

name: Leviathan Domination Spears
description: Massive beasts fight for dominance in the churning sea. Yet a single tusk pointed at just the right angle can pierce right through their skull, and bring them peace. The Adeptus that grew this spear out of their body will feast on the spoils for months to come.

name: Leviathanius' Golden Claws
description: This gilded weapon was part of the Water Titan's closely-guarded treasure, kept safe deep under the waves until you defeated it.

name: Lich's Necronomicon and Staff
description: A combo devastating to all that are living.

name: Lichen-Crusted Blades
description: *No description*

name: Lichen-Crusted Crypt Blades
description: While flowers can be strong, those with thorns are strongest!

name: Light Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Light!

name: Light Dual CA Assaulters
description: This weapon is the property of the Crystallis administration. Return to Suite 37a1C, c/o Chief Munitions Coordinator.

name: Light in the Mist Daggers
description: These mystical daggers will light your way to victory, as you eradicate your foes while journeying of your path to becoming a HERO!

name: Light's Defender Spear and Shield
description: Defend all that is holy and divine! You shall be protected as you in turn protect others.

name: Light Thief Pistols (AC)
description: A pistol that relies solely on your mana. Even those that have little talent with Light magic can wield it. Some believe that Light magic should be exclusive to the chosen seek to destroy these kinds of weapons whenever possible.

name: Light Thief Pistols (Legend)
description: A pistol that relies solely on your mana. Even those that have little talent with Light magic can wield it. Some believe that Light magic should be exclusive to the chosen seek to destroy these kinds of weapons whenever possible.

name: Lightglaive Ordens
description: This weapon has been enchanted by a master weaponsmith. Click its handle to activate a transformation that will distract your enemy in battle!

name: Lighting Bolt Cutlasses
description: Omigoshomigoshomigoshomigoshomigosh! It's WONDER(ful) Bolt!

name: Lightning Helixes
description: Conductive weapons carved from horns shed by an Energy Dragon after a calamitous battle. They're charged to the very limit, despite how the feud with the Manticores ended long ago.

name: Lightning Knuckle Daggers (AC)
description: What better way to tear into Tinsel's gifts?

name: Lightning Knuckle Daggers (Legend)
description: What better way to tear into Tinsel's gifts?

name: Lightning Necromancer's Dagger
description: Channeling elemental energy siphoned from the storms that tear through the peaks of Thunderfang Spire, the Lightning Necromancers that rule there terrify all who oppose them. Their threat? Unleashing the NecroStorm!

name: Lightning Pirate's Cutlass + Charged Wheel
description: When ye sail the seas, ye get the storms. Lightnin' crashes and suddenly yer electric!

name: Lightning Pirate's Dual Charged Wheels
description: When ye sail the seas, ye get the storms. Lightnin' crashes and suddenly yer electric!

description: When ye sail the seas, ye get the storms. Lightnin' crashes and suddenly yer electric!

name: Lightning Pirate's Dual WheelGuns
description: When ye sail the seas, ye get the storms. Lightnin' crashes and suddenly yer electric!

name: Lightning Sea Splitters (0 AC)
description: Relics found in a metal ship that had turned into rust at the bottom of the sea. A stab could electrocute everyone in the water. A slash could spit the oceans open.

name: Lightning Sea Splitters (AC)
description: Relics found in a metal ship that had turned into rust at the bottom of the sea. A stab could electrocute everyone in the water. A slash could spit the oceans open.

name: Lightwielder's Armblades
description: Dual armblades of the Lightwielders, an elite order of zombie hunters.

name: Lightwielder's Knuckles
description: Dual fist weapons of the Lightwielders, an elite order of zombie hunters.

name: Lightwielder's Shield and Spear
description: Complete the arsenal of the Lightwielders, an elite order of zombie hunters, with this equally protective and deadly gear.

name: LionSlayer Soul Whip and Shield (0 AC)
description: The sound of violent lashing can be heard in the distance, or is it right behind you? Are you hunting a tired shade, or did you just become the hunted?

name: LionSlayer Soul Whip and Shield (AC)
description: The sound of violent lashing can be heard in the distance, or is it right behind you? Are you hunting a tired shade, or did you just become the hunted?

name: Litch Knight's Dual Swords
description: Just because you're a knight doesn't mean you can't take pride in your appearance!

name: Litch Knight's Sword + Whip
description: Just because you're a knight doesn't mean you can't take pride in your appearance!

name: Live Dragon Daggers
description: These daggers were drawn and colored by J6 LIVE in AQ Worlds on July, 29th 2010 with the help of player suggestions. Did you join and help him create these deadly daggers?

name: Living Shadow Katana (Dagger)
description: Summon the shadows to aide you. HAS SHADOW ANIMATION

name: Livyatan's Billow Harpoons
description: A precise shot in just the right spot can take down a monster five times the size of your ship. As your quarry slowly bleeds out, you follow the blood trail, like death lurking the waves.

name: Llussion's Glaives
description: The war glaives designed for specialized combat by Llussion.

name: Lolosian Corsairs Hands of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite Corsairs with this giant hand!

name: Long Lycan Dagger
description: Isn't a long dagger just a sword? A Lycan doesn't really care as long as it works!

name: Longswords of the Dark
description: In a sea of darkness, real or imaginary, makes one realize how small they are. This sword that was born from a wish to escape weakness, to fuse into a greater, powerful wave of shadow.

name: Looking Glass Cutlasses (AC)
description: Cutlasses Scarletta made from enchanted glass, able to perfectly catch her reflection as well as her victims. They're very fragile, and the people inside them know that all too well. Their screams are great at distracting the enemy.

name: Looking Glass Cutlasses (Legend)
description: Cutlasses Scarletta made from enchanted glass, able to perfectly catch her reflection as well as her victims. They're very fragile, and the people inside them know that all too well. Their screams are great at distracting the enemy.

name: Lord Soul Blades (AC)
description: Blades that pulse with a power that the greatest Mages of Lore could only ever hope to attain. Having seen the center of the universe, Dage the Evil crafted these weapons from its essence and tempered it with his own soul.

name: Lord Soul Blades (Legend)
description: Blades that pulse with a power that the greatest Mages of Lore could only ever hope to attain. Having seen the center of the universe, Dage the Evil crafted these weapons from its essence and tempered it with his own soul.

name: Lore's Champion Daggers
description: These daggers draw in all the negative flow around Lore and transmit it to their owner. A very heavy price to pay.

name: Lorosian Hunter Gun Set
description: Capable of hunting the most devious of bounties, the Lorosian Hunters were feared all through the Galaxy.

name: Lorosian Hunter Handguns
description: Capable of hunting the most devious of bounties, the Lorosian Hunters were feared all through the Galaxy.

name: Lorosian Hunter Sabers
description: Capable of hunting the most devious of bounties, the Lorosian Hunters were feared all through the Galaxy.

name: Lost Bayonets
description: Bayonets once fastened to the muzzle of a respected commander's rifle. They snapped off the moment a deep sea curse claimed the lost seafarer. Will it pass that curse to you, too?

name: Lost Claws of the Oasis
description: Assumed to be an elegant weapon fit for royalty, the endless beating of sand and wind have warped these blades considerably. No one knows for sure just what these looked like before the Sandsea took its toll.

name: Lost Daggers
description: Careful or you might lose these daggers… in your enemy's back.

name: Love's Gladiator Daggers
description: Ruby blades of condensed love, slicing through the hate and loneliness of a hero's life.

name: Loveletters of Beleen!
description: OMGOMGOMG how super duper ADORABLE! See what happens when Beleen gets hold of the ArchFiend Nulgath's infamous Bloodletters? She creates Loveletters, d'awww

name: Lovely Fan
description: Dress wearing martial artists will look great while sawing things in half with this lethal fan. Also good for cooling yourself off during the summer heat.

name: Lovely Moonlighters
description: May silver moonlight and diamond stars lead you to love. The wielder of these arcane blades of illusion and mystery can let the loveless live their dreams, even if they'll never be real.

name: Lovely Rocker's Drum Set
description: Count the drum beats like this: Tsun. Tsun. Tsun. Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-TsunTsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun.
