name: Lovely Rocker's Drumsticks
description: Count the drum beats like this: Tsun. Tsun. Tsun. Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-TsunTsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun-Tsun.

name: Lovesick Infernal Hammers
description: Your volatile emotions feed these Infernal hammers to the point that they're bursting from an overcharge. May you strike your love true. (Click to transform)

name: Loyal Alloy Daggers
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master of their kin.

name: Loyal Alloy Dirks
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master or their kin.

name: Loyal Alloy Knives
description: Liquid metal drawn from the blood of Steel Dragons can be forged into any form. Weapons of this make are noted to never wound their master or their kin.

name: Loyal Hand of Victory
description: Cheer for your favorite patriotic team!

name: Loyal Hands of Domination
description: Cheer for your favorite patriotic team!

name: Lucky Emerald Cutter
description: Brilliantly reflective, these green blades shine with the luck of generations of fighting men and women. Light in your hands, you will be able to move deftly and skillfully to kill anyone who crosses you and tries to take your luck.

name: Lucky O'Daggers
description: This glistening gold blade is nothing short of extremely deadly. What says "Good luck with life!" better than a jagged, shining golden axe at one's throat. Wrapped around the green handle is a golden 4-leaf clover. Luck is with you!

name: LUDP Halters (0 AC)
description: When competition between rivals gets too crazy, EbilCorp encourages you to take matters into your own hands. Do it with the scariest looking weapons imaginable. Make it send a message.

name: LUDP Halters (AC)
description: When competition between rivals gets too crazy, EbilCorp encourages you to take matters into your own hands. Do it with the scariest looking weapons imaginable. Make it send a message.

name: Lumiel Spinsaws
description: Intimidating contraptions with utility in and outside of battle. They efficiently dismember the Undead, and easily cut through stone walls. The saws are a lifesaver if your party gets stuck in a collapsing tomb.

name: Lumina Claw
description: These claws emit a steady glow which will light your way to your enemies on even the darkest of desert nights.

name: Luminous Warrior's Armblades (0 AC)
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Luminous Warrior's Armblades (AC)
description: Illuminated by the love and loyalty they feel for their Lord, Luminous Warriors are shining examples of what it means to serve the Avatar of Light.

name: Lunar Sand Daggers
description: Stab by the light of the moon!

name: Lunar Thief Pistols (AC)
description: There's a charm on this pistol that puts the target to sleep rather than putting them to death. It could be a mercy, or it could be a cruelty to make them live with their failures.

name: Lunar Thief Pistols (Legend)
description: There's a charm on this pistol that puts the target to sleep rather than putting them to death. It could be a mercy, or it could be a cruelty to make them live with their failures.

name: Lunarian Blasters
description: This is one of the best weapons available for an Astromancer training to learn the ways of the Moon.

name: Lunarian Mallets
description: A replica of the tools the moon rabbits use to pound mochi. Getting your hand struck by one hurts pretty bad. Pounding a head is something the real moon rabbits think about a lot.

name: Lunaris Curved Moonbeam Daggers
description: The Lunaris Clan's moon watches over them no matter where they go.

name: Lunaris Moonbeam Sabers
description: The Lunaris Clan's moon watches over them no matter where they go.

name: LunaSol Beam Sabers
description: Sol and Luna are meant to be in harmony.

name: Lustrous Bow and Arrow
description: This luminous bow will light the way through the darkness as you hunt your enemies.

name: Luxuria's Daggers
description: Luxuria's TRUE desire is to possess, then destroy.

name: Luxuria's Reversed Daggers
description: Luxuria's TRUE desire is to possess, then destroy.

name: M4tr1x Bloodletter of Nulgath
description: The dual blades of the Blood Void.

name: M4trix SkyGuard Sword + Shield (0 AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: M4trix SkyGuard Sword + Shield (AC)
description: Patrolling the skies above the kingdom of Swordhaven, the Skyguard are elite members of King Alteon's flying army. Much more than just a job, the Skyguard is a life-long commitment.

name: Mac the Knife
description: Looks like Macky's back in town!

name: Macuahuitl of the Dead Daggers
description: Common weapon used by tribes to fend off enemies.

name: Mad Pirate-Smith's Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Mad Pirate-Smith's Cutlasses (AC)
description: Your local mad weaponsmith woke up one day and wanted you to become ruler of the seas! He suited you up with all the tools you need, made out of yesterday's laundry and several gallons of recalled anti-sea monsters spray.

name: Mad Weapon Smithing Tools (Legend)
description: Cysero said that he always wanted to give hand me downs, despite him making this brand new for you. They look like smithing gear but the man himself said they were daggers.

name: Mad Weapon Smithing Tools (Non-Legend)
description: Cysero said that he always wanted to give hand me downs, despite him making this brand new for you. They look like smithing gear but the man himself said they were daggers.

name: Mage's Kris and Staff
description: Why wield just a sword or just a staff when you can…(wait for it)…wield BOTH! Each weapon is color custom.

name: Magical Bean Moglins
description: You can squish Twilly against your right cheek, and squish Twig against your left cheek.

name: Magical Bean Twigs
description: It's so soft! The insides must be made of ice cream and fish paste.

name: Magical Bean Twillys
description: How huggable! Or biteable? Maybe both?

name: Magical Dryad's Daggers
description: These nymphs of the forest help the plants flourish with their powers. Small seeds suddenly become towering trees in their presence.

name: Magical Gecko Action Figures
description: Eye of newt and toe of frog, Wool of bat and tongue of dog - but absolutely no gecko parts in your magic potion!

name: Magical Hammers Of Time (AC)
description: They sparkle when you bonk an enemy into the last century. But only if you remember to call out your attack.

name: Magical Hammers Of Time (Legend)
description: They sparkle when you bonk an enemy into the last century. But only if you remember to call out your attack.

name: Magistral's Bow + Arrow
description: These Aeromancers gain power from the very air around them. Wind power!

name: Magitech Clawblades (AC)
description: Blades that have yet to reach their full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Magitech Clawblades (Legend)
description: Blades that have yet to reach their full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Magitech Time Sigils (0 AC)
description: Instead of finding ways to travel through time, magitech engineers are inventing ways to make time move around them. This is incredibly dangerous magic, a product of hubris instead of altruistic creation.

name: Magitech Time Sigils (AC)
description: Instead of finding ways to travel through time, magitech engineers are inventing ways to make time move around them. This is incredibly dangerous magic that is a product of hubris instead of altruistic creation.

name: Magma Claws
description: Why just attack someone with normal weapons when you can beat them with a red-hot dagger?

name: Magmagilt Kamas
description: It's only right that you keep it as a reward.

name: Magmagilt Odachis
description: It's only right that you keep it as a reward.

name: Magmagilt Tabars
description: It's only right that you keep it as a reward.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Blades (AC)
description: Greatswords forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Blades (Legend)
description: Greatswords forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Daggers (AC)
description: Daggers forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Daggers (Legend)
description: Daggers forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Swords (AC)
description: Swords forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Magna Draconic Regalia Swords (Legend)
description: Swords forged with every last piece of gold from a Dragon's hoard. Their bones and blood were poured into the mould, made in their likeness, to please the ego of a rival that defeated them in battle.

name: Mahorc-Uraga Branched Knives
description: Sacred blades swing and ring, ring. With these relics, I summon…

name: Making a Point (Dagger)
description: When you want to make a point, this is how you do it.

name: Malani Scimitar
description: These deadly blades are wielded by the horse-loving Malani Warriors, feared throughout the SandSea and beyond of their deadly skills in battle, whether on fighting on sand or ahorse!

name: Malefic Curse Pistols (AC)
description: Take aim, fire, and take their soul before Death's hands can reach them. Their hate will be another bullet in your arsenal. (CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Malefic Curse Pistols (Legend)
description: Take aim, fire, and take their soul before Death's hands can reach them. Their hate will be another bullet in your arsenal. (CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Maleno's Fangs
description: This blade is carried only by Idalion's most brutal enforcers. Each strike leaves a trail of smoldering ash - a warning to those who would defy their master's claim.

name: Malevolent Scarecrow Chainsaws
description: Cuts through bone as easy as a scythe can cut through wheat.

name: Malevolent Two Headed Torch
description: The two flames were lit by powerful sorcerers who are trapped in a bitter rivalry. A middle party can harness the great fiery power of both.

name: Malgor's Exalted Light Blades
description: The Lord of Exalted Light's personal blade and most treasured possession. Before Malgor's creator set him free, letting go of their last hopes, they gave him blades engraved with their courage and conviction.

name: Malicious Code Blades
description: They can hack their way through any simulation…which means they can cut through everything?

name: Malicious Daggers of Nightmares
description: One sight of you with this weapon equipped and your enemies will NEVER sleep peacefully again. Mission accomplished.

name: Mallow Longswords
description: Be careful when you swing this… and don't get it hot! So sticky.

name: Mallowpuffs
description: Be careful when you swing this… and don't get it hot! So sticky.

name: Mammoth Hand Of Domination
description: Cheer on your favorite hairy giants with this giant hand!

name: Mana Crystals Dagger
description: Snow obeys your every whim.

name: Mana Dagger
description: These daggers are nothing but pure mana, woven together tightly so that it is tangible object of offense. Don't let the odd shape fool you. What you see is a direct manifestation of your mind. Not our fault if you see something strange.

name: Mana Fenix Feathered Armblades
description: To receive the honor to touch the frozen jungle parrot's feathers unharmed in a huge accomplishment that brings you good fortunes in the years to come.

name: Mana Flame Torches
description: The endless potential of mana is dangerous. Such a thing could be said about new ideas and youth. Warlic imparted that wisdeom to Tara, and with great care, she lit torches that would light your way and protect you.

name: Mana Guardian's Hammers
description: The Mana Core contains the most pure magic available. Any mage drawing from the Core would be flooded with pure magic, overcome in a deluge of power which would burn through their physical, mental, and magical veins. It MUST be guarded to protect our world.

name: Mana Paladin's Awe Sword + Shield
description: A weapon made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest a reflection this pure.

name: Mana Scholar's Arcane Craft
description: A delicate and etheral staff that disappears when Winter ends. At the cost of its master's life, it can blanket an entire country in snow, and put them in a deep sleep. Only a most dire circumstace would call for that fatal spell.

name: Mana Solace Paladin's Axes
description: A popular favorite. When manifesting weapons from mana and the light of their souls, the Mana Solace Paladins' aspirations take this form to fulfill their childhood dreams.

name: Mana Solace Paladin's Spear + Shield
description: A spear made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. This is a personal favorite of Tara's. Warlic's wisdom and Artix's "sense for cool" taught her how to summon it at the snap of a finger.

name: Mana Solace Paladin's Swords
description: Weapons made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest reflections this pure.

name: Manana Cleavers
description: Like with their strange and terrifying natural predators, you should never give Mananas knives.

name: ManaShaper's Sword & Staff
description: Legend says the glacial core for this was stolen from the Ice Queen Aisha.

name: Maniacal Neko Maces
description: This…isn't actually a Maneki Neko, is it? They got too much of a foul mouth to give anyone good fortune.

name: Maraca of Doom +15 (AC)
description: The ONLY maracas used to celebrate Cinco de Mayo in Doomwood! Now it does 15% MORE DAMAGE against the Undead!

name: Maraca of Doom +15 (Legend)
description: The ONLY maracas used to celebrate Cinco de Mayo in Doomwood! Now it does 15% MORE DAMAGE against the Undead!

name: Maraud of the Minotaur (Dagger) (AC)
description: Got beef with somebody? "Convince" them to see things your way by showing them the Maraud of the Minotaur battle axe!

name: Maraud of the Minotaur (Dagger) (Legend)
description: Got beef with somebody? "Convince" them to see things your way by showing them the Maraud of the Minotaur battle axe!

name: Marauder's Cutlass + Pistol
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Marauder's Cutlasses
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Marauder's Pistols
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Marauder's Rapier + Cutlass
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Marauder's Rapiers
description: Under a black flag we sail and the sea shall be our empire! No ship be safe from our guns, an' glory an' gold be the treasure we seek.

name: Mariachi Hero Maracas
description: All I wanted was to be a nightmare, like my ancestors. But the dream I thought would bring me luck, brought only a curse. I lost my moglin, my mustache, and my maracas.

name: Marsh Flames
description: A weapon found in the long lost depths of a marsh.

name: Martial Master Nunchucks
description: Weapons that requires quick hand movements and tight focus, which makes them effective training tool as well. Supposedly, an Emperor invented the nunchucks, and they were completely made of bronze as opposed to wood.

name: Martial White Lotus Runes
description: The rune is a spiral of petals, growing and dying. Flowers wilt. Snow melts. One's time is limited, so you must make it count.

name: Marvel-ous Dual Photon Blades (0 AC)
description: This weapon was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Dual Photon Blades before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Marvel-ous Dual Photon Blades (AC)
description: This weapon was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Dual Photon Blades before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Marvel-ous Dual Photon Guns (AC)
description: This weapon was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Dual Photon Guns before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Marvel-ous Dual Photon Guns (Legend)
description: This weapon was originally going to be called the WidowMaker Dual Photon Guns before EbilCorp's legal team intervened.

name: Master Cleavers
description: You'll never MEAT an enemy you can't find a good use for when you have this axe equipped.

name: Master Terror Guard's Spears
description: This relic gives off a very otherworldly aura. Warlic says it comes from another timeline… one very similar - but significantly different - than ours. (This item is fully color customizable.)

name: May Tricks Dual Machine GunZ
description: Don't THINK you are a Hero. KNOW you are a Hero.

name: MC Miko's Enchanted Microphones
description: Dropping the sickest music outta Yokai Isle!

name: MC Miko's Microphones
description: Dropping the sickest music outta Yokai Isle!

name: Mecha Dragon Commander Blades
description: You are the commander of Mecha Dragons… all shall bow before you! (Item is customizable to base and accessory.)

name: Mecha Kaiju Slayer Daggers
description: Because sometimes smaller is better… Right?… Guys…?

name: Mecha Leprechaun Swords
description: The future is now and your mecha helm is primed for combat. Do ya feel LUCKY?! (Color-customizable to accessory)

name: Mechanical Star Daggers
description: Toss them quick and fast and from a distance, you're practically firing a laser from the palm of your hands.

name: Mechanized Armblades
description: Using Shadowscythe technology, defeated allies are converted into mindless undead cyborgs. Defiance is futile; supremacy is inevitable. (Shadow series gen 2)

name: Mediator Armblades
description: A pair of high-frequency armblades for close-quarter situations.

name: Melano Amethyst Daggers
description: A deep violet dagger of sophisticated make. The jewellers and forgemasters collaborated to make this, and brag about how it can ward off poison.

name: Melodic Ice Crystals
description: An orb of concentrated ice magic, created by Glace when her corpse was possesssed by a fallen god. The orb sings as it generates icy magic instead of consuming mana to cast spells.

name: Melody Of The Roses
description: As the sun rises over the mountains, a condor calls the warriors to battle. The Dawn Duelists prepare to defend their home. They will give their life for the land and people they love so much.

name: Memeat Formal Cleavers
description: Sure, it's a little uncomfortable. But on the plus side, it tastes good.

name: Memento Mori Maces
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever be forgotten…

name: Menacing Underworld Dagger
description: Slice 'em up, Legion Style.

name: Mendicant's Last Resorts
description: The Medicants vowed to heal, but needing to claim lives to save souls is inevitable in the line of duty.

name: Mercilessness Mercenary Guns
description: You have got some BIG guns there. Are you just happy to see me… or are you just after my bounty?

name: Merry Gentlemen
description: Sometimes, your neighbor won't open the door when you knock. That doesn't mean they don't want a carol. Help them out, and take out the annoying thing getting in the way of holiday cheer. These merry gentlemen are perfect for the job.

name: Merry Silver Pistols (AC)
description: Silver is an essential tool in a Shadowslayer's arsenal. Iron is turning into a close favorite as the wandering hunters become more aware of the Fae's dark side.

name: Merry Silver Pistols (Legend)
description: Silver is an essential tool in a Shadowslayer's arsenal. Iron is turning into a close favorite as the wandering hunters become more aware of the Fae's dark side.

name: Messina Helmsman's Gear
description: Steering the capricious ship known as the Messina Mirage takes grit and a sharp mind. The ship knows its handler, and lends its strength to defend them. (Item is Color Customizable)

name: Messina Mirage Crew's Gear
description: A glinting blade and a swig of feel good potion makes the crew of the Messina Mirage an unpredictable and savage force to be reckoned with. (Item is Color Customizable)

name: Metal Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Metal!

name: Meteoric Crescent Axes
description: Forged in the shadow of a collapsing star, this axe channels the force of a thousand streaking meteors.

name: Metrea's Disciple
description: As a trainer of Rogues, Metrea must be wary of getting stabbed in the back by her own students. Luckily for her she is quicker than just about anyone else…

name: Metrea's First Daggers
description: The blades been replaced multiple times, so they can hardly be considered the first daggers Metrea ever used. That said, they have traces of magic that make it harder to hear her coming. Considering how they used to be sacrificial knives…

name: Metrea's Frostkissed Daggers
description: There's a slight sheen to these daggers. Instead of poison, it's covered in a layer of enchanted ice. One nick and the target's limb will soon be lost to frostbite.

name: Mia's Dual Slashers
description: The Evil Undead are coming, and if there's one thing a Hero (or Heroine) knows, it's that you can never go wrong with a good katana or two! Zombies HATE dual katanas!

name: Midnight Assassin Daggers
description: These assassins use their stealth to averge their fallen brothers and sisters whom those blood drinkers killed. Lycan's will win!

name: Midnight Blades of Joy (0 AC)
description: The Northlands Rangers travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful season!

name: Midnight Blades of Joy (AC)
description: The Northlands Rangers travel the frozen wastes in search of Good heroes to reward with silver, gold, and treasure beyond compare… ensuring a most joyful season!

name: Midnight Fiend Swords
description: Blood continuously drips from these fell swords. Its wielder underwent painful rituals to be able to master the blades, forgetting who they were before the strike of midnight.

name: Midnight Masquerade Polearm
description: Trying to find a costume for a masquerade can be difficult.. but not anymore! Keep this outfit in your closet for all your masquerade needs - no matter what time of year!

name: Midnight Sea Commander's Blunderbusss
description: There's no escape from the Midnight Sea, even if you make it back to land. The gold bullet lodged in your rib will turn you into a gilded statue - an enchanted treasure beacon for the ship to follow.

name: Midnight Sea Commander's Cutlasses
description: A pirate's desires are carved into these gilded blades. Vain gold, sought merely for the pleasure of possessing it. The red chains bind a hunger for more in you. Greed feeds the sea. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Midnight Sea Commander's Flintlocks
description: There's no escape from the Midnight Sea, even if you make it back to land. The gold bullet lodged in your rib will turn you into a gilded statue - an enchanted treasure beacon for the ship to follow. (Item is color-customizable)

name: Midnight Unicorn Plushies
description: A comfy companion that will find you if you're lost in dreams, and rescue you from nightmares.

name: Midnight Unicorn Swords
description: The blades, as sharp as a unicorn's horn, is made of crystalized light. They can cut through darkness, and dispel unending nightmares.

name: Midsummer Rhapsodies
description: Replicas of summer salvation from the dark ages of Lore. Humankind thrived when the sun shone, frolicking in flower circles to beg for the favor of the divine. In the chaos of revelry and ritual sacrifice, Changelings would sneak in.

name: Mighty Horc Claw
description: Used like a dagger this weapon deadly in close quarters. This is so much more mighty than the Horc Claw. Damage range increases to 45!

name: Mighty Steel Chopper
description: Unlike most daggers, this dagger is made for chopping and blocking attacks with it's thick edge. This is so much more mighty than the Steel Chopper. Damage range increases to 55.

name: Mikey's Hatchets
description: Mikey better clean that Moglinberry Smoothie off his axe blade or it'll start to rust.

name: Militis Snowflake Rapiers
description: The Court of the Winter Fae enjoy the dramatics of romance and duels. It is tradition for the duelists to have their weapons created by the ice magic of their heart's desire. A banished Glaceran made this rapier.

name: Mindbreaker Lance + Shield
description: Made from ore from the Orpheum Elementals, this lance and shield combo is enhanced by the power of the MindBreaker wielding it.

name: MindBreaker Paladin's Awe Sword + Shield
description: A weapon made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest a reflection this pure.

name: MindBreaker Paladin's Axes
description: A popular favorite. When manifesting weapons from mana and the light of their souls, the Mindbreaker Paladins' aspirations take this form to fulfill their childhood dreams.

name: MindBreaker Paladin's Spear + Shield
description: A spear made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. This is a personal favorite of Tara's. Warlic's wisdom and Artix's "sense for cool" taught her how to summon it at the snap of a finger.

name: MindBreaker Paladin's Swords
description: Weapons made manifest from one's mana and the light of their soul. Only those who can face their own shadows can manifest reflections this pure.

name: Mindflayer's Infested Bow and Arrow
description: The ocean is teeming with life, and it takes as much as it gives. You tore this bow out of a mighty sea beast to live, just as it did to another when it was a calf. The dark cycle continues, but that is a mere fact of nature.

name: MindSmasher Blades
description: This sharpened tooth was torn from the maw of a leviathan that fell into the depths. The entity who rules the deep imbued it with a maddening resonance. Every sound it makes shakes the mind with visions writing in the dark.

name: Miner Hand Of Domination (Dagger)
description: Cheer on your favorite gold digging destroyers with this giant hand!

name: Mini Shave Point
description: It slices, it dices, it nicks, it pricks, it rends, it tears, it frightens bears!

name: Minotiger Dagger
description: Rugged but powerful.

name: Minotiger Spear and Dagger
description: Cinderclaw's spear is only won by the mightiest warriors.

name: Mirrored Dragon Claws
description: You are the ruler of Dragons… all shall bow before you!

name: Mischievous Magic Kit
description: Load up your broom for another night of mysticism and magic.

name: Misericorde de Nyx
description: Crafted for the Vampire Queen herself, this is the dagger of Safiria. Yeah, Safiria wanted it this small.

name: Missile Mouse's Dual Blasters
description: He's a risk taker and a rule breaker! Grab Missile Mouse's gun and go wiiild!

name: Mistique Phoenix Blades (AC)
description: The ashes froze before they could reignite, but the phoenix will always come alive.

name: Mistique Phoenix Blades (Legend)
description: The ashes froze before they could reignite, but the phoenix will always come alive.

name: Mix n' Match Sickles
description: They look really cool if you can manage to twirl them like a baton.

name: MOAR CowBell
description: MOAR COWBELL ACQUIRED

name: MockingSlayer Accoutrements
description: Your enemies will Rue the day they face this bow in battle.

name: Moganth's Calamity
description: The crushing force of the Earth Prime is now in your hands! But you're going to need dragon-sized upper body strength to wield them…

name: Molten GreatSwords (0 AC)
description: Pyroclastic necromancers walk where the faint-hearted fear to tread, seeking undead minions among those who've perished in the hearts of volcanic lands.

name: Molten GreatSwords (AC)
description: Pyroclastic necromancers walk where the faint-hearted fear to tread, seeking undead minions among those who've perished in the hearts of volcanic lands.

name: Molten Lava Orbs
description: A ball of molten lava harvested from the scar of a volcano. It is said that if one bathes in the fires that Kalayo protects, they will transform into a dragon themselves. No intruder has ever succeeded - they were turned to ash for their mortal folly.

name: Molten Maw's Battle Accoutrements (0 AC)
description: A trident made of burning iron. It can only be wielded safely underwater in near frigid temperatures. Otherwise, it'll burn your skin off.

name: Molten Maw's Battle Accoutrements (AC)
description: A trident made of burning iron. It can only be wielded safely underwater in near frigid temperatures. Otherwise, it'll burn your skin off.

name: Molten Monarch Orbs
description: You'll never fall victim to the head of the summer once you can control the flames!

name: Molten Morningstars
description: A weapon created by the Sunborn when they found that on Lore, paintings of their home depicted its rays as spikes. The core is made of hardening plasma and its golden metallic rays shift and move.

name: Molten Scimitars of Time
description: On the edge of the Timevoid, a molten wall of flame blocks the entrance to the Plane of Fire. Only Chronomancers of Fire are able to survive the combined might of time magic mixed with the Plane's scorching elemental power.

name: Monster Queen Commander's Cutlasses (AC)
description: If'n ye are smarter than ye look, yell jump to obey when th' Monster Queen commands. Else she'll be destroyin' ye, me, an' th' rest o' th' world.

name: Monster Queen Commander's Cutlasses (Legend)
description: If'n ye are smarter than ye look, yell jump to obey when th' Monster Queen commands. Else she'll be destroyin' ye, me, an' th' rest o' th' world.

name: Monstrous Claws (Legend)

name: Moon Bow Dual Weapons
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of the Moon Bow ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Moon Crusher Kanabos
description: One of the mighty Oni clan leaders of the Yokai Isles, Hoshiguma-Douji, bragged that they could crush the moon with a swing of their club. The Great Yokai Spirit has yet to give them a chance to try.

description: Bonnie Blood has gifted every member of her crew with a Moon-forged weapon. These silver blades are made with the sole purpose of doing grievous bodily harm to lycans. Vampire smiths are ONLY able to craft them during a lunar eclipse, to maximize the power of the magic spells woven into them.

name: Moonbeast Cutlasses (AC)
description: The daring blades of a brave wolf. A golden snarl bites down on a slice of the moon.

name: Moonbeast Cutlasses (Legend)
description: The daring blades of a brave wolf. A golden snarl bites down on a slice of the moon.

name: Moonborn Guardian's Battlegear
description: Nothing is immortal, and those arrogant enough to believe they can overcome the concept of forever are foolish. The Moonborn's armaments will release their stars into the sky when they fall, to truly watch over Lore for eternity.

name: Moonlight Hunter's Dual Candle Blades
description: The power of the Moon keeps these hunters warm and guides their way on every mission.

name: Moonlit Steel Rapiers
description: These blades are invisible in the night, only seen when the moonlight reflects off them. By then, the shinobi's target is already sinking into the sea.

name: Moonpetal & Starlight (AC)
description: When courage and beauty must strike as one, these are the weapons you wield.

name: Moonpetal & Starlight (Legend)
description: When courage and beauty must strike as one, these are the weapons you wield.

name: Morningstars in Shadow
description: The silver moon illuminates the night sky along with the starry constellations. Moonborn Guardians have taken a piece of the night sky to carve proof of their existence into the history of Lore.

name: Mortal Bane
description: Death comes to us all, and if Sleezter Bunny had his way, it would have come to Lore today! Thanks for crackin' his egg and bustin' his head, Hero!

name: Mortal Doom Captain Pistols (0 AC)
description: A curse possesses this pistol, and it literally screams to see battle. Even the dead won't get any sleep.

name: Mortal Doom Captain Pistols (AC)

name: Mortal Fiend Claws
description: A pretty handy tool, which any Fiend would have fun with. Pity of your victims.

name: Mortal Fiend Katanas

name: Mortal Fiend Reavers
description: A proper weapon for a high rank fiend.

description: A Phantom Chronomancer seeks to maintain the natural order of time and space. Eliminating cowards living on borrowed time should be done with little disruption, but these guns are pretty loud…

name: Muenster Monster Hand
description: Cheer on your favorite dairy titans with this giant hand! Smells a little cheesy (Like 85% of the jokes in this game)

name: Mystic Tribal Dagger

name: Mystical Acolyte's Axes
description: Some of the most sensitive mage and priests believe that they have heard the heart of our world whispering to them. These Mystical Acolytes believe a being lives inside the Mana Core itself. They are not — yet — a cult.

description: Some of the most sensitive mage and priests believe that they have heard the heart of our world whispering to them. These Mystical Acolytes believe a being lives inside the Mana Core itself. They are not -- yet -- a cult.

name: Mystical Chakrams Of Illusion
description: Conjure and destroy - the fighting style that complements the chakrams confuses the enemy with illusions. The fight must end with the destruction of both enemy and lies.

name: Mystical Devotee's Scimitars
description: At rest, the scimitars appears as ornamental hilts. In battle, mana flares into the curve of a blade. It burns, freezes, shocks, and persists.

name: Mystical Glass Orbs
description: Let the music and magic of the Black Labyrinth entice you. Give in to the spell the Goblin King weaves. Your fate is in his hands.

name: Mystical Holiday Trick Blades (AC)
description: It's just a trick of the light.

name: Mystical Holiday Trick Blades (Legend)

description: *No description*

name: Mythic Elemental Edges
description: Light and Darkness clash and fuse. These forces tear into each other, making them stronger. Through this chaos comes evolution, if the wielder can survive the tempest it creates.

name: Na'al's Cutlasses (AC)
description: When Naal was still a Celestial, he had a fascination with weapons of all shapes and purposes. His brethren saw Azalith in him. Perhaps, this was what the Bright One had always intended.

description: Having risen from the deepest dethos of the Underworld, the Narakan Fiend has allied with Nulgath to destroy the Undead Legion.

name: Narwhal Plushies
description: The unicorns of the sea!

description: Rapiers made from the horns of a 'whale' with a horn made of steel. When dipped into the sea, the swords shakes if an abomination is swimming nearby.

name: Nation Dragonbane Blades (AC)
description: Dragons are a uniquely powerful lifeform, blessed with power and purpose - perfect for the Fiends to devour and use. Members of the Nation seek to slay them and use their parts to make weapons that embody their might.

name: Nature Dagger

name: Nautican Knight Daggers
description: These blades remain one of the Medusae's favorite swords to award his most talented defenders!

name: Naval Guard's Cutlasses

description: How many parts of Rotfinger ARE there in the Underworld? Now the Necromancers are using bits of them to make weapons.

description: Unlife is cruel. But sail with a good crew and yer afterlife will be richer than your mortal life ever was!

description: A myth sleeps in these blades, one of fallen civilizations, a lost future, and the flames of vengeance. A Doom Spirit is not trapped to this blade, but its spite is.

name: Necrotic ShadowFlame Daggers
description: These sacred daggers were once used to promote peace but now they've been tarnished and now force innocent people from their homes.

name: NegaNet Protective Gear
description: Forget a firewall - fight off net viruses by infecting them with your own malware! Just touching this shield could turn a living person into a brick.

name: Nekonomicon Copies
description: Truly? The orginal tomes of ancient kitty yarns and forbidden mews?

name: Nekyia Rite Blades (0 AC)
description: To descend to the Underworld and return would prove you immortal and untoucheable. These blades were born under the sun, and darkened in the Underworld. It has yet to complete its journey.

name: NeoBattleon Short Barrel Guns
description: Pull the trigger and watch the buildings melt.

name: NeoChaos DoomSwords
description: Individually, the powers of Doom and Chaos could shake the foundations of our world. Combined into one ultra-powerful Hero… we could destroy it entirely!

name: NeoFiend Blades of Revontheus
description: Given to the Nation as a reward from the ArchFiend for winning the second skirmish of the Dage vs Nulgath war, these blades will rip though Legion flesh with the greatest of ease.

name: Neon Spectrum Dagger
description: By the power of Rainbows!

name: Neon Wires

name: NeOni Katanas (0 AC)

name: Netherworld Comedian Hammers

name: Neuling Brandt + Aegis
description: A balanced and durable blade meant for adventurers who've just made the switch from wood to steel. The Dwarves make a lot of them, but each is forged with care. This is the start of someone's dream, after all.

name: Neuling Stahlschwert + Aegis
description: A greatsword meant for bulkier beginners. These are usually forged for Dwarves who're looking for new horizons, but regularly given to humans and Drows that like carrying bigger sticks.

name: Neverborn Energy Sabers
description: The hilt of these sabers draws energy from the realm of souls yet to be born. Though it robs some souls completely of a chance at life, it dooms others to a short one. Their anguish gives power to this blade.

name: Nevermore Tribute Blades
description: Quoth the raven on Mogloween Eve, "Nevermore!"

name: Nexus Blade of Chaos
description: Found by a mage through the nexus closest to Battleon, he's brought it back to be inspected by Alteon to see if he can feel an affinity to it.

name: Nexus Blade of Evil
description: Found by a mage passing through the nexus closest to Battleon, he's brought it back to be inspected by Gravelyn.

name: Nexus Blade of Good
description: Found by a mage passing through the nexus closest to Battleon, he's brought it back to be inspected by Cysero.

name: NibbleOn Guardian Accoutrements
description: You've been given the task to defend NibbleOn!

name: Nightborn Drak Armblades
description: Creatures of the night are no like you and I. Those from the Rift are even more alien Beware… oh, beware!

name: Nightcleavers
description: Its edge bears the mark of Idalion's strike, a deep burn where dragonfire met steel, now turned into a weapon of defiance.

name: NightFrost Elf Daggers
description: Elves are some of the most resourceful beings in Lore. Even the colds of the Northlands cannot keep these skilled warriors away.

name: NightFrost Elf Reversed Daggers
description: Elves are some of the most resourceful beings in Lore. Even the colds of the Northlands cannot keep these skilled warriors away.

name: Nightmare Carnax's Daggers
description: Carnax, a beast that is nearly immortal, has appeared in the Nightmare Queen’s realm. It retains its power to dominate all life but is now even MORE monstrous than before.

name: Nightmare Fiend Sawblades (0 AC)
description: You can't hide from the reach of the Nation. Their Fiends can even invade your dreams. If you have the ability to see further than mortal eyes, they'll turn you into one of them.

description: Each of the Yokai Isles’ Noble Houses passes a blessed blade from one family head to the next. It must be periodically purified at a shrine to keep evil spirits from possessing the heirloom.

description: Carrots aren't actually that healthy of a snack to feed to rabbits. Too much sugar. It makes more sense to shower your enemies in a rain of adorable carrot kunai.

name: Pastel Grenwog Waterguns
description: Rabbits are known to be careful and cautious, but enjoy a spot of spontaneity. There could be water in this gun, but what if you got creative?

name: Pavane and Fantasia
description: Replicas of a voice that knew joy and sorry, death and delight. They faded into mystery with the King of the Dark's demise, but art brought them back to life. The whispers of ancient ghosts guided the brush, and reached perfection.

name: Pearl Puggio
description: Elegant, simple and completely deadly, this dagger will dispose of anyone who sneaks into your parlour room. And, as an added bonus, it can be worn to add a decorative touch to any armor.

name: Penumbra Pumpkin Axes
description: An eldritch touch made humble pumpkins evolve, and fostered a hunger for supremacy. Smash the competition! There's only room for one to grow!

name: Peppermint Lights-Out Bats (AC)
description: Give it a good swing and you'll make them see the Northern Lights.

name: Peppermint Lights-Out Bats (Legend)
description: Give it a good swing and you'll make them see the Northern Lights.

name: Permafrost DragonBlade and Shield
description: An Ice Dragon froze this Dragonblade with frigid breath, inadvertently creating a weapon that could destroy their fiery rivals. It can easily cut through a Fire Dragon's flames, and freeze their molten blood.

name: Permafrost DragonBlades
description: An Ice Dragon froze these Dragonblades with frigid breath, inadvertently creating weapons that could destroy their fiery rivals. They can easily cut through a Fire Dragon's flames, and freeze their molten blood.

name: Permafrost Flames (0 AC)
description: Frost Shamans draw their power from energy contained in the permafrost. Frozen magic lays dormant under the ice in the Northlands, waiting for a powerful enough magician to tap it.

name: Permafrost Flames (AC)
description: Frost Shamans draw their power from energy contained in the permafrost. Frozen magic lays dormant under the ice in the Northlands, waiting for a powerful enough magician to tap it.

name: Persimmon Branches
description: The lesser known sweet and delicate fall staple. Careful. The Fall Faeries charmed the persimmon seeds. They're hardly enough to survive and grow out of your stomach.

name: Persistences
description: After many years of experience this sword was reforged by the hands of a devoted craftsman. The fine edge and balanced handling is the fruit of their efforts.

name: Personater's Daggers
description: Who's Personater, anyway?

name: Personater's Dual Swords
description: Ooohh, Glowy!

name: Pesugihan Ritual Instruments
description: Little is known about Pesugihan other than it is sorcery that conjures a path to instant riches. Some say that one must sacrifice their humanity in exchange, while others rumor that one must allow a greedy boar deity to inhabit their bodies.

name: Petrified Fiend Dagger (0 AC)
description: Ever hungry for power, the Petrified Fiend will do Nulgath's bidding until the end of time.

name: Petrified Fiend Dagger (AC)
description: Ever hungry for power, the Petrified Fiend will do Nulgath's bidding until the end of time.

name: Petrofire Flintlocks
description: Extremely destructive guns, with a hint of fiery flair. There's a one in three chance that they'll blow up on you. What an insane rush!

name: Phantom Chrono Guns
description: A Phantom Chronomancer seeks to maintain the natural order of time and space. Eliminating cowards living on borrowed time should be done with little disruption, but these guns are pretty loud…

name: Phantom Commander's Cutlass and Bladed Pistol (0 AC)
description: The ghosts of the Phantom Commander's past will never let go, haunting them as their own weapons.

name: Phantom Commander's Cutlass and Bladed Pistol (AC)
description: The ghosts of the Phantom Commander's past will never let go, haunting them as their own weapons.

name: Phantom Commander's Cutlass and Revolver (0 AC)
description: The ghosts of the Phantom Commander's past will never let go, haunting them as their own weapons.

name: Phantom Commander's Cutlass and Revolver (AC)
description: The ghosts of the Phantom Commander's past will never let go, haunting them as their own weapons.

name: Phantom Commander's Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: The ghosts of the Phantom Commander's past will never let go, haunting them as their own blades.

name: Phantom Commander's Cutlasses (AC)
description: The ghosts of the Phantom Commander's past will never let go, haunting them as their own blades.

name: Phantom Naval Bladed Pistols (0 AC)
description: The ghosts of the past will never let go, haunting the next person who finds these guns.

name: Phantom Naval Bladed Pistols (AC)
description: The ghosts of the past will never let go, haunting the next person who finds these guns.

name: Phoenix Blades
description: From the ashes the phoenix will rise. Only the most proven veterans of Lore carry this sword of rebirth. (This weapon gives 25% more class points, xp, gold, and rep when equipped)

name: Picnic Baskets
description: Only the most experienced of combatants can do something as dangerous as having a picnic. That's not even a joke. Wolves, Zards, and all manner of nasties are going to stalk your salami.

name: Pine Rosin Violin (0 AC)
description: An instrument carved from deep, cherry-red wood. It creates the perfect sound, and is sturdy enough to teach someone to shut up during a performance.

name: Pine Rosin Violin (AC)
description: An instrument carved from deep, cherry-red wood. It creates the perfect sound, and is sturdy enough to teach someone to shut up during a performance.

name: Pineapple Pens
description: You have a pen. You have a pineapple. Unh PINEAPPLE PEN PINEAPPLE PEN PINEAPPLE PEN PINEAPPLE PEN PINEAPPLE PEN /dance

name: Pineapple Thorn Blades
description: Help your enemies pine for you.

name: Pineapples On Sticks
description: NOM NOM NOM

name: Pink and Ugly Sticks
description: There's quite a few monsters that have already been beaten with this.

name: Pink Default Dagger
description: By default, Default Daggers are better when they're pink! Now you can truly be a rouge rogue!

name: Pink Gummi Were-bear and Lolly
description: Prepare yourself for delicious battle! The time has come to (gummi)bear arms!

name: PinkSlayer's Knives
description: You battle the shadows, but that doesn't mean you have to dress like them!

name: Pirate Captain Sally's Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Sally became a lot more interested in classic pirate weapons after they got an adorable makeover. She even did some arm curls, gaining a little muscle to be able to lift such heavy accessories.

name: Pirate Captain Sally's Cutlasses (AC)
description: Sally became a lot more interested in classic pirate weapons after they got an adorable makeover. She even did some arm curls, gaining a little muscle to be able to lift such a heavy accessories.

name: Pirate Mage Flintlock and Cutlass
description: The better ye armed, the better chances ye survive.

name: Pirate's First Gold
description: Sophisticated blades forged from gold, strengthened by a variety of other rare metals. They’re usually made from a corsair’s first plunder, giving every one significant meaning to their wielder.

name: Pirated Media
description: The most sinister of all pirate weapons: the illegally copied movie.

name: Pitiless Privateer's Dual Pistols
description: Real privateers show NO pity.

name: Plague's Cyclops Fang
description: A karambit dagger crafted by Plague herself from the tooth of the Screamfeeder, a lightweight dagger which also deals swift kills to her enemies.

name: Plasma Arm Blades
description: Energy flows through your arms, it does.

name: Plasma Orbs
description: Electricity crackled within the orbs until it was frozen, held ready to serve as an extra battery of energy for Skye's Cailleacha when their mana gives out. Overuse slowly destroys their nervous system, and turns their hair white.

name: Plasmatic Dagger and Tome
description: A poisoned dirk greatly treasured by the cryptkeepers in Eergcast Catacombs for it contains a slow-acting, fatal venom that can either corrupt a willing soul or kill an unwilling soul. It comes with a dusted tome given to trainees upon their initiation.

name: Unidentified 31 (Platinum Battle Shank)
description: You win a "Platinum Battle Shank". Nulgath could need this in the future.

name: Platinum Drum Styx
description: With the Styx of Destiny you will be UNSTOPPABLE! Just like mind bullets.

name: Platinum Engineer's Great Hammers
description: Time flows one way, but what if we invent machines that can reverse the stream? What if it was split in two? Five? Ten? As for why someone would think of doing this…why not?

name: Platinum Eternal Champion's Daggers
description: Guided by the Light, these warriors live to serve and uphold Good. Only the most dedicated warriors are allowed to wear the Platinum Eternal Champion's armor.

name: Platinum Eternal Champion's Dual Katanas
description: Guided by the Light, these warriors live to serve and uphold Good. Only the most dedicated warriors are allowed to wear the Platinum Eternal Champion's.

name: Platinum Heroic Titan's Greatswords
description: Even in moments of deepest despair, we can still find hope. No matter how messed up things get, YOU have the power to save the day.

name: Platinum Magitech Clawblades
description: Blades that has yet to reach their full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Platinum Magitech Time Sigils
description: Instead of finding ways to travel through time, magitech engineers are inventing ways to make time move around them. This is incredibly dangerous magic, a product of hubris instead of altruistic creation.

name: Platinum Star Daggers
description: Toss them quick and fast and from a distance, you're practically firing a laser from the palm of your hands.

name: Platinum Steampunk Fangblades
description: Blades that has yet to reach their full potential. The blueprints were made by engineers who are inventing ways to use time as fuel. There is a being out there who is Time itself, so if they can acquire one of its body parts…

name: Platinum Stormbringer Katanas
description: The life of a true warrior is as fleeting and brilliant as lightning. A katana that sparks with the rage of a ceaseless storm brings honor to those it strikes down.

name: Platinum Technocaster Reavers
description: Technocasters are a group of elite Seraphic warriors from the future. Platinum Technocaster's are the highest class of these.

name: Platinum Temporal Engineer's Hammers
description: Time flows one way, but what if we invent machines that can reverse the stream? What if it was split in two? Five? Ten? As for why someone would think of doing this…why not?

name: Platinum Tvilling Verdighet
description: Swords named for the dignity of the Dragon who knighted the Drakkar. The blades are made of its crystalized breath.

name: Unidentified 30 (Platinum Twin Blade)
description: Nice prize! you have the "Platinum Twin Blade". I heard Nulgath has an empowered version of this blade somewhere.

name: Plunderin' Pistols
description: If'n y'want loot, yer gonna have to TAKE it! And these pistols will do a mighty fine job o' securin' it for ya.

name: Pocky Manslayers
description: Taro has fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. But what no one knew until today is that he'd /rest afterwards and eat pocky as a snack.

name: Poison Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Poison!

name: Poison Drinker Betrayal Blades
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to absorb the power of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Poisoned Kris Daggers
description: Take care not to let the edges of these daggers touch you while you are wielding them. They are coated in an instantly toxic juice made from dehydrated sneevils mixed with the blood of a lich. GROSS!

name: Poisonous Orb And Tome
description: There's a small leaflet tucked inside the book… "Ahuhuhu~ If you're ever craving more than knowledge, then come by our bake sale…~"

name: Poker Hand
description: Is that.. is that 5 aces?

name: Polar Beast Blades (AC)
description: The strongest ice spells transform flesh into solid ice. When a druid in the form of a bear was slain and turned to ice, blades filled with their might were carved from their frigid bones.

name: Polar Beast Blades (Legend)
description: The strongest ice spells transform flesh into solid ice. When a druid in the form of a bear was slain and turned to ice, blades filled with their might were carved from their frigid bones.

name: Polar Freedom Cleavers
description: Cleavers forged under a persimmon tree in spring. They belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Polar Katanas (0 AC)
description: The cold cuts through bone, freezing blood in an instant. Your quarry falls, shattering into pieces, left to melt into the gutter.

name: Polar Katanas (AC)
description: The cold cuts through bone, freezing blood in an instant. Your quarry falls, shattering into pieces left to melt into the gutter.

name: Polaris Duelist Rapiers
description: In the old days, Ice Dragons preferred Elven partners over humans. Competitors would duel each other for the honor of holding an audience with the now-extinct court of Queen Khione.

name: Polychronic Magister's Accoutrements
description: Able to manipulate multiple simultaneous events with ease, the Polychronic Magister glides through space and time, compelling all they meet.

name: Polychronic Magister's Hourglasses
description: Able to manipulate multiple simultaneous events with ease, the Polychronic Magister glides through space and time, compelling all they meet.

name: Polychronic Power-cycles
description: Able to manipulate multiple simultaneous events with ease, the Polychronic Magister glides through space and time, compelling all they meet.

description: Underworld Summoner weapons are forged from steel stripped from tombs and crypts. The nature of such material lends itself to trapping souls.

name: Possessed Grave Altar Blades (Legend)
description: Underworld Summoner weapons are forged from steel stripped from tombs and crypts. The nature of such material lends itself to trapping souls.

name: Possessed Spiritual Cleavers (AC)
description: Countless spirits are sealed in these blades whose names have been cruely taken from them. Their restless anguish sharpens cruel edges.

name: Possessed Spiritual Cleavers (Legend)
description: Countless spirits are sealed in these blades whose names have been cruely taken from them. Their restless anguish sharpens cruel edges.

name: Post-Apocalyptic Cowboy's Revolvers
description: YEEEEEE-HAW! The post-apocalypse is wilder than the old West. The perfect for a desperado with a few morals and fast horse to find (or steal) success.

name: Pretty Pinkie Pirate Balloon Swords
description: Cute, but it's sure to mess up a good hair day. Everyone's nightmare.

name: Pretty Pinkie Pirate Pistols
description: You'll need holsters to keep your pistols from floating away.

name: Pretty Violet Reavers
description: The infamous symbol of the Undead Legion has been turned violet! Dyed purple because purple is pretty.

name: Pride and Glory
description: This sword and shield were originally a relic for the Trolls reserved for ceremonies. When the need for arises, they provide inspiration to allies during battle.

name: Unidentified 33 (Primal Dagger Tooth)
description: Lucky you! You won the "Primal Dagger Tooth". Nulgath crafted this dagger from a smaller Void beast. If creature with a tooth this size can be considered small.

name: Primal Dread Fang
description: Nulgath created these daggers from the actual fangs of a great void beast.

name: Primal Saber Teeth
description: The lifeblood of centuries' worth of prey have sharpen this tooth.

name: Primal Tiger Axes
description: In comparison to the honed claws of the predator, an axe can seem ungainly. It all comes down to the hand of the wielder. Skill is your greatest weapon.

name: Primal Void Tiger Katanas
description: A blade that reflects the will of a solitary beast. Rarely will it ever cut foes on behalf of a lord… unless that lord is Nulgath the ArchFiend.

name: Primaris Paladin's Chainswords
description: No matter how vast your enemies, shielded by the symbol of your order, you battle without fear. Your current mission: to guard the guardians fighting to defend Battleon from the Titans.

name: Primaris Paladin's Hammers
description: No matter how vast your enemies, shielded by the symbol of your order, you battle without fear. Your current mission: to guard the guardians fighting to defend Battleon from the Titans.

name: Prime Dagger of Awe (0 AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Prime Dagger of Awe! (AC)
description: Could this be the real thing? The wielder of this legendary artifact is granted massive power!

name: Prince of Dragon's Shield and Blade
description: The silversmith that created this sword and shield was known to be a savant artist on the battlefield and from the comfort of his forge, therefore, he merged beauty and brute strength into one masterpiece.

name: Prism Ram Axes
description: The horn of a beast, heavy and frought with gnarls, that fought bloody battles to become lord of a mountain. Lost to the depths, its weapons have now become yours. (CC to Base)

name: Prisma Adornments
description: Prismatic Mana has been forged into the sharpest dagger you can imagine.

name: Prisma Claws
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with these color-shifting daggers crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Prisma Daggers
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with these color-shifting daggers crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Prisma Sickles
description: Use the force to mesmerize your enemies with these color-shifting sickles crafted of polarized paladinum.

name: Prismastealth Venom Knives
description: They're called a venomous knives, but the snake wrapped around the blade is actually electrified to stun your opponents. It only seems like the effects of venom.

name: Prismastealth Viper Launchers
description: Sure, they blast your enemies away. Sure, they're functional even when it's submerged in water. More importantly, the snakes are named Nikita.

name: Prismatic Chaos Paint Tools
description: You won the Grand Prize in the Chaos Art Contest! Go forth and paint the world chaotic with your color-custom paintbrush and shield!

name: Prismatic ClawsOfTheBlaze
description: Rend the obsidian rocks around with you with these color custom claws!

name: Prismatic Cryptic Daggers
description: Cryptics are Atealan illusionists whose minds are their most powerful weapons. The only limit to their abilities is their imagination.

name: Prismatic Cyber War Glaive (0 AC)
description: One of Dage the Evil's trusty and handy weapons for crushing the hearts of Nulgath's followers. (Glow is CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Cyber War Glaive (AC)
description: One of Dage the Evil's trusty and handy weapons for crushing the hearts of Nulgath's followers. (Glow is CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Defender's Blades
description: An ordinary sword that accompanied a Defender since the beginning of their journeys. Though good deeds need to reward, the blade was given wings and a guiding light by those who recognize purity of the soul. (CC to Trim)

name: Prismatic Fiendish Transcendence Blades
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Prismatic Fiendish Transcendence Scythes
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Prismatic Long Lycan dagger
description: The pick of the litter! A Lycan's best friend, this prismatic sword features a color custom base and accessory glow.

name: Prismatic Oversoul Assassin's Katanas
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend rules the OverSoul, and in the heart of his realm lies the Minotaur's Labryrinth. This battlegear was taken from its guards after they fell in its defense. (This item is color customizable.)

name: Prismatic Snowheart Needles
description: Blades made from Ice extracted from an Elemental. No one was slain to forge them. A FrostFire Lord manifested them in battle as extensions of their body.

name: Prismatic Sun God Warrior's Orbs
description: Azura the Sun God demands vengeance. Pay homage to his power with the blood of your enemies, and you will prosper in his service. (CC to Accessory)

name: Prismatic Transcendence Cleavers
description: In the transformation from mortal to legend, the true Fiend transcends ALL limitations. Defiance is the only sure path to victory… and total domination.

name: Prismatic Twisted Shadow Dagger
description: Malgor's taint has infected this blade. Beware it does not infect you, too. (Blade is color-customizable.)

name: Prismatic Wings of Destiny
description: For Randor the Red's birthday, he is letting you borrow his personal COLOR CUSTOMIZABLE weapons! A rare set of daggers available only on May 5th.

name: Prismodian Guard's Daggers
description: The colorfully elite unit of the Shadowscythe Army, used mostly for guarding VIPs or putting down rebellions.

name: Prisms of Cold Illusion (0 AC)
description: Gaze at your enemies through this prism, and imagine who you want them to be. Your light reaches through their eyes, and into their mind. Trapped in a dream, you can twist them into their best selves.

name: Prisms of Cold Illusion (AC)
description: Gaze at your enemies through this prism, and imagine who you want them to be. Your light reaches through their eyes, and into their mind. Trapped in a dream, you can twist them into their best selves.

name: Prisms of Possibility (0 AC)
description: The prisms spin and light bends until your surroundings become that of a dream. You could get lost in your dreams, and love illusions that could never exist anywhere else. Best save this destiny for your enemies.

description: YARRRR! It be th' fate o' all privateeers to sail at a moment's notice, so ye'll always want t' yer weapon at hand.

name: ProjectSoul Shocker Slasher
description: A gattling mechanism that is recommended for dealing with heavily shielded armor enemies. Do you care to demonstrate on your next foe?

name: Pronged WarForge Blades (AC)
description: Weapons wielded by the Warforge Tanks of the Legion which double as tools to tug out the blades being tempered inside their bodies. The tips are made of Cocytus Ice that cools molten metal instantly.

description: Weapons wielded by the Warforge Tanks of the Legion which double as tools to tug out the blades being tempered inside their bodies. The tips are made of Cocytus Ice that cools molten metal instantly.

description: The protean blood of the Chimera crystallized into weapons made of their progenitor's qualities. their iron bones and pulsing veins indicate that they've attained life.

description: The word of the Evil and the Beast, converted into runes of immense power.

name: Prowler's Dual Denken
description: Electric katanas with a serrated edge. Cat-like fangs along the blade, and decorating the hilt….well, the manufacturer is definitely consistent.

name: Prowler's Reserve Dual Denken
description: Electric katanas with a serrated edge. Cat-like fangs along the blade, and decorating the hilt….well, the manufacturer is definitely consistent.

name: Psionic Daggers
description: Made from ore from the Orpheum Elementals, this lance and shield combo is enhanced by the power of the MindBreaker wielding it.

name: Psychic Domination Spears
description: Massive beasts fight for dominance in the churning sea. Yet a single tusk pointed at just the right angle can pierce right through their skull, and bring them to peace. The Adeptus that grew this spear out of their body will feast on the spoils for months to come.

name: Pufferfish Plushies
description: If you poke them, they'll puff right up! Don't worry, those spines are soft and non-venomous.

name: Pulsar Armblades
description: Sometimes, technology gives us advanced medical techniques, futuristic processes to grow food, or new ways to communicate. But sometimes it just gives us new ways to stab real good.

name: Pumpkin Fever Axes
description: An eldritch touch made humble pumpkins evolve, and fostered a hunger for supremacy. Smash the competition! There's only room for one to grow!

name: Pumpkin Seeders
description: Time to grow some pumpkins…inside your enemies!

name: Pumpkin Slicers Mach
description: Looking for a clean shave off your opponent's life? The protective shield helps protect against nicks and burns while the curved blade uses Mach technology for a most effortless graze.

name: Punhais Brasileiros
description: These Daggers were crafted to celebrate Brazilian Independence day! Obrigado Brasil!

name: Punishing Void Daggers
description: Weapons Nythera crafted with magic, and the materials she found in her travels through the Void. They're made from creatures that are close to the half-dragon, but she doesn't mind. If anything, that gurantees the dagger's effectiveness.

name: Pure Mana Spatulas
description: Rev up those fryers, 'cause I'm hungry to see the face of the creator!

name: Purgation Pistols
description: These pistols used to belong to an honest soul that tried to wipe away corruption. There is no trace of them that remains, leaving you to pick up from where they started.

name: Purified Accoutrements of Protection
description: Sworn to protect and serve, the Celestial Templar Guardians will defend any who seek refuge from the terrors that lurk in the Shadows.

name: Purified ArchFiend's Battle Gear (0 AC)
description: Even the darkest, most fiendish warrior can be turned to the light.

name: Purified ArchFiend's Battle Gear (AC)
description: Even the darkest, most fiendish warrior can be turned to the light.

name: Purified Chrono Rune Axe (0 AC)

description: The components of these temporal axes were taken from a titanic timekeeper. Each gear diligently revolves, serving a higher purpose.

name: Purified Claw of Nulgath

name: Purified Crystallis Soldier's Gun + Shield
description: Darkness must give way to light. It is the eternal struggle for balance and equilibrium.

name: Purified Deep Terror Blade
description: This blade was recovered from the deepest depths of the ocean. The enscription says that it will unlock a Treasure Chest owned by Captain Rhubarb, so keep it handy!

name: Purified HydraSlayer Blades
description: These blades were crafted from the remains of several weapons left by a fallen HydraSlayer.

name: Purified Malice
description: Along with her twin, Eta, Apa has been entrusted by the Crystallis administration to oversee all of the soldiers on the Shinkansen.

name: Purified Runed Chrono Staff
description: Time doesn't always flow in one direction. Constant attention is needed to guarantee the steady motion of the clock's hands. (This present was ONLY available for 16th Upholders. It opened during our 16th Birthday Celebration. )

name: Purified Void Daggers
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword hold power beyond compare.

name: Purple Crystal Spike
description: While a very odd choice for a weapon, the edges of this crystal are razor sharp and just as capable as any blade. These are purple, too!

name: Purple Iceberg Lollies
description: ﻿﻿The fresh and deep purple flavor of succulent eggplant, cooled to a frosty chill.

name: Purple Paddlepops
description: ﻿﻿The fresh and deep purple flavor of succulent eggplant, cooled to a frosty chill.

name: Purple Purse Pop
description: The ice pop carries as much clout as the bag.

name: Pyroclastic Blaze Hands
description: Only the most powerful mages are strong enough to survive the molten waves of rage, fury and power that flow through the veins of a Pyroclastic mage.

name: Pyroclastic Cutlass + Pistol (0 AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as an Pyroclastic pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Pyroclastic Cutlass + Pistol (AC)
description: Avast ye! If you sailin' the seven seas as an Pyroclastic Pirate, make sure your swag be burstin' in fire and flame!

name: Pyroclastic Water Guns (AC)
description: It's lava resistant, but remember to replace the molten rock cartridge with water if you're just out for a beach trip.

name: Pyroclastic Water Guns (Legend)
description: It's lava resistant, but remember to replace the molten rock cartridge with water if you're just out for a beach trip.

name: Pyromancer Plushies
description: D'AWWW! This plushie will give you the warm fuzzies. Literally.

description: Weapons forged from mana-infused, superheated metal. They’re extremely volatile, and likely to cause an explosion on impact. Only someone who doesn’t mind sixth-degree burns should wield them.
