description: An unknown civilization used light as if it were steel, forging weapons that can withstand the crushing pressure of the domain between worlds. Who or what made them was lost when the worlds collided.

name: Quantum Force Blades
description: An unknown civilization used light as if it were steel, forging weapons that can withstand the crushing pressure of the domain between worlds. Who or what made them was lost when the worlds collided.

name: Quantum Force Spear + Shield
description: An unknown civilization used light as if it were steel, forging weapons that can withstand the crushing pressure of the domain between worlds. Who or what made them was lost when the worlds collided.

name: Quasar Crusher Maces
description: ﻿﻿The destructive force of the collapsing stars entrapped in these maces won't just crush your foes. They'll be twisted and torn in every direction until you stop understanding what you're looking at..

name: Quasar's Grasps
description: The destructive force of the collapsing stars entrapped in these maces won't just crush your foes. They'll be twisted and torn in every direction until you stop understanding what you're looking at.

name: Quill and Scroll
description: PLAYER SUGGESTION: Time to compose an epic love poem for your heart's true desire. Also good for Tic Tac Toe. Suggested by Salinas1994.

name: Rabid Ronin's Carrotnais
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the Rabid Ronin is truly hoppy!

name: Rabid Ronin's Kama Egg
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the Rabid Ronin is truly hoppy!

name: Rabid Ronin's Kamas
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the Rabid Ronin is truly hoppy!

name: Rabid Ronin's Katanas
description: It is only when they are in the middle of battle that the Rabid Ronin is truly hoppy!

name: Rabid Spring Rockstar's Blades
description: Spring flowers? Sunlit groves? Gentle rain and sweet songs? NO. Rabid Rockstars like you are fueled by spikes, storms, and SCREAMS OF VICTORY! (Also maybe cute baby bunnies.)

name: Raccoon Fishies
description: The otters finally have some competition in the adorable fluffy sea critter arena.

name: Raccoons
description: Raccoons are highly intelligeny, very curious, incredibly dextrous, and absolutely adorably furry. They would make excellent secret agents. While their target was distracted by how cute they are, a raccoon would be taking care of business. Fact.

name: Racetrack Tool Bag and Keys
description: Malfunctions can happen anywhere, at any time. You need to be ready for every disaster scenario.

name: Racetrack Tool Bags
description: Malfunctions can happen anywhere, at any time. You need to be ready for every disaster scenario.

name: Radiant Dominion Armblades
description: Those who walk the path of righteousness, following the Archangel Nulgath, can transform drastically. These vicious spikes can be startling, but there's no need to be afraid.

name: Radiant Ice Torches
description: Light shines from the ice crystal's core, refracting an array of colors like a clear opal.

name: Radiant Phoenix Blades (AC)
description: The phoenix's light may die, but it will never fade. (CC to Accessory)

name: Radiant Phoenix Blades (Legend)
description: The phoenix's light may die, but it will never fade. (CC to Accessory)

name: Raging Fire Daggers
description: Crafted by the mysterious Na Tra, these weapons will harness the fury inside of you and channel it into daggers of flame!

name: Ragnarok Cavalier Back Daggers
description: These warriors have an iron clad will which makes them impenetrable to the snow and ice of the Northlands.

name: Random Weapon of Nulgath
description: This weapon can be anything Nulgath decides. At some random point you can expect it to change without warning!

name: Rapiers of Awe
description: "Could dis be the real thing? The wielder o' dis legendary artifact be granted massive power!" If you shout that at Lolosia's docks, you'll get laughs and tomatoes…but is it the real thing? Did you actually just find it that easily in the sand?

name: Raven-Tester's Daggers
description: Pay homage to the lord of the Northlands Warriors. He is the Spear Shaker, the Shield Breaker, and all who do battle honor him in this life… and (if they are worthy) in the next.

name: RavenLord Commander's Cutlasses (AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: RavenLord Commander's Cutlasses (Legend)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: RavenLord Commander's Sabers (AC)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: RavenLord Commander's Sabers (Legend)
description: It be a foolish commander that ignores th' warnings o' his eyes in th' sky. Keep yer friends close, yer crew closer, an' yer raven on yer shoulder. It'll peck per enemies eyes out.

name: Ravenous Monstrosity Blades
description: Dzeza the Insatiable is an envious tangle of vines, teeth, and eyes. It longs for substenance, and the food that tastes best is often coveted by someone else. Its cultist compete with those of other unspeakable gods.

name: Ravenous Reaver Daggers (AC)
description: Reavers eat anything and everything in an attempt fill the gaping void in their lives (and chest).

name: Ravenous Reaver Daggers (Legend)
description: Reavers eat anything and everything in an attempt fill the gaping void in their lives (and chest).

name: Rawg's Swords
description: You carry weapons, you absorb Rawg power and skill. Rawg live on in you. Respect.

name: Raxborg's Axes
description: ﻿Greater levels of cruelty can only be achieved with red hot lasers. Not blue. Not green. It has to be red. Yes, it matters!

name: Raxgore's Skull Crushing Axes
description: Nothing beats the sensation of a skull cracking under your pressure.

name: Raziel's Celestial Glory
description: Battling with a transformed Celestial Knight as your weapon may seem a bit strange, but Raziel can bring even the toughest enemies to justice.

name: RazzleDazzle Daggers
description: A pair of mammoth blades capable of taking out any threat, forged by your fellow player RazzleDazzle!

name: Re's Dual Annihilators
description: "OHHHH! I'm a huge fan of the movie DoomWood Chainsaw Annihilation, and after watching it like a hundred times, I gotta get myself one!" Re boomed.

name: Re's Dual Long Stabbers
description: "If you have a really big bow, this thing will make a great arrow. Or you can use it as a spear," Re said.

name: Re's Dual Sharp Cutters
description: "I've watched this one zombie series, and I gotta try for myself if this thing is as sharp as it seems or not," Re said.

name: Re's Giant Slicers
description: "You see, if you hold one of these in each hand and spin around really REALLY fast, you can roleplay as a tornado," Re said.

name: Re's Short Stabbers
description: "Have you seen the movie Mogloween? Who wouldn't want a knife!" Re said.

name: Re-Vitalized Bloodletter of Nulgath
description: Your thirst for bloodshed has been quenched. But there's always room for seconds… and thirds… and more…!

name: Reality Cutters (0 AC)
description: Reality is what you make of it, and however you choose to break it.

name: Reality Cutters (AC)
description: Reality is what you make of it, and however you choose to break it.

name: Reavers of Agony
description: The tides of love and war overlap. Dull blades that once belonged to a forgotten traveler awaken, furious and alone. They seek to spread an agony that destroys language and cuts a wounded, scorned warrior to the core.

name: Reavers of Amenti
description: An otherworldly aurora surrounds these ancient mysterious blades. Legend foretold that a pair of daggers once belonging to a powerful Netherworld deity fell from the sky and was forever lost… Could it be the Reavers of Amenti?

name: Reavers of Hatoth
description: The spirit of Hatoth imbues these reavers with extra power.

name: Reavers of Serepthys
description: The spirit of Serepthys imbues these reavers with extra power.

name: Reavers of the Abyssal FireLord
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon an Abyssal Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Reavers of the Archfiend
description: Crafted by fiendish weaponsmiths chained to infernal forges, these daggers were crafted in honor of Nulgath the ArchFiend. Only the strongest members of his Nation are worthy of wielding them.

name: Reavers of the FireLord
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Reavers of the Gilded Sun
description: Zular is the oldest, and some say, wisest, of the Djinn Realm Guardians. When Crulon joined their ranks, he was the warrior set to shadow him on his first watchpost.

name: Reavers of the Perishing Star
description: At its core, Darkness desires to spread. When the Avatar of Darkness was born, it knew nothing but instinct. They gave up parts of their body to serve as terrifying weapons. Lore's sky has lost many stars.

name: Red Fox Plushies
description: Also known as Vulpes Vulpes. That's right, "Fox Fox".

name: Red Gummi Were-bear and Lolly
description: Prepare yourself for delicious battle! The time has come to (gummi)bear arms!

name: Red Iron Dragonforge Blades (AC)
description: (This is the 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)Weapons that carry the heat of a fiery Dragon's heart. If one stabs the hearth of a forge with these blades, the smith will produce a thousand divine weapons.

name: Red Iron Dragonforge Blades (Legend)
description: (Alternate 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)

name: Red Iron Dragonforge Dagger (0 AC)
description: (This is the 0 AC version from the Treasure Chest.)Weapons that carry the heat of a fiery Dragon's heart. If one stabs the hearth of a forge with these blades, the smith will produce a thousand divine weapons.

name: Red Iron Dragonforge Dagger (AC)
description: (Alternate 0 AC version available in the Treasure Chest.)

name: Red No.3 Energy Shakes
description: The "3" stands for the number of seconds it will take you to go from 0 to 60 miles per hour after drinking this.

name: Red Sonic Blade (Dagger)
description: When a youngling first becomes a time traveler's apprentice, they must make their own first sonic. The color of the blade is determined by the gem they use.

name: Referee Whistle
description: Time out! Ruling on the field is it's snack time.

name: Refined Blossom Fans
description: "The plum blossom does not jealously cling to spring. As the other flowers endure rot, she falls and turns to dust. Yet, her fragrance lingers, never to change." This story of nobility and legacy inspired the design of these fans.

name: Regal Pirate's Accoutrements
description: With such regal bearing, none will question your right to command either ship or crew.

name: Regal Pirate's Dual Handguns
description: With such regal bearing, none will question your right to command either ship or crew.

name: Regal Vindicator Titan's Axes
description: if you don't fight, you can't win. Vindication will be yours! BATTLE ON!

name: Regression Tear Katanas
description: They can slice through buildings and paralyze giant monsters, but those are just perks. Their intended purpose is to destabalize a Leyline, and plunge the area into chaos.

name: Reincarnated Fiend's Battlegear (0 AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Reincarnated Fiend's Battlegear (AC)
description: What is undead can never die… not when Nulgath can still make use of your skills and abilities!

name: Reki's Twin Dragons
description: Reki knows his blades, and to prove it, he's crafted a dual-wielding sword set to showcase his skill. Bear them well, Hero!

name: Requiem DoomKnight Blades
description: A requiem mourns the dead, and the spirit that once possessed these blades is no more. It gorged on wrath and despair until it snapped. You might as well be using a corpse as vile clubs.

name: Reshaper Swords
description: 2 savage blades not meant for leaving survivors.

name: Resonating Azure Blossom Staff
description: Once blessed by the Avatar of Ice's power, it now radiates with Fimbul's magic. In a twist of dark fate, the staff resonates with Lore's leylines far deeper than it could with Kyanos' influence.

name: Resonating Polaris Rapiers
description: In the old days, Ice Dragons preferred Elven partners over humans. Competitors would duel each other for the honor of holding an audience with the now-extinct court of Queen Khione.

name: Resplendent Polaris Blades (AC)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Resplendent Polaris Blades (Legend)
description: A shimmering star and a beacon of hope, raised aloft to lead the lost and cold back home. May the light shine eternal and sweep all wrongdoing from this world.

name: Restless Soul Cutlasses
description: A pirate's life never ends, in a manner of speaking. This cutlass' steel rusted away. Its new blade is made from a specter's unstoppable soul and desire to plunder.

name: Reverse Blademaster's Wakizashis
description: The blades that wear Orochi's name are considered its younglings, forged from materials taken from its living body. Depending on who's blood seeps into the blade and why, a new yokai will be born and the weapon will be its body.

name: Reverse Daggers of the Void
description: Weapons Nythera crafted with magic, and the materials she found in her travels through the Void. They're made from creatures that are close to the half-dragon, but she doesn't mind. If anything, that guarantees the dagger's effectiveness.

name: Reverse Grip Iron Anchors
description: When someone yells "Anchors away!" no one will know if that means the ship's ready to dock, or if they're about to get a mean concussion.

name: Reverse Nation Rogue's Knives
description: A simple knife is all this Rogue needs to fulfil their end of the contract. After that, they stay with the Nation for the perks. There's a lot of blood out there, and it's easier to hunt when you're a Fiend.

name: Reversed Abyssal FireLord's Dagger
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon an Abyssal Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Reversed Aletsch Glacier Daggers (AC)
description: Shards from the heart of a dead god of the Northlands was forged into jagged keepsakes. Elves who mourned Aletsch's death sought Ouro's power as a way to regain the supremacy they once had.

name: Reversed Aletsch Glacier Daggers (Legend)
description: Shards from the heart of a dead god of the Northlands was forged into jagged keepsakes. Elves who mourned Aletsch's death sought Ouro's power as a way to regain the supremacy they once had.

name: Reversed Apocryphal Katanas
description: To become the warrior you were truly meant to be, you must tap into otherworldly forces. Only then will you be able to unlock the power you need to achieve greatness!

name: Reversed Athame
description: The flames of magic and power rise within you. Lite the embers and ignite your enemies!

name: Reversed Borgrix Blades
description: We are Borgrix, resistance will not be tolerated.

name: Reversed Brawler Dagger
description: These daggers are rated 10 stabbies out of 10. That's not a real rating, but I did stab 10 people with them and none of them have moved. So I think it's the same thing.

name: Reversed Daggers of Thorns
description: When a skilled elvish assassin dies, their connection to Nature and Poison transforms their bodies into vines of thorns. A new assassin tore this thorn from the body of their predecessor.

name: Reversed Dragon Samurai Katana (Dagger)
description: Look straight at the people you kill, and never forget them. Because they'll never, ever forget you.

name: Reversed Dragonslayer's Demise
description: The blood red blade pulses when Dragonslayers are around.

name: Reversed Dual AeroFrost Katanas
description: Gundahar, famed Northlands Hunter and Smith, forged this blade from the frozen breath of a dire beast terrorizing helpless villagers in the Northlands.

name: Reversed Dual Ebil Saber
description: Fear is the path to darkness. With this you will feel the power of darkness.

name: Reversed Duality Daggers
description: The Duality Sorcerer reaches through Time to gather power from both Good and Chaos in order to power their spells.

name: Reversed Empyrean Chronomancer Daggers
description: Empyrean Chronomancers seem to have simply always existed. Their bodies transcend space and time and can be in all dimensions and infinities at once. Others who control time revere them and are strengthened by their presence. To tap into this strength requires particular insight though.

name: Reversed Enchanted Daggers
description: Something wicked is definitely on its way when Enchanted DragonMage's meet to summon powerful dragons. Their rituals are magic in the making.

name: Reversed FireLord's Dagger
description: Only the strongest summoners can channel their rage to summon a Firelord from deep within the heart of its Elemental Plane.

name: Reversed Flameborn Blades
description: Forged in the heat of the Champion of Fire's fury, these blades will sear the souls of all who oppose you.

name: Reversed Grimskull's Survival Knives (0 AC)
description: Tool for getting back to the basics of dungeon building in the wild. If Grimskull's hurting for gold, he'll sell these at his post-dungeon experience gift shops.

name: Reversed Grimskull's Survival Knives (AC)
description: Tool for getting back to the basics of dungeon building in the wild. If Grimskull's hurting for gold, he'll sell these at his post-dungeon experience gift shops.

name: Reversed Legion Athame
description: Legion Pyromancers don't play around with normal fire. Their blue flames come deep with the underworld.

name: Reversed Plasmatic Dagger
description: A poisoned dirk greatly treasured by the cryptkeepers in the Eergcast Catacombs for it contains a slow-acting, fatal venom that can either corrupt a willing soul or kill an unwilling soul. One of these dirks are usually found in discarded tombstones spread out around the catacombs.

name: Reversed Psionic Daggers
description: Made from ore from the Orpheum Elementals, this lance and shield combo is enhanced by the power of the MindBreaker wielding it.

name: Reversed Revenge
description: The true nature of the ninja should always be concealed… much like these reversed daggers of revenge!

name: Reversed Seabutcher's Twinblades (AC)
description: If a fishy beastie is bigger than a ship, start cutting and piercing from its soft insides. This blade is two tools in one.

name: Reversed Seabutcher's Twinblades (Legend)
description: If a fishy beastie is bigger than a ship, start cutting and piercing from its soft insides. This blade is two tools in one.

name: Reversed ShadowFlame Dragon Daggers
description: Something wicked is definitely on its way when Shadowflame DragonMage's meet to summon powerful dragons.

name: Reversed ShadowSnake Katanas
description: Slithering through the shadowy back alleys of Akiba, the rogues of the ShadowSnake Clan live outside the law… but remain loyal to the Empress, a descendent of the Jade Serpent Prince.

name: Reversed Spiralling Keyblades
description: A rare key that was once thought to open crevices containing red power-boosting potions. The theory later proved to be false, but it still has means to leave an enemy wide open to severe damaging weaknesses.

name: Reversed Streamer's Edges
description: Slice through enemies like lag through a bad connection.

name: Reversed Urban Duelist Rebel Katanas
description: Astravia's ancient rulers stole swords from distant lands, and a servant snuck them out of the castle. The commoners forged copies, arming the Duelists with weapons to train with.

name: Rhapsodic Espressivos
description: A fell blade with a song that fortells death. Only the most skilled of virtuosos can express their ambitions with this weapon. To the amusement of the Rulers of Evil, many of their arrogant followers embarass themselves by clumsily performing with the Espressivo in duels.

name: Rhapsodic Sforzando
description: ﻿This harp was forged from the armor of famed Shadowscythe warriors. Their legends and infamy are sung through the strumming of these bloodied harpstrings.

name: Rhiannon's Daggers
description: Centaur warriors have long been some of Lore's fiercest and fastest fighters. With 4 hooves and as many blades as they can carry, they are a force to be reckoned with. (Gives 25% more gold when equipped)

name: Riftkin's Toxic Daggers
description: The bright colors of this gleaming emerald knife are as deceptive as the swamp itself. Don't touch the blade!

name: RiftWalker's Dual Blades
description: The blades Riftwalkers wield are enhanced with ancient runes which, it is said, an ancient alien race used before they found better ways of traveling between realms.

name: Ring Of Ice Daggers
description: Children of the ice never freeze nor crack. Their power is an eternal crystal cutting ever sharper.

name: Rings of Power (AC)
description: Battles using the ever-growing strength of the shadows make the world go round and round.

name: Rings of Power (Legend)
description: Battles using the ever-growing strength of the shadows make the world go round and round.

name: Ripper Blades of the Underworld
description: Blades for combat that are also used to prep bones and marrow to use as reagents or new mindless minions. Magic is quicker and more efficient, but deeper control can be forged with skilled hands.

name: Rippling Void Katanas
description: Pieces of deep emptiness, torn from the depths of the Void. The violet color is deceptive. Get too close, and their true hues will steal your sight. Who's to know what will happen if they actually touch flesh.

name: Riptide Blades (AC)
description: Everybody needs to get away after a long session of waging war, boss battles, and hauling home loot… and a hidden island retreat is the BEST place to /rest. recoup, and re-energize.

name: Riptide Blades (Legend)
description: Everybody needs to get away after a long session of waging war, boss battles, and hauling home loot… and a hidden island retreat is the BEST place to /rest. recoup, and re-energize.

name: Risen Sun Dual Katanas
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of the Risen Sun Ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Risen Sun Dual Weapons
description: Only those who devote themselves to the path of the Risen Sun Ninja may wield this weapon.

name: Road Rage Bats
description: In case you can't settle a racetrack incident with words…

name: Rogue Fiend Daggers of Nulgath
description: Take caution. It may be empowered by the harvested souls trapped in the deadly Lake Hiyfar, one stab can result in the rapid formation of slanted ice crystals.

name: Rogue of Time's Daggers
description: Said to be forged from the tempered scales of the Eternal Sovereign. Frankly, it hurt to pick off scales, but it was interesting to see how enchanted fire cooled their green into a shade of sharp, cold blue.

name: Rogue Rocker Guitar + Hat
description: The greatest companion a rocker could ask for.

name: Rogue's Dagger
description: A dagger enhanced to improve a rogue's power!

name: Roroth's First Revolvers
description: Thsese two revolvers were Roroth's first firearms! They don't fire bullets anymore, but are still just as effective on the battlefield.

name: Roroth's Training Shotguns
description: The remnants of Roroth’s first forays into the art of gunslinging. They don’t work anymore, unfortunately. Probably worn down from overuse.

name: Rose Flaming Fists (AC)
description: You passion to fight burns hot within your heart…and your fists! Ahhhh! Stop drop and roll! STOP DROP AND ROLL!! (Suggested by AQW Hero Charizard!)

name: Rose Flaming Fists (Legend)
description: You passion to fight burns hot within your heart…and your fists! Ahhhh! Stop drop and roll! STOP DROP AND ROLL!! (Suggested by AQW Hero Charizard!)

name: Rose Of The Fire Avatar
description: For the most prismatic of all the staff, this lovely flame was gifted to Beleen who wants to share it with you!

name: Rose Visionary's Blades
description: There's a future that can be won, with great sacrifice. One without war, suffering, or prejudice! Only a visionary can seize that dream. Only a real Hero can make blue roses real.

name: Roses on Fire Batons
description: Two everlasting flames are better than one especially since the flames could inflict pink-like colors upon contact with their target.

name: Rot-Touched Guns
description: A shot will kill you, just not right away. The wound starts looking gangrenous, and spreads until your entire body's zombified.

name: Rot-Touched Knives
description: Even a slight nick will kill you, just not right away. The wound starts looking gangrenous, and spreads until your entire body's zombified.

name: Rot-Touched Pistols
description: A shot will kill you, just not right away. The wound starts looking gangrenous, and spreads until your entire body's zombified.

name: Rotfinger's ArmBlades
description: I'm not sure if this is Rotfinger's weapon… or a weapon made out of bits of Rotfinger. Ew.

name: Rotfinger's Hollowborn ArmBlades
description: Pieces of Rotfinger made their way to the Underworld, so the Hollowborn incorporated them into a set of weapons.

name: Rotten Grasps
description: The clammiest handshake on the planet.

name: Rotting Cutlasses
description: Dead men tell no tales… but they do leave behind weapons for ye to loot. Yaaarrrr!

name: Rouge Reversed Daggers
description: You killed them, killed them all. They're dead, every single one of them. All of the enemies threatening your home. In the setting sunlight, the sands are tinted pink and gold with all their blood.

name: Royal Blade of Swordhaven (Dagger)
description: It may seem abnormally heavy at first, but if the wielder is a worthy owner, the soothing power of light helps support the weight you must carry. It's the same way your burdened responsibility as a faithful commander must carry to save the world.

name: Royal Crystalline Swords
description: It's not royal because it belongs to a King. So many bluebloods have been felled by this sword that it has taken up their color. It's an intruiging story to tell on a long winding road.

name: Royal Cyber Blades of Z (0 AC)
description: Claymores of gleaming gold forged by a blacksmith residing in Swordhaven who still has faith that the fallen city can rise again. Surprisingly, he was one of the gifted few who could forge weapons worthy of royalty.

name: Royal Cyber Blades of Z (AC)
description: Claymores of gleaming gold forged by a blacksmith residing in Swordhaven who still has faith that the fallen city can rise again. Surprisingly, he was one of the gifted few who could forge weapons worthy of royalty.

name: Royal Dragon Swords
description: Corvak was King Alteon's Draconic partner, meant to protect the realm and his family till the end of their shared days. This dream did not come to be, but his memory lives on, defending the realm and King Alteon's daughters.

name: Royal DragonSlayer's Slashers
description: Feared by dragons, wyverns, basilisks, and hydra, and serpents across the land, DragonSlayers are among Lore's most-skilled warriors and known for their unparalleled courage in battle.

name: Royal Fortune Daggers
description: Jewel-encrusted blades that are so opulent, they're almost too difficult to wield. Each gem is enchanted with a powerful spell, one imparted by each noble family in Greenguard…or at least, the ones that like you.

name: Royal Fortune Greatswords
description: Jewel-encrusted blades that are so opulent, they're almost too difficult to wield. Each gem is enchanted with a powerful spell, one imparted by each noble family in Greenguard…or at least, the ones that like you.

name: Royal Fortune Swords
description: Jewel-encrusted blades that are so opulent, they're almost too difficult to wield. Each gem is enchanted with a powerful spell, one imparted by each noble family in Greenguard…or at least, the ones that like you.

name: Royal Glaceran Daggers
description: This dagger is inscribed with runes unique to the children of the royal house of Glacera. Loremasters believe -- but cannot be certain -- that one of the runes indicates it is wielded by the women of the family.

name: Royal GrenwogSlayer's Lacerators
description: Even royalty wants to get in on the GrenwogSlaying fun!

name: Royal Mage Staff + Tome
description: If you want to use the power of your magic for Good, the best place to study is with the Royal Swordhaven Mages. Learn all you can to protect Swordhaven and fight for Good!

name: Royal Nautican Shell Fans
description: Wielded by some of the deadliest Nautican Warriors, and especially effective since no one expects DEADLY FAN DEATH!

name: Royal Paladin's Avalanches
description: Avalanche, named for the crushing and unforgiving rage from the mountains. But they must happen, to uncover the secrets, traps, and blood hidden in shadow and snow.

name: Royal Quill and Scroll
description: The Royal Archives aim to record EVERYTHING that happens in Swordhaven. We know all, we see all, and we write it all down… for posterity!

name: Royal Saber And Shield
description: The Royal Guard of Swordhaven swear only one vow: to protect the royal family with their swords, shields, and lives. It is an honor to serve Good.

name: Royal Serpent Fans
description: The refined visage of a serpent decorates these delicate fans. Following Ai No Miko's rise to the Yokai Isles' throne, the snake became a symbol of the royal family.

name: Royal Shadowslayer's Battle Gear
description: When you are royalty, yet wish to be a Shadowslayer… you dress the part!

name: Royal Skye Pistols (0 AC)
description: Blessed by Iona's touch, these pistols are supercharged with her lightning. Multiple targets can be executed at once. To her quiet chagrin, the Queen's children were able to bless weapons like this as well.

name: Royal Skye Pistols (AC)
description: Blessed by Iona's touch, these pistols are supercharged with her lightning. Multiple targets can be executed at once. To her quiet chagrin, the Queen's children were able to bless weapons like this as well.

name: Royal Winter Paladin Rapiers
description: Rapier's are a noble's dueling weapon of choice. The sharp point slides under the creases of armor and scales to piece the enemy's warmth with cold.

name: Royal Winter Paladin's Starlight Sentinel
description: The fusion of the weapons 'Starlight' and 'Sentinel.' In the unforgiving dark and cold, the will of the people the paladins protect live in their legends, accompanying them in battle.

name: Royal Winter Paladin's Starlight Sentinels

name: Rusted Cutlasses

name: Rusted Doom Claws

name: Rusted Rapier's
description: The tips are breaking into rusty chips. Perhaps they lost a duel, and were tossed away.

name: Rusted Slasher

name: S.S. Doom Captain's Pistols (AC)

description: Quietly and gracefully, these daggers will treat your opponent to a beautiful display of technique and charming. So beautiful, they will never see the final strike coming. Woe to the ones who stand against you.

Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Sandsea Fakhfakhina Mugs

name: SandSea Guardian's Daggers
description: The Sandsea Guardian is a member of the elite Oasis Defense Force. Their armor helms helps them blend in with the dunes, making attacking their enemies much easier.

name: Sandsea Naval Accoutrements (0 AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: Sandsea Naval Accoutrements (AC)
description: You would not expect the Sandsea to have a Navy, but you would be wrong! Sail over sand dunes on magic carpets sail as you track down pirates burying their loot… then strike, steal, and savor your victory!

name: SandSea Scimitars
description: A pair of beautiful curved blades used by nobility in the Sandsea. The blade's curve is iconic, allowing it to be identified from anywhere on the battlefield.

name: Sandsea Serpent Clawssss
description: A pair of sickly-green claws adorn each of these weapons. A gemstone snake head was placed in the center and magically enchanted to act as if it was were alive, biting those you strike.

name: Sandsea Sickles
description: A pair of hand sickles originally purposed for harvesting desert crops. Also servers as a handly critter-cutter!

name: Sandsea Slasher
description: The handle is forged of the hardest rock found in the desert. The blade is made of sand packed so tightly together it forms an edge sharp enough to cut steel. Take the fury of the Sandsea with you at all times!

name: Sandsea Strider Crys Knives
description: Pumpkin spice can only be found deep beneath the desert dunes of the Sandsea. Striders are tasked with recovering it and ensuring the supply continues to flow to the rest of Lore.

name: Sandsea WaveCutter
description: A pair of armblades meant to mimic the waves of water. Since they're very light, you can flow into your attacks, much like the flow of the sands in the Sandsea or any other sea.

name: Sandstone Rippers
description: Sculpted after the Skyguard Airship keel, these identical blades take a great amount of strength to wield… and even more reputation.

name: Sanguine Dussacks
description: They're called dussacks, but resemble a butcher's cleavers more than a pair of sabers. Hopefully, none of the monsters you're slaying in Darkovia end up being sold as 'beef.'

name: Santa Claw's Ripper
description: Fits nicely onto Santa Claws' gauntlet.

name: Santa's Impaler
description: Happy Frostval!

name: Sapphire Wish Blades
description: In Sandsea legends, the eye of fate is sky blue, and casts its gaze on those whose wishes will come true. This weapon was forged with sapphires, meant to guide their wielder to their destiny.

name: Sarazen Armaments
description: CervantesMaxi discovered this dagger embedded in the very bones of Lore. With massive strength, he ripped it from the rock and presents it to you as reminder of the power that one can wield if you only put your mind to it.

name: Satay Skewer BIG BITE
description: When one bite isn't enough. These massive skewers are for heroes who battle hunger and monsters in equal measure.

name: Satyrs Hands of Domination
description: *No description*

name: Saurus Armaments
description: Equipped with a blade and a shield made of double-hardened dino hide, you'll be unstoppable!

name: Savage Frostcutters
description: Steel blades of frenetic make. They belonged to a traveling warrior who fell asleep in the lonely arms of Winter.

name: Scarab Fiend ArmBlades
description: Scarab Bloodrunners were once among the Sandsea's greatest warriors. Once they swore allegiance to Nulgath and embraced a new role as Fiends, they became some of his fiercest defenders.

name: Scarbucks Barista Gear
description: Nothing says "Please be patient" better than a quick wallop to the head.

name: Scarbucks Double Dessert
description: Overdose yourself on pumpkin spice the optimal way.

name: Scarlet Flame Scythe and Spellbook

description: An unassuming wand, easily crafted with accessible materials. It's the knowledge and experience, passed on to the next candidate, that makes this wand radiate with blistering and invisible heat.

name: Scarlet Sorcerer's Athames
description: A weapon used to draw blood but often used to engrave runes into stone and skin. The strange magic contained in the blade flows into the objects it cuts.

name: Scarlet Sorcerer's Blades
description: A weapon used to draw blood but often used to engrave runes into stone and skin. The strange magic contained in the blade flows into the objects it cuts.

Don't forget to attach the Swordhaven symbol and toss on some horns that you nabbed when you battled one of the Infernal Army, and voila! New weapon!

name: Scepter and Flail of Yasaris
description: The scepter and flail of the Black Hole Sun Priests.

name: Shadow Soulblades
description: The brighter the light, the darker the shadow. The Future Legion's steel will consume both. But, what are they doing here? Did they slip through a temporal anomaly?

name: Shadow Star Daggers
description: Corrupted with tainted mana, these daggers draws power from the deepest darkest areas of magic.

name: Shadow Thief's Dagger
description: Wisps of mana flow over the royal purple wrap, accenting this blade with a rare power and strength. The exquisite blade is a show of might and leadership, giving you the upper hand in any fight.

name: Shadow WerePyre Slayer Swords (0 AC)
description: When sterling silver blades just aren't enough… enhance them with the element of garlic! A super rare blade only suitable for fearless heroes.

name: ShadowBlast Flames (AC)
description: You passion to fight burns hot within your heart…and your fists! Ahhhh! Stop drop and roll! STOP DROP AND ROLL!!

name: ShadowBone Covenants
description: Ever loyal to Master Nulgath, the Nation's greatest loyalists serve the Archfiend even in death. Their souls cling to their bones, waiting for another chance to prove themselves. (Glow is color-customizable to eye color)

name: Shadowbound Dual Katana
description: The blade can sever one's soul from the natural cycle of life and death, becoming neither undead nor alive. In the Shadows, the soul slowly collapses until it fuses with that crawling void. (Color Customizable to Accessory)

name: Shadowbound Gear
description: The shadowbound extend their reach of their shade with every shot and flash. (Color Customizable to Accessory)

name: Shadowbound Pistols
description: The target of the pistol's bullets fall to their knees, melting into the shadows. Whole ship crews, villages, and even two sides of a naval battle can disappear just like that. (Color Customizable to Accessory)

name: Shadowbrand's Edges
description: Forged in Mount Maleno's sacred fire, this blade hums with a heat that only grows in battle.

name: Shadowcat Hand of Victory
description: Cheer for your favorite feline team!

name: Shadowcat Pom Poms (Dagger)
description: People don't understand exactly how dangerous cheerleaders can be!

name: Shadowed Beacon Daggers
description: This celestial sword dagger was crafted by Bido for Gjappy. It is a beacon of hope, and now they are sharing it with you!

name: Shadowed Blades of Doom
description: With reverence, some call it the original. With derision, others call it ancient. Neither can deny that it is heavy with Doomed fate, meant for the hands of those that would steer the Shadows closer to total domination.

name: Shadowed Butterfly Blades
description: With just a hint of flair, these thick blades will render your enemy unable to fly away from the heat of the battle, cursing him or her to remain until the end has come. And what a glorious end it will be… for you at least.

name: Shadowed Devourer
description: Dark, mysterious and jagged, this blade was designed to cause trouble of the mind and the flesh. It doesn't just look painful, it is. And if your enemy survives, he or she will be plagued by nightmares of defeat.

name: Shadowed Sun Morningstars
description: The image of an eclipsed sun holds a menacing significance to those who call Lore home. But if the Shadows try to wield this mace, the spikes will shoot out and sear them with shaded light.

name: Shadowed Sun Scythes
description: At a certain angle, the scythe brings to mind the image of a dragon of darkness. Perhaps in dark sunspots or during an eclipse, dragons do emerge on the Sun's surface.

name: Shadowfir Athame
description: To come of age in the Grovebreak culture, a child must take this blade and chop down the tree they tended to since birth.

name: ShadowFire Prince's Claws
description: Tyronius commands the shadows themselves. The helm he's crafted is imbued with their darkness mixed with his power. Use this at your peril.

description: Shadowflame is not a spontaneous manifestation. It comes from a place, be it of reason or rage. The blade shreds and maims, volatile like the flames it was born from.

name: ShadowFlame SpellSword's Daggers
description: Spellswords draw magic from the ley lines and imbue their blades with it. ShadowFlame Spellswords mix their magic with Malgor's Darkness and are feared across Lore.

name: ShadowStrike Accoutrements

description: Hold up this extraordinary mirror to the sun to absorb some much-needed powerful light magic. Only then will it unleash a beaming blast that could stun a large group of enemies in a single area.

name: Sharkenguins
description: They're so cute that you're willing to forgive the loss of your limbs.

name: Sharpened Parrot Mallet
description: What did the captain do to Petey?!

name: Shashou Neck Carvers
description: Assassins were sent after Ai No Miko, and these knives were all that were left behind. The dark metal is cursed, driving any it cuts to madness. A power, higher than any throne, wanted the Empress to perish in humiliation

name: Shattered Glass Cutlasses (AC)
description: Cutlasses Scarletta made from enchanted glass, becoming far more dangerous when they shatters. Your enemies are unable to block the shards as they tear through their faces with glee.

name: Shattered Glass Cutlasses (Legend)
description: Cutlasses Scarletta made from enchanted glass, becoming far more dangerous when they shatters. Your enemies are unable to block the shards as they tear through their faces with glee.

name: Shatterglass Chakram
description: Not every snowflake that falls from the sky assimilates with the snow that eventually thaws when spring comes. Some special, larger snowflakes harden into convenient jagged-edged weaponry that'll give frosted flakes a new definition.

name: Shattersword Bandit Kamas
description: You've found this item after slaying a Bandit. Could Graveclaw the Defiler, trapped for so long in Shattersword Cavern, have already contacted creatures aboveground?

name: Shattersword Defiler Kamas
description: You found this item after slaying a Skeletal Warrior. Could Graveclaw the Defiler, trapped for so long in Shattersword Cavern, have already contacted creatures aboveground?

name: Shattersword Imp Kamas
description: You've found this item after slaying a Mana Imp. Could Graveclaw the Defiler, trapped for so long in Shattersword Cavern, have already contacted creatures aboveground?

name: Shattersword Warrior Kamas
description: You've found this item after slaying a Skeletal Warrior. Could Graveclaw the Defiler, trapped for so long in Shattersword Cavern, have already contacted creatures aboveground?

name: Sheep Cookies
description: Milk cookies for a spring tea party. For some reason, it makes the farm dogs go crazy. No… is there real sheep in the baa-tter…

name: Sheep Pillows
description: No need to count sheep! Cushioned by fluff, you'll be visiting the City of Dreams in no time!

name: Sheep Plushies
description: No need to count sheep! Cushioned by fluff, you'll be visiting the City of Dreams in no time! Happy National Hug a Sheep Day!

name: Sheep's Milk Ice Cream Cones
description: Adorable scoops of ice cream made from churned sheep's milk. They taste like cheese!

name: Shelled Stabber
description: These daggers might LOOK fragile, but they are really eggs shells made of adamantine. What monsters hatch out of adamantine eggs? You don't want to know!

name: Shepherd's Dulcet Knives
description: Surely you will only use these knives to spread cream on scones. Oh dear, what are those harps made of? Where did the strings come from? Surely not from an actual little lamb…

name: Shepherd's Euphonious Utensils
description: Having dinner with some music? That sounds wonderful! Flocks of sheep stare at you, hoping that meal's going to be vegetarian.

name: Shepherd's Tuning Harps
description: They're harps fused with pitchforks for both farming and musical purposes. Each strum of the strings makes a distinct 'baa~' that calls the flock home.

name: Shield and Spear o' Plenty
description: Also doubles as a fork and plate if you're super hungry. Just don't eat your weapons!

name: Shielded Cobalt Beast Hand Axe
description: The primeval beasts of yore had bones and hearts made of unbreakable ice. Wearing the pelts of these beasts and fusing with their souls, the Wardens of today forged those bones and hearts into deadly weapons.

name: Shielded Cobalt Glacier Crusher
description: In the past, the great beasts of the Northlands shaped the ice and mountains with their claws. Now in tandem with their mortal partners, they cleave armies in two with weapons made from their hearts.

name: Shielded Conquest of Múspell
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Shielded Conquest of Surtr
description: A warrior, who burned in sacred fire, promised to return to engulf his enemies in sacred flame. He ascended, but flew to join his brethren in the sun. Fatal misunderstandings let to many Champions of Fire being mistaken for Surtr.

name: Shielded Defiler of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged this sword using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Shielded Destroyer of the Ancients
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged this axe using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.
