description: May no soul, mortal or immortal, ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged this axe using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Shielded Ivory Memento Mori
description: May no soul, mortal or immortal ever claim that they are invincible. The Lord of the Legion forged this mace using the souls of former Generals to break the streaks of the undefeated.

name: Shielded Legion Letum Codex
description: This blade is a creature, or many creatures, that recite forbidden passages from the burned tomes. Only a resilient soul can withstand its curses, let they be crushed, twisted, and dragged into the writhing mass themselves.

name: Shielded Nekiya Rite Blade (0 AC)
description: To descend to the Underworld and return would prove you immortal and untoucheable. This blade was born under the sun, and darkened in the Underworld. It has yet to complete its journey.

name: Shielded Nekiya Rite Blade (AC)
description: To descend to the Underworld and return would prove you immortal and untoucheable. This blade was born under the sun, and darkened in the Underworld. It has yet to complete its journey.

name: Shipwrecked Captain's Pistol + Cutlass (0 AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: Shipwrecked Captain's Pistol + Cutlass (AC)
description: Once Captains of the great ships that now lay at the bottom of Davy Jones' locker these pirates now be looking for turtles to strap to their feet.

name: ShockSticks
description: Stand back! These daggers are doing SCIENCE!

name: Short-Wicked Bombs
description: Wind up your throwing arm, or wind up sharing the same grave as the enemy.

name: Shortswords of the Dark
description: Everything mortal and small was born in the dark, and will return to the dark. Take this blade, a reminder of the cradle and grave, to make your mark on the world with what little time you have.

name: Shuang Gou of Shinobi
description: Shuang Gou, commonly known as hook swords, are effective tools for trapping and deflecting your enemy's weapons. Every ninja should own a pair!

name: Shuriken
description: A hand full of throwing stars but you were raised right and know it's dangerous to throw pointy objects.

name: Sickles of the Undead Masses
description: The condensed marrow of a colosseum's worth of bones, waiting for others to join them.

name: Sidhe's Brigand Pistols
description: Pistols styled after the bewitching spectre haunting the brigand's dreams. They always hit the heart, and sport malicious wings.

name: Sidhe's Devotee Daggers
description: An artist was given special iron daggers to kill Leanan Sidhe, and save themselves from death. They were never be able to bring themselves to plunge the weapons into their stalker's chest.

name: SightBlinder Axes of Nulgath
description: Hysterical Blindness is a psychological affliction that occurs when the victim sees something so mindbogglingly traumatizing, he or she is struck with blindness. How do you think this axe got its name?

name: Sil Katar
description: A beautiful and lightweight katar that was recreated from items found in the Ruins of Sil of DragonFable. The katars were forged from Zephyrite, a very rare wind metal.

name: Silent Sentinel Arms
description: Grip deadly silence in your hands as you hunt down the ones who stand against truth, justice and honor.Those who oppose all that you stand for will never hear you coming…

name: Silent Void Blades (AC)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Void Blades (Legend)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Void Katanas (AC)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Void Katanas (Legend)
description: Swordmasters crave reaching the pinnacle of their craft, and some achieve this by signing their name on the ArchFiend's contract. Your form empties as your soul is forfeit to the Fiend's Void.

name: Silent Wanderer Scissor + Comb
description: These wanderers drift through Yokai offering cutting comments on your hairstyles. They sometimes offer to cut your hair… while blindfolded. No thanks!

name: Silphium Love Potions
description: A potion that can rekindle affection, reunite families, and trivialize your rivals. The waters of the Lethe were simmered in a gold basin, refined to make you forget memories that taint pure love.

name: Silphium Rapier and Potion
description: A blade of noble semblance, hiding an irresistible poison. Your dreams of love can become reality if you never open your eyes again.

name: Silphium Rapiers
description: Blades of noble semblance, hiding an irresistible poison. Your dreams of love can become reality if you never open your eyes again.

name: Silver And Blue Pistols
description: Silver and bright as the light on the crescent moon, a swift , cunning swing can strengthen or soften the ocean tides.

name: Silver Carteret Spear and Shield
description: A blacksmith from Mythsong was comissioned to forge this spear. In battle, it pleasantly chimes every time it clashes with steel. In fact, it's so pleasant that it motivates the wielder to find more reasons to fight.

name: Silver Cyborg Monk Sticks
description: Definitely not used for walking, and the Cyborg Monk has long since moved passed the virtue of humility.

name: Silver Dagger (1)
description: One of the prizes for winning the Roach Race. - a gorgeous silver dagger!

name: Silver Dagger (2)
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Silver!

name: Silver Dream Guardian Daggers
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within.

name: Silver Dream Guardian Dual Scimitars
description: There are many creatures that stalk the lands of the Djinn Realm, and the Guardians of the Dream Palace protect all who dwell within. Golden versions of the Guardian's uniform are awarded to those who have saved the lives of those who dwell in the realm.

name: Silver Drow Sabers
description: Once chaorrupted, the blades were putrefied and purified in the fires of Melano and Albedo. Now Prima Materia, the Drows' weapons can conduct and deflect an array of elements.

name: Silver Duel Busters
description: Enven crafted these deadly silver duel busters to help you blast your enemies to bits!

name: Silver Edged Lamenters
description: The blade of an Elven Heritage Guardian that set off to rescue those in need of aid. Now without a master, it laments that it can not rust. In your hands, silver born in forest soil seeks to fulfil the wishes of a lost elf.

name: Silver Exalted Spears of Light
description: Unfortunately, Trolle'din died when a foe told him his shoelace was untied. Down he looked, to double-check, and his enemy took his head - at the neck!

name: Silver Purgatorio Coins
description: These aren't the coins you're looking for.

name: Silver Pyromancer's Sabres
description: AHAHAH! BURN THE WORLD! BURN IT ALL DOWN! NO REMORSE NO REGRET JUST FIRE! AHAHAH

name: Silver Scythes in Shadow
description: In Lore, a scythe is a symbol of Death yet this weapon also captures the precious shine of life. The Moonborn can not exist for long, so they seek to carve proof that they were alive into history, the memories of their comrades, and scar those that threaten both.

name: Silver Skye Armaments
description: Weapons meant to be inherited, and passed from one generation to the next, in an unbroken line back to the first warriors of Skye. The steel has been burned by fiery dragon's breath, enchanting it with strength.

name: Silver Stream Swords
description: Swords passed down through multiple generations of warriors. The steel has been burned by fiery dragon's breath, enchanting it with strength.

name: Silver Swashbuckler Gauntlets
description: They were originally meant to be mining tools, but were refurbished to better serve a pirate's life. Look, a hook that can twitch! The future is here!

name: Silver Throwing Knife
description: For those baddies who you just don't wanna get THAT close to. Super effective against Lycans and dart boards!

name: Silver Victor's Hammers
description: No matter how vast the invading army, no matter how massive the monster, no matter how powerful the villain… the heroes of Battleon will ALWAYS rise to defend their home. And battling together, they will ALWAYS win.

name: Silver Vindicator Swords
description: The lowest rank, recruits have just started learning the way of the Vindicator. As a conscript, you are eligible to wield the Silver Vindicator weapons.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Battle Gear (0 AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Battle Gear (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Lance + Shield (0 AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Lance + Shield (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Sabers (AC)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: SilverStag Warrior's Sabers (Legend)
description: Defenders of the Northlands borders, the SilverStag Warrior Chiefs swear a binding blood oath on the horns of a slain Blight Deer to protect and serve.

name: Simple Celtic Dagger
description: A simple yet elegant dagger of Celtic design. Never back stab your friends, unless you are a rogue. Happy Lucky Day!

name: Sin of the Warlord Cleavers
description: Fiendish blades with a hunger for war as deep as the Fiend God's Void. Only a Nation fanatic could have created such savage masterpieces, born from blood, fangs, and talons.

name: Singapore Spirit Sticks
description: The lion symbolises three of LeoSpire's greatest national values: courage, excellence and strength. May you always embody these as you battle through Lore!

name: Sinister Life Rings (AC)
description: Not all Shadowscythe know how to swim. Sure, they're not going to drown but it's a long walk back to land from the bottom of the sea.

name: Sinister Life Rings (Legend)
description: Not all Shadowscythe know how to swim. Sure, they're not going to drown but it's a long walk back to land from the bottom of the sea.

name: Sinister Pumpkin Sickles
description: A pair of Sickles make harvesting *anything* ten times easier!

name: Sinlithic Daggers
description: A powerful, yet mysterious mace, that was found in the forgotten jungles of the Pinewood forest. The mace posses the strength of the Dwarfhold mountains.

name: Sixteen Bladed Daggers
description: We two auto-attacked and the stream, from noon until server restart time, but bugs between us broad have roared since old long ago.

name: Skeletal Smashers
description: These full-bodied smashers will slice and slash through your most undead of foes!

name: Sketchy Battle Gear
description: This weapon hat looks pretty sketchy to me. ( But then, what would you expect from gear you found inside a Sketchy Dragon?)

name: Skull and Axe Armaments
description: I want to Axe you how you got a Head….

name: Skull Bombs
description: This piece of flotsam washed up on the shore. Do you - - do you hear a ticking sound? O_O

name: Skull-Poms
description: Rah Rah Sis DOOM Bah!

name: SkullBorne Dagger
description: MORE LITTLE SKULLS!

name: Skullbound Chakrams (0 AC)
description: You gained the ability to move through the darkness as silently as a shadow when your soul was stripped from you, twisted, and bound back into you by Dage the Evil's magic.

name: Skullbound Chakrams (AC)
description: You gained the ability to move through the darkness as silently as a shadow when your soul was stripped from you, twisted, and bound back into you by Dage the Evil's magic.

name: Skullbound Kamas
description: You gained the ability to move through the darkness as silently as a shadow when your soul was stripped from you, twisted, and bound back into you by a mysterious Mystcroft necromancer.

name: Skullbound Kusarigama
description: You gained the ability to move through the darkness as silently as a shadow when your soul was stripped from you, twisted, and bound back into you by a mysterious Mystcroft necromancer.

name: Skullbreaker's Blade + Axe
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS.

name: Skullbreaker's Dagger
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS.

name: Skullcrusher's Skeleton Keys
description: Vordred can't be bothered to have a key for every hidden skull trove he has. Why treat them like hidden treasure when he hauls mountains of them back from every battle? Well…it just feels special this way.

name: Skullcrusher Totems
description: The fallen enemies of the BoneBreakers now adorn their weapons of war. These symbols of death loom over the Barbarians, and ignites their thirst for battle. They will be the dealers of death. Not its pitiful victims.

name: Skullface Mace
description: Now THAT's how you get ahead! Perfecting for cracking skulls WITH skulls. That are cracked. So be careful.

name: Skullpiercer Trident and Dagger
description: Like a vengeful god of the sees, Naval Commander Vordred wields his trident with great impunity. He'd rip skull after skull from their bodies, and have to wade through the water to retrieve his weapon whenever he threw it.

name: Sky Frost Daggers
description: Grab power by the hilt and show everyone who is boss. These ice blue daggers will not only look handsome with the Sky Frost armor, but will leave your enemies shaking as you cut them down.

name: Skye Assassin's Final Gifts
description: Daggers that are solid one moment, and phasing through your armor in the next. They strike at the heart, and makes it burst.

name: Skye's Wailing Greatswords
description: Jagged and cruel weapons made from the dead gods of Skye. Their flesh struggles to get free, forced to strike down the people who once looked to the Storms and Shadows for protection.

name: Skye Warrior Axes
description: The original modes for these mass-produced steel axes are made of pure gold, and said to be able to cleave storm clouds and reveal blue skies when in the hands of a true Hero and Champions. However, they lost their luster over time after being passed from a King to his descendants.

name: Skyguard Blade and Shield
description: An honorary sword and shield presented to the most elite members of King Alteon's Skyguard. It is a symbol of true greatness and nobility.

name: SkyGuard Choppers
description: You've heard the phrase, "chop and shop"? That's what these bronze daggers let you do: chop your enemies, then sell your loot in all the Skyguard shops!

name: SkyGuard Pistol
description: Shoot from both hips when you've got these pistols in your holsters! A SkyGuard isn't complete without weapons in hand!

name: Skyguard Quill and Scroll
description: Inspired by heroic exploits of Captain Meilyn Ranisson, the Skyguard Quill and Scroll is awarded to Academy graduates who return to their commanders with intelligence vital to skybattle victories!

name: Slayer Recruit's Dagger
description: Hate dragons? Did one burn down your house? Does the name Targaryen cause rage? Then you've joined the right squad!

name: Slime Dragon Rogue Lann
description: Thank goodness slime doesn't rust metal.

name: Slork's Daggers
description: Dwarf versions of the Micro-Giant, Slork's daggers.

name: Smaragdine Daggers
description: Daggers cut from a sharp, vibrant green gemstones. They're meant to be used in rituals and ceremonies. Anyone cut by this blade will never be able to break a promise or share your secrets.

name: Smol Dreambound Unicorn Toys
description: When the moon hangs in the sky, they protect your dreams from nightmares. Once the sun rises, they'll be the first to wish you a good morning.

name: Smol Ratnegade Katana
description: It's the Year of the Rat, and these renegade Samurai have made their allegiance known!

name: Snow Blossom Fans
description: "In early spring, when the flowers still slumber, the frosty moon finds the plum blossom standing alone. With grace and fortitude, she silent spreads hope." This allegorical story inspired the design of the fan.

name: Snowballs
description: It's kind of creepy, but using an animated snowman head as a weapon can give you those few seconds of bonus time when your opponents stop dead when your weapon looks at them.

name: Snowfall Daggers
description: If you've ever wanted your very own snowstorm, carry around these icy daggers!

name: Snowflake Sickles
description: Ironically meant to break the ice.

name: Snowheart Needles
description: These are larger forms of the original needles used to sew and stitch the FrostFire Lord's clothes. Ice and Fire magic need to be woven into their robes, or else they'll fall apart.

name: Snowshade Carrion Carvers (AC)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late.

name: Snowshade Carrion Carvers (Legend)
description: The Ravens communicate with an unspoken language. To the uninitiated, the sound of scraping metal on bone means that it's too late.

name: Snowshade Carrion Greatswords (0 AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Snowshade Carrion Greatswords (AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Snowshade Carrion Longswords (0 AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: Snowshade Carrion Longswords (AC)
description: The sword is knightly in appearance. Fitting as it was taken from honorable warriors who were forsaken in the snow. They rest as the Ravens relieve them of their duties.

name: SnowStalker's BoneSwords
description: If you go down the woods today, you're in for a big surprise. These hunters come out during the icy months to track prey that only comes out during winter.

name: Snowy Replicas of Destiny
description: These children's replicas are made of tightly packed snow and fallen sticks. Unlike the real Blinding Light of Destiny, they'll will melt under the warm sunlight.

name: Soben Bowl + Sticks
description: Good for eating or impromptu food fights!

name: Solar Dragon Rapiers (AC)
description: Golden rapiers graciously donated to the Skyguard by a curious Dragon, in exchange for quicky entry and a high rank. The new recruit was scolded, but allowed entry after accomplishing the same tests everyone else took.

name: Solar Dragon Rapiers (Legend)
description: Golden rapiers graciously donated to the Skyguard by a curious Dragon, in exchange for quicky entry and a high rank. The new recruit was scolded, but allowed entry after accomplishing the same tests everyone else took.

name: Solar-edge ArmBlades
description: Fierce, razor-edge and uniquely fitted for easy use, these armblades are sharpened by the daystar's rays, ensuring that it is at its best all the time.

name: Solar Pirate's Accoutrements
description: Sail to the ends of the universe. Stop at the restaurant or pillage it. You're a Solar pirate go where those winds take you.

name: Solar Star Daggers
description: Toss them quick and fast and from a distance, you're practically firing a laser from the palm of your hands.

name: Solar Stingers
description: A crescent dirk was placed in an eternal flame that remains lit to this day to test its longevity in extreme heat. Seven years has passed and the dirk was expected to be charred. Instead, the eternal flame granted it massive amounts of fire energy and has shaped it in its image. Because of its new form, the dirk was given to a high sage as a gift for his devotion to Pyritevale.

name: SolarFire Blades
description: The heart of fire gives these beings their power. Their everlasting heat will burn down their enemies.

name: Solarfire Daggers
description: The heart of fire gives these beings their power. Their everlasting heat will burn down their enemies.

name: Solaris Sunbeam Sabers
description: The Solaris Clan is accompanied by the rays of the sun no matter where they go.

name: Solo Ship Captain's Cutlasses
description: You are the master of your fate. You are the captain of your solo ship.

name: Solstice Blood Axes
description: In the far reaches of the universe, the Fiend's Void swallowed dying suns. Their energy still ripples through the Abyss, and Archfiends harnessed the lost rays to forge devastating weapons.

name: Solstice Pulse Blades (AC)
description: Its steel is warm to the touch, its magic growing stronger as the days grow longer. At the peak of the solstice, one could part the clouds with a single slash.

name: Solstice Pulse Blades (Legend)
description: Its steel is warm to the touch, its magic growing stronger as the days grow longer. At the peak of the solstice, one could part the clouds with a single slash.

name: SoLuna Beam Sabers
description: Sol and Luna are meant to be in harmony.

name: Somnian Scroll + Quill
description: Sometimes you just have to hit them over the head with learning (and then stab them with a quill).

name: Sonnets of Elegance
description: During Heroes Heart Day tourneys, courtiers wield these rapiers and act out scenes from legends of love. “I have not broken your heart - you have broken it; and in breaking it, you have broken mine.”

name: Sorrow and Tranquility
description: Yarrr! Your name - and your skill with a cutlass - will live on in infamy. FOREVER.

name: Soul Corroding Betrayal Blades
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to enfeeble the soul of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, the Archfiend was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Soul Devouring Katana and Sheathe (0 AC)
description: Lore has always been a world for the lawless. This blade - which once cut down men for its own entertainment and glory - now devours souls on behalf of the law of the Legion.

name: Soul Devouring Katana and Sheathe (AC)
description: Lore has always been a world for the lawless. This blade - which once cut down men for its own entertainment and glory - now devours souls on behalf of the law of the Legion.

name: Soul Devouring Katanas (AC)
description: Lore has always been a world for the lawless. This blade - which once cut down men for its own entertainment and glory - now devours souls on behalf of the law of the Legion.

name: Soul Devouring Katanas (Legend)
description: Lore has always been a world for the lawless. This blade - which once cut down men for its own entertainment and glory - now devours souls on behalf of the law of the Legion.

name: Soul Devouring Sickles (AC)
description: Sickles that sing as their wielder swing them through their enemies. To the Legion, the shrieks of stolen souls are a sweet song.

name: Soul Devouring Sickles (Legend)
description: Sickles that sing as their wielder swing them through their enemies. To the Legion, the shrieks of stolen souls are a sweet song.

name: Soul Fire Fists
description: Fire bursts from your fists, devastating your opponents as it burns away the nerves in your hands.

name: Soul Stealer Advanced
description: Designed by the famed armorer, Darkondrago, these daggers will delight you, but inspire dread even in the deadliest of foes!

name: Soul Weaver's Daggers (AC)
description: Souls wander throughout the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: Soul Weaver's Daggers (Non-AC)
description: Souls wander throughout the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: SoulDevourer Blades (0 AC)
description: You can hear a whisper coming from the sword: "Valoria… will… fall…"

name: SoulDevourer Blades (AC)
description: You can hear a whisper coming from the sword: "Valoria… will… fall…"

name: Soulfire Odachis
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: Soulfire Tonfas
description: Dage the Evil's SoulForge requires constant sacrifice and labor to keep its flames bright. The unworthy become fuel for the forge, while the fire of victory burns in the hearts of those called to serve the Legion.

name: SoulKnight's Render Blades (0 AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: SoulKnight's Render Blades (AC)
description: The glowing orbs encased in a SoulKnight's battlegear are made of pure, stolen spirit energy, and are only entrusted to Nulgath's most loyal and skilled followers.

name: SoulReaper's Katanas (AC)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: SoulReaper's Katanas (Legend)
description: Dage the Evil has allied with the SoulReapers, a faction of necromancers whose power comes from distilling the energy of stolen souls.

name: SoulStrippers
description: These skulls are actually hollow, meant to hold your soul once the undead strip it from your body.

name: SoulTakers Of Nulgath
description: *No description*

name: South Sea Queen's Tridents
description: These golden tridents have been wielded by the warriors of Wentira, the golden city, for centuries as they pay homage to Nyai Rara Kidul, the Queen of the Southern Sea. It is both an honor and a responsibility for chosen warriors. (Click gem to transform)

name: Sovereign's Anomalous Severances
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Sovereign's Merciless Blade & Shield
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Sovereign's Merciless Blades
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Sovereign Saint's Blade of Equilibrium
description: Once a guardian of Eden’s equilibrium, now a hollow vessel of ‘perfect order,’ the Crystallis Sovereign's purity has been corrupted by an… Anomaly. Their radiance remains, but its glare hides immaculate poise and a merciless heart. A fitting vessel to serve the Administration's highest purpose.

name: Space Ice Kris
description: Made of tempered space ice (how does THAT work?!) this blade will chill your foes to the bone!

name: Space-timeless Claws
description: Time is cyclical… who knows from where (or when?) the Chronocide got these weapons. Doesn't matter - it's yours now!

name: Space-timeless Daggers
description: Time is cyclical… who knows from where (or when?) the Chronocide got these weapons. Doesn't matter - it's yours now!

name: Sparkler Overload
description: Who says you can't play with fire? Because of magical enhancements, this sparkler will never go out!

name: Sparklestar Wand + Tome
description: Every pirate everywhere has a special magical connection with their crewmates… just make sure they never steal yer magical artifacts!

name: Spearmint Candy Canes
description: Make sure to lick between the lights, we don't want a nasty accident ruining our happy holidays.

name: Spears of Mutual Affection
description: Love and pain are one and the same! This weapon is going to rip you into pieces that'll be flushed down the drain.

name: Specter's Cursed Pistols
description: A curse laid by the previous owner grants terrible misfortune on those that dare steal from a pirate. Those that fall to it add their own curse. Just holding the pistols could invite the sea to swallow your ship.

name: Spectral Cutlasses
description: When a person dies and becomes a ghost, they become all spectral-like. Same with their clothes and weapons. If they drop their sword, does it just stay ghostly? Are these the souls of dead swords? How? Why?

name: Spectral Fiend Lanterns
description: Souls phase in and out of visibility. These lanterns, used by the Fiends who reside in the caverns of Tercessuinotlim, can spot Souls attempting to weasel out of their contract.

name: Spectral NovaBlades Alnitak
description: Mystic blades forged with the light of a pale supergiant, born from the merging of stars. Alnitak is an omen that always comes in threes. Should one overcome a triple challenge with its namesakes, they will be given cosmic sight.

name: Spectral StarEdges Saiph
description: Mystic blades forged with the light of a pale supergiant, born from the merging of stars. Saiph favors those who stare into the beyond, reaching into the dangers of the cosmos for the pure sake of knowing what's there.

name: Spectrum Daggers
description: The art of manipulating light into a solid form is a difficult one. But you can't argue with results.

name: Speirling Blades
description: Legends say that the Avatar Haeos sent a lightning bolt down to his First Champion. Gaheris caught it in his hand, and it became his sword. These blades are a copy of the fabled original.

name: Speirling Daggers
description: Instruments of interrogation as well as deadly weapons. The crackle of electricity is constant, and reminds the wielder of the consequences of failure.

name: Speirling Gaheris Blades
description: Legends say that the Avatar Haeos sent lightning bolts down to his First Champion. Gaheris caught them in his hands, and they became his swords.

name: Speirling Guardian Daggers
description: The original gilded daggers wielded by the First Champion of Energy's younger brother. Their gold can be traced back to Camlan, where Light and Lightning clashed for dominion over the continent that would one day become Greenguard.

name: Spellblade's Tool Set
description: For those who wield both magic and might, these two weapons are offered for those rare few who can master both the blade and the spell.

name: SpellCaster's Dark Accoutrements
description: Casters aide the Legion by summoning power and keeping the minions energized during battles.

name: SpellFrost Hammers
description: SpellFrost Mages are known for their mastery of Cryomancy. They are among the most skilled mages of the Northlands, and the sapphire gems they wear are made of crystallized skyfire.

name: SpellSmith Daggers
description: Plumes of magic encircle the blade of this sword. It was not until they discover their chosen SpellSmith that the magic solidifies in a most beautifully unique way, surrounding both your blade and your shield hand.

name: Spellsword Daggers (AC)
description: An elemental sword forged by a master!

name: Spellsword Daggers (Legend)
description: An elemental sword forged by a master!

name: SpellSword's Reversed Daggers
description: Spellswords draw magic from the ley lines and imbue their blades with it. ShadowFlame Spellswords mix their magic with Malgor's Darkness and are feared across Lore.

name: Spiderkin Star Daggers
description: This specially crafted Star Daggers were designed and built for AQW's 10th Upholders on the game's tenth birthday! Thanks for supporting the game!

name: Spinal Debris Swords
description: There were a number of extremities that had to be cut off of Creature 10. Re played around with the leftovers, and gave the Chimera what she called "utensils." She then set them loose, and told them to go make their own lunch.

name: Unidentified 28 (Spinal Tap)
description: Swindle says, that dagger is a "Spinal Tap". Nulgath likes these daggers.

name: Spinal Tap of Nulgath
description: Nulgath empowers your "Spinal Tap" dagger to change to any color you desire.

name: Spinal Tap of Retribution
description: Polish, imbues your "Spinal Tap" dagger with divine light.

name: Spinal Tap of the Wicked
description: Skew, curses your "Spinal Tap" dagger with destructive energy.

name: Spinel Slashers
description: At first glance, these bejeweled blades appear to be carved from rubies. However, given their sell-back value, it is apparent that these gems are actually spinel, the great ruby imposter!

name: Spiralling Keyblades (Dagger)
description: A rare key that was once thought to open crevices containing red power-boosting potions. The theory later proved to be false, but it still has means to leave an enemy wide open to severe damaging weaknesses.

name: Spirit Assassin Blades
description: An assassin is only as good as their ability to escape after a mission. The previous owner of these color-custom blades was not so lucky having become lost within Hollowsoul Castle…

name: Spirit Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Spirit!

name: Spirit Harvester's Daggers + Sword
description: It's the time of year when all things are harvested… including spirits!

name: Spirit Harvester's Triple Daggers
description: It's the time of year when all things are harvested… including spirits!

name: Spirit of Ice Daggers
description: The spirit of ice gives thes beings their power. Their evertasting chill will freeze their enemies to the core.

name: Spirit Oni Swords
description: This blade is drenched in blood, but Oni are innocent in the worst day. They can't comprehend right and wrong, only understanding what feels good to them. It's unfair, but allows them to reincarnate without issue.

name: Spirit Stakes
description: Shaman use dese to talk to da soul of da mountain.

name: SpiritHunter Blades
description: Cleave spirits who would harm you and defend the souls who only want to go home.

name: SpiritHunter Katanas
description: The pulsing red glow of this otherworldly katana will attract spirits whose natures push them towards revenge and anger.

name: SpiritHunter's Hammers
description: That bitter chill you feel is NOT coming from the frigid Northlands wind… it's the icy aura of the invisible spirits surrounding you. Watching… waiting… Will they strike first? Or will you?

name: Split Blades of the Deep
description: *No description*

name: Split Blades of the Void
description: The ShadowFlame army is deadly in ANY world… but especially inside the Void. You've earned the right to wield this weapon, but take care you do not succumb to their dark power.

name: Sporkion Spork
description: Eating soup and spaghetti at the same time will never be a problem again.

name: Spruce's Frigid Scorn
description: Druids live peacefully, and scorn those who cannot appreciate the beauty and simplicity of nature. When the Void invaded, Sister Spruce's scorn took on deadly edge.

name: Squish Game Battle Gear
description: You've already come too far to end this now. VICTORY WILL BE YOURS!

name: Squish Game Guns
description: You've already come too far to end this now. VICTORY WILL BE YOURS!

name: Stack OverflowError
description: Fatal error: Maximum pancake recursion depth exceeded. System breakfast halted.

name: Stained Glass Faerie's Claymores
description: Blue and purple, gold and green,

name: Stained Glass Faerie's Scythes
description: Blue and purple, gold and green,

name: Staked Steak
description: A vampire's two most greatest weaknesses: a wooden stake and a tender, juicy steak.

name: Stallion's Vitality Fans
description: A celebrated poet is the current Descendant of the Jade Stallion, and one of his poems is embroidered into the back. "A word to address all above the heavens, a glance to spare none beneath the clouds."

name: Stallion's Warmth Fans
description: A celebrated poet is the current Descendant of the Jade Stallion, and one of his poems is embroidered into the back. "A word to address all above the heavens, a glance to spare none beneath the clouds."

name: Unidentified 7 (Star Dagger)
description: Swindle says, that there is a "Star Dagger". Though plain it has quite an appealing design.

name: Star Dancer's Katanas
description: Katanas made from the green flickers of a distant kingly planet, used in sword dances and in combat to protect the wise words of an Emperor.

name: Star Lights of Destiny
description: The might of the heavens is in your hands. Your foes have nowhere to escape, for even the darkest nights are under the dominion of the stars. (Changes in Combat)

name: Star Lights of the Empyrean
description: The might of the heavens is in your hands. Your foes have nowhere to escape, for even the darkest nights are under the dominion of the stars. (Changes in Combat)

name: Star Pirate's Cutlass + Rapier
description: They're as sharp as a real pirate's tools of trade. Perhaps they're even sharper, meticulously crafted by smiths motivated by impressing an audience.

name: Star Storm Piercers
description: In the void sea, there's no air to breathe but great glittering star storms rage and prevent explorers from reaching their dreams. The Star Piercers were forged to tear through and make way for progress.

name: Star Swords of the Rogue
description: This specially-crafted Star Sword was designed for AdventureQuest Worlds's Upholders. It was inspired by Metrea. Thanks for supporting the game!

name: StarCrasher Lightblades
description: May the Fourth be with you!

name: Starfire and Darkfire
description: Those of you brave enough, and strong enough can wield the might of the Starfire and the Darkfire at the same time.

name: Starfish Plushies
description: Wish on a seastar, and look for your dreams in the shoals.

name: StarGazer's C-2000s
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: StarGazer's Dual Blades
description: May the 4th be with you!

name: Starlight Candles
description: Candles lit by a Djinn King's flame. Make a wish, blow it out, and pay your price.

name: Sun Kataras
description: Harness the power of a dying star in your hands!

name: Sunborn Guardian's Battlegear
description: Lore is a place where all elements mingle and are bound together as one beautiful creation. The Sunborn can not exist there for long, or their bodies will destroy the land. They leave behind their armaments for others to fight the darkness in their stead.

name: Sunfish Plushies
description: They float flat on the surface of the ocean, like pancakes that can blink.

name: Sunflower Claymores
description: Sunflowers are a symbol of loyalty and longevity, and their bright yellow color signals happiness, friendship, and intelligence. We hope you become rich in all of those attributes and qualities as you adventure through Lore!

name: Sunless Master Sabers
description: The Saber was torn from the core of a Sun, transforming it into a black hole as a Fifth Master trapped the light in dark steel with their own bare hands.

name: Sunless Master Twin Sabers
description: The Saber was torn from the core of a Sun, transforming it into a black hole as a Fifth Master trapped the light in dark steel with their own bare hands.

name: Sunlit Reavers Kama
description: These are the scythes that were found on Fotia! But what are they doing here? And why are they so much lighter?

name: SUPER Dandelion Kiwi Cookies
description: Mmmm, DOUBLE giant dandelion-shaped cookies filled with a light, sweet kiwi creme! Now THIS is what I call a SUPER sweet reward!

name: Supercharged CyberVoid Dagger +5
description: Made entirely of digital code, these minions have escaped from the cyberworld to do the bidding of their cyberfiend master.

name: Supercharged Lightning Katana
description: Do you feel the power flowing through this cursed blade?

name: Supercharged TideStriker Whips
description: Conductive belts that generate their own electricity. They're extremely effective in aquatic combat, but have the tendency to electrocute everything within range, including the wielder.

name: Supernova Octarine Orb (AC)

name: Swashbuckler's Rapiers
description: Pirates come from all walks of life, even from the snooty tooty ranks of royal nobles. When dueling to the death wasn't enough, they took their rapiers to sea.

name: Sweaty Sock Daggers
description: Stabbing people with lost sweaty, socks? Weird. Really weird.

name: Sweet Harvest Combo Snack
description: Delicious, not nutritious, but exactly the reward a hero wants after a long hard Harvest battle!

name: Sweet Sakura Perfume Bottles
description: A little dab here and there creates a sweet yet subtle scent of a nostalgic spring. The scent can even bring tears to one's eyes if you crack the whole thing all at once on someone's head.

name: Sweet Spring Mage's Swords
description: Your magic is fueled by the scent of spring flowers, gentle rains, and the strains of sweet songs drifting through sunlit groves.

name: Sweet Star Sword Breakers (AC)
description: This weapon was crafted by a strange race of beings. It was designed to be the only weapon capable of fighting a Starsword, but was lost before it could be put into production.

name: Sweet Star Sword Breakers (Legend)
description: This weapon was crafted by a strange race of beings. It was designed to be the only weapon capable of fighting a Starsword, but was lost before it could be put into production.

name: Sweetened Chronomenace Blades
description: Rots your teeth at double time.

name: Sword and Shield of the Sky
description: A Centurion of the Sky must be quick, light on his or her feet and ready at a moment's notice to go into battle. This sword and shield combination protects, defends and deals a lethal blow. Keep it close, keep others safe.

name: Sword of Might
description: The Holy Sword and Shield combination of the Paladins of Lightguard Keep. Use it wisely in the name of the Light.

name: Sword of Sponsors
description: Your eye for design and product placement is on par with your blade skills.

name: Swordhaven Cleric Hammers
description: ﻿A hammer that is both used as a weapon of self defence, and a catalyst to cast healing spells. Not all clerics are attuned to light magic, but Swordhaven prefers an element that they're well acquainted with. (CC to Base, Accessory)

name: Swordhaven Emissary Bow and Arrow
description: It’s preferred that the Swordhaven Emissary not appear armed. Bow and arrows, however, are a necessity. Bandits are a universal problem, as are assassins tasked with ruining diplomatic efforts.

name: Swordhaven Prestige Blades
description: Ceremonial swords wielded by nobles capable of combat and offensive light magic this sword glows from their attunment to Light, magnifying the grace and purity that has become one with the element's image.

name: Swordhaven Scout's Daggers
description: Spies and Spy Masters are a thing of the tyrannical past. But if there was, hypothetically, a Swordhaven Spymaster that exists presently…They would have started as a Scout, with a dagger just like this.

name: Swords of Abyssal Order
description: A symbol of prestige and absolute power in the Nation. Nulgath forged it in fire, and cooled it in his blood. Wielding the blade allows a Fiend to control others of their kind.

name: Swords of Hatoth
description: The spirit of Hatoth imbues these swords with extra power.

name: Swords of Isthmia (AC)
description: Blades that hail from a sea sanctuary of pearls and plenty. The harsh predation of the ocean doesn't exist in this paradise…so why do its merpeople still need swords made of leviathan bones and fins?

name: Swords of Isthmia (Legend)
description: Blades that hail from a sea sanctuary of pearls and plenty. The harsh predation of the ocean doesn't exist in this paradise…so why do its merpeople still need swords made of leviathan bones and fins?

name: Swords of Misfortune
description: Everyone knows its bad luck to break a mirror… so to use a broken mirror blade in battle, that takes a level of confidence that only the greatest heroes possess!

name: Swords of Serepthys
description: The spirit of Serepthys imbues these swords with extra power.

name: Swords of Shattered Reflections
description: The sword's blade isn't blood red… that's the reflection of the Ring of Fire solar eclipse gleaming malevolently back at you.

name: Swords of the Depths
description: From out of the depths, a terror rises: ghostly hands grasp these blades aimed directly at your heart. Do not fear… they are a gift from Neso, the Water Avatar, to aid you in battle.

name: Swords of the Oracle
description: The ability to see fate before it culminates is balanced out by the deaf ears of those who need to hear the truth the most. Protect yourself. The truth always hurts.

name: Swords of The Underworld
description: This sword was first forged when Dage the Evil first declared that the Underworld would be his. Rise, reclaim, and reign. His words imbue the blade with a deep possessive magic.

name: Symphonic Duet Daggers
description: The art of music has married martial arts. A choreographed routine is needed to beat some class into your opponent, but creative improvisions are always welcome.

name: Symphonic Espressivos
description: The harp and its light draw out the music of your very soul. To wield it, one must dance and express the will of their life. As a consequence, many have died young with this in hand, yet they shone brighter than the stars.

name: Symphonic Sforzando
description: May the golden strings of these harps carry your people to revolution. Such was the intent behind these harps, created by musicians and mages dreaming of glorious golden days.

name: Symphony Of Sorrows
description: You rule all who enter your domain; their blood, breath, and bones all belong to YOU. And should any choose to challenge you… well, you can always use a new ghoul or two to serve you.

name: Tactical Alpha Blasters

name: Tainted Daggers of Na'al

description: Where the hammer strikes, lightning will too, claiming whatever it touches for its domain. The hammer was carved from a body of rock, and the ice holds its might back.

name: Taro's Dual Pretty Manslayers
description: Nulgath may have taught you how to dual wield Taro's Manslayer, but Beleen got ahold of it and turned it Pink!

name: Taro's Dual Prismatic Manslayers
description: Taro had fought over a 1000 battles in his lifetime. ( You can probably relate.) His spirit, experience and discipline are captured in this sword. Use it well… (Blade is CC. Weapon does 30% more damage to all monsters.)

name: Teapot and Cup
description: It's amazing what you can find in a pile of junk. You know what they say - one person's junk is another person's treasure!

name: Tech Daggers Of Awe

name: Techno Chaos Champion Swords (0 AC)

name: Techtronic Doom Daggers

name: Temporal Disruption
description: A weapon from the future and a shield from the past? Someone has been playing with the Vigilette again, haven't they?

name: The Blades of Cataclysm

name: The Epic Blades
description: There aren't any chains linked to these awesome blades.

name: The First Fallen's Daggers
description: Once mystical Celestial beings created by Arthelyn, the First Fallen left in search of more power.

name: The First Something and Nothing

name: The Hostile Takeover (Dagger)

name: The Piercer Accoutrements

name: The Rogue's Ulterior
description: Not all aliens flaunt their arrival to the masses; some are quite illusive, approaching their victims only when they least expect it.

name: The Syringe Cringe

name: The Zombie Arms of Metal

name: The Zombie Arms of Peace
description: You may say I'm a slayer, but I'm not the only one. I hope some day you'll fall to us. And the world will be saved.

name: Thirteen Bladed Daggers

name: Underworld FlameMaster's Gauntlets (Special)
description: Legend says that a sect of FlameMasters were caught in the underworld during a period of upheaval. With the lack of fire, they pulled the power of the Underworld itself into their bodies. And thus, the Underworld FlameMasters were born.

name: Underworld Fury Blaze Blades (Legend)
description: The enraged souls of your enemies are trapped in these weapons, setting their blades ablaze. If you are ever felled, your soul will join them, and the swords will have a new master.

name: Underworld Fury Blaze Blades (Non-Legend)
description: The enraged souls of your enemies are trapped in these weapons, setting their blades ablaze. If you are ever felled, your soul will join them, and the swords will have a new master.

name: Underworld Gladiator's Blades
description: This gladiator's will was SO strong, they did not even realize when they fell in battle and crossed over into death. Now, they stalk the Underworld looking for new opponents to prove their skill in combat.

name: Underworld Infiltrator Blades
description: Weapons created from the steel from the reaper's blade. It's gutsy to steal from Death, and even gutsier to taunt Death by taking lives with these yourself.

name: Underworld Infiltrator Great Shurikens
description: Weapons created from the steel from the reaper's blade. It's gutsy to steal from Death, and even gutsier to taunt Death by taking lives with these yourself.

name: Underworld Knight's Battle Gear (0 AC)
description: Underworld Knights are among the most feared warriors in all seven circles of heck. Cross them at your peril.

name: Underworld Knight's Battle Gear (AC)
description: Underworld Knights are among the most feared warriors in all seven circles of heck. Cross them at your peril.

name: Underworld Magia Guns
description: ﻿The Underworld Magia are all undead but retain their preserved mortal forms. Their souls were torn from their bodies and forged into a matching weapon to channel their powerful magic.

name: Underworld Mecha Ghoul's Rifles
description: Former members of the Futuristic Legion Optimization team, Underworld Mecha Ghouls deployed by Dage the Evil to assault Nulgath's forces.

name: Underworld Nemesis Claws
description: The Underworld Nemesis is one denizen of the darkness you do NOT want to meet without a battle companion by your side and a blessed blade in your hand.

name: Underworld Nemesis Kamas
description: The Underworld Nemesis is one denizen of the darkness you do NOT want to meet without a battle companion by your side and a blessed blade in your hand.

name: Underworld Oni's Blades
description: The Underworld Oni emerges from its dark realm to hunt down and punish the wicked.

name: Underworld Oni's Burning Blades
description: The Underworld Oni emerges from its dark realm to hunt down and punish the wicked.

name: Underworld Parabellum Armaments
description: In the present, the Legion's hammers and crushes brought cities to ruin. In the future, those hammers were modified to break down the hulls of giant ships and dreadnaughts.

name: Underworld Parabellum Blades
description: Underworld terror in a simple and familiar form. Cold blades that is always ready to drink in the spoils and gore of war.

name: Underworld Piercers
description: FOR THE LEGION!

name: Underworld Prophet's Taker (0 AC)
description: Some heroes are able to receive visions from the Elemental Lords even after death. Heed their warnings.

name: Underworld Prophet's Taker (AC)
description: Some heroes are able to receive visions from the Elemental Lords even after death. Heed their warnings.

name: Underworld Razor Blades
description: Denizens of the Underworld must always be ready for an attack by those who would take their power.

name: Underworld Scourge's Armblades
description: Fighting your way through the arena proves you are truly a scourge of the Underworld. Dage will be so proud!

name: Underworld Sigil Swords (0 AC)
description: Blades that pulses with the mana of the dead. One could use them to lead souls to the surface of Lore undetected. The Legion has been ordered to destroy these weapon on-sight.

name: Underworld Sigil Swords (AC)
description: Blades that pulses with the mana of the dead. One could use them to lead souls to the surface of Lore undetected. The Legion has been ordered to destroy these weapon on-sight.

name: Underworld Soul Weaver's Armblades (0 AC)
description: Souls wander throughout the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: Underworld Soul Weaver's Armblades (AC)
description: Souls wander throughout the Underworld. Only the most skilled can channel the power that remains, using them for arcane spells and magic.

name: Underworld Spirit Kris
description: The spirits of fallen rogues were bound into these blades. Now their strength is yours!

name: Underworld Stealth Ops Rifles (0 AC)
description: These rifles were created in the image of a phantom. Unseen and unheard, they take life and leave no wounds, or any hint that they were even there.

name: Underworld Stealth Ops Rifles (AC)
description: These rifles were created in the image of a phantom. Unseen and unheard, they take life and leave no wounds, or any hint that they were even there.

name: Underworld Viking's Spirit Horns
description: This horn was crafted specially for the Dark War. A blast on it could be heard from miles away, and struck fear into the shriveled hearts of all who heard it.

name: Underworld Void Vigilante BattleGear
description: This armor was crafted from a fusion of Void energy from the AdventureQuest timeline and combined with magic Dage imbues into the gear he crafts for the Undead Legion. The dark horror will terrify your opponents, filling with with an otherworldly dread.

name: Underworld Wrangler's Rifles
description: If it ain't broke, don't fix it. If a blast from a rifle sent those beasts to their graves the first time, it'll put the undead back in their place again.

name: Underworld Wrathfire Katanas (0 AC)
description: A famed swordsmith forged blades to allow warriors to erradicate the deathless. When the katanas fell into the Underworld, the Lord of the Legion built on top of its design. They became swords embodying the inescapable end.

name: Underworld Wrathfire Katanas (AC)
description: A famed swordsmith forged blades to allow warriors to erradicate the deathless. When the katanas fell into the Underworld, the Lord of the Legion built on top of its design. They became swords embodying the inescapable end.

name: Undying Covenants of Bone
description: Ever loyal to Master Nulgath, the Nation's greatest loyalists serve the Archfiend even in death. Their souls cling to their bones, waiting for another chance to prove themselves.

name: Undying Love Chalices
description: If you trust me, you'd take a sip without thinking twice.

name: Undying Loyalty Blades
description: Do you vow to never be too far away? To never back down your sword to protect our home? (Click gem to transform)

name: Undying Sickles
description: Toothed sickle that rake the souls out of stubborn bones. Their master is undying, but their Lich rivals are not.

name: Unending Light Arrows
description: Arrows that can cut open the night sky. If shot by the Light's chosen heroes, it will call down the might of the Titan of Light.

name: Unending Light Bow and Arrow
description: A great bow of Light found deep within the tomb of a Sandsea Pharaoh. It was left behind, its purpose forgotten. It may never call on the Titan of Light again.

name: Ungodly Reavers of Nulgath
description: All will tremble before you when you wield this.

name: Ungourdly Rage Blades
description: In the Terror Dimension, a mysterious warrior roams the lands of the Harvest, striking fear into all who cross his path. Channel his un-gourdly wrath with this greatsword depicting his intimidating visage, illuminated by blood-red lightning.

name: Ungourdly Wrath Blades
description: In the Terror Dimension, a mysterious warrior roams the lands of the Harvest, striking fear into all who cross his path. Channel his un-gourdly wrath with this greatsword depicting his intimidating visage, illuminated by blood-red lightning.

name: Unholy Fang Blades of Nulgath
description: You are compelled to feed the fiend's spirit inhabiting this blade. Slay to slowly, and it may turn to feed on YOU! (This item is color customizable)

name: Unholy Reaper of Nulgath
description: The you've obtained the final form of this mysterious weapon. The weapon sprouts sinister tentacles, they whip around violently before resting in place.

name: Universeas Staff and Tome
description: A staff created from tireless studies into the nature of the cosmos and where they flowed from. The entire time, the scholars needed only look inward where their mana flowed.

name: Unlucky 13th Chainsaws
description: Chainsaws unlucky enough to find itself being used to blend moglinberry smoothies at the inn.

name: Unsheathed Kagutsuchi Inori
description: The flames can only be lit with blood. A swordsmith modeled this masterpiece after a child of flame. Their birth and immediate death created eight volcanos.

name: Unstable Betrayal Blades
description: A unique Nation weapon that cycles through the forms of different blades. All of them were meant to pierce the Archfiend at the same time. (Randomizes Art on Equip)

name: Unstable Dark Sprites Daggers
description: Command your imps, your sprites, your night terrors. No one can control the monsters that hide in the darkness except

name: Usagi Oni Battle Fans
description: Some of Yue's customers are Oni who belong to Torakuma-Doji's clan. She designed battle fans to fit how their bloodthirsty nature and fondness for the adorable exists in harmony. Of course, she's terrified whenever they visit.

description: A robust Ceremonial Dagger used by Vampires during not only sacred rituals but battles against the Lycan pack as well.

name: Vampiric Hollowborn Sabers
description: The enemies of Darkovia are faced with a new threat; you.

name: Vampiric Knight's Accoutrements
description: More heavily armored than their un-Knighted breathen, BloodVoid Knights are used to hunt Nulgath the ArchFiend's unluckiest prey. They hide in the shadows, attacking his victims when they least expect it.

name: Vampiric Knight SUPER Swords
description: Claiming dominance is what average vampires consider to be a high honor anc the wielder of this elegant but batty sword that sent victims packing for centuries is rarely denied such a right.

name: Vampiric Noble's Scythes
description: You rule all who enter your domain; their blood, breath, and bones all belong to YOU. And should any choose to challenge you… well, you can always use a new ghoul or two to serve you.

name: Vanta Daggers
description: These lone blademaster's hide within the shadows, carefully avoiding enemies until their foes least expect it.
