name: Venatrix Stilettos
description: Metallic spikes inspired by deadly insect stingers. They were gifts made by a Necromancer to be given to an Arachnomancer friend. They taught each other new and novel ways to rain terror on the unsuspecting world.

name: Venatrix Thorns
description: Sharp spikes woven from tightly bound spider's silk. They're soaked in venom that causes flesh to rot and melt. The effect can backfire on the wielder if they aren't Undead themselves.

name: Vendetta Daggers
description: If you don't want to use your fangs, a sharp dagger will do in a pinch.

name: Vengeful DragonKnight Swords
description: Ancestral blades, said to be stained by the blood of a Dragonlord's partner when the beast died protecting them. The Astravian nobility insist that they are only tales of fantasy. Dragons have never called Astravia home.

name: Vengeful Ivory Soul Sickles
description: Sickles used by the Penitent Keepers to tear the souls out of their quarry's bodies. Once their eyes laid on the secrets of the dead, they lost the right to leave.

name: Vengeful Soul Sickles
description: Sickles used by the Penitent Keepers to tear the souls out of their quarry's bodies. Once their eyes laid on the secrets of the dead, they lost the right to leave.

name: Venom Liquidator Firearms (AC)
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿The bubbling sludge fizzes dangerously inside these guns. Anything it shoots will go from solid to liquid in a blink.

name: Venom Liquidator Firearms (Legend)
description: ﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿﻿The bubbling sludge fizzes dangerously inside these guns. Anything it shoots will go from solid to liquid in a blink.

name: Verdant Venom Knives
description: They're called a venomous knives, but the snake wrapped around the blade is actually electrified to stun your opponents. It just seems like the effects of venom.

name: Verdant Viper Launchers
description: Sure, they blast your enemies away. Sure, they're functional even when it's submerged in water. More importantly, the snake is named Nikita.

name: Vert Vitriol Daggers
description: Crystal daggers with acidic properties, rumored to have been forged from the wrath of the mountains. You aren’t sure if they’re actually made of ferrous sulfate, but the color matches well enough.

name: Vestal Gold Axes
description: Axes that fell spirals of centuries, able to easily cleave the trees of Doomwood before darkness fell. Now, they cut steel and bone. The Undead and the Paladins who fight them are their master's enemies.

name: Vestal Gold Blades
description: Blades of thorns, gilded in gold from a bygone era. They came to Doomwood before darkness fell, and tried to plant their blood in pure soil.

name: Victor's Dual Glory Blades
description: To the victor goes the spoils… and to the victor with Dual Glory Blades goes double the rewards!

name: Vile Blades
description: The Red and Depraved's main tool for causing mayhem and anarchy!

name: Vindicated Dawn Blades
description: What transpired in the Dawn Sanctum left a lasting impression on the Hollowborn. Even their blades began to glow with the light of the Midnight Sun.

name: Vindicator Assassin Daggers
description: The Assassin's tools of trade are opulently forged with gold, partly to hide Gramiel's distaste for his cloak and dagger followers. He believes their trade to be shameful, but necessary for his goals.

name: Vindicator Naval's Claymore (Dagger) (AC)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed against you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRS!

name: Vindicator Naval's Claymore (Dagger) (Legend)
description: Through arduous battling and a perilous journey, you defeated all who sailed against you. Your crew and fleet have been vindicated and revenge is YARRRRS!

name: Vindicator Titan's Axes
description: If you don't fight, you can't win. Vindication will be yours! BATTLE ON!

name: Vinyl Records
description: These records are etched with the contents of the soul. They'll speak to anyone who'll listen, and cut anyone who doesn't.

name: Violent Violet Gavels
description: ﻿It's not a weapon. It's a tool of justice! So confiscating it is against the law.

name: Violent Violet Hammers
description: ﻿﻿﻿It's not a weapon. It's a tool of justice! So confiscating it is against the law.

name: Violet Brand Pop
description: The ice pop carries as much clout as the bag.

name: Violet Detention Gear
description: You're packing silly purple contraband. It's against the rules but violet, not violent.

name: Violet Mayhem Mall Gear
description: Stay hydrated as you fight your way through a sale stampede.

name: Violet Shades Daggers
description: Have you seen the spikes on this thing? Mother nature doesn't fool around.

name: Viper Sickles
description: Daggers crafted from crystalized serpent venom, they still contain their poisonous qualities without needing to be coated after each use.

name: Viper Venom Knives
description: They're called a venomous knives, but the snake wrapped around the blade is actually electrified to stun your opponents. It just seems like the effects of venom.

name: Virgo Changeling's Maces
description: A sapling nurtured by a Virgo Changeling continues to grow despite being ripped from the ground. They're often used to beat out the imperfections Changelings see in the nature around them.

name: Visionary Betrayal Blades
description: A blade of unknown origin, meant to harvest the eyes of the Archfiend. Upon its discovery, Nulgath was amused. He perfected it, and awarded it to his loyalists.

name: Vivid Rosales Blades
description: Thorny roses, plucked from the grave of a lover, grow into the shape of a deadly blade. In the chaos of battle, dye their undyng passion red.

name: Vodarage Accoutrements
description: Making your enemies scream for KELP one slash at a time!

name: Void Advocatus Blades
description: Even having tiny fragments of a Fiend Shard hammered into a blade can elevate a member of the Nation's might. They come harrowingly close to the Archfiend's level.

name: Void Awakening Accoutrements (AC)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Void Awakening Accoutrements (Special)
description: The final stage of the Void. Stronger, more powerful, these fiends of the nation have final awoken their true form.

name: Void Beetle General Armaments
description: Forged from the exoskeleton of the Void Beetle. The process of removing and growing back said exoskeleton is painful but rewarding.

name: Void Beetle General Machetes
description: The blades of the Void Beetle move fast. Before the enemy knows it, they have already been diced and devoured.

name: Void Beetle Warlord Armaments
description: Forged from the exoskeleton of the Void Beetle. The process of removing and growing back said exoskeleton is painful but rewarding.

name: Void Beetle Warlord Armblades
description: The blades of the Void Beetle move fast. Before the enemy knows it, they have already been diced and devoured.

name: Void Beetle Warlord Blades
description: The blades of the Void Beetle move fast. Before the enemy knows it, they have already been diced and devoured.

name: Void Betrayer Daggers
description: Nameless traitors mean little to Nulgath. Only lost potential incites his rage. It's his loyalists that relentlessly hunt for the skins of the betrayers, seeking to carve them with their stolen knives.

name: Void Betrayer Reavers
description: Even if they're nameless, members of the Empire and Legion keep their distance from Nation Traitors. They're ready to face a fate worse than death, and have the ferocity to do so.

name: Void Betrayer Swords
description: The blade of a nameless betrayer. Every time a Nation Minion turns traitor, a voice cackles. It doesn't belong to Nulgath. These slights are merely needles stabbed into his back.

name: Void Champion Daggers
description: Flickering with Void magic, this sword hold power beyond compare.

name: Void Commander Scythes (0 AC)
description: A tool chiefly used to cull the weak from the Nation. The Archfiend expects his commanders to do their due diligence.

name: Void Commander Scythes (AC)
description: A tool chiefly used to cull the weak from the Nation. The Archfiend expects his commanders to do their due diligence.

name: Void Commander Swords (0 AC)
description: The blade has a mind of it's own, and will devour those unworthy to wield it. Such is the way of the Nation - to eat the weak.

name: Void Commander Swords (AC)
description: The blade has a mind of it's own, and will devour those unworthy to wield it. Such is the way of the Nation - to eat the weak.

name: Void Decimation Blades (0 AC)
description: When a Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, proving themselves unworthy, their successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Void Decimation Blades (AC)
description: When a Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, proving themselves unworthy, their successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Void Dragonfang Blades
description: A brutal sword that was forged from the tainted amethysts by one of the lead cultists devoted to Tyrath. Although pure darkness can be used by either good or evil, the cultist desired to cleave the light in two, transforming this sword into a dangerous thorn to his targets.

name: Void Dusk Glaives (0 AC)
description: Created from the remains of those deemed unspeakable on the ranks of the Nation. Their dead gaze reminds the Fiends how easy it is to fall to their own ambition.

name: Void Dusk Glaives (AC)
description: Created from the remains of those deemed unspeakable in the ranks of the Nation. Their dead gaze reminds the Fiends how easy it is to fall to their own ambition.

name: Void Dusk Glaives (Legend)
description: Created from the remains of those deemed unspeakable on the ranks of the Nation. Their dead gaze reminds the Fiends how easy it is to fall to their own ambition.

name: Void GateKeeper's Armblades (0 AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void GateKeeper's Armblades (AC)
description: Only Nulgath's most trusted acolytes are allowed to become Gatekeepers of the Void into the Realm of the OverSoul. Do not betray his trust… or he WILL be displeased.

name: Void Guardian's Claws
description: Giant claws composed of void magic straight to the realm it came from, a hit from these claws will chill your opponents to the core.

name: Void Horror Hands
description: They might be 'horrible' but they're nice and sharp!

name: Void Paladin Katanas
description: The bursts of electricity that spiral down the blade will deliver a "shocking" blow to the foolish who dare challenge you.

name: Void Pirate's Dagger
description: Whether they said the Black Seas or the rivers of dark blood flowing through the underworld, the Void Pirates are feared by all.

name: Void Rebirth Blade (Dagger)
description: Witness the rebirth of the Void!

name: Void Recruit's Sword + Shield
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend calls only the strongest to serve him. To become a recruit, one must be among Lore's greatest, most evil heroes.

name: Void Recruit's Swords
description: Nulgath the ArchFiend calls only the strongest to serve him. To become a recruit, one must be among Lore's greatest, most evil heroes.

name: Void's Arsenal Ripper Blades
description: The weapons of a Voidseeker's arsenal can only be wielded by Fiends. If a mortal touches them, their skin will scream and peel back. They could claim more heads by just leaving these blades out in the open.

name: Void's Bile Swords
description: When an unworthy Fiendish Abomination collapses in on itself, its successors take ownership of the remains. Mutated veins and bronchi are forged into twisted weapons.

name: Void Slicer Daggers
description: Even when enveloped by the Void's corruption, the dagger's emotionless still radiates a beauty long-thought to be lost.

name: Void Snake Daggers
description: I will hunt thee down through time and space! You can not run and you can not hide from me!

name: Void Spartan Blade and Shield
description: Long ago, there was an ancient civilization with fearsome warriors. A single warrior from their army could wipe out a group of elite assassins alone. Now twisted from their original purpose, they serve Nulgath with a fervor rarely seen in Lore.

name: Void Spartan Daggers
description: Long ago, there was an ancient civilization with fearsome warriors. A single warrior from their army could wipe out a group of elite assassins alone. Now twisted from their original purpose, they serve Nulgath with a fervor rarely seen in Lore.

name: Void Spartan Spear and Shield
description: Long ago, there was an ancient civilization with fearsome warriors. A single warrior from their army could wipe out a group of elite assassins alone. Now twisted from their original purpose, they serve Nulgath with a fervor rarely seen in Lore.

name: Void Vigilante Blades
description: This armor was crafted from a fusion of Void energy from the AdventureQuest timeline and combined with magic Dage imbues into the gear he crafts for the Undead Legion. The dark horror will terrify your opponents, filling with with an otherworldly dread.

name: Void Warmonger Armaments
description: Fiendish blades with a hunger for war as deep as the Fiend God's Void. Only a Nation fanatic could have created such savage masterpieces, born from blood, fangs, and talons.

name: Voidborn Warlock Chakrams (Dagger)
description: Voidborn Warlocks draw their power from the dark energies that saturate the place between worlds and times. They can traverse universes in the blink of an eye.

name: Voidfangs of Nulgath
description: The sister of the Bane of Nulgath. These are said to be crafted from the fangs of an ancient beast.

name: VoidFiend Outlaw Revolvers
description: If Nulgath the ArchFiend weren't such a viscious villain, you might just betray him… but you know what fate awaits the foolish rogues that cross him.

name: Voidfiend Symbiote Battleaxes (0 AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: Voidfiend Symbiote Battleaxes (AC)
description: The swirling red-orange pattern that pulses through the thin, dark skin of the Voidfiend Symbiote is a sign that the symbiosis with Nulgath's dark energy is complete.

name: Voidfire Blades (AC)
description: A piece of molten earth ripped from the Voidfire themselves, forged into a fiery weapon by their master.

name: Voidfire Blades (Legend)
description: A piece of molten earth ripped from the Voidfire themselves, forged into a fiery weapon by their master.

name: VoidPirate Captain Armaments
description: A weapon in each hand is the true pirate spirit.

name: Voidsplinter Shards
description: Bearing crystallized bits of the void itself (the same material the Heart of the Void is made of), this weapon courses with dark energy!

name: Volleyball Hero's WaterGuns
description: Life's a beach, no matter which position you play on your team! Bump… Set… SPIKE!

name: Vordred's Knight Blade + Axe
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS. (CC to Base and Accessory)

name: Vordred's Knight Dagger
description: YOU ARE A SKULLBREAKER KNIGHT, TRAINED BY PALADINSLAYER VORDRED. IT TOOK MUCH SKILL AND MANY BROKEN SKULLS TO GAIN HIS APPROVAL. NOW GO BREAK MORE. MORE SKULLS. (CC to Base and Accessory)

name: Wanderer's Void Katana Sheath
description: The ronin which wander through tercessuinotlim were cast out by their former masters. They have not sworn allegiance to Nulgath, but choose to slay the creatures who oppose him. Their creed is: "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."

name: Wanderer's Void Katanas
description: The ronin which wander through tercessuinotlim were cast out by their former masters. They have not sworn allegiance to Nulgath, but choose to slay the creatures who oppose him. Their creed is: "The enemy of my enemy is my friend."

name: War Blades of Courage
description: The battlefield is where your courage is put to the test. Everyone dreams of making history but few are willing to die for it. The light of their courage will shine through this blade, tempered and sharpened by hardship.

name: War Blades of Speed
description: Dreams and ideals will disappear into thin air if nothing is done about them. The Blades of Speed are bestowed upon those who understand the urgency of taking action.

name: War Cultist Claws (AC)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: War Cultist Claws (Special)
description: They say war does strange things to you. Turning you into a half human half bio creature is one of them.

name: War's Glory Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Even on the open seas, the fires of war burn. They smoulder, and die. The Horseman of War takes the banners of the fallen, and flies them on his own blades to honor the glory of battle.

name: War's Glory Cutlasses (AC)
description: Even on the open seas, the fires of war burn. They smoulder, and die. The Horseman of War takes the banners of the fallen, and flies them on his own blades to honor the glory of battle.

name: War's Ironblood Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Intrigued by how the warriors of land and ocean differ in their weapons of choice, the Horseman of War had special blades forged for himself. These cutlasses are part of the set he takes into battles at sea.

name: War's Ironblood Cutlasses (AC)
description: Intrigued by how the warriors of land and ocean differ in their weapons of choice, the Horseman of War had special blades forged for himself. These cutlasses are part of the set he takes into battles at sea.

name: War's Ironblood Pistols
description: The Horseman of War has the quickest trigger finger out of all of us riders. He shoots so fast that he doesn't realize his gun ran out of bullets until one of us walks right in front of him.

name: WarForge Blades and Axe (0 AC)
description: Weapons wielded by the Warforge Tanks of the Legion which double as tools to tug out the blades being tempered inside their bodies. The tips are made of Cocytus Ice that cools molten metal instantly.

name: WarForge Blades and Axe (AC)
description: Weapons wielded by the Warforge Tanks of the Legion which double as tools to tug out the blades being tempered inside their bodies. The tips are made of Cocytus Ice that cools molten metal instantly.

name: WarForge Tank Axe and Shield (0 AC)
description: When they join the Legion's march, the Warforge Tanks are frequently targetted for the weapons being tempered in their bodies. Thieves beware. Their axes will find your necks.

name: WarForge Tank Axe and Shield (AC)
description: When they join the Legion's march, the Warforge Tanks are frequently targetted for the weapons being tempered in their bodies. Thieves beware. Their axes will find your necks.

name: Warforged Endbringers
description: War has no mercy. Fire burns flesh, and the masses will dream of blades until knives sprout from their skulls. In another time and space, the gods allowed this. They watched War leave Death's palm.

name: Warforged Retribution Shield
description: The final adversary. Father of bloodshed. Mother of scars. A sacrifice of life. The one who sought retribution is not unlike the focal point of time, walking among men. May your War be the final calamity, and the push Lore needs to seek salvation.

name: Warlord of Nulgath Blades
description: Fiendish blades with a hunger for war as deep as the Fiend God's Void. Only a Nation fanatic could have created such savage masterpieces, born from blood, fangs, and talons.

name: Warok's Binding Cords
description: Tradition turned weapon: each is a single braided cord used to ensnare both foes and fates.

name: Warp Necromancer Blade
description: You have become a Warp Necromancer! When the call to battle against the Desterrat Moya rings out, rise up and reach out to destroy your greatest enemy… in ANY dimension!

name: Warrior of Kyanos Daggers
description: The Warriors of Kyanos have very special gear to help handle the cold as they battle through the icy lands of Glacera.

name: Warrior of Time's Blades
description: Said to be forged from the tempered scales of the Eternal Sovereign. Frankly, it hurt to pick off scales, but it was interesting to see how enchanted fire cooled their green into a shade of sharp, cold blue.

name: WASDaggers
description: Up down left right W A S D! Epic joystick daggers Unlocked!

name: Water Dagger (1)
description: This sharp dagger is made from the condensed spirits of water!

name: Water Dagger (2)
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Water!

name: Water Dragon's Fang Reavers
description: Deep below the waves lives a nation of sea dragons. Masters of aquatic elemental magic, these ancient and powerful creatures have never been known to interact with the humans of Lore… until now. (This item is color-customizable to base, trim, and accessory.)

name: Water Weaver Swords
description: Weapons crafted by a special sect of weavers. They received some sort of gift from Hyonix to make them. She tore it out of herself, no longer needing such a thing…or deserving it.

name: Waves of Affliction
description: Double the blades, double the trouble. A death blow in each hand will take you from behind the scenes to front and center. No one will put you in a comer with these deadly blades in your hand.

name: Waves of Cobalt
description: Feel the rush of waves with these daggers.

name: Waves of Despair (0 AC)
description: A Dark Caster waded through the Acheron River to find suffering souls. With fell arts, they dragged terrifying memories to the surface, and solidified them into woeful blades.

name: Waves of Despair (AC)
description: A Dark Caster waded through the Acheron River to find suffering souls. With fell arts, they dragged terrifying memories to the surface, and solidified them into woeful blades.

name: Web of Shadows Axe
description: It's not about the size of the axe but rather the size of the enemy that it's about to defeat!

name: Werepyre Devotee's Cutlasses
description: Dangerous silver blades that a Werepyre shouldn't be swinging around willy-nilly. They're twice as weak to this metal, but risk it to terrorize their pureblooded kin. Accidents happen often, but scars give character.

name: Werepyre Devotee's Silver Pistols
description: Prized silver pistols that were pried out of a ShadowSlayer's death-grip. They happen to hunt the same prey the Werepyres do, but the weapon was redesigned to better fit a dual nature.

name: Werepyre Guard's Daggers
description: A new power has arisen in Darkovia - the Cult of the Werepyre. Sometimes humans get sucked into these supernatural cults… to their detriment.

name: Werepyre Guard's Reversed Daggers
description: A new power has arisen in Darkovia - the Cult of the Werepyre. Sometimes humans get sucked into these supernatural cults… to their detriment.

name: Wereslitter Daggers
description: Slice 'em, dice 'em, then reuse as much as you can. THAT's efficient mad science!

name: Westion Commander's Cutlasses (0 AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Westion Commander's Cutlasses (AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Westion Commander's Flintlocks (AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Westion Sailor's Double Delight (0 AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Westion Sailor's Double Delight (AC)
description: Bounty hunting gear fit for hurricanes, ghost ships, and whatever the sea has to throw at you. It's not that much different from bounty hunting in outer space.

name: Whispering Magic Kit
description: Load up your broom for another night of mysticism and magic.

name: Whispers of Autumn
description: The sword was discovered when a druid tugged on the root of an ancient tree. They left as quick as they could, knowing that the tree was a dormant Spirit of Autumn.

name: White Calligraphy Pen & Scroll
description: This scroll seems to contain some foreign text about Yoshino, but you can't make out what it is…

name: Whitehot Rings Of Fire
description: Children of the magical fire never burn or singe. The power is an eternal flame growing even stronger.

name: WhiteTiger's Fans
description: You possess a rare power - the ability to summon and control a White Tiger Shikigami! It will serve you loyaly as long as your intent is honorable and your heart pure.

name: Wicked Edged Slicers
description: Despite the fearsome name, it is wielded to protect a temple deep in a sacred ravine. Upon hearing of another temple that holds great meaning, the Trolls and H'orcs were eager to give this blade as a gift.

name: Willbreaker Blades
description: Blades that made up for the holes in their master's heart with splattered blood and cold cruelty. They almost brought an end to the magic of Lore, and momentarily garnered a glance from the gods.

name: Willbreaker's Implements (AC)
description: These blades are intentionally kept blunt and chipped. It hurts more that way.

name: Willbreaker's Implements (Legend)
description: These blades are intentionally kept blunt and chipped. It hurts more that way.

name: Wind Dagger (1)
description: These strong winds will whip into your opponents with this wind dagger!

name: Wind Dagger (2)
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Wind!

name: WindWalker's Hidden Blades
description: The WindWalkers are a sect of Warrior-Mages that defend and protect the people of Nusantara. They are sworn to serve Garuda the Bird King, and will do anything to keep their home safe.

name: WindWalker's Parang Blades
description: The WindWalkers are a sect of Warrior-Mages that defend and protect the people of Nusantara. They are sworn to serve Garuda the Bird King, and will do anything to keep their home safe.

name: WindWalker's Parang + Sheath
description: The WindWalkers are a sect of Warrior-Mages that defend and protect the people of Nusantara. They are sworn to serve Garuda the Bird King, and will do anything to keep their home safe.

name: Winter Assassin Katana + Ninjato
description: *No description*

name: Winter Assassin Kunai
description: *No description*

name: Winter Assassin Shuriken
description: *No description*

name: Winter Light Crystals
description: Fusions of Ice and Light magic created this twinkling snowflake. Though delicate, they can store an incredible amount of mana.

name: Winter's Dirges
description: Replicas of the dark ages' cold hands. Winter plucked the old and the sick from loving embraces. Even the highest castle and the warmest hearth can't keep out the cold when nature demands death. Men propose. The Gods dispose.

name: Winter's Double Bitter Edge
description: *No description*

name: Winter Sign Axes
description: Monasteries have armories that are only to be opened when the monks need to defend themselves. While some see meaning in war, those who meditate in the cold see little meaning in staining red snow when it'll eventually melt.

name: Winter Spirit Fan Parasol (0 AC)
description: When the snow comes knocking on your windows in the depths of winter, it may herald the appearance of a Yuki-onna. Be very careful when looking outside.

name: Winter Spirit Fan + Parasol (AC)
description: When the snow comes knocking on your windows in the depths of winter, it may herald the appearance of a Yuki-onna. Be very careful when looking outside.

name: WinterWild Dagger
description: Pledge your life and honor to the defense of Coldwind Valley, for this winter and all winters to come.

name: Wiracana Fans
description: It's good at keeping heat, bugs, and unwanted vistors away.

name: Wisteria's Claw
description: You have Wisteria's claw modified so that it is now YOUR claw.

name: Wisterrora's Claw
description: You have Wisterrora's claw modified so that it is now YOUR claw.

name: Witching Armaments
description: Only the foolish are not afraid of witches. The foolish or… heroes like you! With these bewitched armaments taken after defeating clever crones in battle, you'll not need to worry about being bespelled!

name: Wolf's Honor Rapiers (AC)
description: Lycans aren't known for their sophistication, but they uphold heirarchy and trial by first blood. These rapiers came from the past life of a Werewolf who embraced the honor of beasts.

name: Wolf's Honor Rapiers (Legend)
description: Lycans aren't known for their sophistication, but they uphold heirarchy and trial by first blood. These rapiers came from the past life of a Werewolf who embraced the honor of beasts.

name: Wolffang Knives
description: Stick them white the pointy ends!.

name: Wolfhound Fang Daggers
description: It is not only four-legged wolfhounds who have sharp fangs!

name: Wolfwing's Last Paws
description: Lets all give Wolfwing a hand after this.

name: Wolfwing's Last Paws +3
description: Lets all give Wolfwing a hand after this. (DISCLAIMER: NOT intended for back scratching uses!!) (Gives 3% more damage against Chaos AND 3% more Class Points.)

name: Wolfwood Blade
description: From the tree of Brightoak, the magical Wolfwoods grow these blades from magical wolf bark. It is incredibly rare for a Wolfwood to drop his blade when defeated, as they only do so as a sign of respect.

name: Wonderland Hare's Harmonies (0 AC)
description: You're going to be late for a wonderful tea party, and that won't do! Not at all! If people keep insisting on keeping you from respecting promises, you'll have to force the matter!

name: Wonderland Hare's Harmonies (AC)
description: You're going to be late for a wonderful tea party, and that won't do! Not at all! If people keep insisting on keeping you from respecting promises, you'll have to force the matter! (0 AC version permanently drops from Twilly's Treasure Chest.)

name: Wood Dagger
description: Double slice through ChaosWeavers with the power of Wood!

name: Wooden Stake
description: This is used against Vampires and no… you can't eat this kind of stake. Happy Mogloween!

name: World Core's Lights
description: Use the World Core to suck the souls right out of your enemies!

name: World's Core Blades (AC)
description: The origin of all magic, the cores of several worlds fused into one, have been condensed into blades that can end time. This is a theoretical idea meant for a moment when there's nothing left to lose.

name: World's Core Blades (Legend)
description: The origin of all magic, the cores of several worlds fused into one, have been condensed into blades that can end time. This is a theoretical idea meant for a moment when there's nothing left to lose.

name: Worldbreaker's Armblades
description: Kin to Kezeroth the World Ender, Thorezek the World-Breaker knows that where his cousin and Quetzal failed… HE will succeed. When he is through, nothing and no one will be left standing.

name: Worldbreaker's Blade + Shield
description: Kin to Kezeroth the World Ender, Thorezek the World-Breaker knows that where his cousin and Quetzal failed… HE will succeed. When he is through, nothing and no one will be left standing.

name: Wraith of Darkness Dual Blades
description: From the darkness you came, and to the darkness you shall return. For the Longest Night approaches, and the undead roam the streets of Mystcroft.

name: Wraith Reapers
description: Reap what you sow with Wraith Reapers! Click to Activate and make your blades even more ferocious.

name: Wraith's Cursed Daggers
description: Those that hide their food from the Primal Wraith face it's fury. The gagger transfers the guilty party's soul into itself and leaves the body as a hollow shell of itself.

name: Wrath of the Divine
description: The purest Paladins are awarded this wicked weapon to wield in the name of their patron. With it, they can mete out justice and protect the innocent! The Wrath of the Divine is truly in your hands now, Hero!

name: Wreath of Wrath
description: Beautifully crafted for battle or for your front door! Happy Frostval!

name: Wretched Blades of Evil
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Wretched Blades of the Underworld
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Wretched Blades of the Void
description: When the darkest, most evil forces on Lore battle for dominion over the Underworld, their legacy is power, death, and destruction! Only the strongest will survive.

name: Wyvern's Edges
description: Green as venom, sharp as vengeance. Favored by those who never miss their mark.

name: Xing and Xang Plushies Dagger
description: Dawww! Made from the Birthday Cake's Hero Plushie and Chaorrupted Button Eyes… Who ever thought the 2nd Lords of Chaos would be THIS CUTE as a plushie?!

name: XL Autumn Fox Plushies
description: The nights are getting colder, and the leaves are getting crispier. That makes snuggling with these soft buddies all the more comfier.

name: XL Ducky Isopod Plushies
description: They can quack and…make whatever noises ispods do.

name: XL Ermine Plushies (0 AC)
description: You have to wrap this guy around your neck. That is the only right way to play with this plushie.

name: XL Ermine Plushies (AC)
description: You have to wrap this guy around your neck. That is the only right way to play with this plushie.

name: XL Gallant Gecko Plushies
description: They're no Dragon, but their gallant heart is as big as one!

name: XL Kawaii Gecko Plushies
description: They're no Dragon, but their gallant heart is as big as one!

name: XL Red Fox Plushies
description: Also known as Vulpes Vulpes. That's right, "Fox Fox".

name: Yami no Akuma Arms
description: Driven by the dark, these warriors seek to extinguish all the good in the world.

name: Yami no Ronin Dual Blades
description: While others /partied, you studied the blade. While others were training their reputation, you mastered the art of unsheathing and striking. While others wasted their days being AFK in Yulgar, you cultivated inner strength. Now that the world is set aflame and the fiends are at the gates, only you have the power to cut through shadow as if it were steel.

name: Yami no Ronin Shurikens
description: While others /partied, you studied the blade. While others were training their reputation, you mastered the art of unsheathing and striking. While others wasted their days being AFK in Yulgar, you cultivated inner strength. Now that the world is set aflame and the fiends are at the gates, only you have the power to cut through shadow as if it were steel.

name: Yellow Coward Armaments
description: The sword and shield of the fearful will protect you. If you're brave enough to use them!

name: Yellow Gummi Were-bear and Lolly
description: Show your enemies what too much candy can really do with these sweet daggers.

name: Yeti Soul Destroyer Claws (0 AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Destroyers work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yeti Soul Destroyer Claws (AC)
description: Allied to one of the more peaceful tribes of Northlands Krampus, the YetiKun Destroyers work with them to guard their friends and family from the bloodthirsty yeti that roam the land.

name: Yokai Oni's Cutlasses (AC)
description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

description: Sworn enemy of Teja, Pirate Queen of the Southern Seas, it is rumored that the Yokai Naval Commander summoned an ancient Oni Guardian to ensure his nautical success.

name: Your Dreams Are Collapsing
description: Are you Evil enough to wield both of these blades?

name: Zardian Pilot Miniguns
description: A compact weapon that's easy to hide, and won't get jammed by copius amounts of sand. Perfect for covert ops in sandy environments, or sleeping underneath it. Zardians prefer that to tents.

name: Zardian Pilot Olfactory Tools
description: These are sensitive tools given to the Zardian's human compatriots to make up for their abysmal senses. Most will admit not knowing how to properly use them, and restoring to swinging them around like a bat instead.

name: Zay_M8's Caladbolg
description: Congratulations, Zay_M8! You've won a custom weapon for upgrading in February 2017. This weapon will change into your custom pink Caladbolg on Friday, March 17th.

name: Zealith Busters
description: Crafted from the rarest ores in the Styx River and intact with the souls of late Nation soldiers, this gun is only given by Zealith to Legion Ministers who are very skilled in assassination and marksmanship.

name: Zealith Reavers
description: The infamous symbol of the Undead Legion forged by Dage the Evil himself. Only those who have fully committed themselves to the Legion may bask in the Zealith's almighty power.

name: Zelkur's Daggers
description: Little is known about Zelkur, Lich of the Dream Palace… except that the ShadowHunter desires the Mystic Sapphire he possesses. Rumor has it that the gem contains the essence of his power.

name: Zenobia's BerryStain Blades
description: You roam the Black Labryinth, harvesting the bodies of fallen creatures for any loot you can find. These blades, made of petrified moglinberry juice, won't earn you much gold. But they WILL come in handy during battle.

name: Zenobia's BerryStain Daggers
description: You roam the Black Labryinth, harvesting the bodies of fallen creatures for any loot you can find. This blade, made of petrified moglinberry juice, won't earn you much gold. But it WILL come in handy during battle.

name: Zephyric Blades
description: Known as Chakram, the Zephyric Blades were designed to be thrown, but are just as effective in melee combat. Because of their aerodynamic design, these blades are not easily deflected by wind.

name: Zhongchéng's Dual Katanas
description: Those born in the Year of the Dog are considered good natured, loyal and ready to help others!

name: Zhu Ronin Cleaver + Kanabo
description: A ronin is a samurai with no master but these follow the ancient ways of the Zhu.

name: Zombie Cleavers
description: Once used for dicing up carrots… now used for dismembering zombies!

name: Zombie Voodoo Dagger
description: It was a shame to let all of those Carnaval zombies go to waste, so we made some weapons out of 'em!

name: Zorbak's VordredSlayers
description: MEHEHE! He wants more skulls? I'LL GIVE HIM SKULLS. TO THE FACE.

name: Zorbak's Voyager BattleGear (0 AC)
description: In space, no one can hear you MEHEHEHE!

name: Zorbak's Voyager BattleGear (AC)
description: In space, no one can hear you MEHEHEHE!

name: Zurvana's Pity (Dagger)
description: The gears of time have been set in motion. What will the future bring for you? (This item was originally released in DragonFable and has been imported to AQWorlds to celebrate Artix Entertainment's 20th anniversary!)

description: The gears of time have been set in motion. What will the future bring for you? (This item was originally released in DragonFable and has been imported to AQWorlds to celebrate Artix Entertainment's 20th anniversary!)
